CREATE TRIGGER ' + @trigname + CHAR( 10 ) +
'ON ' + @tabname + CHAR( 10 ) +
'FOR ' + @verb + CHAR( 10 ) +
'NOT FOR REPLICATION ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'AS ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'  DECLARE @sqlidentity INTEGER ' + CHAR( 10 )
          
          /* Specific code per table. */
          IF @tabname IN ( 'R5HOME', 'R5ENTITYSAFETY', 'R5TASKS', 'R5PSCATEGORIES', 'R5OBJECTS', 'R5TASKTRADES', 'R5COMPANIES', 'R5DEVICES', 'R5DOCUMENTS', 'R5FUNCTIONS', 'R5OBJDEPTYPES', 'R5OBJECTCAPACITIES',
                           'R5OBJECTLOTO', 'R5OBJLINEARREF', 'R5OBJTESTPOINTS', 'R5REQUISITIONS', 'R5SERVICECATALOGUE', 'R5TASKCHECKLISTS', 'R5TASKTOOLS', 'R5WORKSAFETY', 'R5TRANSACTIONS' )
            SET @statement = @statement +
'  DECLARE @func NVARCHAR( 6 ) ' + CHAR( 10 )

          IF ( @tabname IN ( 'R5FUNCTIONS', 'R5OBJECTS' ) AND @action = 'SYNC' ) OR @tabname = 'R5OBJLINEARREF'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'  DECLARE @tab NVARCHAR( 3 ) ' + CHAR( 10 )


          SET @statement = @statement +
'  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'    BEGIN ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'      SET NOCOUNT ON ' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'      DECLARE c_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR ' + CHAR( 10 )

          /* More specific code per table. */
          IF @tabname = 'R5HOME'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE hom_type WHEN ''C'' THEN ''BSCHRT'' WHEN ''+'' THEN ''BSKPIC'' ELSE ''BSINBX'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5ENTITYSAFETY'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE esf_rentity WHEN ''STWO'' THEN ''WSSTWO'' WHEN ''PPM'' THEN ''WSPPMS'' WHEN ''PART'' THEN ''SSPART'' ELSE ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = SUBSTRING( esf_code, 1, CHARINDEX( ''#'', esf_code ) - 1 ) AND obj_org = SUBSTRING( esf_code, CHARINDEX( ''#'', esf_code ) + 1, 100 ) ) END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )          
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJDEPTYPES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN ''I'' THEN ''OSECON'' ELSE ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype END FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = obd_object AND obj_org = obd_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJTESTPOINTS'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN ''I'' THEN ''OSECON'' ELSE ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype END FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = otp_object AND obj_org = otp_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJECTCAPACITIES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = ocp_object AND obj_org = ocp_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJECTLOTO'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = olo_object AND obj_org = olo_object_org ) FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
         ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5OBJLINEARREF'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, ( SELECT ''OSOBJ'' + obj_obrtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = lrf_objcode AND obj_org = lrf_objorg ), CASE lrf_linear_reftype WHEN ''O'' THEN ''LRF'' WHEN ''R'' THEN ''RUT'' ELSE ''SGM'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5TASKS'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE tsk_jobplan WHEN ''+'' THEN ''WSJBPL'' ELSE ''WSTASK'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5COMPANIES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE com_customer WHEN ''+'' THEN ''SSSUPC'' ELSE ''SSSUPP'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5DEVICES'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE dev_rtype WHEN ''PRNT'' THEN ''BSDEVS'' ELSE ''BSMDEV'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5DOCUMENTS'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT ' + @abb + '_sqlidentity, CASE doc_warranty WHEN ''-'' THEN ''BSDOCU'' ELSE ''OSWARR'' END FROM ' + @tablename + CHAR( 10 )
          ELSE IF @tabname = 'R5FUNCTIONS' AND @action = 'SYNC'
            SET @statement = @statement +
'        SELECT i.fun_sqlidentity,' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'               CASE WHEN (    COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltertype, ''x'' )          <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltertype, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfilterclass, ''x'' )         <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfilterclass, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfilterwoobjtype, ''x'' )     <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfilterwoobjtype, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfilterchecklist, ''x'' )     <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfilterchecklist, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltercfclass, ''x'' )       <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltercfclass, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltercfclass_org, ''x'' )   <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltercfclass_org, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_fieldfiltercforg, ''x'' )         <> COALESCE( d.fun_fieldfiltercforg, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                           OR COALESCE( i.fun_reservationcalendar, ''x'' )      <> COALESCE( d.fun_reservationcalendar, ''x'' ) ) THEN ''BSFFSP''' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                    ELSE CASE WHEN (    COALESCE( i.fun_schedulerview, ''x'' )            <> COALESCE( d.fun_schedulerview, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_blockduration, ''x'' )            <> COALESCE( d.fun_blockduration, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingstarttimehours, ''x'' )    <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingstarttimehours, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingstarttimeminutes, ''x'' )  <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingstarttimeminutes, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingendtimehours, ''x'' )      <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingendtimehours, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) + 
'                                     OR COALESCE( i.fun_workingendtimeminutes, ''x'' )    <> COALESCE( d.fun_workingendtimeminutes, ''x'' )' + CHAR( 10 ) +  
'


-- ========================================

create trigger ' + @sTriggerName + @sCRLF +
                             N'on ' + @sTable + @sCRLF +
                             N'for ' + @sTriggerType + @sCRLF +
                             N'as begin' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(4)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @nReturn int' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sOldColVal nvarchar(250)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sNewColVal nvarchar(250)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sPKVal nvarchar(80)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sSKVal nvarchar(180)' + @sCRLF +
                             @sColDeclareList + @sCRLF


  set @sTriggerHeadCursor =  N'  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    begin' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      SET NOCOUNT ON' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      declare c_audit cursor local for ' + @sColSelectList + @sCRLF

  set @sTriggerHeadFetch =   N'      open c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      fetch next from c_audit into ' + @sColFetchList + @sCRLF +
                             N'      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0' + @sCRLF +
                             N'        begin' + @sCRLF


  /*Build trigger footer*/
  set @sTriggerFoot =        N'          fetch next from c_audit into ' + @sColFetchList + @sCRLF +
                             N'        end' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      close c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      deallocate c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    end' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    return' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    ERR_1:' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    close c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    deallocate c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    execute O7RAE N''' + @sTriggerName + ''', N''TRIG'', N''999'', @@ERROR' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    rollback transaction' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    return' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    ERR_2:' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    close c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    deallocate c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    execute O7RAE N''O7AUDIT'', N''PROC'', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    rollback transaction' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    return' + @sCRLF +
                             N'end' + @sCRLF


  /*Build trigger drop statement*/
  set @sTriggerDrop =        N'if exists (select NAME from SYSOBJECTS' + @sCRLF +
		                         N'where NAME = ''' + @sTriggerName + ''' and TYPE = ''TR'')' + @sCRLF +
	                           N'drop trigger ' + @sTriggerName + @sCRLF


END

CREATE TRIGGER '+ @sTriggerName + N' ON ' + @sTableName + N' FOR UPDATE AS ' + @sCRLF
             + N'BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'DECLARE @sTMPStoreVal1   NVARCHAR(24) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(255) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@sErrCheck       NVARCHAR(10) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(240) ' + @sCRLF
             + N'       ,@nReturn         INT ' + @sCRLF
             + N'' + @sCRLF
             + N'DECLARE ScrollTMP CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ' + @sIdColName + N'  FROM inserted' + @sCRLF
             + N'' + @sCRLF
             + N'SELECT @sErrCheck = N''0'', @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN() ' + @sCRLF
             + N'IF @sTenant IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(INT, @sTenant) != ' + @sTenant1 + @sCRLF
             + N'   RETURN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'' + @sCRLF
             + N'OPEN ScrollTMP ' + @sCRLF
             + N'WHILE 1=1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      FETCH ScrollTMP INTO @sTMPStoreVal1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
   IF @sTableName IN (N'R5ORDERLINES', N'R5ACCOUNTDETAIL', N'R5REQUISITIONS', N'R5REQUISLINES', N'R5TRANSACTIONS', N'R5TRANSLINES', N'R5ORDERS', N'R5BOOKEDHOURS', N'R5EVENTS', N'R5OBJECTS', N'R5PARTS', N'R5PROPERTYVALUES')
      SET @sSQL = @sSQL
             + N'      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSUPD_' + @sColumn + N'1 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @sErrCheck != N''0'' ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
             + @sUpdate
             + N'      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXUSR_POSUPD_' + @sColumn + N'2 @sTMPStoreVal1, @sErrCheck OUTPUT, @sErrMsg OUTPUT ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
             + N'      IF @sErrCheck != N''0'' ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         RAISERROR(@sErrMsg, 16, 1)' + @sCRLF
             + N'         SET @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         BREAK ' + @sCRLF
             + N'         END ' + @sCRLF
   ELSE
      SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @sUpdate

   SET @sSQL = @sSQL
             + N'      END ' + @sCRLF
             + N'CLOSE ScrollTMP ' + @sCRLF
             + N'DEALLOCATE ScrollTMP ' + @sCRLF
             + N'IF @nReturn = -1 ' + @sCRLF
             + N'   BEGIN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'   ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ' + @sCRLF
             + N'   RETURN ' + @sCRLF
             + N'   END ' + @sCRLF
             + N'END ' + @sCRLF
   END
IF @sSQL IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE (@sSQL)
   IF @@ERROR != 0
      RETURN -1

   set @sSQL2 = 'sp_settriggerorder @triggername = ''' + @sTriggerName + N''', @order = ''last'', @stmttype = ''UPDATE'''
   EXECUTE (@sSQL2)    
   IF @@ERROR != 0
      RETURN -1

   END

END

create procedure ADRV @sTenant nvarchar(50)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @sErrmsg			nvarchar(240)	--r5interfaceerrors.ine_error%TYPE
	declare @nStat				int
	declare @nTimeout			int
	declare @nStop				int
	declare @sResult			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(10)
	declare @nJobid				int
	declare @sTenantstatement	nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sTenantpassword	nvarchar(20)
	declare @nTenantid			int

	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @bIsLocked			bit
	declare @dTemp				datetime

	declare @nIntRowid			int
	declare @nIntTransid		bigint
	declare @sIntAction			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sIntKeyfld1		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sIntKeyfld2		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sIntKeyfld3		nvarchar(80)
	declare @nIntTransorgid		bigint
	declare @nIntGroup			int
	declare @sIntStatus			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sIntTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sNdeforg			nvarchar(200)
    declare @sProducts          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sAspjobs           nvarchar(200)



	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sProducts OUTPUT, N'PRODUCTS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAspjobs OUTPUT, N'ASPJOBS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    set @sProducts = upper(@sProducts)
    set @sAspjobs = coalesce(upper(@sAspjobs), N'OFF')

	IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
	begin
		--the body of the first if statement is dead code.  The net result 
		--would always be setting the id to null
		if @sTenant is not null
			set @nTenantid = null
	
		execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_SET_MODULE N'ADRV', N'Starting'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	
		--lock exclusive function portion
		set @bIsLocked = 1
		if not exists ( select 'x' from r5install where ins_code = N'~ADRV~' )
			begin
				INSERT INTO r5install (ins_code,ins_desc,ins_comment,ins_fixed)
				   VALUES ( N'~ADRV~',
							N'RUNNING ' + cast(dbo.o7gttime2(null) as nvarchar),
							N'Object Audit Control Row',
							N'-' )
				if @@ERROR <> 0
					set @bIsLocked = 0
				else
					commit
			end
	
		if @bIsLocked = 1
			begin
				--get_timeout procedure portion
				select @nTimeout = cast( ins_desc as int )
				from r5install
				where ins_code = N'~SLEEP~'
				
				if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
					set @nTimeout = 300
	
				set @nStop = 0
				execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_SET_MODULE N'ADRV', N'Processing'
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
	
				--process_rows procedure portion
				set @nStop = 0
				declare c_int cursor local for   SELECT int_sqlidentity,
														int_transid,
														int_action,
														int_keyfld1,
														int_keyfld2,
														int_keyfld3,
														int_transorgid,
														int_group,
														int_status,
														int_table
												   FROM r5interface
												  WHERE int_table = N'R5OBJECTAUDITS' 
												  ORDER BY int_transid
				open c_int
				fetch next from c_int into @nIntRowid, @nIntTransid, @sIntAction, @sIntKeyfld1, 
											@sIntKeyfld2, @sIntKeyfld3, @nIntTransorgid, @nIntGroup, 
											@sIntStatus, @sIntTable
				while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					begin
						
						IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
						begin
							select @nStop = count(*)
							FROM r5install
							WHERE ins_code = N'~SADRV~'
		
							if @nStop <> 0
								break
						end
						--delete_errors
						DELETE
						FROM r5interfaceerrors
						WHERE ine_transid = @nIntTransid
	
						commit
	
						set @sChk = N'0'
						set @sErrmsg = null
						if @nIntTransorgid is not null
							begin
								
								SELECT @sChk = isnull(cast(int_transid as nvarchar), N'0')
								FROM r5interface
								WHERE int_transorgid = @nIntTransorgid
								AND int_group      < @nIntGroup
								
								if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
									set @sChk = N'0'
	
								if @sChk <> N'0'
									begin
										set @sErrmsg = N'Transaction on HOLD, waiting for completion of - ' + @sChk
										INSERT INTO r5interfaceerrors ( ine_transid,
																		 ine_error,
																		 ine_create )
										   VALUES (@nIntTransid, @sErrmsg, dbo.o7gttime2(null))
	
										--raise procerr portion
										UPDATE r5interface
										  SET int_status = N'+',
											  int_retries = isnull(int_retries, 0) + 1,
											  int_process = dbo.o7gttime2(null)
										WHERE int_sqlidentity = @nIntRowid
	
										GOTO PostExceptionIf
									end
							end
	
						if @sIntTable = N'R5OBJECTAUDITS' and @sIntKeyfld2 = N'S'
							begin
								execute @nReturn = O7ADTINT @nIntTransid, @sIntKeyfld1, @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_int
										deallocate c_int
										return -1
									end
							end
	
						if @sIntTable = N'R5OBJECTAUDITS' and @sIntKeyfld2 = N'X'
							begin
								execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ADTDEL @nIntTransid, @sIntKeyfld1, @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_int
										deallocate c_int
										return -1
									end
							end
	
						--if there_are_errors
						if exists ( select 'x' from r5interfaceerrors where ine_transid = @nIntTransid )
							begin
								rollback transaction
								--raise procerr portion
								UPDATE r5interface
								  SET int_status = N'+',
									  int_retries = isnull(int_retries, 0) + 1,
									  int_process = dbo.o7gttime2(null)
								WHERE int_sqlidentity = @nIntRowid
	
								GOTO PostExceptionIf
							end
	
						DELETE
						  FROM r5interface 
						 WHERE int_sqlidentity = @nIntRowid
						   AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT NULL
											  FROM r5interfaceerrors
											  WHERE ine_transid = int_transid)
	
						PostExceptionIf:
						if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
							commit
	
						fetch next from c_int into @nIntRowid, @nIntTransid, @sIntAction, @sIntKeyfld1, 
													@sIntKeyfld2, @sIntKeyfld3, @nIntTransorgid, @nIntGroup, 
													@sIntStatus, @sIntTable
					end
				close c_int
				deallocate c_int
	
				if @nStop <> 0
					begin
						--unlock_exclusive procedure portion
						DELETE
						FROM r5install
						WHERE ins_code LIKE '%ADRV%'
	
						COMMIT
					end
				else
					begin
						set @dTemp = DATEADD( ss, @nTimeout, GetDate() )
						execute @nReturn = DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT @nJobid OUTPUT, N'ADRV(null)', @dTemp
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
						commit
					end
				execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_SET_MODULE N'ADRV', N'Waiting'
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end
	end
	else
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'ADRV', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_SET_MODULE N'ADRV', N'Exiting'
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	else
	begin
		--process_rows procedure portion
		set @nStop = 0
		declare c_int cursor local for   SELECT int_sqlidentity,
												int_transid,
												int_action,
												int_keyfld1,
												int_keyfld2,
												int_keyfld3,
												int_transorgid,
												int_group,
												int_status,
												int_table
										   FROM r5interface
										  WHERE int_table = N'R5OBJECTAUDITS' 
										  ORDER BY int_transid
		open c_int
		fetch next from c_int into @nIntRowid, @nIntTransid, @sIntAction, @sIntKeyfld1, 
									@sIntKeyfld2, @sIntKeyfld3, @nIntTransorgid, @nIntGroup, 
									@sIntStatus, @sIntTable
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
				begin
					select @nStop = count(*)
					FROM r5install
					WHERE ins_code = N'~SADRV~'

					if @nStop <> 0
						break
				end
				--delete_errors
				DELETE
				FROM r5interfaceerrors
				WHERE ine_transid = @nIntTransid

				commit

				set @sChk = N'0'
				set @sEr

CREATE PROCEDURE AUDITSQL_CREATE_TRIGGER   @sTriggerType nvarchar(10), @sTable nvarchar(30), @sChk nvarchar(10) OUTPUT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nReturn int
	declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(10)
  declare @sPrimaryKey nvarchar(100)
  declare @sSecondaryKey nvarchar(1000)  /*can have multiple keys concatenated together*/
  declare @nCode numeric(18,0)
  declare @sColumn nvarchar(30)
  declare @sUpdate nvarchar(1)
  declare @sInsert nvarchar(1)
  declare @sDelete nvarchar(1)
  declare @sDataType nvarchar(30)
  declare @sNewValue nvarchar(1000)
  declare @sOldValue nvarchar(1000)
  declare @sTriggerBody nvarchar(max)
  declare @sTriggerHeadDeclare nvarchar(max)
  declare @sTriggerHeadCursor nvarchar(max)
  declare @sTriggerHeadFetch nvarchar(max)
  declare @sTriggerFoot nvarchar(max)
  declare @sTriggerDrop nvarchar(400)
  declare @sTriggerName nvarchar(40)
  declare @sCRLF nvarchar(4)
  declare @i int


  set @sChk = N'0'
  set @sTriggerBody = N''
  set @sTriggerHeadDeclare = N''
  set @sTriggerHeadCursor = N''
  set @sTriggerHeadFetch = N''
  set @sTriggerFoot = N''
  set @sTriggerDrop = N''
  set @sCRLF = nchar(13) + nchar(10)
  set @i = 1  /*used for spreading trigger body across multiple variables*/

  /*set trigger name based on type*/
  if @sTriggerType = N'INSERT' set @sTriggerName = N'IAU_' + @sTable
  if @sTriggerType = N'UPDATE' set @sTriggerName = N'UAU_' + @sTable
  if @sTriggerType = N'DELETE' set @sTriggerName = N'DAU_' + @sTable


  /*Fetch key data from r5auditpk for the given table and trigger type*/
	execute @nReturn = AUDITSQL_GET_KEYS @sTriggerType, @sTable, @sPrimaryKey OUTPUT, @sSecondaryKey OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
      set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			/*suppress error-reporting and rollback to behave like Oracle does in AuditSetupTriggerOperation.java*/
      set @sChk = N'1' + @sCheckresult
			return
		end


  /*Next, go through each row in r5audvalues (populated from Admin | Security | Audit Trail in the frontend) for the given table
    and create a call to o7audit for each one.  Each row of this table represents a column to audit.*/
  declare c_auditattrib cursor local for
  select a.aat_code, a.aat_column, a.aat_update, a.aat_insert, a.aat_delete FROM r5audattribs a where a.aat_table = @sTable
	open c_auditattrib
	fetch next from c_auditattrib into @nCode, @sColumn, @sUpdate, @sInsert, @sDelete

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 begin

    /*Execute the following code only if trigger type matches a '+' in the appropriate attrib column: insert, update, delete*/
    if (@sTriggerType = N'UPDATE' and @sUpdate = N'+') or (@sTriggerType = N'INSERT' and @sInsert = N'+') or (@sTriggerType = N'DELETE' and @sDelete = N'+') begin

      /*get datatype for this column to see if it must be cast*/
    	execute @nReturn = AUDITSQL_GET_DATATYPE @sTable, @sColumn, @sDataType OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
    	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    		begin
          set @sChk = N'2'
        	close c_auditattrib
          deallocate c_auditattrib
    			return
    		end

    	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
    		begin
    			/*suppress error-reporting and rollback to behave like Oracle does in AuditSetupTriggerOperation.java*/
       	  close c_auditattrib
          deallocate c_auditattrib
          set @sChk = N'2' + @sCheckresult
    			return
    		end

        /*If datatype is not nvarchar, cast it*/
        /*substring is used here to ensure data fits in variables since o7audit can only receive strings of a limited size*/
        if @sDataType = N'DATE' OR @sDataType = N'DATETIME' begin
          set @sOldValue = N'set @sOldColVal = substring(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @vOLD_' + @sColumn + N', 120), 1, 16)' + @sCRLF
          set @sNewValue = N'set @sNewColVal = substring(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @vNEW_' + @sColumn + N', 120), 1, 16)' + @sCRLF
        end else if @sDataType <> N'NVARCHAR' begin
          set @sOldValue = N'set @sOldColVal = substring(cast(@vOLD_' + @sColumn + N' as nvarchar), 1, 250)' + @sCRLF
          set @sNewValue = N'set @sNewColVal = substring(cast(@vNEW_' + @sColumn + N' as nvarchar), 1, 250)' + @sCRLF
        end else begin
          set @sOldValue = N'set @sOldColVal = substring(@vOLD_' + @sColumn + N', 1, 250)' + @sCRLF
          set @sNewValue = N'set @sNewColVal = substring(@vNEW_' + @sColumn + N', 1, 250)' + @sCRLF
        end

        /*Adjust values set above according to trigger type since delete triggers do not have NEW values and insert triggers do not have OLD values*/
        if @sTriggerType = N'INSERT' set @sOldValue = N'set @sOldColVal = null' + @sCRLF
        if @sTriggerType = N'DELETE' set @sNewValue = N'set @sNewColVal = null' + @sCRLF


        /*Build call to o7audit for this column*/
        set @sTriggerBody = @sTriggerBody + @sCRLF +
                            N'/*Audit ' + @sColumn + N'*/' + @sCRLF +
                            @sOldValue + @sNewValue +
                            @sPrimaryKey + @sSecondaryKey +
                            N'set @sCheckresult = N''0''' + @sCRLF +
                            N'execute @nReturn = o7audit ' + cast(@nCode as nvarchar) + ', ' +
                            N'N''' + @sTriggerType + N''', ' +
                            N'N''' + @sTable + N''', ' +
                            N'@sOldColVal, @sNewColVal, ' +
                            N'@sPKVal, @sSKVal, ' +
                            N'@sCheckresult OUTPUT ' + @sCRLF +
                            N'if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 goto ERR_1' + @sCRLF +
                					  N'if @sCheckresult <> N''0'' goto ERR_2' + @sCRLF +
                            N'/*End ' + @sColumn + N'*/' + @sCRLF

    end
		fetch next from c_auditattrib into @nCode, @sColumn, @sUpdate, @sInsert, @sDelete
	end

  /*close and deallocate cursor*/
	close c_auditattrib
  deallocate c_auditattrib


  /*Now create trigger header and footer if we have a body*/
  if @sTriggerBody <> N'' begin
  	execute @nReturn = AUDITSQL_GET_TRIGGER_HEADFOOT @sTable, @sTriggerName, @sTriggerType, @sTriggerHeadDeclare OUTPUT, @sTriggerHeadCursor OUTPUT, @sTriggerHeadFetch OUTPUT, @sTriggerFoot OUTPUT, @sTriggerDrop OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
  	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
  		begin
        set @sChk = N'4'
  			return
  		end

  	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
  		begin
  			/*suppress error-reporting and rollback to behave like Oracle does in AuditSetupTriggerOperation.java*/
        set @sChk = N'4' + @sCheckresult
  			return
  		end


    /*Drop any old audit trail triggers on the table*/
    begin try
      exec sp_executesql @sTriggerDrop
    end try
    begin catch
    end catch

    /*Finally, build (execute) the trigger from its header, body, and footer*/
    exec (@sTriggerHeadDeclare + @sTriggerHeadCursor + @sTriggerHeadFetch + @sTriggerBody + @sTriggerFoot)
  end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE AUDITSQL_GET_DATATYPE  @sTable nvarchar(30), @sColumn nvarchar(30), @sDataType nvarchar(30) OUTPUT, @sChk nvarchar(10) OUTPUT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

  set @sChk = N'0'
  set @sDataType = 'NVARCHAR'  /*data type only matters for casting, so assume type is string and no casting is necessary*/

  /*Using sql server system tables, fetch the datatype of the given table column*/
  select @sDataType = upper(c.name) from syscolumns a, sysobjects b, systypes c
  where a.id = b.id and b.xtype='U' and b.name=@sTable and a.name=@sColumn
  and a.xtype = c.xtype and a.xusertype = c.xusertype

END

CREATE PROCEDURE AUDITSQL_GET_FIELDLISTS  @sTable nvarchar(30), @sTriggerType nvarchar(10), @sDeclareList nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sSelectList nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sFetchList nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sChk nvarchar(10) OUTPUT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @sCRLF nvarchar(4)
  declare @sCol nvarchar(100)
  declare @sType nvarchar(100)
  declare @nPrec smallint
  declare @nScale int
  declare @sDeclareOldList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sDeclareNewList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sSelectOldList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sSelectNewList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sFetchOldList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sFetchNewList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sIdentColName nvarchar(50)
  declare @sPrec nvarchar(100)
  declare @sScale nvarchar(100)
  declare @sTypeDeclare nvarchar(250)

  set @sCRLF = nchar(13) + nchar(10)
  set @sDeclareOldList = N''
  set @sDeclareNewList = N''
  set @sSelectOldList = N''
  set @sSelectNewList = N''
  set @sFetchOldList = N''
  set @sFetchNewList = N''


  /*Need to find the name of the sqlidentity column to use for update triggers when joining inserted and deleted tables.*/
  /*Since every table will contain an identity column, find this table's by comparing column name to '%SQLIDENTITY'*/
  select @sIdentColName = a.name from syscolumns a, sysobjects b where a.id = b.id and b.name = @sTable and a.name like '%SQLIDENTITY'


  /*delcare cursor to select only those columns that are either a key value or a field being audited*/
  declare c_fields cursor local for select upper(a.name), upper(c.name), a.prec, a.scale from syscolumns a, sysobjects b, systypes c
                                    where a.id = b.id and b.xtype='U' and b.name=@sTable
                                    and a.xtype = c.xtype and a.xusertype = c.xusertype
                                    and upper(a.name) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN in (
                                    (select upper(apk_column) from r5auditpk where apk_table = @sTable)
                                    union
                                    (select upper(aat_column) from r5audattribs where aat_table=@sTable))

	open c_fields
	fetch next from c_fields into @sCol, @sType, @nPrec, @nScale


	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 begin


    /*Build datatype for column declaration*/
    IF @nPrec < 0 AND (@sType = 'NVARCHAR' OR @sType = 'VARCHAR' OR @sType = 'NCHAR')
      BEGIN
        set @sPrec = 'max'
      END
    ELSE
      BEGIN
        set @sPrec = cast(@nPrec as nvarchar)
      END
    set @sScale = cast(@nScale as nvarchar)
    set @sTypeDeclare = @sType + case @sType when N'NVARCHAR' then N'(' + @sPrec + N')'
											 when N'VARCHAR' then N'(' + @sPrec + N')'
                                             when N'NUMERIC' then N'(' + @sPrec + N',' + @sScale + N')'
                                             when N'NCHAR' then N'(' + @sPrec + N')'
                                             else N'' end

    set @sDeclareNewList = @sDeclareNewList + N'  declare @vNEW_' + @sCol + N' ' + @sTypeDeclare + @sCRLF
    set @sDeclareOldList = @sDeclareOldList + N'  declare @vOLD_' + @sCol + N' ' + @sTypeDeclare + @sCRLF
    set @sSelectNewList = @sSelectNewList + N',i.' + @sCol
    set @sSelectOldList = @sSelectOldList + N',d.' + @sCol
    set @sFetchNewList = @sFetchNewList + N',@vNEW_' + @sCol
    set @sFetchOldList = @sFetchOldList + N',@vOLD_' + @sCol

    fetch next from c_fields into @sCol, @sType, @nPrec, @nScale
  end

  close c_fields
  deallocate c_fields


  /*remove leading commas from select and fetch lists*/
  if len(@sSelectNewList) > 0 set @sSelectNewList = right(@sSelectNewList, len(@sSelectNewList) - 1)
  if len(@sSelectOldList) > 0 set @sSelectOldList = right(@sSelectOldList, len(@sSelectOldList) - 1)
  if len(@sFetchNewList) > 0 set @sFetchNewList = right(@sFetchNewList, len(@sFetchNewList) - 1)
  if len(@sFetchOldList) > 0 set @sFetchOldList = right(@sFetchOldList, len(@sFetchOldList) - 1)


  /*build final lists based on trigger type*/
  if @sTriggerType = N'INSERT' begin
    set @sDeclareList = @sDeclareNewList
    set @sSelectList = N'select ' + @sSelectNewList + N' from inserted i' + @sCRLF
    set @sFetchList = @sFetchNewList
  end
  if @sTriggerType = N'DELETE' begin
    set @sDeclareList = @sDeclareOldList
    set @sSelectList = N'select ' + @sSelectOldList + N' from deleted d' + @sCRLF
    set @sFetchList = @sFetchOldList
  end
  if @sTriggerType = N'UPDATE' begin
    set @sDeclareList = @sDeclareNewList + @sDeclareOldList
    set @sSelectList = N'select ' + @sSelectNewList + N',' + @sSelectOldList + N' from inserted i, deleted d where i.' + @sIdentColName + ' = d.' + @sIdentColName + @sCRLF
    set @sFetchList = @sFetchNewList + N',' + @sFetchOldList + @sCRLF
  end


END

CREATE PROCEDURE AUDITSQL_GET_KEYS  @sTriggerType nvarchar(30), @sTable nvarchar(30), @sPrimaryKey nvarchar(100) OUTPUT, @sSecondaryKey nvarchar(1000) OUTPUT, @sChk nvarchar(10) OUTPUT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @sColumnName nvarchar(30)  /*R5AUDITPK.APK_COLUMN%Type*/
  declare @nPosition int  /*R5AUDITPK.APK_SEQNO%Type*/
  declare @sDataType nvarchar(30)  /*R5AUDITPK.APK_DATATYPE%Type*/
  declare @sOldNew nvarchar(10)
  declare @sPK nvarchar(100)
  declare @sSK nvarchar(1000)
  declare @sSK2 nvarchar(100)  /*additional secondary key*/
  declare @sCRLF nvarchar(4)

  set @sChk = N'0'
  set @sPK = null
  set @sSK = null
  set @sCRLF = nchar(13) + nchar(10)

  /*select columnm, position, and data type from r5auditpk table to build keys*/
  declare c_auditpk cursor local for
    SELECT upper(apk_column) column_name, apk_seqno position, upper(apk_datatype) datatype
    FROM r5auditpk
    WHERE apk_table = @sTable
    ORDER BY apk_seqno


  /*Build primary and secondary key strings based on datatype and trigger type*/
  if @sTriggerType = N'INSERT' or @sTriggerType = N'UPDATE' begin
    set @sOldNew = N'@vNEW_'
  end else begin
    set @sOldNew = N'@vOLD_'
  end

	open c_auditpk
	fetch next from c_auditpk into @sColumnName, @nPosition, @sDataType

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 begin

    /*if position is 1, this is a primary key so build key string based on data type*/
    if @nPosition = 1 begin
      set @sPK = @sOldNew + @sColumnName
      if @sDataType = N'DATE' OR @sDataType = N'DATETIME' begin
        set @sPK = N'dbo.f_sqlformat_date(' + @sPK + ', N''O'')'
      end else begin
        if @sDataType <> N'VARCHAR2' begin
          set @sPK = N'cast(' + @sPK + ' as nvarchar(80))'
        end
      end
    end

    /*if position is 2, this is the first secondary key so build key string based on data type*/
    if @nPosition = 2 begin
      set @sSK = @sOldNew + @sColumnName
      if @sDataType = N'DATE' OR @sDataType = N'DATETIME' begin
        set @sSK = N'dbo.f_sqlformat_date(' + @sSK + ', N''O'')'
      end else begin
        if @sDataType <> N'VARCHAR2' begin
          set @sSK = N'cast(' + @sSK + ' as nvarchar)'
        end
      end
      set @sSK = N'ISNULL(' + @sSK + N', '''')'
    end

    /*if position is > 2, this is another secondary key so concat with previous secondary key string based on data type*/
    if @nPosition > 2 begin
      set @sSK2 = @sOldNew + @sColumnName
      if @sDataType = N'DATE' OR @sDataType = N'DATETIME' begin
        set @sSK2 = N'dbo.f_sqlformat_date(' + @sSK2 + ', N''O'')'
      end else begin
        if @sDataType <> N'VARCHAR2' begin
          set @sSK2 = N'cast(' + @sSK2 + ' as nvarchar)'
        end
      end
      set @sSK = @sSK + N' + '' '' + ISNULL(' + @sSK2 + N', '''')'
    end


		fetch next from c_auditpk into @sColumnName, @nPosition, @sDataType
	end


  /*close and deallocate cursor*/
	close c_auditpk
  deallocate c_auditpk

  /*add set notation and pass back the primary and secondary keys*/
  /*substring is used here to ensure data fits in variables since o7audit can only receive strings of a limited size*/
  if @sPK is null
    set @sPrimaryKey = N'set @sPKVal = null' + @sCRLF
  else
    set @sPrimaryKey = N'set @sPKVal = substring(' + @sPK + N', 1, 80)' + @sCRLF

  if @sSK is null
    set @sSecondaryKey = N'set @sSKVal = null' + @sCRLF
  else
    set @sSecondaryKey = N'set @sSKVal = substring(' + @sSK + N', 1, 180)' + @sCRLF

CREATE PROCEDURE AUDITSQL_GET_TRIGGER_HEADFOOT  @sTable nvarchar(30), @sTriggerName nvarchar(40), @sTriggerType nvarchar(10), @sTriggerHeadDeclare nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sTriggerHeadCursor nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sTriggerHeadFetch nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sTriggerFoot nvarchar(max) OUTPUT, @sTriggerDrop nvarchar(400) OUTPUT, @sChk nvarchar(10) OUTPUT
AS BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @sCRLF nvarchar(4)
  declare @sColDeclareList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sColSelectList nvarchar(max)
  declare @sColFetchList nvarchar(max)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(10)

  /*set defaults*/
  set @sColDeclareList = N''
  set @sColSelectList = N''
  set @sColFetchList = N''
  set @sCRLF = nchar(13) + nchar(10)


  /*First get delcare list, select list, and fetch list for table by building from system tables according to trigger type*/
  	execute @nReturn = AUDITSQL_GET_FIELDLISTS @sTable, @sTriggerType, @sColDeclareList OUTPUT, @sColSelectList OUTPUT, @sColFetchList OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
  	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
  		begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
  			return
  		end

  	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
  		begin
  			/*suppress error-reporting and rollback to behave like Oracle does in AuditSetupTriggerOperation.java*/
        set @sChk = N'1' + @sCheckresult
  			return
  		end


  /*Build trigger header*/
  /*Note that many separate variables are used in case every field in a table is audited*/
  set @sTriggerHeadDeclare = N'create trigger ' + @sTriggerName + @sCRLF +
                             N'on ' + @sTable + @sCRLF +
                             N'for ' + @sTriggerType + @sCRLF +
                             N'as begin' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sCheckresult nvarchar(4)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @nReturn int' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sOldColVal nvarchar(250)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sNewColVal nvarchar(250)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sPKVal nvarchar(80)' + @sCRLF +
                             N'  declare @sSKVal nvarchar(180)' + @sCRLF +
                             @sColDeclareList + @sCRLF


  set @sTriggerHeadCursor =  N'  if @@ROWCOUNT > 0' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    begin' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      SET NOCOUNT ON' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      declare c_audit cursor local for ' + @sColSelectList + @sCRLF

  set @sTriggerHeadFetch =   N'      open c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      fetch next from c_audit into ' + @sColFetchList + @sCRLF +
                             N'      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0' + @sCRLF +
                             N'        begin' + @sCRLF


  /*Build trigger footer*/
  set @sTriggerFoot =        N'          fetch next from c_audit into ' + @sColFetchList + @sCRLF +
                             N'        end' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      close c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'      deallocate c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    end' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    return' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    ERR_1:' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    close c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    deallocate c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    execute O7RAE N''' + @sTriggerName + ''', N''TRIG'', N''999'', @@ERROR' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    rollback transaction' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    return' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    ERR_2:' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    close c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    deallocate c_audit' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    execute O7RAE N''O7AUDIT'', N''PROC'', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    rollback transaction' + @sCRLF +
                             N'    return' + @sCRLF +
                             N'end' + @sCRLF


  /*Build trigger drop statement*/
  set @sTriggerDrop =        N'if exists (select NAME from SYSOBJECTS' + @sCRLF +
		                         N'where NAME = ''' + @sTriggerName + ''' and TYPE = ''TR'')' + @sCRLF +
	                           N'drop trigger ' + @sTriggerName + @sCRLF


END

CREATE FUNCTION BAIMERROR_GETERRORMESSAGE(@nErrorCode integer) returns nvarchar(255)
as 
begin
	declare @sRetVal		nvarchar(255)
	declare @nError			integer
	declare @nRowcount		integer
	
	select @sRetVal = ERT_TEXT
	from    R5ERRTEXTS e,
			R5INSTALL i
	where   e.ERT_CODE = cast(@nErrorCode as nvarchar(38))
	and     i.INS_CODE = N'DEFLANG'
	and     e.ERT_LANG = i.INS_DESC

	SELECT @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT

	If @nRowcount = 0  
		set @sRetVal = N'Error Message does not exist for this error code ' + cast(@nError as nvarchar(38))	
	
	If @nRowcount > 1   
		set @sRetVal = N'ErrorMessage retrieve error: ' + cast(@nError as nvarchar(38))	

	set @sRetVal = substring(@sRetVal,1,240)

	return @sRetVal
end

create procedure BAIMERROR_SAVELOCALMESSAGE	@nTransid	bigint
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @nExists				int
	declare @sErrorDate				nvarchar(64)
	declare @dErrorDate				datetime
	declare @sErrorMessage			nvarchar(240)
	declare @sDate					nvarchar(64)
	declare @sKeyValues				nvarchar(240)
	declare @sPositionCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sErrorCode				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sInterfaceProcessName	nvarchar(50)
	declare @sAPPSOrgID				nvarchar(30)
	declare @dDate					datetime
	declare @nErrorCode				integer

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'ErrorDate', @sDate OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dErrorDate = cast(@sDate as datetime)

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'ErrorMessage', @sErrorMessage OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'KeyValues', @sKeyValues OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'PositionCode', @sPositionCode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'ErrorCode', @sErrorCode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	select 1
	from R5INTERFACEERRORS
	where INE_TRANSID = @nTransid and
	INE_ERRORCODE = @sErrorCode and
	coalesce(INE_RECORDLOCATORINFO, N'-XX') = coalesce(substring(@sKeyValues,1, 240), N'-XX') and
	coalesce(INE_POSITIONCODE, N'-XX') = coalesce(@sPositionCode, N'-XX')

	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
		update R5INTERFACEERRORS
		set INE_CREATE = @dErrorDate, INE_ERROR = substring(@sErrorMessage, 1, 240)
		where INE_TRANSID = @nTransid and
		INE_ERRORCODE = @sErrorCode and
		coalesce(INE_RECORDLOCATORINFO, N'-XX') = coalesce(substring(@sKeyValues,1, 240), N'-XX') and
		coalesce(INE_POSITIONCODE, N'-XX') = coalesce(@sPositionCode, N'-XX')
	ELSE
		begin

			set @nErrorCode = cast(@sErrorCode as integer)
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'InterfaceProcessName', @sInterfaceProcessName OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'APPSOrgID', @sAPPSOrgID OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			insert into R5INTERFACEERRORS (
				INE_TRANSID,
				INE_CREATE,
				INE_ERROR,
				INE_INTERFACE,
				INE_POSITIONCODE,
				INE_ERRORCODE,
				INE_TRANSORGID,
				INE_RECORDLOCATORINFO)
			values(
				@nTransid,
				@dErrorDate,
				substring(@sErrorMessage, 1, 240),
				@sInterfaceProcessName,
				@sPositionCode,
				@nErrorCode,
				@sAPPSOrgID,
				substring(@sKeyValues,1, 240))
		end

name: CALC_ILON_CONSUMPTION
body:
create procedure CALC_ILON_CONSUMPTION
	@dpLatestDate          datetime,        -- latest date to calculate, default to SYSDATE-1
	@npDatesToCalculate    integer,         -- 1 to 14, default to 1
	@npCutoffHour          integer,         -- 0 to 23, default 0
	@npIntervalInMinutes   numeric(24, 6),  -- 0+ or more, default to 5
	@npMinPercent          numeric(24, 6)   -- 0+ to 100, default to 95
as
	set nocount on

	declare @dLatestDate          datetime
	declare @nDatesToCalculate    integer
	declare @nCutoffHour          integer
	declare @nIntervalInMinutes   numeric(24, 6)
	declare @nMinPercent          numeric(24, 6)

	declare @nMinReadingCount     integer
	declare @dDateLowEnd          datetime
	declare @dDateLowEndPrevious  datetime
	declare @dDateTruncated       datetime
	declare @dDateHighNear        datetime

	declare @sEquipmentCode       nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEquipmentOrg        nvarchar(15)
	declare @nThreshold           numeric(24, 6)
	declare @sCommodity           nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCommodityUOM        nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDesignUsageUOM      nvarchar(30)  -- DA, DAY, HR, HUR, HOUR
	-- UOMs other than these values will be regarded as irrelevant, and the usage will be calculated by hour
	declare @nUsageUOMDivisor     numeric(24, 6)

	declare @nExistsNear          integer
	declare @nExistsNearPrevious  integer
	declare @nReadingCount        integer
	declare @nReading             numeric(24, 6)  -- end of date
	declare @nReadingFirst        numeric(24, 6)  -- meter replace
	declare @nReadingMax          numeric(24, 6)  -- meter replace
	declare @nReadingPrevious     numeric(24, 6)  -- end of prevous date
	declare @nActualConsumption   numeric(24, 6)
	declare @nActualUsage         numeric(24, 6)
	declare	@sCharValue           nvarchar(80)
	declare @nSlashPosition       integer
	declare @nExists              integer

	declare @sCNum                nvarchar(2)
	declare @sUNum                nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCounter             integer
	declare @sIndex               nvarchar(2)
	declare @sFieldName           nvarchar(13)
	declare @sSql                 nvarchar(400)

	-- fix bad parameters
	set @dLatestDate = ISNULL(@dpLatestDate, GETDATE()-1)
	set @nDatesToCalculate = ISNULL(@npDatesToCalculate, 1)
	set @nCutoffHour = ISNULL(@npCutoffHour, 0)
	set @nIntervalInMinutes = ISNULL(@npIntervalInMinutes, 0)
	set @nMinPercent = ISNULL(@npMinPercent, 95)

	if @nDatesToCalculate < 1
		set @nDatesToCalculate = 1

	if @nDatesToCalculate > 14
		set @nDatesToCalculate = 14

	if @nCutoffHour < 0 or @nCutoffHour > 23
		set @nCutoffHour = 0

	if @nIntervalInMinutes <= 0
		set @nIntervalInMinutes = 5

	if @nMinPercent <= 0 or @nMinPercent > 100
		set @nMinPercent = 95

	set @dDateLowEnd = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dLatestDate, 'DD') + (@nCutoffHour/24.0)

	-- find consumption column and commodity UOM
	set @nCounter = 1
	while @nCounter <= 33
	begin
		if @nCounter < 10
			set @sIndex = '0' + CAST(@nCounter as nvarchar(1))
		else
			set @sIndex = CAST(@nCounter as nvarchar(2))

		set @sFieldName = 'ADO_UDFCHAR' + @sIndex

		set @sSql = 'select @sValue = ' + @sFieldName + ' from R5ALERTDATAOBJ where ADO_UDFCHAR34 = ''ILON'' and '
			+ @sFieldName + ' like ''%/%_%/C'' and ADO_UDFDATE01 >= @dDatetime-@nDays+1 and ADO_UDFDATE01 < @dDatetime+1'

		execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@sValue nvarchar(80) output, @dDatetime datetime, @nDays integer', @sCharValue output, @dDateLowEnd, @nDatesToCalculate
		if @@ERROR <> 0 return -10

		if @sCharValue is not null
		begin
			set @sCNum = @sIndex
			set @nSlashPosition = CHARINDEX('/', @sCharValue)
			set @sCommodityUOM = SUBSTRING(@sCharValue, @nSlashPosition+1, LEN(@sCharValue)-1-@nSlashPosition-1)
			break
		end

		set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
	end

	if @sCommodityUOM is null
		return -20                -- cannot find commodity UOM

	-- find usage column
	select @nCounter = 1, @nExists = 0
	while @nCounter <= 33
	begin
		if @nCounter < 10
			set @sIndex = '0' + CAST(@nCounter as nvarchar(1))
		else
			set @sIndex = CAST(@nCounter as nvarchar(2))

		set @sFieldName = 'ADO_UDFCHAR' + @sIndex

		set @sSql = 'select @nCount = 1 where exists (select 1 from R5ALERTDATAOBJ where ADO_UDFCHAR34 = ''ILON'' and '
			+ @sFieldName + ' like ''%/%/U'' and ADO_UDFDATE01 >= @dDatetime-@nDays+1 and ADO_UDFDATE01 < @dDatetime+1)'

		execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nCount int output, @dDatetime datetime, @nDays integer', @nExists output, @dDateLowEnd, @nDatesToCalculate
		if @@ERROR <> 0 return -30

		if @nExists = 1
		begin
			set @sUNum = @sIndex
			break
		end

		set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
	end

	set @nMinReadingCount = 24*60*@nMinPercent/(100.0*@nIntervalInMinutes)

	-- date loop
	set @nCounter = 1
	while @nCounter <= @nDatesToCalculate
	begin
		set @dDateLowEnd = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dLatestDate, 'DD') - (@nCounter - 1) + (@nCutoffHour/24.0)
		set @dDateLowEndPrevious = @dDateLowEnd - 1
		set @dDateHighNear = @dDateLowEnd + (@nMinPercent/100.0)
		set @dDateTruncated = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDateLowEnd, 'DD')

		declare c_int cursor local for
			select distinct ADO_OBJ, ADO_ORG
			from R5ALERTDATAOBJ join R5OBJECTS on ADO_OBJ = OBJ_CODE and ADO_ORG = OBJ_ORG
			where ADO_UDFCHAR34 = 'ILON' and ADO_UDFDATE01 >= @dDateLowEnd and ADO_UDFDATE01 < @dDateLowEnd+1

		open c_int
		fetch next from c_int into @sEquipmentCode, @sEquipmentOrg

		-- main equipment loop
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			declare c2_int cursor local for
				select ODC_COMMODITY, ODC_DESIGNUSAGEUOM
				from R5OBJDESIGNCONSUMPTION join R5COMMODITIES on ODC_COMMODITY = CMD_CODE
				where ODC_OBJECT = @sEquipmentCode and ODC_OBJECT_ORG = @sEquipmentOrg and CMD_UOM = @sCommodityUOM
				and @dDateTruncated between ODC_FROMDATE and ODC_TODATE
				order by ODC_COMMODITY

			open c2_int
			fetch next from c2_int into @sCommodity, @sDesignUsageUOM

			if @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				close c2_int
				deallocate c2_int

				if @sDesignUsageUOM = 'DA' or @sDesignUsageUOM = 'DAY'
					set @nUsageUOMDivisor = 1.0
				else if @sDesignUsageUOM = 'HR' or @sDesignUsageUOM = 'HUR' or @sDesignUsageUOM = 'HOUR'
					set @nUsageUOMDivisor = 24.0
				else
					set @nUsageUOMDivisor = 24.0

				if @sUNum is not null
				begin
					set @sSql = 'select @nCount = COUNT(*) from R5ALERTDATAOBJ '
						+ 'where ADO_OBJ = @sCode and ADO_ORG = @sOrg '
						+ 'and ADO_UDFCHAR34 = ''ILON'' and ADO_UDFDATE01 >= @dDatetime and ADO_UDFDATE01 < @dDatetime+1 '
						+ 'and ADO_UDFNUM' + @sUNum + ' is not null'

					execute sp_executesql @sSql,
						N'@nCount int output, @dDatetime datetime, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15)',
						@nReadingCount output, @dDateLowEnd, @sEquipmentCode, @sEquipmentOrg

					if @@ERROR <> 0
					begin
						close c_int
						deallocate c_int
						return -40
					end
				end

				set @sSql = 'select @nCount = 1 '
					+ 'where exists (select 1 from R5ALERTDATAOBJ '
					+ 'where ADO_UDFCHAR34 = ''ILON'' and ADO_OBJ = @sCode and ADO_ORG = @sOrg '
					+ 'and ADO_UDFDATE01 >= @HighNear and ADO_UDFDATE01 < @dDatetime + 1 and ADO_UDFNUM' + @sCNum + ' is not null)'

				execute sp_executesql @sSql,
					N'@nCount int output, @HighNear datetime, @dDatetime datetime, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15)',
					@nExistsNear output, @dDateHighNear, @dDateLowEnd, @sEquipmentCode, @sEquipmentOrg

				if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					close c_int
					deallocate c_int
					return -50
				end

				if @nExistsNear is null
					set @nExistsNear = 0

				set @sSql = 'select @nCount = 1 '
					+ 'where exists (select 1 from R5ALERTDATAOBJ '

CREATE PROCEDURE DATABASE_ERROR_HANDLER
                 @nTranId       NUMERIC(18, 0)
                ,@nSQLErrorCode INT
                ,@sErrorSource  NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorFunc    NVARCHAR(40)
AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	/* Do not go any further if no error encountered */
	IF @nSQLErrorCode = 0
	   RETURN

	DECLARE @sErrorCheck	NVARCHAR(30)
		   ,@sErrorType		NVARCHAR(40)
		   ,@sErrorMessage	NVARCHAR(240)
		   ,@nReturn		int

	/* Decode error code and set other variables required for dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR */
	SELECT @sErrorCheck = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nSQLErrorCode)
		  ,@sErrorType = 'ORACLE'
		  ,@sErrorMessage = description
	  FROM master.dbo.sysmessages
	 WHERE error = @nSQLErrorCode

	EXECUTE @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nTranId, @sErrorCheck, @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, @sErrorFunc, NULL, NULL, @sErrorMessage
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

CREATE PROCEDURE DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT	@nJob		int				OUTPUT,
									@sWhat		nvarchar(2000),
									@dNextdate	datetime = null,
									@sInterval	nvarchar(2000) = null,
									@nNoparse	bit = null
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sJobName		nvarchar(128)
	declare @nDeleteLevel	int
	declare @sDbName		nvarchar(128)
	declare @nDatePart		int
	declare @nTimePart		int

	/*
		- @nNoparse will be ignored
		- if @dNextdate is null then run this job now
		- if @sInterval is null then run this job once only
	
		- The special parameter values for job definitions (job, next_date, broken)
			are not going to be supported here.  If they are needed, something else 
			will have to take the place of this "conversion" or a redesign of that
			section of the app may be needed.

		- As of 03-05-03 @sInterval and @nNoparse are not used by EWS or any 
			schema object.  Therefore this will be coded without their functionalities
			at this time.  This may have to change in the future.
	*/

	--Get Job Number
	execute @nReturn = P_GETNEXTID 'DBMS_JOB', @nJob OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		return -1

	set @sJobName = 'DBMS_JOB#' + cast( @nJob as nvarchar(64))

	--determine delete level
	if @sInterval is null or Upper(@sInterval) = N'NULL'
		set @nDeleteLevel = 3  --run once only
	else
		begin
			set @nDeleteLevel = 0  --run according to schedule
			--Error for now because this functionality has not been added.
			RAISERROR( 'DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT - Unexpected parameter value in interval parameter.', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end
		
	
	execute @nReturn = msdb.dbo.sp_add_job	@job_name		= @sJobName, 
											@delete_level	= @nDeleteLevel
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			RAISERROR( 'DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT - Unexpected error calling sp_add_job', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end

	set @sDbName = DB_NAME()

	execute @nReturn = msdb.dbo.sp_add_jobstep	@job_name		= @sJobName,
												@step_name		= @sJobName,
												@subsystem		= 'TSQL',
												@step_id		= 1,
												@command		= @sWhat,
												@database_name	= @sDbName,
												@retry_attempts	= 16,
												@retry_interval	= 1
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			RAISERROR( 'DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT - Unexpected error calling sp_add_jobstep', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end

	set @dNextdate = isnull( @dNextdate, DateAdd( mi, 1, GetDate() ) )
	set @nDatePart = DATEPART( yyyy, @dNextdate ) * 10000 + 
						DATEPART( mm, @dNextdate ) * 100 +
						DATEPART( dd, @dNextdate )

	set @nTimePart = DATEPART( hh, @dNextdate ) * 10000 + 
						DATEPART( mi, @dNextdate ) * 100 +
						DATEPART( ss, @dNextdate )


	execute @nReturn = msdb.dbo.sp_add_jobschedule	@job_name			= @sJobName,
													@name				= @sJobName,
													@freq_type			= 1, 
													@active_start_date	= @nDatePart,
													@active_start_time	= @nTimePart

	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			RAISERROR( 'DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT - Unexpected error calling sp_add_jobschedule', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = msdb.dbo.sp_add_jobserver	@job_name		= @sJobName,
													@server_name	= N'(local)'
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			RAISERROR( 'DBMS_JOB_SUBMIT - Unexpected error calling sp_add_jobserver', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end

create function DSDATE(@sDate   nvarchar(128), @sFormat nvarchar(128))
returns datetime
as
begin
    Declare @dReturnDate    datetime
    Declare @nConvert       integer

    Declare @sDayValue  nvarchar(4)
    Declare @sMonthValue    nvarchar(4)
    Declare @sYearValue nvarchar(4)
    Declare @sHour      nvarchar(4)
    Declare @sMinute        nvarchar(4)
    Declare @sSecond        nvarchar(4)


    set @sFormat = UPPER(@sFormat)
    set @nConvert = 0
    set @dReturnDate = null

    IF ISDATE(@sDate) = 0
        return null

    If @sFormat = 'MON DD YYYY HH:MIAM' or @sFormat = 'MON DD YYYY HH:MIPM'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 100  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'MM/DD/YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 101  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'YY.MM.DD'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 102  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'DD/MM/YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 103  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end


    If @sFormat = 'DD.MM.YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 104  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'DD-MM-YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 105  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'DD MON YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 106  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'MON DD, YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 107  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'HH:MM:SS'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 108  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'MON DD YYYY HH:MI:SS:MMMAM' or @sFormat = 'MON DD YYYY HH:MI:SS:MMMPM'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 109  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'MM-DD-YY'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 110  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'YY/MM/DD'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 111  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'YYMMDD'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 112  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end


    If @sFormat = 'DD MON YYYY HH:MM:SS:MMM(24H)'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 113  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'HH:MI:SS:MMM(24H)'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 114  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS(24H)'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 120  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end

    If @sFormat = 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MMM(24H)'
        begin
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 121 )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end


    --special Oracle Formats used by DSTM
    If @sFormat = 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS'
        begin 
            SELECT @sDayValue = cast( DATEPART(dd, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
            SELECT @sMonthValue = cast( DATEPART(mm, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
            SELECT @sYearValue = cast( DATEPART(yyyy, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
            SELECT @sHour = cast( DATEPART(hh, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
            SELECT @sMinute = cast( DATEPART(mi, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
            SELECT @sSecond = cast( DATEPART(ss, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))

            --create the following format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS(24H)'
            SET @sDate  = @sYearValue + '-' + @sMonthValue + '-' +  @sDayValue + ' ' + @sHour + ':' + @sMinute + ':' + @sSecond
            SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sDate, 120  )
            set @nConvert = 1
        end
    

    If @nConvert = 0 
        return null

    return( @dReturnDate )  
end

create procedure DSTM_ORATRACE_OUTPUTLOG @sLogLine nvarchar(3000)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nLoop				integer
	declare @sString			nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nFileHandle		integer
	declare @nProcessDepth		integer
	declare @nReturn			integer

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_ProcDepth', @nProcessDepth OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nProcessDepth = 2 * @nProcessDepth
	set @sString = convert(nvarchar, getdate() ,108)  
	set @nLoop = 1
	While @nLoop < @nProcessDepth
	begin
		set @nLoop = @nLoop + 1
		set @sString = @sString +  ' '
	end

	set @sString = @sString + @sLogLine
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_FileHandle', @nFileHandle OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	execute @nReturn = UTL_FILE_PUT_LINE @nFileHandle, @sString
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

create procedure DSTM_ORATRACE_STARTTRACE @sTraceName nvarchar(255)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nError				integer
	declare @nReturn 			integer
	declare @sTraceEnableFlag	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sTraceLogErrorFlag	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sError				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sTraceText			nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sInsCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sObjType			nvarchar(20)
	declare	@sSessionEnableFlag	nvarchar(12)
	declare @sInternalRaise		nvarchar(128)
	declare @sNoR5install		nvarchar(128)
	declare @sTraceFileDir		nvarchar(512)
	declare @sTraceFileName		nvarchar(256)
	declare @sFileHandle		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sFileOpenFail		nvarchar(128)
	declare @sOutput			nvarchar(2000)

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceLogErrorFlag', N'False'
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceLogErrorMessage', null
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceEnabledFlag', N'False'
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_ProcDepth', N'0'
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	--set the necessary local variable equivalents
	set @sTraceEnableFlag = N'False'
	set @sTraceLogErrorFlag = N'False'
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_Session_Enable_Flag', @sSessionEnableFlag OUTPUT
	-- g_TraceEnabledFlag is already set to false.  
	-- No need to do it again if there is an error so error handling is skipped here.

	IF UPPER(@sSessionEnableFlag) = N'SET' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceEnabledFlag', N'True'
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
			--set local equivalent
			set @sTraceEnableFlag = N'True'
		end
	else
		begin
			-- if we are here then g_TraceEnabledFlag is already set to false.  Skip setting it again
			IF UPPER(@sSessionEnableFlag) != N'OFF'
				begin
					select @sTraceText = INS_DESC 
					from R5INSTALL
					where INS_CODE = N'$BTRACE'
					
					-- g_TraceEnabledFlag is already set to false.  
					-- No need to do it again if rowcount doesn't equal 1.
					If @@ROWCOUNT = 1 and ((upper(@sTraceText) = N'YES') or (upper(@sTraceText) = N'Y'))
						begin
							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceEnabledFlag', N'True'
							set @nError = @@ERROR
							if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
							--set local equivalent
							set @sTraceEnableFlag = N'True'
						end
				end
		end

	IF UPPER(@sTraceEnableFlag) = N'True' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileDir', null
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

			--set local equivalent
			set @sTraceFileDir = null

			-- determine where the package is installed
			select @sObjType = OBJECT_TYPE 
			from USER_OBJECTS
			where OBJECT_NAME= N'R5INSTALL'
			and OBJECT_TYPE in (N'TABLE',N'SYNONYM')
			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'e_internal_raise', @sInternalRaise OUTPUT
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

					execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'e_no_r5install', @sNoR5install OUTPUT
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

					set @sInternalRaise = @sInternalRaise + ': ' + @sNoR5install
					RAISERROR(@sInternalRaise, 16, 1 )
					return -1
				end

			IF @sObjType = N'TABLE' 
				set @sInsCode = N'$LTRCDIR'
			ELSE
				set @sInsCode = N'$RTRCDIR'

			-- get the directory name
			select @sTraceFileDir = INS_DESC 
			from R5INSTALL
			where INS_CODE = @sInsCode
			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
				set @sTraceFileDir = NULL
			
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileDir', @sTraceFileDir
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

			IF @sTraceFileDir  is NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceLogErrorFlag', N'True'
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
					--set local equivalent
					set @sTraceLogErrorFlag = N'True'
					
					execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'e_no_dir', @sError OUTPUT
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceLogErrorMessage', @sError
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
				end

			ELSE
				begin
					set @sTraceFileName = @sTraceName + replace(convert(nvarchar(40), GetDate(), 12) + convert(nvarchar(40), GetDate(), 14),':','') + '.baim'
					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileName ', @sTraceFileName
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
				end

			IF upper(@sTraceLogErrorFlag) = 'FALSE'  -- parameters are set.  Time to open file
				begin
					execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'e_file_open_fail', @sFileOpenFail OUTPUT
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
					
					execute @nReturn = UTL_FILE_FOPEN @sFileHandle OUTPUT, @sTraceFileDir, @sTraceFileName, 'w'
					SELECT @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceLogErrorFlag', N'True'
							set @nError = @@ERROR
							if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

							set @sError = @sFileOpenFail + N' ' + cast(@nError as nvarchar(38))
							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceLogErrorMessage', @sError
							set @nError = @@ERROR
							if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

							execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceEnabledFlag', N'False'
							set @nError = @@ERROR
							if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

							return

					SELECT @nError = @@ERROR

create trigger FOK2DEL_RIS_OBR
on R5RISK
for delete
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sCode		nvarchar(8)
	declare @nRev		int
	declare @nCount		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_deleted cursor local for select RIS_CODE, RIS_REVISION from deleted
			open c_deleted 
			fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRev
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sCode is not null and @nRev is not null
						begin
							select @nCount = count(*)
							  from R5OBJECTRISK	 
							 where OBR_RISK = @sCode	AND
									OBR_RISKREV = @nRev

							if @nCount > 0
								begin
									close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									RAISERROR( 'Simulated constraint violation deleting from R5RISK.  Child record exists.  Simulated constraint is R5FOK2_OBR.', 16, 1)
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
					
					fetch next from c_deleted into @sCode, @nRev
				end
			close c_deleted
			deallocate c_deleted
		end

									RAISERROR( 'Simulated constraint violation updating R5RISK.  Child record exists.  Simulated constraint is R5FOK2_OBR.', 16, 1)

CREATE FUNCTION F_ASSIGNREPAIRDETAILSINFO_OBJ_HIER (@cobject    NVARCHAR(30),@cobjectorg    NVARCHAR(15))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (stc_child       NVARCHAR(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        stc_child_org   NVARCHAR(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @nLevel             INTEGER
    DECLARE @currentchild       NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @currentchildorg    NVARCHAR(15)

    DECLARE @tStack TABLE ( stc_child       NVARCHAR(30), 
                            stc_child_org   NVARCHAR(15),
                            LevelID         INTEGER )

    SET @nLevel = 1

    INSERT INTO @tStack
        SELECT  stc_child,
                stc_child_org,
                @nLevel
        FROM    r5structures
        WHERE   stc_parent     = @cobject
        AND stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg
        AND stc_rolldown = '+'

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    IF @nLevel >= 1
                        BEGIN
                            SELECT  @currentchild       = stc_child,
                                    @currentchildorg    = stc_child_org
                            FROM    @tStack
                            WHERE   LevelID = @nLevel
                            INSERT INTO @tReturn
                                    VALUES ( @currentchild, @currentchildorg)
                        END

                    DELETE FROM @tStack
                    WHERE   LevelID = @nLevel
                    AND stc_child       = @currentchild
                    AND stc_child_org   = @currentchildorg

                    INSERT INTO @tStack
                    SELECT  stc_child,
                            stc_child_org,
                            @nLevel + 1
                    FROM    r5structures
                    WHERE   stc_parent      = @currentchild
                    AND     stc_parent_org  = @currentchildorg
                    AND     stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg
                    AND     stc_rolldown = '+'

                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE 
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        END
    RETURN 
END

CREATE function F_COPYTOCHILDLIST ( @sParent	nvarchar(30),
				    @sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_child	nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
			stc_child_org	nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin

	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentChild	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg	nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sSDMPresent    nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @sSDMPath       nvarchar(1)  
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child nvarchar(30), stc_child_org nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select stc_child, stc_child_org, 1 from r5structures s
			        	where s.stc_parent = @sParent
						and s.stc_parent_org = @sOrg
						and exists (select 1 from r5objects 
							where obj_code = stc_child and obj_org = stc_child_org
							and obj_sdmpath = N'+')

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel )
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentChild = stc_child, @sCurrentOrg = stc_child_org from @tStack where levelID = @nLevel
					select @sSDMPath = obj_sdmpath, @sSDMPresent = obj_sdmpresent from r5objects
				    			where obj_code = @sCurrentChild and obj_org = @sCurrentOrg and obj_sdmpath = N'+'					    
					IF (@sSDMPresent = N'-' and @sSDMPath = N'+')
						BEGIN
							delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCurrentChild and stc_child_org = @sCurrentOrg
							insert into @tStack select stc_child, stc_child_org, @nLevel + 1 
								from r5structures
								where stc_parent = @sCurrentChild
								and   stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
								and exists (select 1 from r5objects 
										where obj_code = stc_child and obj_org = stc_child_org
										and obj_sdmpath = N'+')

							IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
								SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
						END
					IF (@sSDMPresent = N'+' and @sSDMPath = N'+')
						BEGIN	
							insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentChild, @sCurrentOrg )
							delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCurrentChild and stc_child_org = @sCurrentOrg
						END
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	return
end

create function F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@sDate datetime, @sFormat nvarchar(128))
returns nvarchar(128)
as
BEGIN
	Declare @sReturnValue			nvarchar(128)
	Declare @sYearWithCentury		nvarchar(4)
	Declare	@sYearWithoutCentury	nvarchar(4)
	Declare @sDay					nvarchar(2)
	Declare @sMonth					nvarchar(2)
	Declare	@sMonthName				nvarchar(3)
	Declare @sHour					nvarchar(4)
	Declare @sMinute				nvarchar(4)
	Declare @sSecond				nvarchar(4)

	set @sFormat = UPPER(@sFormat)
	set @sReturnValue = null

	IF ISDATE(@sDate) = 0
		set @sReturnValue = null
	ELSE IF @sFormat IS NULL
		set @sReturnValue = CAST(@sDate as nvarchar)
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sYearWithCentury = cast( DATEPART(yyyy, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
			SELECT @sYearWithoutCentury = SUBSTRING(cast( DATEPART(yy, @sDate) as nvarchar(4)),3,2)
			SELECT @sMonth = cast( DATEPART(mm, @sDate) as nvarchar(2))
			SELECT @sMonthName = UPPER(cast( DATENAME(month, @sDate) as nvarchar(3)))
			SELECT @sDay = cast( DATEPART(dd, @sDate) as nvarchar(2))
			SELECT @sHour = cast( DATEPART(hh, @sDate) as nvarchar(2))
			SELECT @sMinute = cast( DATEPART(mi, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))
			SELECT @sSecond = cast( DATEPART(ss, @sDate) as nvarchar(4))

			set @sMonth = Right('0' + @sMonth , 2)
			set @sDay = Right('0' + @sDay , 2)
			set @sHour = Right('0' + @sHour , 2)
			set @sMinute = Right('0' + @sMinute , 2)
			set @sSecond = Right('0' + @sSecond , 2)

			set @sReturnValue = @sFormat
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'YYYY',@sYearWithCentury)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'YY',@sYearWithoutCentury)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'RRRR',@sYearWithCentury)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'RR',@sYearWithoutCentury)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'MM',@sMonth)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'MON',@sMonthName)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'DD',@sDay)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'HH24',@sHour)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'HH',@sHour)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'MI',@sMinute)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'SS',@sSecond)
			SELECT @sReturnValue = REPLACE(@sReturnValue,'(24H)','')
		END
	return( @sReturnValue )
END

				BEGIN

							@sCurrentOrg = loc_org
						from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

					insert into @tStack select loc_code, loc_org, @nLevel + 1

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0

CREATE function F_GETSDMINHERITEDEQUIPMENT( @schild	nvarchar(30),
				    	    @sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_parent	nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
			stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin

	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentparent	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg	nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sSDMPresent    nvarchar(1)
	DECLARE @sSDMPath       nvarchar(1)  
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_parent nvarchar(30), stc_parent_org nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select stc_parent, stc_parent_org, 1 from r5structures s
			        	where s.stc_child = @schild
						and s.stc_child_org = @sOrg
						and exists (select 1 from r5objects 
							where obj_code = stc_parent and obj_org = stc_parent_org
							and obj_sdmpath = N'+')

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel )
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentparent = stc_parent, @sCurrentOrg = stc_parent_org from @tStack where levelID = @nLevel
					select @sSDMPath = obj_sdmpath, @sSDMPresent = obj_sdmpresent from r5objects
				    			where obj_code = @sCurrentparent and obj_org = @sCurrentOrg and obj_sdmpath = N'+'					    
					IF (@sSDMPresent = N'-' and @sSDMPath = N'+')
						BEGIN
							delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCurrentparent and stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
							insert into @tStack select stc_parent, stc_parent_org, @nLevel + 1 
								from r5structures
								where stc_child = @sCurrentparent
								and   stc_child_org = @sCurrentOrg
								and exists (select 1 from r5objects 
										where obj_code = stc_parent and obj_org = stc_parent_org
										and obj_sdmpath = N'+')

							IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
								SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
						END
					IF (@sSDMPresent = N'+' and @sSDMPath = N'+')
						BEGIN	
							insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentparent, @sCurrentOrg )
							delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCurrentparent and stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
						END
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	return
end

                              WHERE  bus_parent = @sCurrentChild

          IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
        END
      ELSE
        SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
    END

create function F_GET_DEPENDENT_UPLOADTABLES ( @nUploadid numeric(38), @sRefTable nvarchar(30) )
returns @tReturn table( ded_srctable            nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        nLevel                  int   )
as
begin
  declare @nLevel     int
  declare @sSrcTable  nvarchar(30)
  declare @tStack     table ( ded_srctable nvarchar(30), LevelID int )

  insert into @tStack 
  select ded_srctable, 1
    from r5dataconvextdef, r5dataconvlist, r5dataconversion
   where dtc_upcode = @nUploadid
     and dct_srcproductid = dtc_srcproductid
     and dct_sourcetable = @sRefTable
     and ded_srcproductid = dtc_srcproductid
     and ded_reftable = dct_desttable

  SET @nLevel = 1

  WHILE @nLevel > 0
  BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
      BEGIN
        select @sSrcTable = ded_srctable
          from @tStack
         where LevelID = @nLevel

        insert into @tReturn values (  @sSrcTable, @nLevel )

        delete from @tStack 
         where LevelID = @nLevel 
           AND ded_srctable = @sSrcTable
        
        insert into @tStack 
        select ded_srctable, @nLevel + 1
          from r5dataconvextdef, r5dataconversion
         where dtc_upcode = @nUploadid
           and dtc_srcproductid = ded_srcproductid
