body:
create function F_GET_EQUIP_CHILD_HIER_INFO (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
												@sOrg	nvarchar(15), 
												@sLang	nvarchar(2) )
returns @tReturn table( PARENT_DESC		nvarchar(80)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						PARENT_ORG_DESC	nvarchar(80)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						CHILD_DESC		nvarchar(80)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						CHILD_ORG_DESC	nvarchar(80)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						CHILD_TYPE_DESC nvarchar(80)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_level		int, 
						treeorder		int, 
						stc_rollup		nvarchar(1)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_rolldown	nvarchar(1)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
						stc_child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_childrtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_childtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
						stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_updatecount	int
					)
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @nRownum		int
	declare @sRollup		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sRolldown		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sChildrtype	nvarchar(4)	
	declare @sChildtype		nvarchar(4)	
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sParent_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount	int
	declare @nRetrieveLevel	int
	
	set @nRetrieveLevel = 1 
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_rollup		nvarchar(1)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
							stc_rolldown	nvarchar(1)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
							stc_child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
							stc_childrtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
							stc_parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
							stc_updatecount	int, 						
							LevelID			int )

	declare @tHier table(	stc_level		int, 
							treeorder		int, 
							stc_rollup		nvarchar(1)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
							stc_rolldown	nvarchar(1)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
							stc_child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
							stc_childrtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
							stc_parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,  
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
							stc_updatecount	int
						)

	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_rollup, 
				stc_rolldown,  
				stc_child, 
				stc_child_org,
				stc_childrtype,
				stc_childtype, 
				stc_parent,  
				stc_parent_org,
				stc_updatecount,
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg
		ORDER BY STC_CHILDTYPE, STC_CHILD, STC_CHILD_ORG
	SET @nLevel = 1
	SET @nRownum = 0

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			--NOTE:  Added a work around for 12811/13117.  Customer need the hierarchal query to be faster.
			--So the change now only retrieve x number of levels based on the paramter @nRetrieveLevel (hard coded to 1).  


			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	top 1
							@sRollup		= stc_rollup, 
							@sRolldown		= stc_rolldown,  
							@sCode			= stc_child, 
							@sOrg			= stc_child_org,
							@sChildrtype	= stc_childrtype, 
							@sChildtype		= stc_childtype, 
							@sParent		= stc_parent,  
							@sParent_org	= stc_parent_org,
							@nUpdatecount	= stc_updatecount
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					  ORDER BY stc_childtype, stc_child, stc_child_org

                    if @nLevel <= @nRetrieveLevel
                        begin
                            insert into @tHier values ( @nLevel, @nRownum + 1, @sRollup, @sRolldown, @sCode, @sOrg,
							@sChildrtype, @sChildtype, @sParent, @sParent_org, @nUpdatecount )
					        
                            set @nRownum = @nRownum + 1
					        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg

					        insert into @tStack	select	stc_rollup, 
												        stc_rolldown,  
												        stc_child, 
												        stc_child_org,
												        stc_childrtype, 
												        stc_childtype, 
												        stc_parent,  
												        stc_parent_org,
												        stc_updatecount,
												        @nLevel + 1
										          from	r5structures
										         where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
												        stc_parent_org	= @sOrg
										        ORDER BY STC_CHILDTYPE, STC_CHILD, STC_CHILD_ORG
					        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                        end
                    else
                        begin
                            delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
                        end
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	insert into @tReturn	select	a.des_text, 
									d.des_text, 
									b.des_text, 
									e.des_text, 
									f.des_text,
									c.* 
							  from	R5DESCRIPTIONS a, 
									R5DESCRIPTIONS b, 
									@tHier c, 
									R5DESCRIPTIONS d, 
									R5DESCRIPTIONS e,
									R5DESCRIPTIONS f 
							 where	a.des_rentity		= N'OBJ'		and 
									b.des_rentity		= N'OBJ'		and 
									d.des_rentity		= N'ORG'		and 
									e.des_rentity		= N'ORG'		and 
									c.stc_parent		= a.des_code	and 
									c.stc_parent_org	= a.des_org		and 
									c.stc_child			= b.des_code	and 
									c.stc_child_org		= b.des_org		and 
									c.stc_parent_org	= d.des_code	and 
									c.stc_child_org		= e.des_code	and 
									a.des_lang			= @sLang		and 
									b.des_lang			= a.des_lang	and 
									d.des_lang			= a.des_lang	and 
									f.des_rentity		= N'UCOD'		and 
									f.des_rtype			= N'OBTP'		and
									c.stc_childtype		= f.des_code	and
									e.des_lang			= a.des_lang	and
									f.DES_LANG			= a.des_lang
							
	return
end

create function F_GET_REPGETHIERCHILD_LOC2_HIER (   @sCode  nvarchar(30),
                                                    @sOrg   nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( loc_parent      nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_parent_org  nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_code        nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        loc_org         nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        nLevel          int  )
as
begin
    declare @nLevel         int
    declare @sParent        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sParentorg     nvarchar(15)
            
	--NOTE:  IF '%' is passed in this will create a stack with every record from r5location.  To avoid this 
	-- massive hierarchy we are not allowing '%' to be a valid value for @sCode -- per Vijay 01/06/2006.  This will
	-- improve performance.
	if @sCode <> N'%'
		begin	
			declare @tStack table ( loc_parent      nvarchar(30),
									loc_parent_org  nvarchar(15),
									loc_code        nvarchar(30),
									loc_org         nvarchar(15),
									LevelID         int )
			INSERT INTO @tStack 
				select  loc_parent,
						loc_parent_org,
						loc_code,
						loc_org,
						1 
				  from  r5locations
				 where  loc_code    like @sCode

			SET @nLevel = 1

			WHILE @nLevel > 0
				BEGIN
					IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
						BEGIN
							select  @sCode      = loc_code,
									@sOrg       = loc_org,
									@sParent    = loc_parent,
									@sParentorg = loc_parent_org
							  from  @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
							insert into @tReturn values ( @sParent, @sParentorg, @sCode, @sOrg, @nLevel )
							delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND loc_code = @sCode and loc_org = @sOrg
							insert into @tStack select  loc_parent,
														loc_parent_org,
														loc_code,
														loc_org,
														@nLevel + 1
												  from  r5locations
												 where  loc_parent      = @sCode and
														loc_parent_org  = @sOrg
							IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
								SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
						END
					ELSE
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
				END
		end
    return
end

body:
create function F_GET_REPPARAMTEXT (@func nvarchar(30), 
  @param nvarchar(30), 
  @lang nvarchar(30) )
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin
  declare @sReturn nvarchar(255);

  declare @tParams table ( 
    pmt_function nvarchar(6),
    pmt_parameter nvarchar(20),
    pmt_datatype nvarchar(2),
    pmt_line numeric(8,0),
    ptypechar nvarchar(1),
    paramkey int IDENTITY(1,1));

  declare @tBoiler table ( 
    bot_function nvarchar(6),
    bot_number numeric(3,0),
    bot_text nvarchar(255),
    bot_dest nvarchar(2),
    bot_lang nvarchar(2),
    btypechar nvarchar(1),
    boilerkey int IDENTITY(1,1));


  INSERT INTO @tParams
    (pmt_function, pmt_parameter, pmt_datatype, pmt_line, ptypechar)
  SELECT t.pmt_function, t.pmt_parameter, t.pmt_datatype, t.pmt_line, 'A' PTYPECHAR
  FROM r5repparms t 
  WHERE pmt_function = @func
    AND pmt_datatype in('O') 
  UNION
  SELECT t.pmt_function, t.pmt_parameter, t.pmt_datatype, t.pmt_line, 'B' PTYPECHAR
  FROM r5repparms t 
  WHERE pmt_function = @func
    AND pmt_datatype in('C','N','CB','DF','DT')  
  ORDER BY ptypechar, pmt_line;

  INSERT INTO @tBoiler
    (bot_function, bot_number, bot_text, bot_dest, bot_lang, btypechar)
  SELECT b.bot_function, b.bot_number, b.bot_text, b.bot_dest, b.bot_lang, 'A' BTYPECHAR 
  FROM R5BOILERTEXTS b 
  WHERE bot_function = @func
    AND BOT_LANG = @lang
    AND bot_dest in('O') 
    AND bot_number <> 1
  union
  SELECT b.bot_function, b.bot_number, b.bot_text, b.bot_dest, b.bot_lang, 'B' BTYPECHAR 
  FROM R5BOILERTEXTS b 
  WHERE bot_function = @func
    AND BOT_LANG = @lang
    AND bot_dest in('F','FO','CB','DF','DT') 
    AND bot_number <> 1
  ORDER BY btypechar, bot_number;

  SELECT @sReturn = b.bot_text
  FROM @tParams p, @tBoiler b
  WHERE p.paramkey = b.boilerkey
    AND p.pmt_parameter = @param;

  return(isNull(@sReturn,'NOT FOUND'));
end

CREATE FUNCTION [DBO].[F_GET_STOCKPART_HIER]
               (@sStore NVARCHAR(15),
                                @sPrefSup NVARCHAR(30))
RETURNS @tReturn TABLE(STO_PART      NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN,
                                                          STO_PART_ORG  NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN,
                                                          STO_STORE     NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN,
                                                          STO_PREFSTORE NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN,
                                                          STO_PREFSUP   NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN,
                                                          NLEVEL        INT)
AS
  BEGIN
          DECLARE @sPart NVARCHAR(30)
          DECLARE @sPartOrg NVARCHAR(15)
          DECLARE @sPrefStore NVARCHAR(15)
          DECLARE @nLevel INT
                                        
                                        
          DECLARE @tStack TABLE (
                 STO_PART      NVARCHAR(30),
                 STO_PART_ORG  NVARCHAR(15),
                 STO_STORE     NVARCHAR(15),
                 STO_PREFSTORE NVARCHAR(15),
                 STO_PREFSUP   NVARCHAR(30),
                 LEVELID       INT)
          
          INSERT INTO @tStack
          SELECT STO_PART,
                 STO_PART_ORG,
                 STO_STORE,
                 STO_PREFSTORE,
                 STO_PREFSUP,
                 1
          FROM   R5STOCK
          WHERE  STO_STORE LIKE @sStore
          AND STO_PREFSTORE IS NULL
          AND CASE WHEN @sPrefSup ='%' THEN '%' ELSE STO_PREFSUP END
                                  LIKE @sPrefSup
                
                                         
                                          
          SET @nLevel = 1
                                                 
                                                 
          WHILE @nLevel > 0
                  BEGIN
                          IF EXISTS (SELECT *    FROM   @tStack
                                                 WHERE  LEVELID = @nLevel)

                                  BEGIN
                                          SELECT @sPart = STO_PART,
                                                 @sPartOrg = STO_PART_ORG,
                                                 @sStore = STO_STORE,
                                                 @sPrefStore = STO_PREFSTORE,
                                                 @sPrefSup = STO_PREFSUP
                                          FROM   @tStack
                                          WHERE  LEVELID = @nLevel

                                          INSERT INTO @tReturn
                                          VALUES     (@sPart,
                                                      @sPartOrg,
                                                      @sStore,
                                                      @sPrefStore,
                                                      @sPrefSup,
                                                      @nLevel)
                                          
                                          
                                          DELETE FROM @tStack
                                          WHERE       LEVELID = @nLevel
                                          AND STO_STORE LIKE @sStore
                                          AND STO_PART = @sPart
                                          AND STO_PART_ORG = @sPartOrg  

                

                                          INSERT INTO @tStack
                                          SELECT STO_PART,
                                                 STO_PART_ORG,
                                                 STO_STORE,
                                                 STO_PREFSTORE,
                                                 STO_PREFSUP,
                                                 @nLevel + 1
                                          FROM   R5STOCK
                                          WHERE  STO_PART = @sPart
                                          AND STO_PART_ORG = @sPartOrg
                                          AND STO_PREFSTORE = @sStore
                                                                
                                    
                                                                                  
                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                  
                                          IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                                                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                          
                                  END


                                ELSE
                                 SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                          
                  END
           RETURN
  END

create function F_GRID_LVUNIONEQUIP_HIERARCHY (	@sUom		nvarchar(255), 
												@sObject	nvarchar(30),
												@sObjectorg	nvarchar(15), 
												@sDeptsecInstall nvarchar(4),
												@sUser nvarchar(255)
												)
returns @tReturn table(    stc_childtype        nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_childrtype       nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_child            nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parenttype       nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parentrtype      nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parent           nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_rolldown         nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_rollup           nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_equivalent       nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_downtime         nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_child_org        nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parent_org       nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   level				int )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel				int
	DECLARE @sCurrentParent		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sChildtype			nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sChildrtype		nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sChild				nvarchar(30)    
	DECLARE @sParenttype		nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sParentrtype		nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sRolldown			nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sRollup			nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sEquivalent		nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sDowntime			nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sChild_org			nvarchar(15)    
						   			
	declare @tStack table (		stc_childtype       nvarchar(4),
								stc_childrtype      nvarchar(4),
								stc_child           nvarchar(30),
								stc_parenttype      nvarchar(4),
								stc_parentrtype     nvarchar(4),
								stc_parent          nvarchar(30),
								stc_rolldown        nvarchar(1),
								stc_rollup          nvarchar(1),
								stc_equivalent      nvarchar(1),
								stc_downtime        nvarchar(1),
								stc_child_org       nvarchar(15),
								stc_parent_org      nvarchar(15),
								LevelID				int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select	stc_childtype,
								stc_childrtype,
								stc_child,
								stc_parenttype,
								stc_parentrtype,
								stc_parent,
								stc_rolldown,
								stc_rollup,
								stc_equivalent,
								stc_downtime,
								stc_child_org,
								stc_parent_org, 
								1 
						from r5structures s
						WHERE   EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' 
										 FROM   r5objusagedefs o,
												r5objects j
										 WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
										 AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
										 AND    o.oud_uom   = @sUom
										 AND    o.oud_parent = N'+' 
										 AND    j.obj_rstatus <> N'D'
										 AND    o.oud_object = s.stc_parent
										 AND    o.oud_object_org = s.stc_parent_org 
										 AND    (@sDeptsecInstall =N'OFF' 
										 OR     (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =@sUser 
										 AND    dse_mrc = COALESCE(j.obj_loaneddept, j.obj_mrc) 
 										 AND    coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
						AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
									 FROM   r5objusagedefs o
									 WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
									 AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
									 AND    o.oud_child      = N'+' )
						and s.STC_CHILD = @sObject
						and s.STC_CHILD_ORG = @sObjectorg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sChildtype = stc_childtype,
							@sChildrtype = stc_childrtype,
							@sChild = stc_child,
							@sParenttype = stc_parenttype,
							@sParentrtype = stc_parentrtype,
							@sCurrentParent = stc_parent,
							@sRolldown = stc_rolldown,
							@sRollup = stc_rollup,
							@sEquivalent = stc_equivalent,
							@sDowntime = stc_downtime,
							@sChild_org = stc_child_org,
							@sCurrentOrg = stc_parent_org						
					from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sChildtype, @sChildrtype, @sChild, @sParenttype, @sParentrtype, 
													@sCurrentParent, @sRolldown, @sRollup, @sEquivalent, @sDowntime,
													@sChild_org, @sCurrentOrg, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND 
												stc_parent = @sCurrentParent and 
												stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg and
												stc_child = @sChild AND
												stc_child_org = @sChild_org
					INSERT INTO @tStack select	stc_childtype,
												stc_childrtype,
												stc_child,
												stc_parenttype,
												stc_parentrtype,
												stc_parent,
												stc_rolldown,
												stc_rollup,
												stc_equivalent,
												stc_downtime,
												stc_child_org,
												stc_parent_org, 
												@nLevel + 1												
										from r5structures s
										WHERE   EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' 
														 FROM   r5objusagedefs o,
																r5objects j
														 WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
														 AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
														 AND    o.oud_uom   = @sUom
														 AND    o.oud_parent = N'+' 
														 AND    j.obj_rstatus <> N'D'
														 AND    o.oud_object = s.stc_parent
														 AND    o.oud_object_org = s.stc_parent_org ) 
										AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
													 FROM   r5objusagedefs o
													 WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
													 AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
													 AND    o.oud_child      = N'+' )
										and s.STC_CHILD = @sCurrentParent

create function F_GRID_LVUNIONEQUIP_HIERARCHY (	@sUom		nvarchar(255),

												@sDeptsecInstall nvarchar(4),
												@sUser nvarchar(255)
												)
returns @tReturn table(    stc_childtype        nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_childrtype       nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_child            nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parenttype       nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parentrtype      nvarchar(4)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parent           nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_rolldown         nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_rollup           nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_equivalent       nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_downtime         nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_child_org        nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   stc_parent_org       nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						   level				int )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel				int
	DECLARE @sCurrentParent		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sChildtype			nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sChildrtype		nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sChild				nvarchar(30)    
	DECLARE @sParenttype		nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sParentrtype		nvarchar(4)     
	DECLARE @sRolldown			nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sRollup			nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sEquivalent		nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sDowntime			nvarchar(1)     
	DECLARE @sChild_org			nvarchar(15)    
						   			
	declare @tStack table (		stc_childtype       nvarchar(4),
								stc_childrtype      nvarchar(4),
								stc_child           nvarchar(30),
								stc_parenttype      nvarchar(4),
								stc_parentrtype     nvarchar(4),
								stc_parent          nvarchar(30),
								stc_rolldown        nvarchar(1),
								stc_rollup          nvarchar(1),
								stc_equivalent      nvarchar(1),
								stc_downtime        nvarchar(1),
								stc_child_org       nvarchar(15),
								stc_parent_org      nvarchar(15),
								LevelID				int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select	stc_childtype,
								stc_childrtype,
								stc_child,
								stc_parenttype,
								stc_parentrtype,
								stc_parent,
								stc_rolldown,
								stc_rollup,
								stc_equivalent,
								stc_downtime,
								stc_child_org,
								stc_parent_org, 
								1 
						from r5structures s
						WHERE   EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' 
										 FROM   r5objusagedefs o,
												r5objects j
										 WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
										 AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
										 AND    o.oud_uom   = @sUom
										 AND    o.oud_parent = N'+' 
										 AND    j.obj_rstatus <> N'D'
										 AND    o.oud_object = s.stc_parent
										 AND    o.oud_object_org = s.stc_parent_org 
										 AND    (@sDeptsecInstall =N'OFF' 
										 OR     (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =@sUser 
										 AND    dse_mrc = COALESCE(j.obj_loaneddept, j.obj_mrc) 
 										 AND    coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
						AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
									 FROM   r5objusagedefs o
									 WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
									 AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
									 AND    o.oud_child      = N'+' )
						and s.STC_CHILD = @sObject
						and s.STC_CHILD_ORG = @sObjectorg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sChildtype = stc_childtype,
							@sChildrtype = stc_childrtype,
							@sChild = stc_child,
							@sParenttype = stc_parenttype,
							@sParentrtype = stc_parentrtype,
							@sCurrentParent = stc_parent,
							@sRolldown = stc_rolldown,
							@sRollup = stc_rollup,
							@sEquivalent = stc_equivalent,
							@sDowntime = stc_downtime,
							@sChild_org = stc_child_org,
							@sCurrentOrg = stc_parent_org						
					from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sChildtype, @sChildrtype, @sChild, @sParenttype, @sParentrtype, 
													@sCurrentParent, @sRolldown, @sRollup, @sEquivalent, @sDowntime,
													@sChild_org, @sCurrentOrg, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND 
												stc_parent = @sCurrentParent and 
												stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg and
												stc_child = @sChild AND
												stc_child_org = @sChild_org
					INSERT INTO @tStack select	stc_childtype,
												stc_childrtype,
												stc_child,
												stc_parenttype,
												stc_parentrtype,
												stc_parent,
												stc_rolldown,
												stc_rollup,
												stc_equivalent,
												stc_downtime,
												stc_child_org,
												stc_parent_org, 
												@nLevel + 1												
										from r5structures s
										WHERE   EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' 
														 FROM   r5objusagedefs o,
																r5objects j
														 WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
														 AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
														 AND    o.oud_uom   = @sUom
														 AND    o.oud_parent = N'+' 
														 AND    j.obj_rstatus <> N'D'
														 AND    o.oud_object = s.stc_parent
														 AND    o.oud_object_org = s.stc_parent_org ) 
										AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
													 FROM   r5objusagedefs o
													 WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
													 AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
													 AND    o.oud_child      = N'+' )
										and s.STC_CHILD = @sCurrentParent
										and s.STC_CHILD_ORG = @sCurrentOrg

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function F_LAST_DAY(@dDate	datetime)
returns datetime
as
begin
	Declare @dReturnDate    datetime
    Declare @dBasedate      datetime
    set  @dBasedate= '1900-01-01'

    select @dReturnDate = dateadd(day, -1, dateadd( month,datediff(month,@dBasedate,@dDate)+1,@dBasedate)) 

	return( @dReturnDate )	
end

create function F_LPAD( @sString nvarchar(4000), @nLen integer, @sPad nvarchar(4000) )
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
	declare @sResult				nvarchar(4000)

    Set @sResult =  CASE WHEN LEN(@sString) >= @nLen THEN @sString ELSE SUBSTRING(REPLICATE(@sPad,@nLen),1,@nLen-LEN(@sString))+@sString END	
	return ( @sResult )

end

create function F_METERREADINGINFO_HIER_1 (	@sUom1		nvarchar(30),

											@sUom2		nvarchar(30),

begin

	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg	nvarchar(15)
		
    declare c_temp cursor local for select stc_parent, stc_parent_org
						            from dbo.F_METERREADINGINFO_HIER_1A( @sChild, @sOrg)
    open c_temp
    fetch next from c_temp into @sCurrentParent, @sCurrentOrg
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from R5OBJUSAGEDEFS o, R5OBJECTS j 
							   where  o.OUD_OBJECT     = j.OBJ_CODE 
							   and    o.OUD_OBJECT_ORG = j.OBJ_ORG

							 where  o.OUD_OBJECT     = @sObject 
							 and    o.OUD_OBJECT_ORG = @sObjectorg 
							 and    o.OUD_CHILD      = N'+' ) 
				and not exists ( select 1 from dbo.F_METERREADINGINFO_HIER_1A( @sCurrentParent, @sCurrentOrg) s2

												and    o.OUD_PARENT     = N'+'

												and    o.OUD_OBJECT     = s2.STC_PARENT 
												and    o.OUD_OBJECT_ORG = s2.STC_PARENT_ORG ) ) 
                begin
                    insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentParent, @sCurrentOrg )
                end

            fetch next from c_temp into @sCurrentParent, @sCurrentOrg
        end
    close c_temp
    deallocate c_temp

	return
end

create function F_O7CHKPSD(@sUsr nvarchar(255), @sPswd nvarchar(32))
returns nvarchar(4)
AS

BEGIN

	declare @sR5pass   	nvarchar(50)
	declare @dExpuser  	datetime
	declare @dExppass  	datetime
	declare @sEncrppass 	nvarchar(32)
	declare @dToday		datetime
	declare @nCount		integer
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
	
	set @sChk = 0

	select @dToday = CurrDate from V_GETDATE

	
	set @sEncrppass = dbo.O7CRPPAS (@sPswd)

	SELECT @sR5pass = usr_password , @dExpuser = usr_expuser, @dExppass = usr_exppass
	FROM   r5users
	WHERE  usr_code = @sUsr
	AND    coalesce( usr_login, N'+' ) = N'+'


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			if @sR5pass <> coalesce(@sEncrppass, N'@')   
				begin
					set @sChk = 2
				end

			if @dExpuser < @dToday 
				begin
					set @sChk = 3
				end

			if @dExppass < @dToday 
				begin
					set @sChk = 4
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = 1
		end

	return (@sChk)
end

create function F_O7WOARCHIVE_ISWOMODIFIED( @sWorkOrder nvarchar(30),@sERecordCode nvarchar(30),@nUpdateCount numeric(38))
returns nvarchar(1)
as
begin
        DECLARE @sNewERecordCode        nvarchar(30)
        DECLARE @sIsModified            nvarchar(1)
        
        SET  @sIsModified = '-'
        
        SELECT  @sIsModified = '-'
        FROM    r5events
        WHERE   evt_code = @sWorkOrder AND evt_updatecount = @nUpdateCount
        
        SELECT  @sNewERecordCode = ets_code
        FROM    r5eventsignature
        WHERE   ets_event = @sWorkOrder
        
        if COALESCE(@sERecordCode, '') <>  COALESCE(@sNewERecordCode, '')
                set  @sIsModified = '+'
                
        return @sIsModified
end

create function F_RTRIM_STRING( @sString nvarchar(4000), @sSet nvarchar(4000) )
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
	declare @sResult				nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nLenset				integer
	declare @nCharindex			integer
	set @nLenset = len(@sSet)
	set @nCharindex = 1

	While @nCharindex > 0 
		begin	
			set @nCharindex = charindex(@sSet, @sString, len(@sString) - @nLenset + 1 )
			
			If @nCharindex > 0 
				set @sString = Substring(@sString,1,len(@sString) - @nLenset )
			else
				begin
					set @sString = @sString 
					break
				end
		end

	set @sResult = @sString
	return ( @sResult )
end

create function F_SQLFORMAT_DATE(@dDate	datetime, @sType nvarchar(2))
returns nvarchar(20)
as
begin
	declare @sReturn nvarchar(20)
  declare @s nvarchar(4)
  set @sReturn = N''

  if @dDate is null 
    return (null)

  /*if type is O for Oracle, then return oracle formatted date 26-NOV-2003*/
  if @sType = N'O' begin
    set @sReturn = replace(upper(convert(nvarchar(20), cast(@dDate as datetime), 106)), N' ', N'-')
    return (@sReturn)
  end

  set @s  = cast( DATEPART(mm, @dDate) as nvarchar(4)) 
  if len(@s) = 1 set @s = N'0' + @s
  set @sReturn = @sReturn + @s + N'/'

  set @s  = cast( DATEPART(dd, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
  if len(@s) = 1 set @s = N'0' + @s
  set @sReturn = @sReturn + @s + N'/'

  set @sReturn = @sReturn + cast( DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
  

  /*if type is DT then add the time to the result*/
  if @sType = N'DT' begin
    set @sReturn = @sReturn + N' '
                 
    set @s  = cast( DATEPART(hh, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
    if len(@s) = 1 set @s = N'0' + @s
    set @sReturn = @sReturn + @s + N':' 

    set @s  = cast( DATEPART(mi, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
    if len(@s) = 1 set @s = N'0' + @s
    set @sReturn = @sReturn + @s
  end

	return( @sReturn )	
end

begin

    DECLARE @sCurrentChild      nvarchar(15)
   
    DECLARE @tStack table ( str_code nvarchar(15), LevelID int )

    INSERT INTO @tReturn values ( @sStore)

    INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, 1 
            FROM    r5stores s
            WHERE   s.str_parent = @sStore

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @sCurrentChild = str_code
                    FROM   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel

                    INSERT INTO @tReturn values ( @sCurrentChild)
                    DELETE FROM @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND str_code = @sCurrentChild 
                    INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, @nLevel + 1 
                    FROM r5stores s
                    WHERE s.str_parent = @sCurrentChild

                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        END
    return
end

create function F_TREQ_PSLCHILDFOSTER( @sObject nvarchar(30), @sObjectorg nvarchar(15), @sNotused1 nvarchar(30), @sNotused2 nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table(stc_child nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                       stc_child_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                       stc_parent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                       stc_parent_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin
    DECLARE @sChild      nvarchar(30)
    DECLARE @sChildOrg   nvarchar(15)
    DECLARE @sParent     nvarchar(30)
    DECLARE @sParentOrg  nvarchar(15)

    DECLARE c_children CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org FROM F_TRANSFEREQUIPMENT_HIER_1(@sObject, @sObjectorg)

    OPEN c_children
    FETCH NEXT FROM c_children INTO @sChild, @sChildOrg

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            SET @sParent = NULL

            SELECT @sParent = stc_parent, @sParentOrg = stc_parent_org
            FROM F_TREQ_PSLFOSTER(@sObject, @sObjectorg, @sChild, @sChildOrg)

            IF @sParent IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@sChild, @sChildOrg, @sParent, @sParentOrg)
                    BREAK
                END

            FETCH NEXT FROM c_children INTO @sChild, @sChildOrg
        END

    CLOSE c_children
    DEALLOCATE c_children

    RETURN
end

create function F_TREQ_PSLFOSTER(@sRoot nvarchar(30),       @sRootorg nvarchar(15),
                                 @sStartchild nvarchar(30), @sStartchildorg nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table(stc_parent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                       stc_parent_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ,
                       stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
    DECLARE @nLevel         int
    DECLARE @sCurrentParent nvarchar(30)
    DECLARE @sCurrentOrg    nvarchar(15)
    DECLARE @sParentRType   nvarchar(4)

    DECLARE @tStack TABLE ( stc_parent nvarchar(30), stc_parent_org nvarchar(15), stc_parentrtype nvarchar(4), LevelID int )

    INSERT INTO @tStack
    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_parentrtype, 1
    FROM   r5structures s
    WHERE  stc_child = @sStartchild
    AND    stc_child_org = @sStartchildorg
    AND NOT (stc_parent = @sRoot AND stc_parent_org = @sRootorg)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM F_TRANSFEREQUIPMENT_HIER_1(@sRoot, @sRootorg) h
                    WHERE s.stc_parent = h.stc_child AND s.stc_parent_org = h.stc_child_org)

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    SELECT @sCurrentParent = stc_parent,
                           @sCurrentOrg = stc_parent_org,
                           @sParentRType = stc_parentrtype
                    FROM   @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel

                    INSERT INTO @tReturn VALUES(@sCurrentParent, @sCurrentOrg, @sParentRType)

                    IF @sParentRType IN ('P', 'S', 'L')
                        BREAK

                    DELETE FROM @tStack
                    WHERE LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCurrentParent AND stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg AND stc_parentrtype = @sParentRType

                    INSERT INTO @tStack
                    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_parentrtype, @nLevel + 1
                    FROM   r5structures s
                    WHERE  stc_child = @sCurrentParent
                    AND    stc_child_org = @sCurrentOrg
                    AND NOT (stc_parent = @sRoot AND stc_parent_org = @sRootorg)
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM F_TRANSFEREQUIPMENT_HIER_1(@sRoot, @sRootorg) h
                                    WHERE s.stc_parent = h.stc_child AND s.stc_parent_org = h.stc_child_org)

                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        END

    DELETE FROM @tReturn WHERE stc_parentrtype NOT IN ('P', 'S', 'L')

    RETURN
end

create function F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDate datetime, @sMode nvarchar(4))
returns datetime
WITH SCHEMABINDING
as
begin
   Declare @dReturnDate datetime
   Declare @sValue  nvarchar(20)
   Declare @sMinuteValue nvarchar(2)
   Declare @sHourValue nvarchar(2)
   Declare @sDayValue nvarchar(4)
   Declare @sMonthValue nvarchar(4)
   Declare @nQuarterValue int
   Declare @sYearValue nvarchar(4)
    if @dDate is null
        return null
   set @sMode = UPPER(@sMode)
   If @sMode = 'DD'
      BEGIN
         SELECT @sDayValue = cast(DATEPART(dd, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sMonthValue = cast(DATEPART(mm, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sYearValue = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SET @sValue  = @sMonthValue + '/' + @sDayValue + '/' +  @sYearValue
         SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sValue, 101)
      END
   If @sMode = 'MM'
      BEGIN
         SELECT @sMonthValue = cast(DATEPART(mm, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sYearValue = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SET @sValue  = @sMonthValue + '/1/' +  @sYearValue
         SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sValue, 101)
      END
   If @sMode = 'YY'
      BEGIN
         SELECT @sYearValue = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SET @sValue  = '1/1/' +  @sYearValue
         SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sValue, 101)
      END
   If @sMode = 'QQ'
      BEGIN
         SELECT @sYearValue = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @nQuarterValue = cast(DATEPART(qq, @dDate) as int)
         If @nQuarterValue = 1
            BEGIN
               SET @sMonthValue = '1'
            END
         Else If @nQuarterValue = 2
            BEGIN
               SET @sMonthValue = '4'
            END
         Else If @nQuarterValue = 3
            BEGIN
               SET @sMonthValue = '7'
            END
         Else If @nQuarterValue = 4
            BEGIN
               SET @sMonthValue = '10'
            END
         SET @sValue  = @sMonthValue +  '/1/' +  @sYearValue
         SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sValue, 101)
      END
   if @sMode = 'HH'
      BEGIN
         SELECT @sHourValue = cast(DATEPART(hh, @dDate) as nvarchar(2))
         SELECT @sDayValue = cast(DATEPART(dd, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sMonthValue = cast(DATEPART(mm, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sYearValue = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SET @sValue  = @sMonthValue + '/' + @sDayValue + '/' +  @sYearValue + ' ' + @sHourValue + ':00:00'
         SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sValue, 120)
      END
   if @sMode = 'MI'
      BEGIN
         SELECT @sMinuteValue = cast(DATEPART(mi, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sHourValue = cast(DATEPART(hh, @dDate) as nvarchar(2))
         SELECT @sDayValue = cast(DATEPART(dd, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sMonthValue = cast(DATEPART(mm, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SELECT @sYearValue = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
         SET @sValue  = @sMonthValue + '/' + @sDayValue + '/' +  @sYearValue + ' ' + @sHourValue + ':' + @sMinuteValue + ':00'
         SET @dReturnDate = convert (datetime,  @sValue, 120)
      END
   return(@dReturnDate)
end

create function F_TRUNC_WEEK(@dDate datetime, @nStartDOW integer)
returns datetime
as
begin
	Declare @nCurDOW integer
	declare @nOffset integer
	Declare @sDayValue nvarchar(4)
	Declare @sMonthValue nvarchar(4)
	Declare @sYearValue nvarchar(4)

 	SET @nCurDOW = datepart(dw, @dDate)-1
 	if @nStartDOW <= @nCurDOW 
 		SET @nOffset = @nStartDOW - @nCurDOW
 	else
		SET @nOffset = (@nStartDOW - @nCurDOW) - 7
	SELECT @sDayValue = cast( DATEPART(dd, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
	SELECT @sMonthValue = cast( DATEPART(mm, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
	SELECT @sYearValue = cast( DATEPART(yyyy, @dDate) as nvarchar(4))
 	return dateadd(day, @nOffset, convert(datetime, @sMonthValue + '/' + @sDayValue + '/' + @sYearValue, 101  ))
end

BEGIN

		  ,Upper(elm_coltype)
	  FROM r5elecmapping
	 WHERE elm_entity = @sEntity AND elm_code >= @nStartelmcode AND elm_code <= @nEndelmcode
	ORDER BY elm_code

	OPEN GetMappedColumns

				SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N' + '

			--We have to calculate the hash the same as is being don ein preins_ela.

				begin

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.GET_MULTIPLIER @nFactor      BIGINT OUTPUT
                                   ,@sPart        NVARCHAR(30)
                                   ,@sSupplier    NVARCHAR(30)
                                   ,@sPartOrg     NVARCHAR(15)
                                   ,@sSupplierOrg NVARCHAR(15)
                                   ,@sPurUOM      NVARCHAR(30)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
/**************************************************************************************************************/
/* Set the factor to -1. This is the value to be returned if no row is found in database                      */
/**************************************************************************************************************/
SELECT @nFactor = -1

SELECT @nFactor = cat_multiply
  FROM dbo.r5catalogue
 WHERE cat_part = @sPart
   AND cat_part_org = @sPartOrg
   AND cat_supplier = @sSupplier
   AND cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierOrg
   AND cat_puruom = @sPurUOM
   AND cat_multiply IS NOT NULL

/**************************************************************************************************************/
/* If no row found, then query the table again without supplier org                                           */
/**************************************************************************************************************/
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
   BEGIN
   SET ROWCOUNT 1                                              /* Pick up only first row if more than 1 exist */
   SELECT @nFactor = cat_multiply
     FROM dbo.r5catalogue
    WHERE cat_part = @sPart
      AND cat_part_org = @sPartOrg
      AND cat_supplier = @sSupplier
      AND cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierOrg
      AND cat_puruom = @sPurUOM
      AND cat_multiply IS NOT NULL
   SET ROWCOUNT 0
   END
END

create function GET_OPKEYBLOCK( @sPi_stSyncTable nvarchar(30), @nPi_lBlockSize integer )    
returns int
as
begin
    declare @nReturn int
    declare @nOutput int
    declare @sDatabase  varchar(128)

    set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )

    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_OPKEYBLOCK_PROC', @sPi_stSyncTable, @nPi_lBlockSize, @nOutput OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return null

    set @nReturn = @nOutput + @nPi_lBlockSize - 1
    return @nReturn
end

CREATE PROCEDURE GET_OPKEYBLOCK_PROC @sPi_stSyncTable varchar(30), @nPi_lBlockSize integer, @nOutput int OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
    declare @nStartVal      integer


    SELECT @nStartVal = OPB_STARTVAL FROM R5OPSYNCBLOCK (UPDLOCK) WHERE UPPER(OPB_SYNCTABLE) = UPPER(@sPi_stSyncTable)

    UPDATE R5OPSYNCBLOCK SET OPB_STARTVAL = @nStartVal+@nPi_lBlockSize WHERE UPPER(OPB_SYNCTABLE) = UPPER(@sPi_stSyncTable);
    COMMIT

    set @nOutput = @nStartVal

    RETURN

create procedure GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE 	@sPackage	nvarchar(32), 
										@sVariable	nvarchar(32), 
										@sValue		nvarchar(2000)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL	nvarchar(500)
	declare @sTable	nvarchar(32)
	declare @nCount	int
	
	SET @sValue = N'@@Error@@'

	SET @sTable = dbo.GET_PACKAGE_VAR_TEMP_TABLENAME()

	--create temp table if necessary
	EXEC CREATE_PACKAGE_VAR_TEMP_TABLE
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	--verify that the package / variable combo is there
	SET @sSQL = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sTable
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where PACKAGE_NAME	= ''' + @sPackage + N''' and '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N'		VARIABLE_NAME	= ''' + @sVariable + N''''

	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCount int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT

	if @nCount = 1
		BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = N'select @sValue = VARIABLE_VALUE from ' + @sTable
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where PACKAGE_NAME	= ''' + @sPackage + N''' and '
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N'		VARIABLE_NAME	= ''' + @sVariable + N''''
			
			EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sValue nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT', @sValue OUTPUT
		END
	else
		RAISERROR ('The package / variable combination is not valid.  Package: %s; Variable: %s.', 16, 1, @sPackage, @sVariable )

create function GET_PARAM_DESC(@sLang nvarchar(3), @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                          @sCode  nvarchar(60), @sRtype nvarchar(4), @sType nvarchar(4))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

    declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDeforg	nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
    declare @sCod		nvarchar(100)
    declare @sOrg		nvarchar(100)
    declare @sHorg		nvarchar(100)
    declare @sTxt		nvarchar(500)
    declare @sNewcod	nvarchar(100)

	if @sRentity IS NULL 
		RETURN NULL

	if charindex(N'%' , @sCode ) <> 0 
		RETURN NULL
	
	if charindex(N'_' , @sCode) <> 0 
		RETURN NULL
	
	if @sRentity IN ( N'PORD', N'OBJ',  N'CLAS', N'CAT', N'INV', N'PART', N'COMP', N'EIV', N'RMA' ) 
		begin
			set @sDeforg = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEFORG')
			if charindex( N'#' , @sCode ) > 0 
				begin
					set @sCod = SUBSTRING( @sCode, 1, charindex( N'#' , @sCode  ) - 1 )
					set @sOrg = SUBSTRING( @sCode, charindex( N'#', @sCode  ) + 1, len(@sCode) - charindex( N'#', @sCode  ) )
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sCod = @sCode
					set @sOrg = @sDeforg
				end

			if @sRentity = N'CAT' 
				set @sOrg = @sDeforg
			else
				begin
					if dbo.o7getmos( @sRentity ) = N'-' 
						set @sOrg = @sDeforg
					else
						begin
							set @sTxt = RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sCode, @sRtype, @sType ) )
							if @sTxt <> N'?' 
									RETURN( N'[ ' + @sTxt + ' ]' )
							else
								begin
									set @sHorg = @sOrg
									if    @sRentity = N'OBJ'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = obj_org
											FROM   r5objects
											WHERE  obj_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'PORD' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = ord_org
											FROM   r5orders
											WHERE  ord_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'CLAS' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = cls_org
											FROM   r5classes
											WHERE  cls_code = @sCod
											AND    cls_rentity = @sRtype
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'INV'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = inv_org
											FROM   r5invoices
											WHERE  inv_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'EIV'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = eiv_org
											FROM   r5extinvoices
											WHERE  eiv_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'PART' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = par_org
											FROM   r5parts
											WHERE  par_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'COMP' 
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = com_org
											FROM   r5companies
											WHERE  com_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
									if @sRentity = N'RMA'  
										begin
											SELECT @sOrg = rma_org
											FROM   r5rma
											WHERE  rma_code = @sCod
											If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
												set @sOrg = @sHorg
										end
								end
						end
				end
			set @sNewcod = @sCod + N'#' + @sOrg
			RETURN( N'[ ' + RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sNewcod, @sRtype, @sType)) + ' ]')
		end

    RETURN( N'[ ' + RTRIM(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, @sRentity, @sCode, @sRtype, @sType)) + ' ]')
end

create function GET_R5REPORLCOL()
returns @tPrc table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						  evt_location nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						  evt_location_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						  evt_completed nvarchar(64) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						  evt_object_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						  loc_class nvarchar(8) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin
	declare @sEvtCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtLocation		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEvtLocationOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEvtCompleted		nvarchar(64)
	declare @sEvtObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sLocClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sLocCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sLocOrg			nvarchar(15)
	


	declare c_prj cursor local for select Cast(E.EVT_CODE as nvarchar(30)) EVT_CODE, E.EVT_LOCATION, E.EVT_LOCATION_ORG,
											coalesce(cast(E.EVT_COMPLETED as nvarchar(64)),N'X') EVT_COMPLETED,
											E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG, coalesce(RL.LOC_CLASS,N'') LOC_CLASS, rl.loc_code, rl.loc_org
											FROM R5EVENTS E, R5LOCATIONS RL
											WHERE 	E.EVT_PARENT IS NULL
											AND	 	E.EVT_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
											AND		E.EVT_JOBTYPE IS NOT NULL
											AND		E.EVT_JOBTYPE NOT IN (	SELECT U.UCO_CODE
																			FROM R5UCODES U
																			WHERE U.UCO_RCODE IN (N'IS',N'RP')
																			AND U.UCO_RENTITY = N'JBTP')
											AND		E.EVT_RTYPE IN (N'JOB',N'PPM')
											AND		E.EVT_RSTATUS = N'C'
	open c_prj
	fetch next from c_prj into @sEvtCode, @sEvtLocation, @sEvtLocationOrg, @sEvtCompleted, @sEvtObjectOrg, @sLocClass, @sLocCode, @sLocOrg
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			if @sEvtLocation + N'#' + @sEvtLocationOrg in ( dbo.R5REPORLCOL_GET_HIERARCHY(@sLocCode, @sLocOrg) ) 
				insert into @tPrc values (@sEvtCode, @sEvtLocation, @sEvtLocationOrg, @sEvtCompleted, @sEvtObjectOrg, @sLocClass)

			fetch next from c_prj into @sEvtCode, @sEvtLocation, @sEvtLocationOrg, @sEvtCompleted, @sEvtObjectOrg, @sLocClass, @sLocCode, @sLocOrg
		end
	close c_prj
	deallocate c_prj

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE GET_R5Rootitems_Hierarchy @sCpar2 nvarchar(8), @sCpar3 nvarchar(8)

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @nCurrentID		int
		
	CREATE TABLE #tRootItmes ( Rotreqm nvarchar(8) )
	CREATE TABLE #tStack( Rotreqm nvarchar(8), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO #tStack 
		SELECT	rot_reqm, 1
		  FROM	r5rootitems 
		 WHERE	rot_reqm = @sCpar3 
		 AND	rot_suggest = @sCpar2

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCpar2 = Rotreqm from #tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into #tRootItmes  values ( @sCpar2)
					delete from #tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND Rotreqm = @sCpar2
					insert into #tStack select rot_reqm, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5rootitems 
										 where rot_suggest = @sCpar2 
										 and rot_reqm = @sCpar3 
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	DROP TABLE #tStack
	SELECT * FROM #tRootItmes

  	execute @nReturn = AUDITSQL_GET_TRIGGER_HEADFOOT @sTable, @sTriggerName, @sTriggerType, @sTriggerHeadDeclare OUTPUT, @sTriggerHeadCursor OUTPUT, @sTriggerHeadFetch OUTPUT, @sTriggerFoot OUTPUT, @sTriggerDrop OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
  	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
  		begin
        set @sChk = N'4'
  			return
  		end

  	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
  		begin
  			/*suppress error-reporting and rollback to behave like Oracle does in AuditSetupTriggerOperation.java*/
        set @sChk = N'4' + @sCheckresult
  			return
  		end


    /*Drop any old audit trail triggers on the table*/
    begin try
      exec sp_executesql @sTriggerDrop
    end try
    begin catch
    end catch

    /*Finally, build (execute) the trigger from its header, body, and footer*/
    exec (@sTriggerHeadDeclare + @sTriggerHeadCursor + @sTriggerHeadFetch + @sTriggerBody + @sTriggerFoot)
  end

END

CREATE function IDAUTOMATION_CODE128
( @sData_to_encode nvarchar(4000), @nReturn_type integer)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) 
    begin
		declare @sDataToPrint     nvarchar(4000)    --Data to be returned 
		declare @sDataToFormat    nvarchar(4000)    
		declare @sDataToEncode    nvarchar(4000)
		declare @s128Start       nvarchar(8)
		declare @s128_StartA     nvarchar(8)     
		declare @s128_StartB     nvarchar(8)     
		declare @s128_StartC     nvarchar(8)     
		declare @s128Stop        nvarchar(8)     

		declare @sHumanReadableText nvarchar(4000)
		declare @nCurrentCharNum    integer

		declare @sCurrentEncoding   nvarchar(8)
		declare @nWeightedTotal     integer
		declare @nCheckDigitValue   integer
		declare @s128_CheckDigit	nvarchar(2)
		declare @nStringLength      integer

		declare @nCurrentValue  integer
        declare @nCounter integer
		declare @sReturn	nvarchar(4000)

		set @s128_StartA     = nchar(203)
		set @s128_StartB     = nchar(204)
		set @s128_StartC     = nchar(205)
		set @s128Stop        = nchar(206)
		set @sHumanReadableText = ' '
		set @sDataToEncode = ' '
		set @sDataToPrint = ' '
		set @sDataToEncode = ' ' 

        set @nCounter = 1
		set @sDataToFormat = rtrim(ltrim(@sData_to_encode))
		set @nCurrentCharNum = ascii(cast (substring(@sDataToFormat,1,1) as nchar))

		-- Select the start character 
		if @nCurrentCharNum < 32  
            set  @s128Start = @s128_StartA 
		if @nCurrentCharNum >= 32 and @nCurrentCharNum < 127 
            set @s128Start = @s128_StartB 
		if len(@sDataToFormat) > 4 and dbo.IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER(substring(@sDataToFormat, 1, 4) ) = 1
            set @s128Start = @s128_StartC 
		-- 202 is the FNC1, character set C is mandatory 
		if @nCurrentCharNum = 202 
            set @s128Start = @s128_StartC 
		if @s128Start = nchar(203) 
            set @sCurrentEncoding = N'A' 
		if @s128Start = nchar(204)   
            set  @sCurrentEncoding = N'B' 
		if @s128Start = nchar(205) 
            set @sCurrentEncoding = N'C' 

		set @nStringLength = len(@sDataToFormat)

        set @nCounter = 1
        WHILE @nCounter <=  @nStringLength
            begin
                -- check for FNC1 in any set 
                if substring(@sDataToFormat,@nCounter,1) = nchar(202) 
                    set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(202)
                -- check for switching to character set C	
                else
                    begin
                        if ((@nCounter < @nStringLength - 2) and (dbo.IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER(substring(@sDataToFormat, @nCounter, 1)) = 1)  and (dbo.IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER(substring(@sDataToFormat, @nCounter+1, 1)) = 1) and (dbo.IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER(substring(@sDataToFormat, @nCounter, 4)) =1))
	                        or ((@nCounter < @nStringLength) and (dbo.IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER(substring(@sDataToFormat, @nCounter, 1)) = 1) and (dbo.IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER(substring(@sDataToFormat, @nCounter+1, 1)) = 1) and (@sCurrentEncoding = N'C'))  
                            begin
                                -- switch to set C if not already in it 
                                if @sCurrentEncoding <> N'C' 
	                                set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(199)

                                if @nCurrentValue < 95 and @nCurrentValue > 0

                                if @nCurrentValue = 0 
	                                set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(194)

                                    begin

                                        if @sCurrentEncoding <> N'A' 
	                                        set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(201)

                                        -- Get the ascii value of the next character 
                                        set @nCurrentCharNum = ascii(cast(substring(@sDataToFormat,@nCounter,1) as nchar))
                                        if @nCurrentCharNum = 32 
                                            set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(194) 
                                        if @nCurrentCharNum < 32 
                                            set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(@nCurrentCharNum + 96) 
                                        if @nCurrentCharNum > 32 
                                            set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(@nCurrentCharNum) 

                                        -- check for switching to character set B 	  
                                    end
                                else

                                        if (@nCounter <= @nStringLength) and ((ascii(cast(substring(@sDataToFormat,@nCounter,1) as nchar))) > 31 and (ascii(cast(substring(@sDataToFormat,@nCounter,1)as nchar))) < 127) 
                                            begin

	                                                set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(200)
                                                set @sCurrentEncoding = N'B'
                                                -- get the ascii value of the next character 
                                                set @nCurrentCharNum = ascii(cast(substring(@sDataToFormat,@nCounter,1) as nchar))
                                                if @nCurrentCharNum = 32 
                                                  set @sDataToEncode = @sDataToEncode + nchar(194)

                                            end
                                    end
                            end    
                    end

                set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1  
		    end

        WHILE @nCounter <=  len(@sDataToFormat)
            begin
                -- get ascii value of each character

                -- check for FNC1

CREATE function IDAUTOMATION_CODE128B
( @sData_to_encode nvarchar(2000))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000) 
    begin
        declare @sCheck_digit_char       nvarchar(8)    
        declare @nCheck_digit            integer         
        declare @sStart_character        nvarchar(8)    
        declare @sStop_character         nvarchar(8)    
        declare @nCurrent_value          integer         
        declare @sEncoded_string         nvarchar(1000) 
        -- Calcuation variables
        declare @nWeight_total           integer             

        declare @nCounter               integer
        declare @nLength                integer
		        
        set @sCheck_digit_char       = null	  
        set @nCheck_digit            = null
        set @sStart_character        = nchar(0204)
        set @sStop_character         = nchar(0206)
        set @nCurrent_value          = null  
        set @sEncoded_string         = null
        -- Calcuation variables
        set @nWeight_total           = ascii(cast(@sStart_character as nchar)) - 100

        -- Determine the check digit 
        set @nLength =  len(@sData_to_encode)
        set @nCounter = 1 
        while @nCounter <= @nLength 
            begin
                set @nCurrent_value = cast(ascii(cast(substring(@sData_to_encode, @nCounter, 1) as nchar)) as numeric(38,0))
                if @nCurrent_value < 135 
                    set @nCurrent_value = @nCurrent_value - 32						
                else
                    begin
                        if	@nCurrent_value >= 135  
                            set @nCurrent_value = @nCurrent_value - 100
                    end					

                -- Calculate the check digit 
                set @nCurrent_value = @nCurrent_value * @nCounter
                set @nWeight_total = @nWeight_total + @nCurrent_value
				set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
            end 

        -- Get the check digit value 	  
        set @nCheck_digit = @nWeight_total % 103
        -- Get the corresponding character from the check_digit 

        if @nCheck_digit < 95 and @nCheck_digit > 0 
            set @sCheck_digit_char = nchar(@nCheck_digit + 32)						
        else
            begin
                if	@nCheck_digit >= 95 
                    set @sCheck_digit_char = nchar(@nCheck_digit + 100)
                else
                    begin
                        if @nCheck_digit = 0 
                            set @sCheck_digit_char = nchar(194)
                    end
            end 
        -- check digit determined 

        -- Replace any occurence of ' ' (space) with nchar(194) 
        set @sEncoded_string = replace(@sData_to_encode, N' ',nchar(194))

        return @sStart_character + @sEncoded_string + @sCheck_digit_char + @sStop_character   


    end

CREATE function IDAUTOMATION_IS_NUMBER
( @sString nvarchar(4000))
RETURNS bit
    begin
		declare @nCounter integer
        -- SQL SERVER DOES NOT HAVE BOOLEAN so returning bit -- 1 = TRUE 0 = FALSE.
        set @nCounter = 1
        while @nCounter <=  len(@sString)
            begin
	            if substring (@sString, @nCounter, 1) not in (N'1',N'2',N'3',N'4',N'5',N'6',N'7',N'8',N'9',N'0') 
	                Return 0
                set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
            end


        return 1  -- All the characters are numbers 
    end

on r5ipvendorsvw
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount   numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nCode    		integer      
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(1040)    	
	declare @sURL			nvarchar(1040)        	
	declare @sNotes			nvarchar(4000)      	
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3)        	

	       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	VENDORNUM, VENDORNAME, VENDORURL, VENDORNOTES from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nCode,	@sDesc,	@sURL,	@sNotes
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							SELECT N'x'

							WHERE ipv_code = @nCode

							IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
								INSERT INTO r5ipvendors
								( ipv_code, ipv_desc, ipv_url, ipv_notes )
								VALUES ( @nCode,	@sDesc,	@sURL,	@sNotes )
							ELSE
								UPDATE r5ipvendors
								SET ipv_desc = @sDesc,
								ipv_url = @sURL,

								WHERE ipv_code = @nCode
						end
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nCode,	@sDesc,	@sURL,	@sNotes
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create PROCEDURE KDRV @sV_tenant nvarchar(255)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @nTtimeout                      numeric(38)
	declare @nStop							integer
	declare @nJobid                         integer
	declare @nOtfirst						integer
	declare @dKpistart                      datetime
	declare @sInstalldate                   nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nLockBit						integer
	declare @nReturn						integer
	declare @sTemp							nvarchar(300)
	declare @sChk							nvarchar(5)
    declare @sProducts          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sAspjobs           nvarchar(200)

	set @nLockBit = 0
	set @nOtfirst = 0

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sProducts OUTPUT, N'PRODUCTS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAspjobs OUTPUT, N'ASPJOBS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    set @sProducts = upper(@sProducts)
    set @sAspjobs = coalesce(upper(@sAspjobs), N'OFF')

	IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
	begin
		--the first if block is dead code because none of the values calculated are used.
	
		execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_set_module N'KDRV', N'Starting'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	
		select 1 from r5install where ins_code = N'~KDRV~'
		if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			begin
				set @nOtfirst = 1
				set @nLockBit = 1
			end
		else
			begin
				INSERT INTO r5install (ins_code,ins_desc,ins_comment,ins_fixed)
				VALUES (    N'~KDRV~',
						  N'RUNNING ' + convert (nvarchar(200), dbo.o7gttime2(null), 113),
						  N'KPI Scores',
						  N'-'
					   )
				COMMIT
	
				if @@ERROR <> 0 
					set @nLockBit = 0
				else		
					set @nLockBit = 1
			end
	
		
		if @nLockBit = 1
			begin
				--begin get_timeout
				SELECT @nTtimeout = convert (numeric(38), ins_desc)
				FROM   r5install
				WHERE  ins_code = N'KPISLEEP'
				if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
					set @nTtimeout = 1
				--end get_timeout
				
				set @nStop = 0
				
				execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_set_module N'KDRV', N'Processing'
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
								
				if @nOtfirst = 0 
					set @dKpistart = Getdate() + @nTtimeout
				else
					begin
						SELECT @sInstalldate = ins_desc
						FROM   r5install
						WHERE  ins_code = N'KPIDATE'
						if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
							set @sInstalldate = convert(nvarchar(200), GetDate(), 113 )
	
						set @dKpistart = convert (datetime, @sInstalldate, 113)
						set @dKpistart = @dKpistart + @nTtimeout
                    end

				--begin process_rows
				set @nStop = 0
				IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
				begin
					select @nStop = count(*)
					FROM r5install
					WHERE ins_code = N'~SKDRV~'
	
				end

				if @nStop = 0
					begin	
						execute @nReturn = O7KPISCORES_CALSCORES
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									return -1
			
						COMMIT
					end	
				--end process_rows
				if @nOtfirst = 0 
					begin
						set @dKpistart = Getdate() + @nTtimeout
						INSERT INTO r5install (ins_code, ins_desc, ins_comment,ins_fixed )
						VALUES ( N'KPIDATE', convert(nvarchar(200),  @dKpistart, 113), N'KPI JOB START', N'+' )
						COMMIT
					end
				else
					begin
						UPDATE r5install
						SET    ins_desc = convert( nvarchar(200), @dKpistart, 113 )
						WHERE  ins_code = N'KPIDATE'
						COMMIT
					end
				
				if @nStop != 0
					begin 
						--begin unlock_exclusive
						DELETE
						FROM r5install
						WHERE ins_code LIKE N'%KDRV%'
						COMMIT
						--end unlock_exclusive
					end
				else
					begin
						set @sTemp = N'KDRV(''' + @sV_tenant + ''')'
						execute @nReturn = DBMS_JOB_submit @nJobid,@sTemp,@dKpistart
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
						commit
	
					end 
				
			end
	
		else
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'KDRV', N'PROC', 1
					return -1
			end
	
		
		execute @nReturn = DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_set_module N'KDRV', N'Exiting'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
	else
	begin
		set @nStop = 0
		IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
		begin
			select @nStop = count(*)
			FROM r5install
			WHERE ins_code = N'~SKDRV~'
		end

		if @nStop = 0
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7KPISCORES_CALSCORES
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				commit
			end
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE MAILSQL_GET_DATATYPE  @sTable nvarchar(30), @sColumn nvarchar(30), @sType nvarchar(30) OUTPUT, @sDeclare nvarchar(30) OUTPUT
AS BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @sPrec nvarchar(20)
  declare @sScale nvarchar(20)

  /*set default values*/
  set @sType = N'nvarchar'  
  set @sDeclare = N'nvarchar(200)'
  set @sPrec = N''
  set @sScale = N''

  /*Using sql server system tables, fetch the datatype and size/precision/scale of the given table column*/
  select @sType = lower(c.name), 
         @sPrec = cast(a.prec as nvarchar(20)),
         @sScale = cast(a.scale as nvarchar(20))
  from syscolumns a, sysobjects b, systypes c
  where a.id = b.id and b.xtype='U' and b.name=@sTable and a.name=@sColumn
  and a.xtype = c.xtype and a.xusertype = c.xusertype

  if @sPrec <> N'' begin
    set @sDeclare = @sType + case @sType when N'nvarchar' then N'(' + @sPrec + N')'
                                         when N'numeric' then N'(' + @sPrec + N',' + @sScale + N')'
                                         when N'nchar' then N'(' + @sPrec + N')'
                                         else N'' end
  end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACDINT   @nAcitransid    numeric(38),
                            @nInttransid    numeric(38)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sAccount       nvarchar(200)
    declare @nAcdcode       bigint
    declare @sAccounted     nvarchar(2)
    declare @sChk           nvarchar(3)
    declare @sTranstype     nvarchar(4)

    declare @sACITranstype  nvarchar(4)
    declare @nACICode       bigint
    declare @sACIAccounted  nvarchar(2)
    declare @sACIAlias      nvarchar(45)
    declare @sACIRentity    nvarchar(4)

    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @nRowcount      int
    declare @bExists        bit
    declare @bAcdExists     bit
    declare @nError         int

    DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
    WHERE  ine_transid = @nAcitransid

    SELECT @sACITranstype   = aci_transtype,
           @nACICode        = aci_code,
           @sACIAccounted   = aci_accounted,
           @sACIAlias       = aci_alias,
           @sACIRentity     = aci_rentity
    FROM   r5accountdetailinterface
    WHERE  aci_transid = @nAcitransid

    set @sTranstype = @sACITranstype
    set @nAcdcode = @nACICode
    set @sAccount = coalesce( dbo.o7dflt2( N'ACCOUNT' ), N'NO' )

    if ( @sAccount = N'YES' and ( @sACIAccounted is null or @sACIAccounted not in ('CR', 'DR')) OR
        ( @sAccount = N'NO' and coalesce( @sACIAccounted, N'*' ) <> N'*' ) )
        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7interface_interr @nInttransid, N'2', N'O7ACDINT', N'PROC', null, null, null, null
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
            return
        end

    set @sAccounted = coalesce( @sACIAccounted, N'*' )

    if @nACICode is null
        begin
            if @sACIAlias is null 
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = o7interface_interr @nInttransid, N'3', N'O7ACDINT', N'PROC', null, null, null, null
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1
                    return
                end
            else
                begin
                    select @nAcdcode = acd_code
                    FROM r5accountdetail
                    WHERE acd_alias     = @sACIAlias
                    AND(( @sAccount      = N'NO'
                    AND   acd_accounted = N'*' )
                    OR  ( @sAccount      = N'YES'
                    AND   acd_accounted = @sAccounted ))

                    set @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT

                    if @nRowcount > 1
                        begin
                            execute @nReturn = o7interface_interr @nInttransid, N'5', N'O7ACDINT', N'PROC', null, null, null, null
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                return -1
                            return
                        end

                    if @nRowcount = 0
                        begin
                            execute @nReturn = o7interface_interr @nInttransid, N'4', N'O7ACDINT', N'PROC', null, null, null, null
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                return -1
                            return
                        end
                end
        end

    set @bExists = 0
    
    if exists ( select 1
                FROM r5accountdetail
                WHERE acd_code      = @nAcdcode
                AND(( @sAccount      = N'NO'
                AND   acd_accounted = N'*' )
                OR  ( @sAccount      = N'YES'
                AND   acd_accounted = @sAccounted )) )
        set @bExists = 1

    set @bAcdExists = 0

    if @sACIRentity = N'EVNT'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5events where evt_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'BOOK'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5bookedhours where boo_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'REQ'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5requisitions where req_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'REQL'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5requislines where rql_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'TRAN'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5transactions where tra_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'TRL'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5translines where trl_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'OBJ'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5objects where obj_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'PORD'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5orders where ord_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'PORL'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from r5orderlines where orl_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    if @sACIRentity = N'TOOL'
        begin
            if exists ( select 1 from R5TOOLUSAGE where tou_acd = @nAcdcode )
                set @bAcdExists = 1
        end

    
    if @bAcdExists = 0
        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7interface_interr @nInttransid, N'1', N'O7ACDINT', N'PROC', null, null, null, null
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
            return
        end

    if @sACITranstype = N'A'
        begin
            if @bExists = 0
                begin
                    INSERT INTO r5accountdetail ( acd_code,
                                                  acd_accounted,
                                                  acd_rentity,
                                                  acd_segment1,
                                                  acd_segment2,
                                                  acd_segment3,
                                                  acd_segment4,
                                                  acd_segment5,
                                                  acd_segment6,
                                                  acd_segment7,
                                                  acd_segment8,
                                                  acd_segment9,
                                                  acd_segment10,
                                                  acd_segment11,
                                                  acd_segment12,
                                                  acd_segment13,
                                                  acd_segment14,
                                                  acd_segment15,
                                                  acd_segment16,
                                                  acd_segment17,
                                                  acd_segment18,
                                                  acd_segment19,
                                                  acd_segment20,
                                                  acd_segment21,
                                                  acd_segment22,
                                                  acd_segment23,
                                                  acd_segment24,
                                                  acd_segment25,
                                                  acd_segment26,
                                                  acd_segment27,
                                                  acd_segment28,
                                                  acd_segment29,
                                                  acd_segment30,
                                                  acd_usrattr1
