CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACDIU    @nTransid   numeric(38),
                            @sRentity   nvarchar(4),
                            @sAcdcode   nvarchar(38),
                            @sAcdalias  nvarchar(45),
                            @sErrchk    nvarchar(6) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sAccount   nvarchar(200)
    declare @nAcdcode   bigint
    declare @sChk       nvarchar(3)
    declare @nRowcount  numeric(38)
    declare @nReturn    int
    declare @nError     int

    set @sErrchk = N'0'
    set @nAcdcode = cast( @sAcdcode as bigint )
    set @sAccount = coalesce( dbo.o7dflt2( N'ACCOUNT' ), N'NO')

    if @sAcdcode is null
        begin
            select @nAcdcode = acd_code
              from r5accountdetail
             where acd_alias = @sAcdalias
               and ( ( @sAccount = N'NO'
                        and acd_accounted = N'*' )
                    OR
                     ( @sAccount = N'YES'
                        and acd_accounted = N'CR' ) )

            set @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
            if @nRowcount > 1
                begin
                    set @sErrchk = N'2'
                    return
                end

            if @nRowcount = 0
                begin
                    set @sErrchk = N'1'
                    return
                end
        end

    if NOT exists ( select 1 from r5accountdetail 
                    where acd_code = @nAcdcode
                      and ( ( @sAccount = N'NO'
                               and acd_accounted = N'*' )
                           OR
                            ( @sAccount = N'YES'
                               and acd_accounted = N'CR' ) ) )
        begin
            if @sAccount = N'YES'
                begin
                    INSERT INTO r5accountdetail ( acd_code, acd_rentity, acd_alias, acd_accounted )
                    VALUES ( @nAcdcode, @sRentity, @sAcdalias, N'CR' )
                    -- We'll pretend that SQL Server has error handling.  BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAH!!!!
                    set @nError = @@ERROR
                    if @nError <> 0
                        begin
                            set @sErrchk = N'3'
                            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
                        end

                    INSERT INTO r5accountdetail ( acd_code, acd_rentity, acd_alias, acd_accounted )
                    VALUES ( @nAcdcode, @sRentity, @sAcdalias, N'DR' )
                    set @nError = @@ERROR
                    if @nError <> 0
                        begin
                            set @sErrchk = N'3'
                            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
                        end
                end
            else
                begin
                    INSERT INTO r5accountdetail ( acd_code, acd_rentity, acd_alias, acd_accounted )
                    VALUES ( @nAcdcode, @sRentity, @sAcdalias, '*' )
                    set @nError = @@ERROR
                    if @nError <> 0
                        begin
                            set @sErrchk = N'3'
                            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
                        end
                end
        end
    else
        begin
            UPDATE r5accountdetail
            SET    acd_alias = @sAcdalias
            WHERE  acd_code  = @nAcdcode

            set @nError = @@ERROR
            if @nError <> 0
                begin
                    set @sErrchk = N'4'
                    GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
                end
        end
return

ERROR_HANDLER:
    execute @nReturn = o7interface_interr @nTransid, @nError, N'O7ACDINT', N'ORACLE', N'UPD ACD', null, null, null
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

name: O7ACTDMA
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACTDMA   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),
							@sClass			nvarchar(80),
							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
							@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sInsclause		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)			
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(800)	
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost2			numeric(30,6)
	declare @nHours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours2		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPos			int
	declare @sActclause		nvarchar(2000)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''

    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	if @sSource = N'ACT'
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sCode )
			set @sEvent = substring( @sCode, 1, @nPos - 1 )
            --ensure no conversion error
            if @sCode is not null and isnumeric( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) ) = 0
                return
			set @nAct = cast( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) as numeric(8) )
			set @sActclause = N' and trl_act = @nAct '
		end
	else
		set @sEvent = @sCode

	/* NOTE: CEV and BAN are special cases and their functionality has been split out from 
	*			the main code in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  CEV uses
	*			the rownum keyword that doesn't exist in SQL Server.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  Those two functionalities
	*			have been broken out and the rest should resemble the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N''RETN'' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END *
													( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
														isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
														dbo.O7AXTDMA( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org,
																  t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ), 2 ) costs,
										isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) rate,
										 CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N''RETN'' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END *
													isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) qty,
										 t.trl_event act_event,
										 t.trl_act act_act,
										 t.trl_sqlidentity recid 
								from r5transactions a, r5translines t, r5ububat u 
								where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code
								 and    a.tra_rstatus = N''A''
								 and    t.trl_io      = 0
								 and    t.trl_rtype   IN ( N''RECV'', N''RETN'', N''MISC'' )
								 and t.trl_event = u.bub_event
								 and u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
								 and t.trl_date between	CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) and
														CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by t.trl_price,
										CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N''RETN'' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END *
													isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ),
										t.trl_event,
										t.trl_act,
										t.trl_sqlidentity '
			return
		end

	--the BAN portion returns out so the else after the CEV part is OK.
	IF @sSource  = N'CEV'
		begin
			CREATE TABLE #r5calcevtlines
				(cost      NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
				,event     NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
				,increment NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
				,line      INT            IDENTITY                             NOT NULL
				,rtype     NVARCHAR(8)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subevent  NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subact    NUMERIC(8, 0)                                           NULL
				,part     NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL
				,partorg  NVARCHAR(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,qty     NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL)

			INSERT INTO #r5calcevtlines
										( cost
										 ,event
										 ,increment
										 ,rtype
										 ,subevent
										 ,subact
										 ,part
										 ,partorg
										 ,qty) 
	  		select sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N'RETN' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END *
													( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
														isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
														dbo.O7AXTDMA( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org,
																  t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ) costs
	  			   ,@sCode 
				   ,@sClass
				   ,N'DMA'
				   ,t.trl_event
				   , t.trl_act
				   ,t.trl_part
				   , t.trl_part_org
				   , t.trl_qty
			FROM r5transactions a, r5translines t
			where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code
					and    a.tra_rstatus = N'A'
					and    t.trl_io      = 0
					and    t.trl_rtype   IN ( N'RECV', N'RETN', N'MISC' )
					and   t.trl_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))
			GROUP BY  t.trl_sqlidentity
					  ,t.trl_event
					  ,t.trl_act
					  ,t.trl_part
					  ,t.trl_part_org
					  ,t.trl_qty

			INSERT INTO r5calcevtlines
				  (cel_cost
				  ,cel_event
				  ,cel_increment
				  ,cel_line
				  ,cel_rtype
				  ,cel_subevent
				  ,cel_subact
				  ,cel_part
				  ,cel_part_org
				  ,cel_qty)
			SELECT cost
				 ,event
				 ,increment
				 ,(line + 4000)
				 ,rtype
				 ,subevent
				 ,subact
				 ,part
				 ,partorg
				 ,qty 
			FROM #r5calcevtlines
			
			DROP TABLE #r5calcevtlines
		end
	else
		begin
			/* Set from statement */
			IF @sSource in ( N'OSVCST', N'EVT', N'ORCSTL', N'ACT' ) 
				set @sFromstat = N'r5transactions a, r5translines t '
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'PRJ'
				set @sFromstat = N'r5transactions a, r5translines t, r5events e '
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5transactions a, r5translines t, r5ububat u '
			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N''RETN'' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END *
											( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
												isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
												dbo.O7AXTDMA( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org,
														  t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ), 2 )
								 from ' + @sFromstat +
							   N' where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code
								 and    a.tra_rstatus = N''A''
								 and    t.trl_io      = 0
								 and    t.trl_rtype   IN ( N''RECV'', N''RETN'', N''MISC'' )'
			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and t.trl_event in

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACTFIX   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),
							@sClass			nvarchar(80),
							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
							@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sInsclause		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)			
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(800)	
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost2			numeric(30,6)
	declare @nHours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours2		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPos			int
	declare @sActclause		nvarchar(2000)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''

    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	if @sSource = N'ACT'
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sCode )
			set @sEvent = substring( @sCode, 1, @nPos - 1 )
            --ensure no conversion error
            if @sCode is not null and isnumeric( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) ) = 0
                return
			set @nAct = cast( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) as numeric(8) )
			set @sActclause = N' and boo_act = @nAct '
		end
	else
		set @sEvent = @sCode

	/* NOTE: CEV and BAN are special cases and their functionality has been split out from 
	*			the main code in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  CEV uses
	*			the rownum keyword that doesn't exist in SQL Server.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  Those two functionalities
	*			have been broken out and the rest should resemble the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs,
										null  rate,
										null  qty,
										b.boo_event act_event,
										b.boo_act act_act,
										b.boo_sqlidentity recid
	                 			from  r5ububat u, r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l on b.boo_event = l.orl_event
	                 												   and b.boo_act = l.orl_act 
	                			where ( ( l.orl_rtype = N''SF'' and not ( l.orl_rstatus = N''C'' and coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) = 0 ) ) or
										b.boo_routertype = N''SF'' ) 
										and   b.boo_date between CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) and
																	CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								 and   b.boo_event = u.bub_event
								 and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
								group by b.boo_event,
										 b.boo_act,
										 b.boo_sqlidentity '
			return
		end

	--the BAN portion returns out so the else after the CEV part is OK.
	IF @sSource  = N'CEV'
		begin
			CREATE TABLE #r5calcevtlines
				(cost      NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
				,event     NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
				,increment NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
				,line      INT            IDENTITY                             NOT NULL
				,rtype     NVARCHAR(8)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subevent  NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subact    NUMERIC(8, 0)                                           NULL
				,trade     NVARCHAR(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,octype    NVARCHAR(4)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,hours     NUMERIC(12, 2)                                          NULL)

			INSERT INTO #r5calcevtlines
										( cost
										 ,event
										 ,increment
										 ,rtype
										 ,subevent
										 ,subact
										 ,trade
										 ,octype
										 ,hours) 
	  		select sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ) 
	  			   ,@sCode 
				   ,@sClass
				   ,N'FIX'
				   ,b.boo_event
				   ,b.boo_act
				   ,b.boo_trade
				   ,b.boo_octype
				   ,b.boo_hours 
			FROM r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l on b.boo_event = l.orl_event
                 												   and b.boo_act = l.orl_act
			where ( ( l.orl_rtype = N'SF' and not ( l.orl_rstatus = N'C' and coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) = 0 ) )
					or b.boo_routertype = N'SF')
				  and   b.boo_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))
			GROUP BY   b.boo_sqlidentity
					  ,b.boo_event
					  ,b.boo_act
					  ,b.boo_trade
					  ,b.boo_octype
					  ,b.boo_hours 

			INSERT INTO r5calcevtlines
				  (cel_cost
				  ,cel_event
				  ,cel_increment
				  ,cel_line
				  ,cel_rtype
				  ,cel_subevent
				  ,cel_subact
				  ,cel_trade
				  ,cel_octype
				  ,cel_hours)
			SELECT cost
				  ,event
				  ,increment
				  ,(line + 5000)
				  ,rtype
				  ,subevent
				  ,subact
				  ,trade
				  ,octype
				  ,hours
			FROM #r5calcevtlines
			
			DROP TABLE #r5calcevtlines
		end
	else
		begin
    		IF @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sFromstat = N'r5ububat u, r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l on b.boo_event = l.orl_event
	                 												   and b.boo_act = l.orl_act '
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5bookedhours b left outer join r5orderlines l on b.boo_event = l.orl_event
																					and b.boo_act = l.orl_act '

			/* Set select statement it self */
			

			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
								  from  ' + @sFromstat +
								N' where ((b.boo_misc = ''+'' and b.boo_ocrtype = ''X'' and coalesce( l.orl_rtype, N''SF'' ) = N''SF'' ) or (b.boo_misc = N''-'' and ( ( l.orl_rtype = N''SF'' and not
										( l.orl_rstatus = N''C'' and coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) = 0 ) ) or
										b.boo_routertype = N''SF'' ))) '

			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and b.boo_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))'
			set @sEvtclause1 = N' and b.boo_event = @sCode '
			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = N' and ((l.orl_projbud like @sClass
										and b.boo_date between
										CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
										CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
										and l.orl_project in ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))) or 
									  (exists (select 1 from r5events where evt_code = b.boo_event and b.boo_misc = ''+'' and b.boo_ocrtype = ''X''
																		and evt_project in ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))  )))'
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = N' and   b.boo_date between
							  CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
							   CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
						 and   b.boo_event = u.bub_event
						 and   u.bub_code  = @sCode '
			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  @sSource  */
			IF @sSource  IN (N'OSVCST', N'ORCSTL')
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause1
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'EVT'
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'ACT'
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause + @sActclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
			ELSE
				set @sAndclause = N

AS

	set @sExtracol = N''

	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

  DECLARE @orlreqline   NUMERIC( 8 )

  DECLARE @orlsuporg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objcode      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objstore     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objpart      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objpartorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objbin       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objlot       NVARCHAR( 12 )
  DECLARE @objobrtype   NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @objobtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )

  EXECUTE O7DFLT @childtxn OUTPUT, N'CHILDTXN', @chk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE O7DFLT @rspcomp  OUTPUT, N'RSPCOMP',  @chk OUTPUT

  EXECUTE O7SESS_CUR_USER @eamuser OUTPUT
  SET @eamuser = COALESCE( @peamuser, @eamuser, N'R5' )

  /* Determine org. */
  IF @event IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      SELECT @org = evt_org
      FROM   r5events
      WHERE  evt_code = @event
      IF @org IS NULL

    END
  ELSE IF @pk IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SELECT @org = evt_org
      FROM   r5repairbins, r5events
      WHERE  evt_code = rpb_event
      AND    rpb_pk   = @pk
      IF @org IS NULL
        RETURN
    END
  ELSE
    SET @org = @poorg

  DECLARE rpb CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT rpb_pk, rpb_qty, rpb_event, rpb_store, rpb_part, rpb_part_org, rpb_bin, rpb_lot, rpb_object, rpb_object_org,
           orl_order, orl_order_org, orl_ordline, orl_req, orl_reqline, orl_supplier, orl_supplier_org
    FROM   r5repairbins r, r5orderlines
    WHERE  rpb_req       = orl_req
    AND    rpb_reqline   = orl_reqline
    AND    orl_order     = @po
    AND    orl_order_org = @poorg
    AND    orl_ordline   = ISNULL( @poline, orl_ordline )
    AND    orl_active    = N'+'
    AND    orl_rtype     = N'RE'
    AND    @action IN ( N'ACT', N'DEACT' )
    UNION  
    SELECT rpb_pk, rpb_qty, rpb_event, rpb_store, rpb_part, rpb_part_org, rpb_bin, rpb_lot, rpb_object, rpb_object_org, 
           NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
    FROM   r5repairbins
    WHERE  rpb_event    = @event
    AND    rpb_part     = @part
    AND    rpb_part_org = @partorg
    AND    @action       = N'ASS' 
    AND    rpb_object IS NOT NULL AND rpb_qty = 0 
    UNION  
    SELECT rpb_pk, rpb_qty, rpb_event, rpb_store, rpb_part, rpb_part_org, rpb_bin, rpb_lot, rpb_object, rpb_object_org, 
           NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
    FROM   r5repairbins
    WHERE  rpb_event    = @event
    AND    rpb_part     = @part
    AND    rpb_part_org = @partorg
    AND    @action IN ( N'ACT', N'DEACT', N'TABACT', N'TABDEACT' )
    AND    @deltaqty IS NULL
    UNION  
    SELECT rpb_pk, rpb_qty, rpb_event, rpb_store, rpb_part, rpb_part_org, rpb_bin, rpb_lot, rpb_object, rpb_object_org, 
           NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
    FROM   r5repairbins
    WHERE  rpb_pk = @pk
    AND    ( @action = N'DEL' OR @deltaqty IS NOT NULL )
  OPEN rpb
  FETCH NEXT FROM rpb INTO @rpbpk, @rpbqty, @rpbevent, @rpbstore, @rpbpart, @rpbpartorg, @rpbbin, @rpblot, @rpbobject, @rpbobjectorg,
                           @orlorder, @orlorderorg, @orlordline, @orlreq, @orlreqline, @orlsupplier, @orlsuporg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Loop through all repair bin records. */
      SET @transline = 0
      /* Set to columns, depending on PO. */
      IF @po IS NULL
        BEGIN
          SET @torent = N'EVNT'
          SET @tocode = @rpbevent
          SET @toorg  = NULL
        END
      ELSE
        SELECT @torent = N'COMP', 
               @tocode  = ord_supplier,
               @toorg   = ord_supplier_org
        FROM   r5orders
        WHERE  ord_code = @po
        AND    ord_org  = @poorg

      IF @action = N'TABACT' AND @deltaqty IS NOT NULL
        SET @qty = @deltaqty
      ELSE IF @action IN ( N'ACT', N'TABACT' ) 
        BEGIN
          SET @qty     = @rpbqty
          SET @rstatus = N'CIR'
        END
      ELSE IF @action = N'ASS' 
        BEGIN
          SET @qty     = 1
          SET @rstatus = N'CIR'
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @qty     = -@rpbqty
          SET @rstatus = N'CRR'
        END

      EXECUTE r5o7_o7ucode @status OUTPUT, @rstatus, N'OBST', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @qty <> 0 
        BEGIN
          DECLARE stc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT '2', obj_code, obj_org, obj_store, obj_part, obj_part_org, obj_bin, obj_lot, obj_obrtype, obj_obtype
            FROM   r5objects, dbo.O7TRANS_DO_TRANS_GET_HIER( @rpbobject, @rpbobjectorg )
            WHERE  obj_code = stc_child
            AND    obj_org  = stc_child_org 
            UNION
            SELECT '1', obj_code, obj_org, obj_store, obj_part, obj_part_org, obj_bin, obj_lot, obj_obrtype, obj_obtype
            FROM   r5objects
            WHERE  obj_code = @rpbobject
            AND    obj_org  = @rpbobjectorg
            UNION
            SELECT '1', NULL, NULL, NULL, @rpbpart, @rpbpartorg, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
            FROM   dual
            WHERE  @rpbobject IS NULL
            ORDER BY 1
          OPEN stc
          FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @orderby, @objcode, @objorg, @objstore, @objpart, @objpartorg, @objbin, @objlot, @objobrtype, @objobtype
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              /* Loop through all objects involved. */
              IF @objpart IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  IF @action NOT LIKE N'TAB%'
                    BEGIN
                      /* Update r5binstock, repair qty. */
                      UPDATE r5binstock
                      SET    bis_repairqty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( bis_repairqty, 0 ) - @qty, 0 )
                      WHERE  bis_store     = ISNULL( @objstore, @rpbstore )
                      AND    bis_part      = @objpart
                      AND    bis_part_org  = @objpartorg
                      AND    bis_bin       = ISNULL( @objbin, @rpbbin )
                      AND    bis_lot       = ISNULL( @objlot, @rpblot )
                      /* Update r5stock, shop/vendor qty. */
                      UPDATE r5stock
                      SET    sto_shopqty    = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( CASE WHEN @po IS NULL THEN ISNULL( sto_shopqty, 0 ) + @qty ELSE sto_shopqty END, 0 ),
                             sto_vendorqty  = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( CASE WHEN @po IS NOT NULL THEN ISNULL( sto_vendorqty, 0 ) + @qty ELSE sto_vendorqty END, 0

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACTLAB   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),
							@sClass			nvarchar(80),
							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
							@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sInsclause		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)			
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(800)	
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost2			numeric(30,6)
	declare @nHours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours2		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPos			int
	declare @sActclause		nvarchar(2000)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''

    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	if @sSource = N'ACT'
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sCode )
			set @sEvent = substring( @sCode, 1, @nPos - 1 )
            --ensure no conversion error
            if @sCode is not null and isnumeric( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) ) = 0
                return
			set @nAct = cast( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) as numeric(8) )
			set @sActclause = N' and boo_act = @nAct '
		end
	else
		set @sEvent = @sCode
	
	/* NOTE: CEV and BAN are special cases and their functionality has been split out from 
	*			the main code in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  CEV uses
	*			the rownum keyword that doesn;t exist in SQL Server.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  Those two functionalities
	*			have been broken out and the rest should resemble the Oracle code more closely.
	*/

	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )  costs,
										b.boo_rate rate,
										b.boo_hours qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										b.boo_sqlidentity recid
								from r5activities a, r5ububat u, r5bookedhours b
								where  a.act_event = b.boo_event
								 and   a.act_act   = b.boo_act
								 and   b.boo_order is null
								 and   b.boo_routertype is null
								 and not ( b.boo_misc = N''+'' and b.boo_ocrtype in ( N''O'', N''X'' ) )
								 and   ( a.act_order is null or b.boo_misc = N''+'' or b.boo_misc = N''I'' )
								 and   b.boo_date between CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) and
															CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								 and   b.boo_event = u.bub_event
								 and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
								group by b.boo_rate,
										 b.boo_hours,
										 a.act_event,
										 a.act_act,
										 b.boo_sqlidentity'
			return
		end

	--the BAN portion returns out so the else after the CEV part is OK.
	IF @sSource  = N'CEV'
		begin
			CREATE TABLE #r5calcevtlines
				(cost      NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
				,event     NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
				,increment NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
				,line      INT            IDENTITY                             NOT NULL
				,rtype     NVARCHAR(8)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subevent  NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subact    NUMERIC(8, 0)                                           NULL
				,trade     NVARCHAR(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,octype    NVARCHAR(4)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,hours     NUMERIC(12, 2)                                          NULL)

			INSERT INTO #r5calcevtlines
										( cost
										 ,event
										 ,increment
										 ,rtype
										 ,subevent
										 ,subact
										 ,trade
										 ,octype
										 ,hours) 
	  		SELECT SUM(ISNULL(b.boo_cost, 0))
	  			   ,@sCode 
				   ,@sClass
				   ,N'LAB'
				   ,b.boo_event
				   ,b.boo_act
				   ,b.boo_trade
				   ,b.boo_octype
				   ,b.boo_hours 
			FROM r5activities a, r5bookedhours b
			where    a.act_event = b.boo_event
					 and    a.act_act   = b.boo_act
					 and    b.boo_order is null
					 and    b.boo_routertype is null
                     and not ( b.boo_misc = N'+' and b.boo_ocrtype = N'O' )
					 and   ( a.act_order is null or b.boo_misc = N'+' )
					 and   b.boo_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))
			GROUP BY   b.boo_event
					  ,b.boo_act
					  ,b.boo_trade
					  ,b.boo_octype
					  ,b.boo_hours 
					  ,b.boo_sqlidentity

			INSERT INTO r5calcevtlines
				  (cel_cost
				  ,cel_event
				  ,cel_increment
				  ,cel_line
				  ,cel_rtype
				  ,cel_subevent
				  ,cel_subact
				  ,cel_trade
				  ,cel_octype
				  ,cel_hours)
			SELECT cost
				 ,event
				 ,increment
				 ,(line + 1000)
				 ,rtype
				 ,subevent
				 ,subact
				 ,trade
				 ,octype
				 ,hours
			FROM #r5calcevtlines
			
			DROP TABLE #r5calcevtlines
		end
	else
		begin
			IF @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sFromstat = N'r5activities a, r5ububat u, r5bookedhours b '
			/* #7272 Edzard Pasma 14 Mar 2000: @sSource EVT2 includes hours */
			ELSE IF @sSource IN (N'OSVCST', N'EVT2' , N'ORCSTL2')
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5activities a, r5bookedhours b '
					set @sExtracol = N', @nHours = sum( b.boo_hours )'
				end
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5activities a, r5bookedhours b '
		   
			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( b.boo_cost, 0 ) ), 2 ) '
						 + @sExtracol + N' 
						 from ' + @sFromstat +
					   N' where  a.act_event = b.boo_event
						 and    a.act_act   = b.boo_act
						 and    b.boo_order is null
						 and    b.boo_routertype is null
						 and not ( b.boo_misc = N''+'' and b.boo_ocrtype in ( N''O'', N''X'' ) )
						 and   ( a.act_order is null or b.boo_misc = N''+'' or b.boo_misc = N''I'' ) '
			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and   b.boo_event in
							 ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))'
			set @sEvtclause1 = N'and   b.boo_event = @sCode '
			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = N' and   b.boo_date between
							  CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
							  CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
						 and   a.act_projbud like @sClass
						 and a.act_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'
						 
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = N'and   b.boo_date between
							   CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
							   CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
						 and   b.boo_event = u.bub_event
						 and   u.bub_code  = @sCode '
			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  @sSource  */
			IF @sSource IN (N'OSVCST', 'ORCSTL', N'ORCSTL2')
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause1
			ELSE IF  @sSource IN ('EVT', N'EVT2')
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'ACT'
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause + @sActclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'PRJ'
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
			ELSE
				set @sAnd

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACTMAT   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),
							@sClass			nvarchar(80),
							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
							@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sInsclause		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)			
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(800)	
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost2			numeric(30,6)
	declare @nHours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours2		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPos			int
	declare @sActclause		nvarchar(2000)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''

    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	if @sSource = N'ACT'
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sCode )
			set @sEvent = substring( @sCode, 1, @nPos - 1 )
            --ensure no conversion error
            if @sCode is not null and isnumeric( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) ) = 0
                return
			set @nAct = cast( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) as numeric(8) )
			set @sActclause = N' and trl_act = @nAct '
		end
	else
		set @sEvent = @sCode

	/* NOTE: CEV and BAN are special cases and their functionality has been split out from 
	*			the main code in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  CEV uses
	*			the rownum keyword that doesn't exist in SQL Server.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  Those two functionalities
	*			have been broken out and the rest should resemble the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
											isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs, 
										isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) rate,
										isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) qty,
										t.trl_event act_event,
										t.trl_act act_act,
										t.trl_sqlidentity recid 
								from r5translines t, r5ububat u
								where ( ( t.trl_rtype IN ( ''I'', ''RR'')
								and       t.trl_io    = -1 ) or ( t.trl_rtype IN ( ''INVA'' )
								and       t.trl_io    = 0 ) )
								and t.trl_event = u.bub_event
	                 			and u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
	                 			and t.trl_date between CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) and
		                 								CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								group by t.trl_price,
										t.trl_qty,
										t.trl_event,
										t.trl_act,
										t.trl_sqlidentity '
			return
		end

	--the BAN portion returns out so the else after the CEV part is OK.
	IF @sSource = N'CEV'
		begin
			CREATE TABLE #r5calcevtlines
				(cost      NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
				,event     NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
				,increment NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
				,line      INT            IDENTITY                             NOT NULL
				,rtype     NVARCHAR(8)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subevent  NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subact    NUMERIC(8, 0)                                           NULL
				,part      NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL
				,partorg   NVARCHAR(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN   NULL
				,qty       NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL)

			INSERT INTO #r5calcevtlines
										( cost
										 ,event
										 ,increment
										 ,rtype
										 ,subevent
										 ,subact
										 ,part
										 ,partorg
										 ,qty) 
	  		select sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *	isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) costs
	  			   ,@sCode 
				   ,@sClass
				   ,N'MAT'
				   ,t.trl_event
				   ,t.trl_act 
				   ,t.trl_part
				   ,t.trl_part_org
				   ,t.trl_qty
			FROM r5translines t
			where ( ( t.trl_rtype IN ( 'I', 'RR')
			and       t.trl_io    = -1 ) or ( t.trl_rtype IN ( 'INVA' )
			and       t.trl_io    = 0 ) )
				  and t.trl_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))
			GROUP BY   t.trl_sqlidentity
					  ,t.trl_event
			   		  ,t.trl_act 
					  ,t.trl_part
					  ,t.trl_part_org
					  ,t.trl_qty

			INSERT INTO r5calcevtlines
				  (cel_cost
				  ,cel_event
				  ,cel_increment
				  ,cel_line
				  ,cel_rtype
				  ,cel_subevent
				  ,cel_subact
				  ,cel_part, cel_part_org, cel_qty)
			SELECT cost
				 ,event
				 ,increment
				 ,(line + 2000)
				 ,rtype
				 ,subevent
				 ,subact
				 ,part
				 ,partorg
				 ,qty
			FROM #r5calcevtlines
			
			DROP TABLE #r5calcevtlines
		end
	else
		begin
			/* Set from statement */
			IF @sSource in ( N'OSVCST', N'EVT', N'ORCSTL', N'ACT' )
				set @sFromstat = N'r5translines t '
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sFromstat = N'r5translines t, r5events e '
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5translines t, r5ububat u '
			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) *
											isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
	                 			from ' + @sFromstat +
									N' where ( ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N''I'', N''RR'')
									 and       t.trl_io    = -1 ) or
											 ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N''INVA'' )
									 and       t.trl_io    = 0 ) )'
			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and t.trl_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))'
			set @sEvtclause1 = N' and t.trl_event = @sCode '
			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = N' and t.trl_event = e.evt_code
							 and t.trl_date between
							 CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
							 CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
							 and e.evt_projbud like @sClass
							 and e.evt_project in
							   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = N' and t.trl_event = u.bub_event
	                 			and u.bub_code  = @sCode
	                 			and t.trl_date between
	                     		CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
		                 		CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)'
			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  @sSource  */
			IF @sSource IN (N'OSVCST', N'ORCSTL' )
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause1
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'ACT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause + @sActclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
			ELSE
				set @sAndclause = N''
			
			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode  nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(30), @sCharfrom	nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @nAct numeric(8), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @nAct, @sEvent
			If @@ERROR <> 0 
				return - 1
		end

create function O7ACTQTY( @sEvent nvarchar(30), @nAct numeric(8) )
returns numeric(10,2)
as
begin
	declare @nResult		numeric(10,2)
	declare @nCount 		integer

	if @sEvent is null or @nAct is null
		return (1)

	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5activities
	WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
	AND    act_act = @nAct


	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nResult = coalesce(act_qty, 1)
		FROM   r5activities
		WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
		AND    act_act = @nAct
	else
		set @nResult = 1


	return (@nResult)
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ACTTOOL   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),
							@sClass			nvarchar(80),
							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
							@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sInsclause		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)	
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)			
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(800)	
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost2			numeric(30,6)
	declare @nHours			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nHours2		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPos			int
	declare @sActclause		nvarchar(2000)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''

    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	if @sSource = N'ACT'
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sCode )
			set @sEvent = substring( @sCode, 1, @nPos - 1 )
            --ensure no conversion error
            if @sCode is not null and isnumeric( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) ) = 0
                return
			set @nAct = cast( substring( @sCode, @nPos + 1, len( @sCode ) ) as numeric(8) )
			set @sActclause = N' and tou_act = @nAct '
		end
	else
		set @sEvent = @sCode

	/* NOTE: CEV and BAN are special cases and their functionality has been split out from 
	*			the main code in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  CEV uses
	*			the rownum keyword that doesn't exist in SQL Server.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  Those two functionalities
	*			have been broken out and the rest should resemble the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( isnull( t.tou_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )  costs, 
										t.tou_tariff rate, 
										t.tou_hours * t.tou_qty qty,
										t.tou_event act_event, 
										t.tou_act act_act, 
										t.tou_sqlidentity recid
								from r5toolusage t, r5activities a, r5events e, r5ububat u 
								where  a.act_event = t.tou_event
				                and    a.act_event = e.evt_code
								and    a.act_act   = t.tou_act 
								and   t.tou_dateused between CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) and
																CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								and   t.tou_event = u.bub_event
								and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
								group by t.tou_tariff,
										t.tou_hours * t.tou_qty,
										t.tou_event, 
										t.tou_act, 
										t.tou_sqlidentity '
			return
		end

	--the BAN portion returns out so the else after the CEV part is OK.
	IF @sSource  = N'CEV'
		begin
			CREATE TABLE #r5calcevtlines
				(cost      NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
				,event     NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
				,increment NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
				,line      INT            IDENTITY                             NOT NULL
				,rtype     NVARCHAR(8)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subevent  NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
				,subact    NUMERIC(8, 0)                                           NULL
				,tool     NVARCHAR(12)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN      NULL
				,qty       NUMERIC(24, 6)     									   NULL
				,hours     NUMERIC(12, 2)                                          NULL)

			INSERT INTO #r5calcevtlines
										( cost
										 ,event
										 ,increment
										 ,rtype
										 ,subevent
										 ,subact
										 ,tool
										 ,qty
										 ,hours) 
	  		select sum( isnull( t.tou_cost, 0 ) )
	  			   ,@sCode 
				   ,@sClass
				   ,N'TOOL'
				   ,t.tou_event
				   ,t.tou_act
				   ,t.tou_tool
				   ,t.tou_qty
				   ,t.tou_hours
			FROM r5toolusage t, r5events e, r5activities a
			where  a.act_event = t.tou_event
				   and    a.act_act   = t.tou_act
                   and    a.act_event = e.evt_code
				   and   t.tou_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))
			GROUP BY   t.tou_sqlidentity
					   ,t.tou_event
			   		  ,t.tou_act
					  ,t.tou_tool
					  ,t.tou_qty
					  ,t.tou_hours

			INSERT INTO r5calcevtlines
				  (cel_cost
				  ,cel_event
				  ,cel_increment
				  ,cel_line
				  ,cel_rtype
				  ,cel_subevent
				  ,cel_subact
				  ,cel_tool
				  , cel_qty
				  , cel_hours)
			SELECT cost
				 ,event
				 ,increment
				 ,(line + 6000)
				 ,rtype
				 ,subevent
				 ,subact
				 ,tool
				 ,qty
				 ,hours
			FROM #r5calcevtlines
			
			DROP TABLE #r5calcevtlines
		end
	else
		begin
			/* Set from statement */
			IF @sSource = N'BUD' or @sSource = N'BUD2'
				set @sFromstat = N' r5toolusage t, r5activities a, r5events e, r5ububat u '
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N' r5toolusage t, r5events e, r5activities a'
			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( t.tou_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )
								  from ' + @sFromstat +
							   N' where  a.act_event = t.tou_event
								 and    a.act_event = e.evt_code
								 and    a.act_act   = t.tou_act '
			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and   t.tou_event in
							 ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sEvent ))'
			set @sEvtclause1 = N' and   t.tou_event = @sCode '
			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = N' and  t.tou_dateused between
								CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
			             		CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
						 and   a.act_projbud like isnull( @sClass, N''%'')
						 and   a.act_project in
							 ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = N' and   t.tou_dateused between
							   CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
							   CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
							   and   t.tou_event = u.bub_event
							   and   u.bub_code  = @sCode '
			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  @sSource  */
			IF @sSource IN (N'OSVCST', N'ORCSTL' )
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause1
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'ACT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause + @sActclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			ELSE IF  @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'BUD2' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause + ' and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C'' ' 
			ELSE
				set @sAndclause = N''
   			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(30), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @nAct numeric(8), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @nAct, @sEvent
			If @@ERROR <> 0 
				return - 1
		end


-- ========================================

name: O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY

create function O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7ACTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
		
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select PRJ_CODE, @nLevel + 1
										  from R5PROJECTS
										 where PRJ_PARENT = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7ADD_MONTHS (@dStart DATETIME,
                              @nMonths INT)
RETURNS DATETIME AS
BEGIN
    declare @dInputLDM DATETIME /* last day of input month */
    declare @dResult DATETIME
    declare @nDatepart int  /* day part of date */

    set @nDatepart = convert(int, convert(nvarchar(2), @dStart, 103 ))
    set @dResult = dateadd(m, @nMonths, @dStart )

    if @nDatepart >= 28
    begin
        set @dInputLDM = dateadd(dd, -1, dateadd(mm, 1, cast(convert(nvarchar(6), @dStart, 112) + '01' as datetime)))
        if ( @dInputLDM = @dStart )
            set @dResult =  dateadd(dd, -1, dateadd(mm, 1, cast(convert(nvarchar(6), @dResult, 112) + '01' as datetime)))
    end
    return @dResult
END

body:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7ADIINT @nADITranId     NUMERIC(18, 0)
                             ,@nINTTranId     NUMERIC(18, 0)
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sADIPrint       NCHAR(1)
       ,@sADIComment     NVARCHAR(4000)
       ,@sADICode        NVARCHAR(100)
       ,@sADICode1       NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sADILang        NVARCHAR(2)
       ,@sADIUser        NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sADIOrg         NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sADIOrg1        NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sADIRentity     NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sADIEntity      NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sADIEvtAlias    NVARCHAR(45)
       ,@sADIType        NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@nADILine        NUMERIC(12, 0)
       ,@sValidRentity   NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sADDRentity     NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sADDLang        NVARCHAR(2)
       ,@sADDCode        NVARCHAR(100)
       ,@sADDType        NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@nADDLine        NUMERIC(12, 0)
       ,@sADITransType   NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@nADDSQLIdentity INT
       ,@bADDTextPointer VARBINARY(16)
       ,@sMultiOrg       NVARCHAR(8)
       ,@sEvtCode        NVARCHAR(100)
       ,@sEvtRStatus      NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sOrg            NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sOrg1           NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sCode           NVARCHAR(100)
       ,@sDefOrg         NVARCHAR(8)
       ,@sErrorSource    NVARCHAR(20)
       ,@sErrorType      NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sCheck          NVARCHAR(3)
       ,@sFreeText       NCHAR(1)
       ,@nFlag           INT
       ,@nCodeExists     INT
       ,@nReturn         INT
       ,@nError          INT
       ,@nFirstp         integer
       ,@nSecondp        integer 
       ,@sStopart        nvarchar(30)
       ,@sStopartorg     nvarchar(15)
       ,@sStostore       nvarchar(30)
       ,@sPmrvctrl       nvarchar(1)
       ,@nRev            numeric(4)


/* First remove all error messages from r5interfaceerrors */
DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
 WHERE ine_transid = @nADITranId;

SELECT @sADIPrint     = adi_print
      ,@sADIComment   = adi_comment
      ,@sADICode      = adi_code
      ,@sADICode1     = adi_code1
      ,@sADILang      = adi_lang
      ,@sADIUser      = adi_user
      ,@sADIOrg       = adi_org
      ,@sADIOrg1      = adi_org1
      ,@sADIRentity   = adi_rentity
      ,@sADIEntity    = adi_entity
      ,@sADIEvtAlias  = adi_evtalias
      ,@sADIType      = adi_type
      ,@nADILine      = adi_line
      ,@sADITransType = adi_transtype
  FROM r5addetailsinterface
 WHERE adi_transid = @nADITranId

/* Raise error and terminate procedure if adi_user is null or invalid */
IF @sADIUser IS NULL
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'3', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
   IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
     RETURN -1
   RETURN 
   END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM r5users
                WHERE usr_code = @sADIUser
                  AND ISNULL(usr_login, N'+') = N'+')
   BEGIN
	   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'12', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, @sADIUser, NULL, NULL
	   IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
		 RETURN -1
	   RETURN 
   END

IF @sADIRentity = N'EVNT'
	begin
	   IF @sADICode IS NULL
		  BEGIN
			  SELECT @sEvtCode = evt_code
				FROM r5events
			   WHERE evt_code_alias = @sADIEvtAlias
			  IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				 BEGIN
					 EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'15', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, @sADIEvtAlias, NULL, NULL
					 IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
						RETURN -1
					 RETURN 
				 END
		  END
	   ELSE
		  SET @sEvtCode = @sADICode
	end

set @sDefOrg = dbo.O7DFLT2( N'DEFORG' )
set @sMultiOrg = dbo.O7DFLT2( N'MULTIORG' )

SELECT @sErrorSource = N'O7ADIINT'
      ,@sErrorType   = N'PROC'
      ,@sMultiOrg    = UPPER(@sMultiOrg)
      ,@nFlag        = 0

/* Organization code is mandatory when multi-org security is in effect */
IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
	begin
	   IF @sADIOrg IS NULL
		  BEGIN
			  IF @sADIRentity = N'EVENT'
				 BEGIN
					 SELECT @sOrg = EVT.evt_org
					   FROM r5events           EVT
						   ,r5userorganization UOG
					  WHERE EVT.evt_code = @sEvtCode
						AND EVT.evt_org = UOG.uog_org
						AND UOG.uog_user = @sADIUser
						AND UOG.uog_common = N'-'
					 IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 /* No row found in SELECT above */
						SELECT TOP 1 @sOrg = UOG.uog_org
						  FROM r5users            USR
							  ,r5userorganization UOG
						 WHERE USR.usr_code = UOG.uog_user
						   AND UOG.uog_user = @sADIUser
						ORDER BY UOG.uog_default, UOG.uog_org 
				 END
			  /* If @sOrg is still null, then report error and terminate procedure */
			  IF @sOrg IS NULL
				 BEGIN
					 EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'4', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
					 IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
						RETURN -1
					 RETURN
				 END
		  END
	   ELSE
		  BEGIN
			  IF dbo.O7CHECKORG(@sADIOrg, @sADIUser, N'+') = 0
				 BEGIN
					 EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'5', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
					 IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
						RETURN -1
					 RETURN 
				 END
			  IF @sADIOrg1 IS NOT NULL
			  	begin
				 IF dbo.O7CHECKORG(@sADIOrg1, @sADIUser, N'+') = 0
					BEGIN
						EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'5', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
						IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
							RETURN -1
						RETURN
					END
				end
			  SELECT @sOrg = @sADIOrg
					,@sOrg1 = @sADIOrg1
		  END
	end
ELSE
   SELECT @sOrg = @sDefOrg, @sOrg1 = @sDefOrg


/* Validate rentity and entity */
IF @sADIRentity IS NULL AND @sADIEntity IS NULL /* Both can not be null */
   BEGIN
	   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'21', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
	   IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
		 RETURN -1
	   RETURN
   END
ELSE
	begin
		IF @sADIRentity IS NOT NULL AND @sADIEntity IS NULL
		   BEGIN
			   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7UCODE @sADIEntity OUTPUT, @sADIRentity, N'ENTP', @sCheck OUTPUT
			   set @nError = @@ERROR
			   IF @nError != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
				  BEGIN
					  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, @nError, N'O7ADIINT', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
					  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
						RETURN -1
					  RETURN 
				  END
			   IF @sCheck != N'0'
				  BEGIN
					  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'1', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
					  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
						RETURN -1
					  RETURN 
				  END
		   END
		ELSE 
			begin
				IF @sADIRentity IS NULL AND @sADIEntity IS NOT NULL
				   BEGIN
					   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7RCODE @sADIRentity OUTPUT, @sADIEntity, N'ENTP', @sCheck OUTPUT
					   set @nError = @@ERROR
					   IF @nError != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
						  BEGIN
							  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, @nError, N'O7ADIINT', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
							  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
								RETURN -1
							  RETURN 
						  END
					   IF @sCheck != N'0'
						  BEGIN
							  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'23', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
							  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
								RETURN -1
							  RETURN
						  END
				   END
				ELSE
				   BEGIN
					   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7RCODE @sValidRentity OUTPUT, @sADIEntity, N'ENTP', @sCheck OUTPUT
					   set @nError = @@ERROR
					   IF @nError != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
						  BEGIN
							  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, @nError, N'O7ADIINT', N'ORACLE', N'OTHER', NULL, NULL, NULL
							  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0

		RETURN 0
	end

create function O7ADTINT_GETOBJECTHIERARCHY (@sObject   nvarchar(30),
                                             @sOrg      nvarchar(15), 
                                             @sDeforg   nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_child       nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_child_org   nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
   declare @nLevel         int
   declare @sCurrentChild  nvarchar(30)
   declare @sCurrentOrg    nvarchar(15)
      
   declare @tStack table ( stc_child nvarchar(30), stc_child_org nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
   
   insert into @tStack select  stc_child, stc_child, 1 from r5structures
                         where  stc_parent      = @sObject    and
                                stc_parent_org  = coalesce( @sOrg, @sDeforg )
   set @nLevel = 1

   while @nLevel > 0
      begin
         if exists (select * from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel)
            begin
               select @sCurrentChild=stc_child, @sCurrentOrg = stc_child_org from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
               insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentChild, @sCurrentOrg )
               delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel and stc_child = @sCurrentChild and stc_child_org = @sCurrentOrg
               insert into @tStack select stc_child, stc_child_org, @nLevel + 1
                                from r5structures
                                         where stc_parent      = @sCurrentChild    and
                                               stc_parent_org  = @sCurrentOrg
               IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            end
         else
            set @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      end

   return

end

body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7AIRPREV( @pSessionID numeric(18), @pUserID nvarchar(255), @pRole nvarchar(30) = '*' ) AS
    BEGIN

    /* Equipment Selection Parameters List */
    DECLARE @sEquipmentOrg       nvarchar(15) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_org%TYPE
    DECLARE @sAssignedTo         nvarchar(15) -- r5assetinventoryparams.aip_person%TYPE
    DECLARE @sEquipStatus        nvarchar(4) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_status%TYPE
    DECLARE @sEquipClass         nvarchar(8) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_class%TYPE
    DECLARE @sEquipClassOrg      nvarchar(15) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_class_org%TYPE
    DECLARE @sEquipDepartment    nvarchar(15) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_mrc%TYPE
    DECLARE @sParentEquipCode    nvarchar(310) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_parent%TYPE
    DECLARE @sParentEquipOrg     nvarchar(15) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_parent_org%TYPE
    DECLARE @sEquipType          nvarchar(4) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_obj_type%TYPE
    DECLARE @sParentStoreCode    nvarchar(15) --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_parent_store%TYPE
    DECLARE @dInventoryVerificationDate    datetime --r5assetinventoryparams.aip_inventoryverificationdate%TYPE
    DECLARE @sSQL                nvarchar(4000)
    DECLARE @sDEPTSEC            nvarchar(400)
    DECLARE @sObject             nvarchar(30) -- r5objects.obj_code
    DECLARE @sObjectOrg          nvarchar(15) -- r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
    DECLARE @chk                 nvarchar(1)
    DECLARE @nReturn             integer

    /* Used to lookup the session parameters */
    SELECT   @sEquipmentOrg = aip_obj_org, @sAssignedTo= aip_person, @sEquipStatus = aip_obj_status, @sEquipClass = aip_obj_class, @sEquipClassOrg = aip_obj_class_org,
             @sEquipDepartment = aip_mrc, @sParentEquipCode = aip_obj_parent, @sParentEquipOrg = aip_obj_parent_org, @sEquipType = aip_obj_type, @sParentStoreCode = aip_parent_store,
             @dInventoryVerificationDate = aip_inventoryverificationdate
    FROM r5assetinventoryparams
    WHERE aip_sessionid = @pSessionID

    /* Get the Department Security setting */
    SET @sDEPTSEC = N'OFF'
    SELECT @sDEPTSEC = ins_desc
    FROM   r5install
    WHERE ins_code = N'DEPTSEC'

    /* Equipment Selection Criteria*/
    SET @sSQL = N'INSERT INTO #tEquipment '
    
    IF(@sEquipType = 'C')
        BEGIN
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL +
                        N'SELECT o.obj_code, o.obj_org ' +
                        N' FROM r5objects o, r5userorganization u ' +
                        N' WHERE o.obj_rstatus = N''C'' ' +
                        dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'o.obj_store', @sParentStoreCode, N'+', 0)   
        END
    ELSE IF(@sEquipType = 'S')
        BEGIN
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL +
                        N'SELECT s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org ' +
                        N' FROM r5structures s, r5objects o, r5userorganization u ' +
                        N' WHERE o.obj_code = s.stc_child AND o.obj_org = s.stc_child_org ' +
                        N' AND o.obj_rstatus = N''I'' ' +
                        N' AND s.stc_parentrtype = N''S'' AND s.stc_childrtype = o.obj_obrtype ' +
                        dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N's.stc_parent', @sParentEquipCode, N'+', 0) +
                        dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N's.stc_parent_org', @sParentEquipOrg, N'+', 0)
        END 
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL +
                        N'SELECT s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org ' +
                        N' FROM dbo.O7WLSPREV_GET_EQUIP_CHILD_HIERARCHY(''' + @sParentEquipCode + N''',''' + @sParentEquipOrg + N''') AS s, r5objects o, r5userorganization u ' +
                        N' WHERE o.obj_code = s.stc_child AND o.obj_org = s.stc_child_org ' +
                        N' AND o.obj_rstatus = N''I'' '
        
            /* Based on object type, check whether the location\position is not null */
            IF(@sEquipType = 'L')
                BEGIN
                   SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' AND o.obj_location IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5structures where stc_child = s.stc_child AND stc_child_org = s.stc_child_org AND stc_parentrtype IN(N''A'', N''P'') AND coalesce(stc_rolldown, N''-'') = N''+'') '
                END
            ELSE IF(@sEquipType = 'P')
                BEGIN
                   SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' AND o.obj_position IS NOT NULL '
                END
        END
    
    /* Add Parameters criteria */   
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL +
                N' AND u.uog_org = o.obj_org AND u.uog_user = N''' + @pUserID + N''' ' +
                N' AND u.uog_role = N''' + @pRole + N''' ' +
                N' AND o.obj_obrtype = N''A'' ' +
                dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'o.obj_org', @sEquipmentOrg, N'+', 0) +
                dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'o.obj_status', @sEquipStatus, N'+', 0) +
                dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'o.obj_class', @sEquipClass, N'+', 0) +
                dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'o.obj_class_org', @sEquipClassOrg, N'+', 0) +
                dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'o.obj_mrc', @sEquipDepartment, N'+', 0)

    /* Add Inventory Verification Date check if it is provided in the parameters tab */
    IF @dInventoryVerificationDate IS NOT NULL
        SET @sSQL = @sSQL +
                N' AND (obj_inventoryverificationdate IS NULL OR obj_inventoryverificationdate <= CONVERT( DATETIME, ''' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR( 8 ), @dInventoryVerificationDate, 112 ) + N''' ) ) '

    /* Add department security check if DEPTSEC install parameter is turned on */
    IF( UPPER(@sDEPTSEC) IN (N'YES', N'Y', N'ON', N'+') )
        SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' AND (o.obj_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = N''' + @pUserID + N''' AND dse_mrc = o.obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, N''-'') = N''-''))'

    /* Add the equipment that meet the base criteria */
    CREATE TABLE #tEquipment( obj_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN null,
                            obj_org  nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN null)

    EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL

    IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
        BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #tEquipment
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
            RETURN -1
        END

    /* Loop through the temp table containing the equipment records that match the criteria */
    DECLARE cEquipCursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT obj_code, obj_org
    FROM #tEquipment

    OPEN cEquipCursor
    FETCH NEXT FROM cEquipCursor INTO @sObject, @sObjectOrg
    WHILE( @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 )
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5assetinventoryresults
                              WHERE air_sessionid = @pSessionID
                              AND air_obj = @sObject
                              AND air_obj_org = @sObjectOrg )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO r5assetinventoryresults( air_sessionid, air_obj, air_obj_org, air_inventoryverificationdate) VALUES (@pSessionID, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, NULL)
            END
            -- Fetch next equipment matching parameter criteria
            FETCH NEXT FROM cEquipCursor INTO @sObject, @sObjectOrg
        END

    CLOSE cEquipCursor
    DEALLOCATE cEquipCursor
    DROP TABLE #tEquipment

    END

name: O7AIRUPDATE

CREATE PROCEDURE O7AIRUPDATE
  @pTimedependency NVARCHAR(2),
  @pMindate        DATETIME,
  @pMaxdate        DATETIME,
  @pAsset          NVARCHAR(30),
  @pAssetorg       NVARCHAR(15),
  @pPoint          NVARCHAR(30),
  @pMinpm          NVARCHAR(20),
  @pMaxpm          NVARCHAR(20)
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @vPpmdate NVARCHAR(10)

  IF @pMinpm IS NOT NULL OR @pMaxpm IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SELECT @vPpmdate = CASE @pTimedependency
             WHEN N'LD' THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), dbo.F_LEAST_DATE(ISNULL(@pMindate, CONVERT(DATETIME, N'31-12-2150', 105)),
                            ISNULL(MIN(e.epo_mindate), CONVERT(DATETIME, N'31-12-2150', 105))), 105)
             WHEN N'LI' THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), dbo.F_LEAST_DATE(ISNULL(@pMaxdate, CONVERT(DATETIME, N'31-12-2150', 105)),
                            ISNULL(MIN(e.epo_maxdate), CONVERT(DATETIME, N'31-12-2150', 105))), 105)
             ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), dbo.F_LEAST_DATE(ISNULL(@pMindate, @pMaxdate), ISNULL(MIN(e.epo_mindate), MIN(e.epo_maxdate))), 105) END
      FROM     r5eventpoints e, r5events v
      WHERE    e.epo_object       = @pAsset
      AND      e.epo_object_org   = @pAssetorg
      AND      e.epo_point       <> @pPoint
      AND    ( e.epo_result       = N'V' OR  e.epo_result = N'D' )
      AND      e.epo_event        =  v.evt_code
      AND    ( v.evt_routerstatus = N'A' OR e.epo_completed = N'+' )
      AND    ( e.epo_minppm = @pMinpm OR e.epo_maxppm = @pMaxpm )
      AND      NOT EXISTS ( SELECT  p.epo_mindate
                          FROM    r5eventpoints p, r5events t
                          WHERE   p.epo_object       = @pAsset
                          AND     p.epo_object_org   = @pAssetorg
                          AND     p.epo_point       <> @pPoint
                          AND   ( p.epo_result       = N'V' OR
                                  p.epo_result       = N'D' )
                          AND     p.epo_event        = t.evt_code
                          AND   ( t.evt_routerstatus = N'A' OR
                                  p.epo_completed    = N'+' )
                          AND   ( p.epo_minppm = @pMinpm OR e.epo_maxppm = @pMaxpm )
                          AND     p.epo_date         >  e.epo_date )

      IF @vPpmdate <> N'31-12-2150'
        BEGIN
          UPDATE  r5events
          SET     evt_due        = CONVERT(DATETIME, @vPpmdate, 105),
                  evt_target     = CONVERT(DATETIME, @vPpmdate, 105)
          WHERE   evt_ppm        = CASE @pTimedependency WHEN N'LD' THEN @pMinpm WHEN N'LI' THEN @pMaxpm ELSE ISNULL(@pMinpm, @pMaxpm) END
          AND     evt_rstatus    = N'A'
          AND     evt_object     = @pAsset
          AND     evt_object_org = @pAssetorg

          UPDATE  r5ppmobjects
          SET     ppo_due        = CONVERT(DATETIME, @vPpmdate, 105)
          WHERE   ppo_ppm        = CASE @pTimedependency WHEN N'LD' THEN @pMinpm WHEN N'LI' THEN @pMaxpm ELSE ISNULL(@pMinpm, @pMaxpm) END
          AND     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5ppms WHERE ppm_revrstatus = N'A' AND ppm_code = ppo_ppm)
          AND     ppo_object     = @pAsset
          AND     ppo_object_org = @pAssetorg
        END
    END

create procedure O7ALERT_EXECUTESQL @sAlertcode      nvarchar(30),
                                    @sSqltype        nvarchar(4),
                                    @sAbortonfailure nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
                                    @sErrorMsg       nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT,
                                    @sChkresult      nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as 
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sStmt nvarchar(4000)

    set @sChkresult = N'0'

    select @sStmt = als_stmt, 
           @sAbortonfailure = (case when als_rtype = N'B' then als_abortonfailure else N'-' end)
      from r5alertsql
     where als_alert = @sAlertcode
       and als_rtype = @sSqltype
       and als_active = N'+'

    if @sStmt is not null
        begin
            begin try
              set @sStmt = replace ( @sStmt, N':parameter.alert', @sAlertcode )
              execute (@sStmt)
            end try
            begin catch
              set @sChkresult = N'1'
              set @sErrorMsg = substring( ERROR_MESSAGE(), 1, 2000)
            end catch
        end

create procedure O7ALERT_GETFIELDINFO @nGridid     numeric(14),
                                      @nDdspyid    numeric(14),
                                      @nFieldid    numeric(14),
                                      @sLangid     nvarchar(2),
                                      @sFieldalias nvarchar(60) OUTPUT,
                                      @sFieldlabel nvarchar(255) OUTPUT
as 
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    if @nGridid is not null and @nDdspyid is not null and @nFieldid is not null and @sLangid is not null
        select @sFieldalias = gfd_tagname, 
               @sFieldlabel = bot_text
          from r5boilertexts, r5gridfield, r5grid
         where grd_gridid = @nGridid
           and gfd_gridid = grd_gridid
           and gfd_occurrence = 1
           and gfd_fieldid = @nFieldid

           and (dbo.o7alert_iskeyfield(gfd_fieldid, grd_keyfields) = N'+' or

                          and dqf_ddspyid = dds_ddspyid
                          and dqf_fieldid = gfd_fieldid
                          and dqf_viewtype = N'LIST'))

    if @sFieldalias is null
        begin

            SELECT @sFieldlabel = bot_text
              FROM r5boilertexts
             WHERE bot_function = N'BSALRT'
               AND bot_fld1 = N'UNKNOWNFIELD'

create procedure O7ALERT_VALIDATEDETAILFIELDMAPPINGS @sAlertcode           nvarchar(30),
                                                     @nGridid              numeric(14),
                                                     @nDdspyid             numeric(14),
                                                     @sValidwofields       nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
                                                     @sValidtextparameters nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
                                                     @sChkresult           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as 
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nObjectfieldid       numeric(14)
    declare @nObjectorgfieldid    numeric(14)
    declare @nProblemcodefieldid  numeric(14)
    declare @nJobtypefieldid      numeric(14)
    declare @nPriorityfieldid     numeric(14)
    declare @nWorkorderorgfieldid numeric(14)
    declare @nDurationfieldid     numeric(14)
    declare @nSchedstartfieldid   numeric(14)
    declare @nRequeststartfieldid numeric(14)
    declare @nRequestendfieldid   numeric(14)

    if @nDdspyid is null
        begin
            set @sChkresult = N'2'
            set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            set @sValidtextparameters = N'-'
        end
    else
        begin
            select @sValidtextparameters = N'-'
              from r5alerttextparams
             where atp_alert = @sAlertcode
               and atp_fieldid is not null
               and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, atp_fieldid) = N'-'

            if @sValidtextparameters is null      
                set @sValidtextparameters = N'+'

            select @nObjectfieldid = alw_objectfieldid,
                   @nObjectorgfieldid = alw_objectorgfieldid, 
                   @nProblemcodefieldid = alw_problemcodefieldid, 
                   @nJobtypefieldid = alw_jobtypefieldid, 
                   @nPriorityfieldid = alw_priorityfieldid, 
                   @nWorkorderorgfieldid = alw_workorderorgfieldid, 
                   @nDurationfieldid = alw_durationfieldid, 
                   @nSchedstartfieldid = alw_schedstartfieldid, 
                   @nRequeststartfieldid = alw_requeststartfieldid, 
                   @nRequestendfieldid = alw_requestendfieldid
              from r5alertwo
             where alw_alert = @sAlertcode
               and (alw_objectfieldid is not null or 
                    alw_objectorgfieldid is not null or 
                    alw_problemcodefieldid is not null or 
                    alw_jobtypefieldid is not null or 
                    alw_priorityfieldid is not null or
                    alw_workorderorgfieldid is not null or
                    alw_durationfieldid is not null or
                    alw_schedstartfieldid is not null or
                    alw_requeststartfieldid is not null or
                    alw_requestendfieldid is not null)
            
            if @nObjectfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nObjectfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nObjectorgfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nObjectorgfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nProblemcodefieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nProblemcodefieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nJobtypefieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nJobtypefieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nPriorityfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nPriorityfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nWorkorderorgfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nWorkorderorgfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nDurationfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nDurationfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nSchedstartfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nSchedstartfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nRequeststartfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nRequeststartfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else if @nRequestendfieldid is not null and dbo.o7alert_validfieldmapping(@nGridid, @nDdspyid, @nRequestendfieldid) = N'-'
              set @sValidwofields = N'-'
            else
              set @sValidwofields = N'+'      

            if @sValidwofields = N'-' or @sValidtextparameters = N'-'
              set @sChkresult = N'3'
            else
              set @sChkresult = N'0'
        end
