create procedure O7ARCHIVEDATA_WORKORDERS @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
                                        @nEvtacd  numeric(38,0),
                                        @dEnddate datetime
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

    declare @nReturn        integer
    declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
    declare @sArcCode       nvarchar(38)
    declare @nArcCode       numeric(38,0)
    declare @sErrmessage	nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sTemp			nvarchar(100)

    declare @sAct_matlist   nvarchar(20)--r5activities.act_matlist%TYPE
    declare @nAct_matlrev   numeric(4,0)--r5activities.act_matlrev%TYPE
	declare @sTracode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nError			integer
	declare @nActact		numeric(8,0)
	declare @nTraacd		numeric(38,0)
	declare @sOrlorder		nvarchar(30)
	declare @Orlorderorg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOrlacd		numeric(38,0)
	declare @sPofailed			nvarchar(60)
	declare @sReqfailed			nvarchar(60)
	declare @sReqcode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReqacd		numeric(38,0)
	declare @nTouAcd		numeric(38,0)
	declare @nAcd			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nBooAcd		numeric(38,0)

	declare @sSwdcode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sWclcode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMtlcode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nMtlrevision	numeric(4,0)
	declare @sPiccode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sAgrCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sQulquotation	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sQulseqno		nvarchar(2)
	declare @sEilinvoice	nvarchar(30)
	declare @dEdate			datetime
	declare @sEdate			nvarchar(100)
	declare @sActive		nvarchar(4)



    --GET @sArcCode
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ARCHIVEDATA', N'ArcCode', @sArcCode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nArcCode = cast(@sArcCode as numeric(38,0))

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ARCHIVEDATA', N'Edate', @sEdate OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dEdate = cast(@sEdate as datetime)

    /* Check repair bins, if they exist the work order cannot be deleted. */
    if EXISTS (SELECT N'x'
				FROM   r5repairbins
				WHERE  rpb_event = @sEvent)
    begin
        INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
        VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 1 )
        RETURN
    end

    /* Check whether the work order has children. */
    if EXISTS (SELECT N'x'
				FROM   r5events
				WHERE  evt_parent = @sEvent )
    begin
        INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
        VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 2 )
        RETURN
    end

    /* Check whether the @sEvent exists on a partly received PO. */
    SELECT @sActive = o2.orl_active
				FROM   r5orders o, r5orderlines o2, r5orderlines o1
				WHERE  o1.orl_event = @sEvent
				AND    o2.orl_order = o1.orl_order
				AND    o.ord_code = o1.orl_order
				AND    o.ord_org = o1.orl_order_org
				AND    o2.orl_order_org = o1.orl_order_org
				AND  ( o2.orl_active = N'+' OR
					 o.ord_date > @dEdate + .99999 )
    if @sActive = N'+'
	    begin
            INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
            VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 3 )
            RETURN
        end
	else
		begin
			if @sActive = N'-'
				begin
					INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
					VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 7 )
					RETURN
				end
		end


    if EXISTS (SELECT N'x'
				FROM   r5requisitions r, r5requislines r2, r5requislines r1
				WHERE  r1.rql_event = @sEvent
				AND    r.req_code = r1.rql_req
				AND    r2.rql_req = r1.rql_req
				AND  ( r2.rql_active = N'+' OR
					 r.req_date > @dEdate + .99999 ))
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
            VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 4 )
            RETURN
        end

    /* Check whether the @sEvent exists in a r5transtock record. */
    if EXISTS (  SELECT N'x'
				FROM   r5transtock
				WHERE  tst_tocode = @sEvent
				AND    tst_torentity = N'EVNT' )
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
            VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 5 )
            RETURN
        end

    /* Check whether the @sEvent exists on a not approved invoice. */
    if EXISTS (  SELECT N'x'
					FROM   r5invoices, r5invoicelines, r5orderlines
					WHERE  orl_order        = ivl_order
					AND    orl_order_org    = ivl_order_org
					AND    ivl_invoice      = inv_code
					AND    ivl_invoice_org  = inv_org
					AND    orl_event        = @sEvent
					AND    inv_rstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C' ) )
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
            VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 6 )
            RETURN
        end

    if exists ( SELECT 'x'
                FROM   r5contactrecords
                WHERE  ctr_event = @sEvent
                AND    ctr_rstatus = N'O')
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
            VALUES( @nArcCode, 'EVNT', @sEvent, 9 )
            RETURN
        end
    SAVE TRANSACTION  startwo

	/* Check whether the @sEvent exists on a later transaction . */
    if EXISTS (  SELECT N'x'
                                        FROM   r5transactions, r5translines
                                        WHERE  tra_code = trl_trans
                                        AND    trl_event = @sEvent
                                        AND    tra_rstatus IN ( N'A', N'C' )
                                        AND    tra_date > @dEdate + .99999 )
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
            VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 10 )
            RETURN
        end

  /* Transactions. */
	declare c_tra cursor local for     SELECT tra_code, tra_acd
                                        FROM   r5transactions, r5translines
                                        WHERE  tra_code = trl_trans
                                        AND    trl_event = @sEvent
                                        AND    tra_rstatus IN ( N'A', N'C' )   AND    tra_date <= @dEdate + .99999
	open c_tra
	fetch next from c_tra into @sTracode, @nTraacd
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
            execute @nReturn = O7ARCHIVEDATA_TRANSACTIONS @sTracode, @nTraacd
            select @nError = @@ERROR
            if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION startwo
                    set @sErrmessage = SUBSTRING( cast(@nError as nvarchar(38)), 1, 1000 )

                    INSERT INTO r5archiveresults(
                    are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result, are_parent, are_parentrentity, are_errormessage )
                    VALUES( @nArcCode, N'TRAN', @sTracode, 102, @sEvent, N'EVNT', @sErrmessage )

                    INSERT INTO r5archiveresults( are_archive, are_rentity, are_code, are_result )
                    VALUES( @nArcCode, N'EVNT', @sEvent, 102 )
                    close c_tra
                    deallocate c_tra
                    RETURN
                end
  		    fetch next from c_tra into @sTracode, @nTraacd
	    end
    close c_tra
    deallocate c_tra

    /* Archive options. */
    execute @nReturn = O7ARCHIVEDATA_OPTIONS N'EVNT', @sEvent, N'R5EVENTS'
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    /* Archive account details. */
    execute @nReturn = O7ARCHIVEDATA_ACD @nEvtacd
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

  /* Loop through all activities of the current work order. */
	declare c_act cursor local for   SELECT act_act
                                        FROM   r5activities
                                        WHERE

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ASRPBN
                            @sPart            nvarchar(30),
                            @sPartOrg         nvarchar(15),
                            @sStore           nvarchar(15),
                            @sReq             nvarchar(30),
                            @nReqline         numeric(8),
                            @nQtyToBeAssigned numeric(24,6)
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
   
    declare @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty      numeric(30,6)
    declare @sDefaultBin                    nvarchar(15)--r5stock.sto_repdefaultbin%TYPE := NULL
    declare @sAutoAssign                    nvarchar(1)--r5stock.sto_repautoassign%TYPE := '-'
    declare @sByAsset                       nvarchar(1)--r5parts.par_byasset%TYPE := '-'
    declare @nQtyAlreadyAssigned            numeric(30,6)         --r5repairbins.rpb_qty%TYPE;

    declare @nBisrepairqty  numeric(24,6)
    declare @sBislot        nvarchar(12) 
    declare @sBisbin        nvarchar(15)

    declare @nQty        integer
    declare @sObjcode       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObjorg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sObjbin        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sObjlot        nvarchar(12)
    



    set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty = coalesce(@nQtyToBeAssigned, 0)
    set @sDefaultBin = NULL
    set @sAutoAssign = N'-'
    set @sByAsset = N'-'
    
    -- get repairable part setttings 
    SELECT @sDefaultBin = sto_repdefaultbin, @sAutoAssign = sto_repautoassign
    FROM   r5stock
    WHERE  sto_store  = @sStore AND sto_part = @sPart AND sto_part_org = @sPartOrg 

    -- Assign bins for a repairable part only when @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty > 0
    -- and @sAutoAssign is checked.
    IF (@nRemainingToBeAssignedQty <= 0) OR (@sAutoAssign = '-') 
       RETURN
    
    -- get part byasset settings 
    SELECT @sByAsset = par_byasset
    FROM   r5parts 
    WHERE  par_code = @sPart AND par_org = @sPartOrg 
    
    IF (@sByAsset = N'-') 
        begin
            -- Assign bins for a non-asset repairable part
            IF @sDefaultBin IS NOT NULL 
                BEGIN
                    -- assign from default repair bin
                    declare c_DefBinQty cursor local for SELECT bis_repairqty, bis_lot
                                                        FROM   r5binstock 
                                                        WHERE  bis_store  = @sStore AND
                                                            bis_part = @sPart AND 
                                                            bis_part_org = @sPartOrg AND 
                                                            bis_bin = @sDefaultBin AND
                                                            coalesce(bis_repairqty, 0) > 0
                                                        ORDER  BY bis_lot
	                open c_DefBinQty
	                fetch next from c_DefBinQty into	@nBisrepairqty, @sBislot 
	                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		                begin
                            set @nQtyAlreadyAssigned = dbo.o7gtasqy( @sStore, @sPart, @sPartOrg, null, @sReq, @nReqline, @sDefaultBin, @sBislot )
                            IF (@nBisrepairqty - @nQtyAlreadyAssigned ) <= @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty  
                                begin
                                    --createRepairbinRecord
                                    DELETE FROM r5repairbins
                                    WHERE  rpb_part     = @sPart
                                    AND    rpb_part_org = @sPartOrg
                                    AND    rpb_store    = @sStore
                                    AND    rpb_bin      = @sDefaultBin
                                    AND    rpb_lot      = @sBislot
                                    AND    rpb_event    IS NULL
                                    AND    rpb_req      = @sReq
                                    AND    rpb_reqline  = @nReqline

                                    IF coalesce( @nBisrepairqty, 0 ) > 0 
                                        INSERT INTO r5repairbins ( rpb_part,    rpb_part_org, rpb_store, 
                                        rpb_bin,     rpb_lot,      rpb_req, 
                                        rpb_reqline, rpb_qty )
                                        VALUES ( @sPart,    @sPartOrg, @sStore,
                                        @sDefaultBin,     coalesce(@sBislot,N'*'),     @sReq, 
                                        @nReqline, @nBisrepairqty - @nQtyAlreadyAssigned )             

                                    set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty = @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty - (@nBisrepairqty - @nQtyAlreadyAssigned)
                                end
                            ELSE
                                begin
                                    IF @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty > 0 
                                        begin
                                            --createRepairbinRecord
                                            DELETE FROM r5repairbins
                                            WHERE  rpb_part     = @sPart
                                            AND    rpb_part_org = @sPartOrg
                                            AND    rpb_store    = @sStore
                                            AND    rpb_bin      = @sDefaultBin
                                            AND    rpb_lot      = @sBislot
                                            AND    rpb_event    IS NULL
                                            AND    rpb_req      = @sReq
                                            AND    rpb_reqline  = @nReqline

                                            IF coalesce( @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty, 0 ) > 0 
                                                INSERT INTO r5repairbins ( rpb_part,    rpb_part_org, rpb_store, 
                                                rpb_bin,     rpb_lot,      rpb_req, 
                                                rpb_reqline, rpb_qty )
                                                VALUES ( @sPart,    @sPartOrg, @sStore,
                                                @sDefaultBin,     coalesce(@sBislot,N'*'),     @sReq, 
                                                @nReqline, @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty ) 

                                            set @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty = 0
                                        end
                                end

			                fetch next from c_DefBinQty into	@nBisrepairqty, @sBislot  
		                end
	                close c_DefBinQty
	                deallocate c_DefBinQty

                    -- if there are still more parts to be assigned after all parts in default repair bin assigned
                    -- assinged parts from other bins
                    IF @nRemainingToBeAssignedQty > 0 
                        begin
                            declare c_NoDefBinQty cursor local for SELECT bis_repairqty, bis_bin, bis_lot
                                                                FROM   r5binstock 
                                                                WHERE  bis_store  = @sStore AND
                                                                    bis_part = @sPart AND 
                                                                    bis_part_org = @sPartOrg AND 
                                                                    bis_bin != @sDefaultBin AND

                                                                ORDER  BY bis_lot
                            open c_NoDefBinQty

	set @dToday = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2( @sCorg ), N'dd')
    set @sChk = N'0'	
	set @sReportSubID = ''


	/* When printing reports the cOrder will be a concatenated string
	with a # delimiter. Using cOrder to pass in the string
	and splitting the individual components and resetting back the
	cOrder to only contain the order code
	*/

	IF charindex(N'#', @sCorder) != 0
		begin
			set @sReqOrderCode = SUBSTRING(@sCorder,1,charindex(N'#', @sCorder)-1)
			set @sReportSubID = SUBSTRING(@sCorder,charindex(N'#',@sCorder)+1, len(@sCorder))
			if @sReqOrderCode = N''
			    set @sReqOrderCode = null
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			set @sReqOrderCode = @sCorder
			set @sReportSubID = ''
		end

	set @sCorder = @sReqOrderCode

    /* get po system status */
    set @sOustatus = @sCorderStatus
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sOrstatus OUTPUT, @sOustatus,  N'DOST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    PRINT 'sstatus ' + @sOustatus+ 'srstatus'+ @sOrstatus

    /*  get install parameter POCURR */
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPocurr OUTPUT, N'POCURR', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @sPocurr = UPPER(@sPocurr)

    /* Approve_PO check user monetary limit */
    SELECT @nCpordauthappvlimit = uog_pordauthappvlimit, @nCpordappvlimit = uog_pordappvlimit
    FROM   r5userorganization
    WHERE  uog_user = @sCuser
    AND    uog_org  = @sCorg
    AND    uog_role = @sCrole

	SELECT @sUsercurr = org_curr
    FROM   r5organization
    WHERE  org_code = @sCorg

	execute @nReturn = O7GTEXCH     @nNexchuser		OUTPUT,
									@sUsercurr	,
									@sCorg	,
									@dToday
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @sVorder = @sCorder
    set @nCtotalprice = 0
	SELECT @sCurr = com_curr
    FROM   r5companies
    WHERE  com_code = @sCsupplier
    AND    com_org  = @sCsupplierOrg

	execute @nReturn = O7GTEXCH     @nNexch		OUTPUT,
									@sCurr	,
									@sCorg	,
									@dToday
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @nNexch IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'-- no exchange rate defined
        RETURN
    end

     -- get due date
	SELECT  @dOrddue = MIN(tro_due)
    FROM   r5tempreqsfororder
    WHERE  tro_sessionid        = @nNSessionid
    AND    tro_store            = @sCstoreCode
    AND    tro_supplier         = @sCsupplier
    AND    tro_supplier_org     = @sCsupplierOrg
    AND    tro_sel

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ASYNCCUSTINVWRAPPER
AS
  DECLARE @code   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @rev    NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @return INT
  DECLARE @output NVARCHAR( 4 )
BEGIN
  SET @output = N'0'

  /* Reset in progress flag, if it is older than 2 hours. */
  UPDATE r5customerinvoices
  SET    civ_inprogress = NULL
  WHERE  civ_inprogress < getdate() - ( 2.000 / 24.000 )

  /* Reset the regenerate flag in case the invoice status is unequal to U and PE. */
  UPDATE r5customerinvoices
  SET    civ_requestregenerate = N'-',
         civ_inprogress        = NULL
  WHERE  civ_requestregenerate = N'+'
  AND    civ_rstatus NOT IN ( N'U', N'PE' )

  /* Retrieve customer invoice to regenerate, as long as there is no other process running. */
  SELECT @code = civ_code, 
         @org  = civ_org, 
         @rev  = civ_revision
  FROM   r5customerinvoices
  WHERE  civ_requestregenerate = N'+'
  AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5customerinvoicerunning )
  AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5customerinvoices WHERE civ_inprogress IS NOT NULL )
  AND    civ_code = ( SELECT MIN( CAST( civ_code AS NUMERIC ) ) 
                      FROM   r5customerinvoices
                      WHERE  civ_requestregenerate = N'+' )
  IF @code IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Set invoice as 'In Progress'. */
      UPDATE r5customerinvoices
      SET    civ_inprogress = getdate()
      WHERE  civ_code     = @code
      AND    civ_org      = @org
      AND    civ_revision = @rev

      /* Start the actual regenerate process. */
      EXECUTE @return = o7gencustomerinvoices @code, @org, @rev, NULL, NULL, @output OUTPUT
    END
END

CREATE  function O7ATRLIST (@nVarID  numeric(38,0), @sLang nvarchar(2) )
returns nvarchar(1024)
as
   begin
   declare @sResult	nvarchar(1024)	--output list of attributes
   declare @nVarscope	integer		--r5opvariables.ovd_varscope%TYPE
   declare @sFieldIDs	nvarchar(60)	--r5opvariables.ovd_dataspyfieldids%TYPE
   declare @nGridID	numeric(14,0)	--r5opvariables.ovd_gridid%TYPE
   declare @sShortName	nvarchar(20)	--r5opvariables.ovd_shortname%TYPE
   declare @sAttrLbl	nvarchar(20)	--r5opvarattributes.oat_label%TYPE
   declare @sFldName	nvarchar(255)	--translated d7i Fieldname
   declare @nCnt	integer		--Counter in attribute array
   declare @nNxt	integer		--char position in scan
   declare @nNxtC	integer		--Next comma found in scan
   declare @nThisID	integer		--Found field/attribute ID
   declare @nIsFact	integer
   declare @nAttr1	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr2	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr3	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr4	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr5	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr6	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr7	numeric(38,0)
   declare @nAttr	numeric(38,0)
   declare @tAttr table (elem integer, AttrID numeric(38,0))

   set @sResult = ''

   select @nAttr1 = ovd_attr0id,
   	  @nAttr2 = ovd_attr1id,
   	  @nAttr3 = ovd_attr2id,
   	  @nAttr4 = ovd_attr3id,
   	  @nAttr5 = ovd_attr4id,
   	  @nAttr6 = ovd_attr5id,
   	  @nAttr7 = ovd_attr6id,
    	  @nVarscope = ovd_varscope,
    	  @sFieldIDs = ovd_dataspyfieldids,
    	  @nGridID = ovd_gridid,
    	  @sShortName = ovd_shortname
   	from r5opvariables where ovd_id=@nVarID
   if @@ROWCOUNT = 1
   	begin
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 1, @nAttr1
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 2, @nAttr2
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 3, @nAttr3
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 4, @nAttr4
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 5, @nAttr5
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 6, @nAttr6
   	INSERT INTO @tAttr select 7, @nAttr7
	set @nCnt = 1
   	if @nVarscope = 1
   	    begin	-- scan comma sep list for fieldIDs for d7i vars
   	    set @sFieldIDs = replace(@sFieldIDs,'D','') + ','
   	    set @nNxt = 1
	    while @nCnt < 8
	    	begin
   	    	set @nNxtC = charindex(',', @sFieldIDs, @nNxt)
   	    	if @nNxtC = 0
   	    		break
   	    	if substring(@sFieldIDs,@nNxt,1) = 'V'
   	    	    begin
   	    	    set @nNxt = @nNxt + 1
   	    	    set @nIsFact = 1
		    set @sAttrLbl = @sShortName
   	    	    end
   	    	else
   	    	    set @nIsFact = 0
   	    	if isnumeric (substring(@sFieldIDs,@nNxt,@nNxtC-@nNxt)) = 1
   	    	    set @nThisID = cast(substring(@sFieldIDs,@nNxt,@nNxtC-@nNxt) as numeric(38,0))
   	    	else
   	    	    return @sResult
   	    	set @nNxt = @nNxtC + 1
		if @nIsFact = 0
		    begin
   	    	    select @nAttr = AttrID from @tAttr where elem=@nCnt
   	    	    if @nAttr is not null
   	    	    	begin
			select @sAttrLbl = oat_label from r5opvarattributes
				where oat_id = @nAttr
			if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
			    set @sAttrLbl = 'A?'
			end
		    else
			set @sAttrLbl = 'A?'
		    end
		select @sFldName = bot_text
	    		from r5gridfield, r5boilertexts 
	      		where bot_function=gfd_botfunction and
	      		bot_number=gfd_botnumber and 
	      		bot_lang=@sLang and 
	      		gfd_gridid=@nGridID and 
	      		gfd_fieldid=@nThisID;
		if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
		    set @sFldName = 'F?'
	      	set @sResult = @sResult + @sAttrLbl + '=' + @sFldName + ', '
   	    	set @nCnt = @nCnt + 1
   	    	end
   	    end
   	else
   	    begin
	    while @nCnt < 8
	    	begin
   	    	select @nAttr = AttrID from @tAttr where elem=@nCnt
		if @nAttr is null
		    break
		else
		    begin
   	    	    select @sAttrLbl = oat_label
   	    		from r5opvarattributes 
   	    		where oat_id = @nAttr
		    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
			set @sAttrLbl = 'A?'
   	    	    set @sResult = @sResult + @sAttrLbl + ', '
   	    	    set @nCnt = @nCnt + 1
   	    	    end
		end
   	    end
   	set @sResult = substring(@sResult,1,len(@sResult)-1)	-- remove trailing ,
   	end
   return @sResult
   end
0

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7AUDDEL
                 @sTable       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sFromDate    NVARCHAR(10)
                ,@sThroughDate NVARCHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @dFrom    DATETIME
       ,@dThrough DATETIME

/* Validate input dates */

	IF ( @sTable IS NULL OR  @sFromDate  IS NULL OR @sThroughDate  IS NULL )
		RETURN

	SET @dFrom = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @sFromDate, 105)
	SET @dThrough = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @sThroughDate, 105)

	/* Now delete rows from r5audvalues table */
	DELETE
	  FROM r5audvalues
	 WHERE ava_table = @sTable
		AND ava_changed BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dThrough
END

create procedure O7AUDIT	@nAttribute	int,
							@sAction	nvarchar(8),
							@sTable		nvarchar(30),
							@sOldvalue	nvarchar(250),
							@sNewvalue	nvarchar(250),
							@sPrimvalue	nvarchar(255),
							@sSecvalue	nvarchar(180),
							@sChk		nvarchar(3)	OUTPUT
as
BEGIN TRY
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(255)	--r5users.usr_code%TYPE
	declare @sFunction		nvarchar(6)		--r5functions.fun_code%TYPE
	declare @dDate			datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sForgetme		nvarchar(10)
	declare @sPersonorgupdate	nvarchar(10)

	set @sChk = N'0'

	execute O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
	IF @sForgetme = N'TRUE'
		/* No audit during forgetme processing. */
		RETURN

	execute O7SESS_CUR_INPERSONORGUPDATE @sPersonorgupdate OUTPUT
	IF @sPersonorgupdate = N'TRUE'
		/* No audit during person org update processing. */
		RETURN

	if @nAttribute is null or @sAction is null or @sPrimvalue is null
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	if coalesce( @sOldvalue, N'_nvl_value_' ) <> coalesce( @sNewvalue, N'_nvl_value_' )
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUser OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			set @sUser = coalesce(@sUser, N'*')
			execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_FUNCTION @sFunction OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			INSERT INTO R5AUDVALUES (
			  AVA_ATTRIBUTE,
			  AVA_TABLE,
			  AVA_PRIMARYID,
			  AVA_SECONDARYID,
			  AVA_FROM,
			  AVA_TO,
			  AVA_CHANGED,
			  AVA_MODIFIEDBY,
			  AVA_FUNCTION,
			  AVA_UPDATED,
			  AVA_INSERTED,
			  AVA_DELETED )
			VALUES(
			  @nAttribute,
			  @sTable,
			  SUBSTRING( @sPrimvalue, 1, 80 ),
			  @sSecvalue,
			  SUBSTRING( @sOldvalue, 1, 240 ),
			  SUBSTRING( @sNewvalue, 1, 240 ),
			  @dDate,
			  @sUser,
			  @sFunction,
			  CASE @sAction WHEN N'UPDATE' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,
			  CASE @sAction WHEN N'INSERT' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END,
			  CASE @sAction WHEN N'DELETE' THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END)
		end
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
	DECLARE 
		@errMessage NVARCHAR(500),
		@errSeverity INT,
		@errState INT

	SELECT
		@errMessage = N'audittable:' + @sTable + '::action:' + @sAction + '::code:' + 
			convert( nvarchar, ERROR_NUMBER() ) + '::message:' + SUBSTRING(ERROR_MESSAGE(), 1, 380),
		@errSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
		@errState = ERROR_STATE();
		
		RAISERROR(@errMessage, @errSeverity, @errState);
END CATCH

create function o7availableqty (
  @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
  @nAct     numeric(8,0),
  @sPart    nvarchar(30),
  @sPartorg nvarchar(15),
  @sStore   nvarchar(15)
  )
  returns numeric(32,6)
as
begin

    declare @nAvailableqty      numeric(24,6)
    set @nAvailableqty = 0 

    SELECT @nAvailableqty = coalesce( s.sto_qty, 0 ) - coalesce( SUM( r.res_allqty ), 0 ) 
    FROM   r5reservations r right outer join  r5stock s  on ( s.sto_part     = r.res_part 
                                                                AND    s.sto_part_org = r.res_part_org 
                                                                AND    s.sto_store    = r.res_store 
                                                                AND    r.res_event  <> @sEvent )
    WHERE  s.sto_part     = @sPart
    AND    s.sto_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND    s.sto_store    = @sStore 
    GROUP BY s.sto_qty
  
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set  @nAvailableqty = null

    RETURN (@nAvailableqty) 
end

create function o7availqtynodefrtnbin (
  @sPart    nvarchar(30),
  @sPartorg nvarchar(15),
  @sStore   nvarchar(15)
  )
  returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin

    declare @allocateqty               numeric(24,6)
    declare @returnval                 numeric(24,6)
    declare @binstockavailableqty      numeric(24,6) 

    SELECT @binstockavailableqty =  SUM( bis_qty )
    FROM    r5binstock b
    WHERE   b.bis_part     = @sPart
    AND    b.bis_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND    b.bis_store    = @sStore
    AND    b.bis_bin != COALESCE((SELECT sto_defaultreturnbin 
                                  FROM r5stock 
                                  WHERE sto_part = b.bis_part 
                                  AND sto_part_org = b.bis_part_org 
                                  AND sto_store = b.bis_store 
                                  AND COALESCE(sto_preventissuedefrtnbin, '-') = '+'),'#');
	
    SELECT @allocateqty = SUM( COALESCE( r.res_allqty, 0 ) )
    FROM   r5reservations r
    WHERE  r.res_part     = @sPart
    AND    r.res_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND    r.res_store    = @sStore;

    IF(@binstockavailableqty is NULL)
       set @returnval = null;
    ELSE
       set @returnval = @binstockavailableqty - COALESCE(@allocateqty, 0);
       
    RETURN ( @returnval) 
end

create function O7AXTDMA ( @sOrder  nvarchar(30),
							  @sOrg    nvarchar(15),
							  @nLine   numeric(8),
							  @nQty    numeric(24,6)   )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
	begin
		declare @nResult		numeric(24,6)
		declare @sX 			nvarchar(1)

		if exists ( select 1
		            FROM   r5orderlines
		            WHERE  orl_order     = @sOrder
		            AND    orl_order_org = @sOrg
		            AND    orl_ordline   = @nLine
					AND    orl_ordqty <> 0 )
			SELECT @nResult = ( (isnull(orl_totextra,0) + isnull( orl_invcalctaxamount, 0) ) * @nQty / orl_ordqty ) / orl_exch
			FROM   r5orderlines
			WHERE  orl_order     = @sOrder
			AND    orl_order_org = @sOrg
			AND    orl_ordline   = @nLine
		else
			set @nResult = null

		set @nResult = coalesce (@nResult, 0)

		return (@nResult)
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BAL004
  @alert NVARCHAR( 30 ) = '00004' AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @histdays               NUMERIC
  DECLARE @deletedata             NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @interval               NUMERIC
  DECLARE @complete               NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipmenton            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @imbalance              NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @energy                 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @prevdate               DATETIME
  DECLARE @prevenergy             NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @prevenergytruncated    NUMERIC( 18 )

  DECLARE @ado_obj                NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ado_org                NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ado_udfdate01          DATETIME
  DECLARE @ado_sqlidentity        INT
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum01           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum02           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum03           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum04           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum05           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum06           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum07           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum08           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum09           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum10           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum11           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum12           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum13           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum14           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum15           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum16           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum17           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum18           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum19           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum20           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum21           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum22           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum23           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @ado_udfnum24           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @obj_elecusagethreshold NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  DECLARE @obj_elecsubmeterint    NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @oed_object             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @oed_object_org         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @oed_daterecorded       DATETIME
  DECLARE @oed_energytotal_kwh    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @oed_sqlidentity        INT


  /* Get history days of alert. */
  SELECT @histdays = ISNULL( agp_nvalue, 14 )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.HistoryDays'
  IF @histdays < 0
    SET @histdays = 14

  /* Get 'delete alert data' flag of alert. */
  SELECT @deletedata = ISNULL( agp_value, N'NO' )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.DeleteAlertData'

  IF @histdays IS NULL OR @deletedata IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* Loop through all non processed ILON records. */
  DECLARE c_ado CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ado_obj, ado_org, ado_udfdate01, ado_sqlidentity,
           ado_udfnum01, ado_udfnum02, ado_udfnum03, ado_udfnum04, ado_udfnum05, ado_udfnum06,
           ado_udfnum07, ado_udfnum08, ado_udfnum09, ado_udfnum10, ado_udfnum11, ado_udfnum12,
           ado_udfnum13, ado_udfnum14, ado_udfnum15, ado_udfnum16, ado_udfnum17, ado_udfnum18, 
           ado_udfnum19, ado_udfnum20, ado_udfnum21, ado_udfnum22, ado_udfnum23, ado_udfnum24,
           obj_elecusagethreshold
    FROM   r5objects, r5alertdataobj
    WHERE  ado_obj       = obj_code
    AND    ado_org       = obj_org
    AND    ado_udfchar34 = N'ILON'
    AND    ado_udfdate02 IS NULL

  OPEN c_ado
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_ado INTO 
           @ado_obj, @ado_org, @ado_udfdate01, @ado_sqlidentity,
           @ado_udfnum01, @ado_udfnum02, @ado_udfnum03, @ado_udfnum04, @ado_udfnum05, @ado_udfnum06,
           @ado_udfnum07, @ado_udfnum08, @ado_udfnum09, @ado_udfnum10, @ado_udfnum11, @ado_udfnum12,
           @ado_udfnum13, @ado_udfnum14, @ado_udfnum15, @ado_udfnum16, @ado_udfnum17, @ado_udfnum18, 
           @ado_udfnum19, @ado_udfnum20, @ado_udfnum21, @ado_udfnum22, @ado_udfnum23, @ado_udfnum24,
           @obj_elecusagethreshold
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @interval = NULL
      SET @complete = N'-'
      SET @energy   = NULL
      /* Set equipment to ON if more energy used than the threshold. */
      IF @ado_udfnum04 >= @obj_elecusagethreshold
        SET @equipmenton = N'+'
      ELSE
        SET @equipmenton = N'-'

      /* Calculate imbalance. */
      IF ( @ado_udfnum01 + @ado_udfnum02 + @ado_udfnum03 ) <> 0
        SET @imbalance = ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @ado_udfnum01, dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @ado_udfnum02, @ado_udfnum03 ) ) - 
                           dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( @ado_udfnum01, dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( @ado_udfnum02, @ado_udfnum03 ) ) ) /
                         ( ( @ado_udfnum01 + @ado_udfnum02 + @ado_udfnum03 ) / 3 ) * 100
      ELSE
        SET @imbalance = NULL

      /* Insert actual electricity data record. */
      INSERT INTO r5electricitydata( oed_object, oed_object_org, oed_daterecorded, oed_interval, oed_complete, oed_equipmenton,
             oed_voltageab_v, oed_voltagebc_v, oed_voltageca_v, oed_voltage_imbalance, oed_voltagean_v, oed_voltagebn_v,
             oed_voltagecn_v, oed_currenta_a, oed_currentb_a, oed_currentc_a, oed_currentneutral_a, oed_frequency_hz,
             oed_powerfactor_pct, oed_energytotal_kwh, oed_energy_kwh, oed_energytotalapparent_vah, oed_energytotalreactive_varh,
             oed_power_w, oed_powerapparent_va, oed_powerreactive_var, oed_thdvolta_pct, oed_thdvoltb_pct, oed_thdvoltc_pct,
             oed_thdcurrenta_pct, oed_thdcurrentb_pct, oed_thdcurrentc_pct )
      VALUES( @ado_obj, @ado_org, @ado_udfdate01, @interval, @complete, @equipmenton,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BAL005
  @alert NVARCHAR( 30 ) = '00005' AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @histdays                 NUMERIC
  DECLARE @minpercentage            NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @commodity                NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @dailyuom                 NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @hourlyuom                NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cnt                      INT
  DECLARE @usage                    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  
  DECLARE @obj_elecsubmeterinterval NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @oed_object               NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @oed_object_org           NVARCHAR( 15 )      
  DECLARE @oed_date                 DATE 
  DECLARE @odc_designusageuom       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @odc_defaultloadfactor    NUMERIC( 3 )  
  DECLARE @oed_actcons              NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @oed_cnt                  INT
  DECLARE @oed_usage                NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  
  /* Get history days of alert. */
  SELECT @histdays = ISNULL( agp_nvalue, 14 )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.HistoryDays'
  IF @histdays < 0 
    SET @histdays = 14.00
    
  /* Get minimum percentage of alert. */
  SELECT @minpercentage = ISNULL( agp_nvalue, 95.00 )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.MinimumPercentage'
  IF @minpercentage < 0 OR @minpercentage > 100 
    SET @minpercentage = 95.00

  /* Get commodity of alert. */
  SELECT @commodity = ISNULL( UPPER( agp_value ), N'ELECTRICITY' )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.Commodity'

  /* Get daily design UOM of alert. */
  SELECT @dailyuom = ISNULL( agp_value, N'DAY' )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.DailyDesignUOM'

  /* Get hourly design UOM of alert. */
  SELECT @hourlyuom = ISNULL( agp_value, N'HOUR' )
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = @alert
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.HourlyDesignUOM'

  /* Loop through all completed electricity data records with a design consumption within current period. */
  DECLARE c_oed CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT obj_elecsubmeterinterval, oed_object, oed_object_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( oed_daterecorded, N'DD' ), 
           odc_designusageuom, odc_defaultloadfactor,
           SUM( oed_energy_kwh ), COUNT( * ),
           SUM( CASE WHEN oed_equipmenton = '+' THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END ) / CAST( 1440.00 / obj_elecsubmeterinterval AS INT ) 
    FROM   r5objects, r5objdesignconsumption, r5electricitydata
    WHERE  obj_code       = oed_object
    AND    obj_org        = oed_object_org
    AND    odc_object     = oed_object
    AND    odc_object_org = oed_object_org
    AND    odc_commodity  = @commodity
    AND    oed_complete   = N'+'
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( oed_daterecorded, N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( oed_daterecorded, N'DD' ) >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) - @histdays
    GROUP BY obj_elecsubmeterinterval, oed_object, oed_object_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( oed_daterecorded, N'DD' ), odc_designusageuom, odc_defaultloadfactor
    HAVING COUNT(*) / ( CAST( 1440.00 / obj_elecsubmeterinterval AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) * 100.00 > @minpercentage

  OPEN c_oed
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_oed INTO @obj_elecsubmeterinterval, @oed_object, @oed_object_org, @oed_date, 
                             @odc_designusageuom, @odc_defaultloadfactor, @oed_actcons, @oed_cnt, @oed_usage 
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      IF @odc_designusageuom = @dailyuom 
        SET @usage = @oed_usage
      ELSE IF @odc_designusageuom = @hourlyuom
        SET @usage = @oed_usage * 24.00
      ELSE
        SET @usage = NULL
        
      /* Does actual consumption record exist. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
      FROM   r5objactualconsumption
      WHERE  oac_object     = @oed_object
      AND    oac_object_org = @oed_object_org
      AND    oac_commodity  = @commodity
      AND    oac_date       = @oed_date
      IF @cnt = 0
        /* Insert actual consumption record. */
        INSERT INTO r5objactualconsumption( oac_object, oac_object_org, oac_commodity, oac_date, oac_usage,
               oac_actualconsumption, oac_designusageuom, oac_updated, oac_loadfactor )
        VALUES( @oed_object, @oed_object_org, @commodity, @oed_date, @usage,
                @oed_actcons, @odc_designusageuom, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ), ISNULL( @odc_defaultloadfactor, 100.00 ) )
      ELSE
        /* Update. */
        UPDATE r5objactualconsumption
        SET    oac_actualconsumption = @oed_actcons,
               oac_designusageuom    = @odc_designusageuom,
               oac_usage             = @usage,
               oac_updated           = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' )
        WHERE  oac_object     = @oed_object
        AND    oac_object_org = @oed_object_org
        AND    oac_commodity  = @commodity
        AND    oac_date       = @oed_date

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_oed INTO @obj_elecsubmeterinterval, @oed_object, @oed_object_org, @oed_date, 
                                 @odc_designusageuom, @odc_defaultloadfactor, @oed_actcons, @oed_cnt, @oed_usage 
    END
  CLOSE c_oed
  DEALLOCATE c_oed
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BAL010
  @alert NVARCHAR( 30 ) = '00010' AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @maxprio     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ageweight   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @event       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @age         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @jbtpweight  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @obcrweight  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  /* Retrieve maximum priority. */
  SELECT @maxprio = agp_nvalue
  FROM   r5alertgridparams
  WHERE  agp_alert = N'00010' 
  AND    agp_param = N'parameter.MaximumPriority'
  SET @maxprio = COALESCE( @maxprio, 100 )

  /* Loop through all Release work orders. */
  DECLARE c_evt CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT evt_code,
           DATEDIFF( d, COALESCE( evt_due, evt_target ), getdate() ) / 7,
           COALESCE( u1.uco_weight, 1 ),
           COALESCE( u2.uco_weight, 1 )
    FROM   r5events
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ucodes u1 ON ( u1.uco_rentity = N'JBTP' AND u1.uco_code = evt_jobtype )
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects 
                           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ucodes u2 ON ( u2.uco_rentity = N'OBCR' and u2.uco_code = obj_criticality )
           ON ( obj_code = evt_object AND obj_org = evt_object_org )
    WHERE  evt_rstatus = N'R'
    AND    COALESCE( evt_preservecalcpriority, N'-' ) = N'-'
  OPEN c_evt
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt INTO @event, @age, @jbtpweight, @obcrweight
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Get due / overdue weight. */
      SET @ageweight = NULL
      SELECT @ageweight = uco_weight
      FROM   r5ucodes
      WHERE  uco_rentity = N'CPDW'
      AND    uco_code = ( SELECT MAX( CAST( uco_code AS NUMERIC ) ) 
                          FROM   r5ucodes
                          WHERE  uco_rentity = 'CPDW'
                          AND    uco_weight IS NOT NULL 
                          AND    CAST( uco_code AS NUMERIC ) <= @age )
  
      /* Update the calculated priority. */
      UPDATE r5events
      SET    evt_calculatedpriority = ( @maxprio - dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( @jbtpweight * @obcrweight * COALESCE( @ageweight, 1 ), @maxprio ) ) + 1
      WHERE  evt_code = @event

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt INTO @event, @age, @jbtpweight, @obcrweight
    END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BAL015

AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @entitycode   NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @resultcode   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newpk        NVARCHAR( 30 )

  DECLARE alh CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR

    FROM   r5alerthistory
    WHERE  alh_alert   = @alert
    AND    alh_rtype   = N'WA'
    AND    alh_rstatus = N'S'
    AND    alh_created > getdate() - 1
    AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                       FROM   r5nonconformobservations
                       WHERE  nco_workorder = alh_resultcode )
  OPEN alh
  FETCH NEXT FROM alh INTO @entitycode, @resultcode
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE o7createnonconformity @entitycode, @resultcode, N'R5', N'R', @newpk OUTPUT
      FETCH NEXT FROM alh INTO @entitycode, @resultcode
    END
END

create procedure O7BARESC				@sStore			nvarchar(255),
										@sEscape		nvarchar(8)    OUTPUT,
										@sParttoken		nvarchar(30)   OUTPUT,
										@sLottoken		nvarchar(30)   OUTPUT,
										@sStoretoken	nvarchar(30)   OUTPUT,
										@sBintoken		nvarchar(30)   OUTPUT,
										@sObjecttoken	nvarchar(30)   OUTPUT,
										@sSernotoken	nvarchar(30)   OUTPUT,
										@sChk			nvarchar(6)	   OUTPUT
as
begin
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nCnt	int
	
    set @sChk = N'0'
    set @sEscape = NULL
    set @nCnt = 0
	
 
    IF  @sParttoken  IS NULL
    begin
        SELECT @sParttoken = pmt_default
        FROM   r5repparms
        WHERE pmt_function =  N'SBBLAB'
        AND   pmt_parameter = N'SEL_PARTTOKEN'
    end

    IF  @sLottoken  IS NULL
    begin
        SELECT @sLottoken = pmt_default
        FROM r5repparms
        WHERE pmt_function =  N'SBBLAB'
        AND   pmt_parameter = N'SEL_LOTTOKEN'
    end

    IF @sStoretoken  IS NULL
    begin
        SELECT @sStoretoken = pmt_default
        FROM   r5repparms
        WHERE pmt_function =  N'SBBLAB'
        AND   pmt_parameter = N'SEL_STORETOKEN'
    end

    IF  @sBintoken  IS NULL
    begin
        SELECT @sBintoken = pmt_default
        FROM   r5repparms
        WHERE pmt_function =  N'SBBLAB'
        AND   pmt_parameter = N'SEL_BINTOKEN'
    end
    
    IF  @sObjecttoken  IS NULL
    begin
        SELECT @sObjecttoken = pmt_default
        FROM   r5repparms
        WHERE pmt_function =  N'SBBLAB'
        AND   pmt_parameter = N'SEL_OBJECTTOKEN'
    end

    IF  @sSernotoken  IS NULL
    begin
        SELECT @sSernotoken = pmt_default
        FROM   r5repparms
        WHERE pmt_function =  N'SBBLAB'
        AND   pmt_parameter = N'SEL_SERNOTOKEN'
    end

    IF @sParttoken IS NULL
    begin 
       set @sChk = N'2' 
        RETURN  
    end
    
    IF @sLottoken IS NULL
    begin 
       set @sChk = N'3' 
        RETURN  
    end

    IF @sStoretoken IS NULL
    begin 
       set @sChk = N'4' 
        RETURN  
    end
   
    IF @sBintoken IS NULL
    begin 
       set @sChk = N'5' 
        RETURN  
    end

    IF @sObjecttoken IS NULL
    begin 
        set @sChk = N'6' 
        RETURN  
    end

    IF @sSernotoken IS NULL
    begin 
        set @sChk = N'7' 
        RETURN  
    end

    IF @sParttoken   = N'+'   
        set @nCnt=@nCnt+1
    IF @sLottoken    = N'+'   
        set @nCnt=@nCnt+1
    IF @sStoretoken  = N'+'   
        set @nCnt=@nCnt+1
    IF @sBintoken    = N'+'   
        set @nCnt=@nCnt+1
    IF @sObjecttoken = N'+'
        set @nCnt=@nCnt+1   
    IF @sSernotoken  = N'+'
        set @nCnt=@nCnt+1
    IF @nCnt > 4   /* too many things on one label */
        set @sChk = N'10' /* do not return */

 -- Get escape sequence id. = id. of kind of label for Intermec 3400
 -- empty bin, lot etc. will not be shown on label
 -- cast below decision tree in tabular form when we have more experience.
    IF @sObjecttoken = N'+' 
    begin
	    IF @sParttoken = N'+'
	        set @sEscape = N'INTMPON' /* part,  object and serial no. */
	    ELSE
	        set @sEscape = N'INTMON' /* object and serial no. */
	end
    ELSE /* no object */
    begin
	    IF @sSernotoken = N'+'
	        set @sEscape = N'INTMN';  /* only serial no. */
	    ELSE /* no serial */
        begin
	       IF @sParttoken = N'+' 
           begin
			  IF @sLottoken = N'+' 
			  begin
	             IF @sStoretoken = N'+' 
				 begin
	                IF @sBintoken = N'+' 
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPLSB' /* part, lot, store, bin */
	                ELSE
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPLS'  /* part, lot, store */
	             end
	             ELSE /* no store */
                 begin
	                IF @sBintoken = N'+' 
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPLB'  /* part, lot, bin */
	                ELSE
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPL'   /* part, lot */
	             end
              end
	          ELSE /* no lot */
              begin
	             IF @sStoretoken = N'+' 
                 begin
	                IF @sBintoken = N'+' 
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPSB'  /* part,  store, bin */
	                ELSE
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPS'   /* part, store */
                 end
	             ELSE /* no store */
                 begin
	                IF @sBintoken = N'+' 
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMPB'   /* part, bin */
	                ELSE
	                    set @sEscape = N'INTMP'    /* part only */
	             end
	          end
           end
	       ELSE /* no part */
           begin
	          IF @sBintoken = N'+' 
              begin
	             IF @sStoretoken = N'+' 
	                 set @sEscape = N'INTMSB'      /* store and bin */
	             ELSE
	                 set @sEscape = N'INTMB'       /* bin only */
              end
	          ELSE
	              set @sEscape = N'INTMS'          /* store only */
	       end
	    end
	 end
	 RETURN 
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BARPAR
	@sLabeltype			nvarchar(6),
	@sBarcode			nvarchar(120),
	@sPar1				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar2				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar3				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar4				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar5				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar6				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar7				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar8				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPar9				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sPrfx				nvarchar(200) OUTPUT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFill			nvarchar(1)			
	declare @sWprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sPprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sLprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sNprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sBprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sVprefix		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nWlen			integer
	declare @nPlen			integer
	declare @nLlen			integer
	declare @nOlen			integer
	declare @nNlen			integer
	declare @sSlen			integer
	declare @sBlen			integer
	declare @sVlen			integer
	declare @sAlen			integer
	declare @nSep			integer
	declare @sChk2			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		integer
BEGIN

	set @sChk  = N'0'
	set @sPar1 = N''
	set @sPar2 = N''
	set @sPar3 = N''
	set @sPar4 = N''
	set @sPar5 = N''
	set @sPar6 = N''
	set @sPar7 = N''
	set @sPar8 = N''
	set @sPar9 = N''
	set @sPrfx = N''
   
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sBprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODB', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sWprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODB', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sPprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sLprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODL', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sOprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODO', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sNprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODN', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sSprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODS', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sVprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODV', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @sLabeltype    IS NULL OR @sBarcode IS NULL OR @sLabeltype NOT IN ( N'WA', N'PLSB', N'ONSB', N'*' ) 
	   begin
		  set @sChk = N'1'
		  RETURN
	   end

	set @sVlen = LEN( @sVprefix )
	set @nPlen = LEN( @sPprefix )
	set @nWlen = LEN( @sWprefix )
	set @nLlen = LEN( @sLprefix )
	set @sSlen = LEN( @sSprefix )
	set @sBlen = LEN( @sBprefix )
	set @nOlen = LEN( @sOprefix )
	set @nNlen = LEN( @sNprefix )
	set @sAlen = 0

	IF @sLabeltype = N'PLSB'  
		begin
			set @sPar1     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 1 +@nPlen,                18 ) 
			set @sPar2     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 19+@nPlen+@nLlen,           12 ) 
			set @sPar3     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 31+@nPlen+@nLlen+@sSlen,      4  ) 
			set @sPar4     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 35+@nPlen+@nLlen+@sSlen+@nNlen, 12 ) 
		end

	IF @sLabeltype = N'ONSB'  
		begin
			set @sPar1     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 1 +@nOlen,                24 ) 
			set @sPar2     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 25+@nOlen+@nNlen,           24 ) 
			set @sPar3     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 49+@nOlen+@nNlen+@sSlen,      4  ) 
			set @sPar4     = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode, 53+@nOlen+@nNlen+@sSlen+@nNlen, 12 ) 
		end

	IF @sLabeltype = N'WA' 
		begin
			set @nSep = charindex('#',@sBarcode)
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@nWlen,      @nSep -2)							
			set @sPar2 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,@nWlen+@sAlen +@nSep ,LEN(@sBarcode) - @nSep )		
		end

	IF @sLabeltype = N'*' 
	begin
		set @sPrfx = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1,1)
		/* keep @nWlen, @nPlen etc in case some prefixes are empty */
		IF @sPrfx = N'W' 
			begin
				set @nSep = charindex('#',@sBarcode)
				set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@nWlen,      @nSep -2)  
				set @sPar2 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,@nWlen+@sAlen +@nSep ,LEN(@sBarcode) - @nSep )  
			end

		IF @sPrfx = N'P' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@nPlen,18)  

		IF @sPrfx = N'L' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@nLlen,12)  

		IF @sPrfx = N'S' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@sSlen,4)   

		IF @sPrfx = N'B' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@sBlen,12)  

		IF @sPrfx = N'O' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@nOlen,24)  

		IF @sPrfx = N'N' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@nNlen,24)  

		IF @sPrfx = N'C' 
			set @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,2,17)       
		IF @sPrfx = N'V' 
			set  @sPar1 = SUBSTRING( @sBarcode,1+@sVlen,8)   
	end

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sFill OUTPUT, N'BARFILL', @sChk2 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
  
	set @sPar1 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar1, @sFill )
	set @sPar2 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar2, @sFill )
	set @sPar3 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar3, @sFill )
	set @sPar4 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar4, @sFill )
	set @sPar5 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar5, @sFill )
	set @sPar6 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar6, @sFill )
	set @sPar7 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar7, @sFill )
	set @sPar8 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar8, @sFill )
	set @sPar9 = dbo.F_RTRIM_STRING( @sPar9, @sFill )

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BARPRT 
	@sEscape			nvarchar(8),
	@sSession			nvarchar(12),
	@sLang				nvarchar(2),
	@nLabcnt			int,
	@sPart				nvarchar(79),
	@sLot				nvarchar(79),
	@sStore				nvarchar(79),
	@sBin				nvarchar(79),
	@sObject			nvarchar(79),
	@sSerno				nvarchar(79),
	@sChk				nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sDes				nvarchar(255) 
	declare @sWprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sPprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sLprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sNprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sBprefix			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn			integer

	declare @nCount				integer

    declare @sPart1             nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObject1           nvarchar(30)

	set @sChk         = N'0'

	if   @sEscape    IS NULL
		begin  
			set @sChk = N'1'  
			RETURN 
		end
   if   @sSession   IS NULL
		begin  
			set @sChk = N'2'  
			RETURN 
		end

   if   @nLabcnt    IS NULL
		begin  
			set @sChk = N'3'  
			RETURN 
		end
   if   @sLang      IS NULL
		begin  
			set @sChk = N'4'  
			RETURN 
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sBprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODB', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sWprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODW', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sPprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sLprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODL', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sOprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODO', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sNprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODN', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sSprefix OUTPUT, N'BARCODS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1



	if @sChk <> N'0'  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1' 
			RETURN
		end

    if charindex( N'#', @sPart ) > 1
        set @sPart1 = substring( @sPart, 1, charindex( N'#', @sPart ) - 1 )
    else
        set @sPart1 = @sPart


	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'PAR_CODE',
		@sPprefix +  @sPart1,
		@sEscape)

	SET @sDes = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'PART' , @sPart  , null , null )


	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'PAR_DESC',
		@sDes,
		@sEscape)

	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'LOT_CODE',
		@sLprefix + @sLot,
		@sEscape)

	SET @sDes = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'LOT' , @sLot  , null, null)


	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'LOT_DESC',
		@sDes,
		@sEscape)

	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'STR_CODE',
		@sSprefix + @sStore,
		@sEscape)

	SET @sDes = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'STOR' , @sStore  , null , null )

	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'STR_DESC',
		@sDes,
		@sEscape)

	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'BIN_CODE',
		@sBprefix +  @sBin,
		@sEscape)


    if @sBin is not null
	    select @sDes = bin_desc
	    from r5bins
	    where bin_code = @sBin
	    and bin_store = @sStore
    else
        set @sDes = null



	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'BIN_DESC',
		@sDes,
		@sEscape)

    if charindex( N'#', @sObject ) > 1
        set @sObject1 = substring( @sObject, 1, charindex( N'#', @sObject ) - 1 )
    else
        set @sObject1 = @sObject

	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'OBJ_CODE',
		@sOprefix  + @sObject1,
		@sEscape)
	SET @sDes = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'OBJ' , @sObject  , null , null )


	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'OBJ_DESC',
		@sDes,
		@sEscape)
	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'OBJ_SERIAL',
		@sNprefix + @sSerno,
		@sEscape)

	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'SNO_DESC',
		null,
		@sEscape)
	INSERT INTO r5barcodelabels  (
		bcl_sessid,
		bcl_label,
		bcl_column,
		bcl_value,
		bcl_escape )
	VALUES (
		@sSession,
		@nLabcnt,
		N'*',
		null,
		@sEscape )

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7BARSEL
                 @sEscape       NVARCHAR(8)
                ,@sSession      NVARCHAR(12)
                ,@sLang         NVARCHAR(2)
                ,@sFromPart     NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sToPart       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sPartOrg      NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sPartDesc     NVARCHAR(80)
                ,@sPartClass    NVARCHAR(8)
                ,@sPartClassOrg NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sPartSupp     NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sObjCat       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sLot          NVARCHAR(12)
                ,@sStore        NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sBin          NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sInObject     NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sInObjectOrg  NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sInSerNo      NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sChoice       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nMaxLabs      INT
                ,@nActual       INT          OUTPUT
                ,@sInUser       NVARCHAR(255)
                ,@sCheck        NVARCHAR(4)  OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET @sCheck = N'4'
IF @sEscape IS NULL
   RETURN

SET @sCheck = N'2'
IF @sSession IS NULL
   RETURN

SET @sCheck = N'1'
IF @sChoice NOT IN (N'1', N'2')
   IF @sFromPart IS NULL AND @sLot IS NULL AND @sStore IS NULL AND @sBin IS NULL AND @sInObject IS NULL AND @sInSerNo IS NULL
      RETURN

DECLARE @nCounter      INT
       ,@sCheck1       NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sOBJCode      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sOBJSerialNo  NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sOBJPart      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sOBJOrg       NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sPARCode      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sPAROrg       NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sBISBin       NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sBISLot       NVARCHAR(12)
       ,@sBISStore     NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@sCheck2       NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@nReturn       INT

declare @sPartConcat    nvarchar(64)
declare @sObjConcat     nvarchar(64)


DECLARE @tParts    TABLE (par_code     NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,par_org      NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,obj_part     NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,obj_serialno NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,obj_code     NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,obj_org      NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)

DECLARE @tBinStock TABLE (par_code     NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,par_org      NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,obj_code     NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,obj_org      NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,bis_bin      NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,bis_lot      NVARCHAR(12) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                         ,bis_store    NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)


INSERT INTO @tParts
SELECT PAR.par_code
      ,PAR.par_org
      ,OBJ.obj_part
      ,OBJ.obj_serialno
      ,OBJ.obj_code
      ,OBJ.obj_org
  FROM r5parts PAR LEFT JOIN r5objects OBJ ON OBJ.obj_part = PAR.par_code AND OBJ.obj_part_org = PAR.par_org
      ,r5descriptions DES
 WHERE ((@sToPart IS NULL AND ISNULL(PAR.par_code, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sFromPart, N'%')) OR (@sToPart IS NOT NULL AND PAR.par_code BETWEEN @sFromPart AND @sToPart))
   AND ISNULL(PAR.par_class, N'%') LIKE ISNULL( @sPartClass, N'%')
   AND ISNULL(PAR.par_class_org, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sPartClassOrg, N'%')
   AND ISNULL(PAR.par_prefsup, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sPartSupp, N'%')
   AND ISNULL(OBJ.obj_code, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sInObject, N'%')
   AND ISNULL(OBJ.obj_org, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sInObjectOrg, N'%')
   AND ISNULL(OBJ.obj_serialno, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sInSerNo, N'%')
   AND (ISNULL(OBJ.obj_category, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sObjCat, N'%') OR ISNULL(PAR.par_category, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sObjCat, N'%'))
   AND DES.des_text LIKE ISNULL( @sPartDesc, N'%' )
   AND DES.des_code = PAR.par_code
   AND DES.des_org = PAR.par_org
   AND DES.des_rentity = N'PART'
   AND DES.des_lang = @sLang
   AND PAR.par_org LIKE ISNULL(@sPartOrg, N'%')
   AND (dbo.O7GETMOS(N'PART') = N'-' OR (EXISTS (SELECT uog_org
                                                 FROM r5userorganization
                                                WHERE uog_user = @sInUser
                                                  AND uog_org = par_org)))
ORDER BY PAR.par_code

INSERT INTO @tBinStock
SELECT PAR.par_code
      ,PAR.par_org
      ,PAR.obj_code
      ,PAR.obj_org
      ,BIS.bis_bin
      ,BIS.bis_lot
      ,BIS.bis_store
  FROM r5binstock BIS
      ,@tParts    PAR
 WHERE BIS.bis_part = PAR.par_code
   AND BIS.bis_part_org = PAR.par_org
   AND ISNULL( BIS.bis_store, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sStore, N'%')
   AND ISNULL( BIS.bis_lot, N'%') LIKE ISNULL(@sLot, N'%')
   AND ISNULL(BIS.bis_bin, N'%') LIKE ISNULL( @sBin, N'%')
   AND (dbo.O7GETMOS(N'STOR') = N'-' OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                                 FROM r5userorganization
                                                     ,r5stores
                                                WHERE uog_user = @sInUser
                                                  AND str_org = uog_org
                                                  AND str_code = bis_store)))
   AND (PAR.obj_code IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1
                                         FROM R5OBJECTS
                                        WHERE obj_store = BIS.bis_store
                                          AND obj_bin = BIS.bis_bin
                                          AND obj_code = PAR.obj_code
                                          AND obj_org = PAR.obj_org))
	AND    BIS.bis_store IN ( SELECT str_code
                         FROM stores
                         WHERE coalesce( str_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')



SELECT @nCounter = 0
      ,@nActual = 0
      ,@sCheck = N'0'
      ,@sCheck2 = N'0'

IF @sChoice = N'1'
   BEGIN

   OPEN GetParts
   WHILE 1=1 and @sCheck <> N'3'
         BEGIN
         FETCH GetParts INTO @sPARCode, @sPAROrg, @sOBJPart, @sOBJSerialNo, @sOBJCode, @sOBJOrg
         IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
            BREAK
         DECLARE GetBinStock CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT bis_bin
               ,bis_lot
               ,bis_store
           FROM @tBinStock
          WHERE par_code = @sPARCode
            AND par_org = @sPAROrg
            AND ISNULL(obj_code, N'*') = ISNULL(@sOBJCode, N'*')
            AND ISNULL(obj_org, N'*') = ISNULL(@sOBJOrg, N'*')
         OPEN GetBinStock
         WHILE 1=1
               BEGIN
               FETCH GetBinStock INTO @sBISBin, @sBISLot, @sBISStore
               IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
                  BREAK
               SET @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
               IF @nCounter > @nMaxLabs
                  BEGIN
                  SET @sCheck = N'3'
                  BREAK
                  END
               set @sPartConcat = @sPARCode + N'#' + @sPAROrg
               set @sObjConcat = @sOBJCode + N'#' + @sOBJOrg
               EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7BARPRT @sEscape, @sSession, @sLang, @nCounter, @sPartConcat, @sBISLot, @sBISStore, @sBISBin, @sObjConcat, @sOBJSerialNo, @sCheck2 OUTPUT
               IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
				   BEGIN
				   CLOSE GetBinStock
				   DEALLOCATE GetBinStock
                   CLOSE GetParts
                   DEALLOCATE GetParts
				   RETURN -1
				   END

               END
         CLOSE GetBinStock

   CLOSE GetParts

	DECLARE GetObjects CURSOR LOCAL FOR

		  ,obj_serialno

	   AND obj_org LIKE ISNULL(@sInObjectOrg, N'%')

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BDRV @nQueue NUMERIC(18, 0)
AS


SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

DECLARE @sErrMsg         NVARCHAR(200)
       ,@sOnHold         NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sCheck          NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sQueue          NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sTenant         NVARCHAR(50)
       ,@nTimeOut        INT
       ,@nStop           INT
       ,@nDeleted        INT
       ,@nTranOrgId      NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@nJobId          INT
       ,@dDate           DATETIME
       ,@sINSDesc        NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@nError          INT
       ,@sParam          NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@dParam          DATETIME
       ,@nINTTranId      NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@sINTKeyField1   NVARCHAR(80)
       ,@sINTKeyField2   NVARCHAR(80)
       ,@nINTTranOrgId   NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@nINTGroup       NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@sINTTable       NVARCHAR(32)
       ,@sINTAction      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@nINTSQLIdentity INT
       ,@nReturn         INT
       ,@nRowCount       INT
       ,@sTranid         nvarchar(38)
	   ,@nBretries       numeric(38,0)

    declare @sProducts          nvarchar(200)
    declare @sAspjobs           nvarchar(200)

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sProducts OUTPUT, N'PRODUCTS', @sCheck OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAspjobs OUTPUT, N'ASPJOBS', @sCheck OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    set @sProducts = upper(@sProducts)
    set @sAspjobs = coalesce(upper(@sAspjobs), N'OFF')

set @nBretries = coalesce(  dbo.o7dflt2( N'BRETRIES'), 1000000000 )

IF NOT (@sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON')
	GOTO PROCESS_ROWS

SELECT @sTenant = dbo.O7GETTEN()
      ,@sQueue = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nQueue)

SET @sParam = N'BDRV' + @sQueue
EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_SET_MODULE @sParam, N'Starting'
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1
LOCK_EXCLUSIVE:

SET @dDate = dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
SET @sINSDesc = N'RUNNING ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), @dDate, 103) + N' ' + CASE DATEPART(MM, @dDate)
                                                                              WHEN  1 THEN N'January'
                                                                              WHEN  2 THEN N'February'
                                                                              WHEN  3 THEN N'March'
                                                                              WHEN  4 THEN N'April'
                                                                              WHEN  5 THEN N'May'
                                                                              WHEN  6 THEN N'June'
                                                                              WHEN  7 THEN N'July'
                                                                              WHEN  8 THEN N'August'
                                                                              WHEN  9 THEN N'September'
                                                                              WHEN 10 THEN N'October'
                                                                              WHEN 11 THEN N'November'
                                                                              WHEN 12 THEN N'December'
                                                                         END
              + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEPART(YY, @dDate)) + N' '
              + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(5), @dDate, 114)

INSERT INTO r5install
           (ins_code
           ,ins_desc
           ,ins_comment
           ,ins_fixed)
    VALUES (N'~BDRV' + @sQueue + N'~'
           ,@sINSDesc
           ,CASE @nQueue WHEN 0 THEN N'Batch Interface Error Driver' ELSE N'Batch Interface Driver ' + @sQueue END
           ,N'-')
commit

END_OF_LOCK_EXCLUSIVE:

IF @nError IN (0, 2601, 2627)
   BEGIN
   IF @sQueue = '0'
      SET @nTimeOut = CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'~SLEEPB0'), N'86400'))
   ELSE
      SET @nTimeOut = CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(dbo.O7DFLT2(N'~SLEEP~'), N'300'))
   SELECT @sParam = N'BDRV' + @sQueue
         ,@nStop = 0
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO_SET_MODULE @sParam, N'Processing'
   IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn != 0
      RETURN -1

PROCESS_ROWS:

   DECLARE ScrollInterface CURSOR LOCAL FOR
   SELECT int_sqlidentity
         ,int_transid
         ,int_transorgid
         ,int_group
         ,int_action
         ,int_keyfld1
         ,int_keyfld2
         ,int_table
     FROM r5interface
    WHERE int_table IN (N'R5BOOKEDHOURSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5EVENTSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5MANUFACTURERINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5OBJECTSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5READINGSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5TRANSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5INSPECTIONSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5REQUISINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5PARTSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5PURCHASEINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE'
                       ,N'R5ACCOUNTDETAILINTERFACE')
      AND int_queue = @nQueue
      AND    coalesce( int_retries, -1 ) <= @nBretries
   ORDER BY int_transorgid, int_group

   OPEN ScrollInterface
   WHILE 1=1
         BEGIN
         FETCH ScrollInterface INTO @nINTSQLIdentity
                                   ,@nINTTranId
                                   ,@nINTTranOrgId
                                   ,@nINTGroup
                                   ,@sINTAction
                                   ,@sINTKeyField1
                                   ,@sINTKeyField2
                                   ,@sINTTable
         IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
            BREAK

		IF @sProducts = N'D7I' or @sAspjobs = N'ON'
			begin
			   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'~SBDRV' + @sQueue + N'~')
				  break
			end

         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5interface WHERE int_transid = @nINTTranId)
            BEGIN
            IF ISNULL(@nTranOrgId, 8888) != ISNULL(@nINTTranOrgId, 9999)
               BEGIN
				   SET @nTranOrgId = @nINTTranOrgId
				   DELETE_ERRORS:
				   IF @nTranOrgId IS NULL
					  DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
					   WHERE ine_transid = @nINTTranId
				   ELSE
					  DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
					   WHERE ine_transid IN (SELECT int_transid
											   FROM r5interface
											  WHERE int_transorgid = @nTranOrgId)
				   SET @nError = @@ERROR
				   IF @nError != 0
					  BREAK
				   END_OF_DELETE_ERRORS:
				   if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					  COMMIT

                    --TNT 07-15-2004: This section of code is not in Oracle and is a workaround
                    --                for a SQL Server-ism in which errors in triggers abort 
                    --                processing without allowing for an @@ERROR check.  Without
                    --                the code block below, when a trigger errors out, the 
                    --                driver stops and all changes are rolled back.  This gives
                    --                the appearnce that the drivers are not running.  
                    --
                    --                This code block pre-marks the row as having an error and
                    --                commits it to tha database so that if this happens, the
                    --                error is already logged and the next time the driver fires
                    --                it will go to the next record.  If the interface runs 
                    --                successfully, this error will have been deleted.

                    --move transaction to error queue
                    UPDATE r5interface
                     SET int_status  = N'+'
	                    ,int_retries = ISNULL(int_retries, 0) + 1
	                    ,int_process = dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
	                    ,int_queue   = 0

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BINLOT
	@sPart				nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg			nvarchar(15),
	@sStore				nvarchar(15),
	@sForm				nvarchar(6),
	@nIoflag			int,
	@nIssueflag			int,
	@sBin				nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
	@sLot				nvarchar(12)	OUTPUT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn	integer
	declare @nCount		integer
	declare @sAnyqty 	nvarchar(1) -- boolean not allowed in where clause
	declare @nRowcount	integer
	set @sChk  = N'0' 
   
	if (@sPart IS NULL OR @sPartorg IS NULL)  
		begin
			set @sChk = 11  
			RETURN 
		end

	if @sStore IS NULL                       
		begin
			set @sChk = 12  
			RETURN 
		end

	if @sForm  IS NULL                       
		begin
			set @sChk = 13  
			RETURN 
		end

	if @nIoflag IS NULL                       
		begin
			set @sChk = 14  
			RETURN 
		end

	if @sForm   NOT IN (N'SDISSU', N'SDTRAN')  
		begin
			set @sChk = 15  
			RETURN 
		end

	if @nIoflag  NOT IN (-1,0,1)        
		begin
			set @sChk = 16  
			RETURN 
		end

	if @sForm = N'SDISSU' 
		begin
			if @nIssueflag IS NULL               
				begin
					set @sChk = 17 
					RETURN 
				end
			if @nIssueflag NOT IN ( -1, 1 )  
				begin
					set @sChk = 18 
					RETURN 
				end
		end
   
	if @nIoflag <>  0  
		begin
			if  @sForm     = N'SDISSU' AND @nIssueflag = 1  
				set @sAnyqty = N'-'
			else
				set @sAnyqty =  N'+'

			if @sBin IS NULL 
				begin
					SELECT   DISTINCT @sBin = b.bis_bin
					FROM     r5binstock b
					WHERE    b.bis_store    = @sStore
					AND      b.bis_part     = @sPart
					AND      b.bis_part_org = @sPartorg
					AND    ( b.bis_qty > 0 OR @sAnyqty = N'+' )
					select @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
					if @nRowcount <> 1 
						begin
							set @sBin  = null
							if @nRowcount > 1
								set @sChk = 1 
						end
				end 

			if  @sBin IS NOT NULL AND @sLot IS     NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @sLot = b.bis_lot
					FROM   r5binstock b
					WHERE  b.bis_store    = @sStore
					AND    b.bis_part     = @sPart
					AND    b.bis_part_org = @sPartorg
					AND    b.bis_bin      = @sBin
					AND   (b.bis_qty > 0 OR @sAnyqty = N'+' ) 
					if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
						set @sLot = null
				end 
		end

create function O7BINQTY(	@sEvent	NVARCHAR(30),
  							@nAct     	INT,
  							@sPart     	NVARCHAR(30),
 	 						@sPartorg 	NVARCHAR(15),
  							@sStore   	NVARCHAR(15),
							@sBin		NVARCHAR(15),
							@sLot		NVARCHAR(12) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nResult numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQtyinstore numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQtyinbin numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCount	int

    SELECT @nQtyinstore = dbo.O7STOQTY(@sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sStore)
	
	SELECT  @nQtyinbin = ISNULL(b.bis_qty,0)
	FROM    r5binstock b
	WHERE   b.bis_part     = @sPart
	   AND  b.bis_part_org = @sPartorg
	   AND  b.bis_store    = @sStore
	   AND  b.bis_lot      = @sLot
	   AND  b.bis_bin      = @sBin
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
		begin
			IF @nQtyinbin > @nQtyinstore
        		set @nResult = @nQtyinstore
     		ELSE
        		set @nResult = @nQtyinbin
		end
	ELSE
		begin
		 IF @sBin IS NOT NULL AND
			@sLot IS NOT NULL
        		set  @nResult = 0
		end  
	return @nResult
end
