       ,@nReturn        INT
	   ,@sPrjrstatus    NVARCHAR(4)      --r5projects.prj_rstatus%type;
       ,@nError         int
	   ,@sBookdate            nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := UPPER( NVL(o7dflt( 'BOOKDATE', chk ), 'ON') );
       ,@dTruncdate     datetime
       ,@nAcdcode       bigint
       ,@sBOIAcdalias   nvarchar(45)

DECLARE GetBookedHoursInterface CURSOR LOCAL FOR
SELECT boi_transorgid
      ,boi_transgroup
      ,boi_event
      ,boi_act
      ,boi_date
      ,boi_trade
      ,boi_mrc
      ,boi_person
      ,boi_octype
      ,boi_on
      ,boi_off
      ,boi_hours
      ,boi_rate
      ,boi_trans
      ,boi_correction
      ,boi_user
      ,boi_org
      ,boi_evtalias
      ,boi_acdalias
  FROM r5bookedhoursinterface
 WHERE boi_transid = @nBOITranId

set @sDefOrg = dbo.O7DFLT2( N'DEFORG' )
set @sMultiOrg = dbo.O7DFLT2( N'MULTIORG' )
set @sBookdate = UPPER( dbo.O7DFLT2( N'BOOKDATE') )

SELECT @sDummy        = NULL
      ,@sErrorMessage = NULL
      ,@sErrorSource  = N'O7BOIINT'
      ,@sErrorType    = N'PROC'
      ,@sErrorCheck   = N'0'

/* Remove all error messages from r5interfaceerrors */
DELETE FROM r5interfaceerrors
 WHERE ine_transid = @nBOITranId


OPEN GetBookedHoursInterface
WHILE 1=1
      BEGIN
      FETCH GetBookedHoursInterface INTO @nBOITransOrgId
                                        ,@nBOITransGroup
                                        ,@sBOIEvent
                                        ,@nBOIAct
                                        ,@dBOIDate
                                        ,@sBOITrade
                                        ,@sBOIMRC
                                        ,@sBOIPerson
                                        ,@sBOIOCType
                                        ,@nBOIOn
                                        ,@nBOIOff
                                        ,@nBOIHours
                                        ,@nBOIRate
                                        ,@nBOITrans
                                        ,@sBOICorrection
                                        ,@sBOIUser
                                        ,@sBOIOrg
                                        ,@sBOIEvtAlias
                                        ,@sBOIAcdalias
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
         BREAK

      -- set session user with boi_user for auditing bookhours insert/update/remove. 
      IF @sBOIUser IS NOT NULL
         EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7SESS_INIT_SESS @sBOIUser, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
               
      SET @sEvtCode = @sBOIEvent
      IF @sBOIEvent IS NULL AND @sBOIEvtAlias IS NOT NULL
         SELECT @sEvtCode = evt_code
           FROM r5events
          WHERE evt_code_alias = @sBOIEvtAlias

      IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
        begin
         IF @sBOIUser IS NULL
            BEGIN
				CLOSE GetBookedHoursInterface
				DEALLOCATE GetBookedHoursInterface
                EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'40', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
                IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
				    RETURN -1
                RETURN
            END

         /* Organization code is mandatory when multiorg security is ON */
         IF @sBOIOrg IS NULL
            BEGIN
                SELECT @sOrg = EVT.evt_org
                  FROM r5events EVT
                      ,r5userorganization UOG
                 WHERE EVT.evt_code = @sEvtCode
                   AND EVT.evt_org = UOG.uog_org
                   AND UOG.uog_user = @sBOIUser
                   AND UOG.uog_common = N'-'

                IF @sOrg IS NULL
                    BEGIN
                        CLOSE GetBookedHoursInterface
                        DEALLOCATE GetBookedHoursInterface
                        EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'41', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
					    IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
					        RETURN -1
                        RETURN
                    END
            END
         ELSE
            SET @sOrg = @sBOIOrg

         IF dbo.O7CHECKORG(ISNULL(@sBOIOrg, @sOrg) , @sBOIUser, N'-') != 1
            BEGIN
				CLOSE GetBookedHoursInterface
				DEALLOCATE GetBookedHoursInterface
                EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'42', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, NULL, @sBOIOrg, @sBOIUser, NULL
			    IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
				    RETURN -1
                RETURN
            END
        end
      ELSE
         SET @sOrg = @sDefOrg

      IF @sBOIEvent IS NULL AND @sBOIEvtAlias IS NOT NULL
         SELECT @sEvtCode = evt_code
           FROM r5events
          WHERE evt_code_alias = @sBOIEvtAlias
      ELSE
         SET @sEvtCode = @sBOIEvent

      IF @dBOIDate is null
			BEGIN
		        EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, N'1', @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, @sErrorSource, NULL, NULL, NULL
			    IF @@ERROR != 0 or @nReturn != 0
			        BEGIN
				        CLOSE GetBookedHoursInterface
				        DEALLOCATE GetBookedHoursInterface
				        RETURN -1
			        END
			END

      /* Get Occupation rType */
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7CKCODE @sBookedOCRType OUTPUT, @sBOIOCType OUTPUT, N'OCTP', @sCheck OUTPUT
      set @nError = @@ERROR
      IF @nError != 0 or @nReturn != 0
        begin
	        CLOSE GetBookedHoursInterface
	        DEALLOCATE GetBookedHoursInterface
		    EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTranId, @nError, N'O7BOIINT', N'O

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare		@sOrg		nvarchar(15) --r5organization.org_code%type 
	declare		@nCount			integer
	declare		@sX			nvarchar(1)
BEGIN
	set @sChk         = N'0'

	IF   @sBookedmrc      IS NULL
	OR  @sBookedtrade  IS NULL
	OR  @dBookeddate   IS NULL
	OR  @sBookedoctype IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	IF @sBookedevent IS NOT NULL 
		SELECT @sOrg = evt_org
		FROM   r5events
		WHERE  evt_code = @sBookedevent

	set @nRate = 0

	SELECT TOP 1 @dStartdate = trr_start,
			@dEnddate = trr_end, 
			@nRate = trr_ntrate
	FROM   r5traderates
	WHERE  trr_mrc               IN( N'*', @sBookedmrc )
	AND    coalesce( trr_person, N'*') IN( N'*', @sBooperson )
	AND    trr_trade        IN( @sBookedtrade, N'*' )
	AND    trr_supplier     = N'*'
	AND    trr_supplier_org = N'*'
	AND    trr_org          = @sOrg
	AND    trr_octype       = @sBookedoctype
	AND    trr_start       <= @dBookeddate
	AND    trr_end         >=  @dBookeddate
	ORDER BY  CASE trr_person WHEN N'*' THEN N'ZZZZ' ELSE trr_person END, 
				CASE trr_trade WHEN N'*' THEN N'ZZZZ' ELSE trr_trade END, 
				CASE trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN N'ZZZZ' ELSE trr_mrc END 
END

create procedure O7BOORA1 @nOutput numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sBookedmrc      nvarchar(15),
	@sBookedtrade    nvarchar(15),
	@sBookedoctype   nvarchar(4),
	@sBookedocrtype  nvarchar(4),
	@sBookeddate     DATETIME,
	@sBookedorg      nvarchar(30),
	@sBooperson		 nvarchar(15),
	@sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nBookedrate			numeric(24,6) --r5traderates.trr_ntrate%type 
	declare @sX						nvarchar(1)
	declare @nTraderate				numeric(24,6) --r5traderates.trr_ntrate%type          /* Normal Rate       */
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nDeforg				nvarchar(15) --r5organization.org_code%type 
	declare @sChk1					nvarchar(3) 
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @nCount					int

	/* init */
	set @sX = NULL
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @nDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* check mandatory parammeters */
	if   @sBookedmrc    IS NULL	OR  @sBookeddate   IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			set @nOutput = NULL
			RETURN
		end 
	if   @sBookedtrade  IS NULL
		begin
			set @nOutput = NULL
			RETURN
		end 

	if @sBookedoctype IS NOT NULL 
	/* W0312A2    Select Rates from Traderates   */
		begin
			if @sBookedocrtype IN ( N'N', N'O', N'*') 
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5traderates t
					WHERE  t.trr_mrc					IN ( N'*', @sBookedmrc )
			        AND    isnull(t.trr_person, N'*')	IN ( N'*', @sBooperson )
					AND    t.trr_trade					IN ( @sBookedtrade, N'*')
					AND    t.trr_supplier				= N'*'
					AND    t.trr_supplier_org			= @nDeforg
					AND    t.trr_org					= coalesce( @sBookedorg, @nDeforg )
					AND    t.trr_octype					= @sBookedoctype
					AND    t.trr_start					<= @sBookeddate
					AND    t.trr_end					>=  @sBookeddate
					
					if @nCount > 0 
						SELECT @nBookedrate = t.trr_ntrate
						FROM   r5traderates t
						WHERE  t.trr_mrc					IN ( N'*', @sBookedmrc )
						AND    t.trr_person					IN ( N'*', @sBooperson )
						AND    t.trr_trade					IN ( @sBookedtrade, N'*')
						AND    t.trr_supplier				= N'*'
						AND    t.trr_supplier_org			= @nDeforg
						AND    t.trr_org					= coalesce( @sBookedorg, @nDeforg )
						AND    t.trr_octype					= @sBookedoctype
						AND    t.trr_start					<= @sBookeddate
						AND    t.trr_end					>=  @sBookeddate
				        ORDER BY CASE isnull(t.trr_person, N'*') WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC,
									CASE isnull(t.trr_trade, N'*') WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC,
									CASE isnull(t.trr_mrc, N'*') WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC
					else
						set @nBookedrate = null
				end
			else
				set @nBookedrate = 0
		end
	else
		/* PVCS 2495 Paul van Gastel Retrieve standard trade rates when no user occupation type */
		/* is provided                                                                          */
		begin
		    if @sBookedocrtype IN ( N'N', N'O', N'*') 
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5traderates t
					WHERE  t.trr_trade					= @sBookedtrade
					AND    t.trr_mrc					IN ( N'*', @sBookedmrc )
					AND    t.trr_person					IN ( N'*', @sBooperson )
					AND    t.trr_supplier				= N'*'
					AND    t.trr_supplier_org			= @nDeforg
					AND    t.trr_org					= COALESCE( @sBookedorg, @nDeforg )
					AND    t.trr_start					<= @sBookeddate
					AND    t.trr_end					>=  @sBookeddate
					AND    t.trr_octype					IN (SELECT uco_code
															FROM r5ucodes
															WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
															AND   uco_rcode   = @sBookedocrtype
															AND   uco_system  = N'+')
					if @nCount > 0 
				        SELECT @nBookedrate = t.trr_ntrate
						FROM   r5traderates t
						WHERE  t.trr_trade					= @sBookedtrade
						AND    t.trr_mrc					IN ( N'*', @sBookedmrc )
						AND    isnull( t.trr_person, N'*')	IN ( N'*', @sBooperson )
						AND    t.trr_supplier				= N'*'
						AND    t.trr_supplier_org			= @nDeforg
						AND    t.trr_org					= COALESCE( @sBookedorg, @nDeforg )
						AND    t.trr_start					<= @sBookeddate
						AND    t.trr_end					>=  @sBookeddate
						AND    t.trr_octype					IN (SELECT uco_code
																FROM r5ucodes
																WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
																AND   uco_rcode   = @sBookedocrtype
																AND   uco_system  = N'+')
				        ORDER BY CASE isnull(t.trr_person, N'*') WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC,
									CASE isnull(t.trr_trade, N'*') WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC,
									CASE isnull(t.trr_mrc, N'*') WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC
					else
						set @nBookedrate = 0
				end
			else
				set @nBookedrate = 0
		end

	set @nOutput = @nBookedrate

create procedure o7boora2  @nReturn numeric(24,12) OUTPUT,
 @sOrderlinertype nvarchar(3),
 @nOrdprice     numeric(24,6),
 @nRecprice     numeric(24,6),
 @nExchrate     numeric(24,12),
 @sChk	         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

 
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nBookedrate            numeric(24,12)
	declare @nPrice                 numeric(24,6)
	declare @nExchrate2             numeric(24,12)
	declare @nRdecs                 int

   /* init */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
   /* check mandatory parameters */
	if @sOrderlinertype IS   NULL OR  @sOrderlinertype NOT IN ( N'SF', N'ST' )     
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			set @nReturn = -1
		end
	
	/* prevent division by zero */
	set @nExchrate2 = coalesce( @nExchrate, 1 )
	if @nExchrate2 = 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			set @nReturn = -2
			RETURN 
		end

	if  @sOrderlinertype = N'ST' 
        -- W0312B1A get price from activity, orderline  for time and material
		set @nPrice =  coalesce( @nOrdprice, 0.0 ) 
	else   
		--  W0312B1B Fixed price service: interpret boo_hours as amount
		-- received in foreign currency
		set @nPrice = 1.0 

	set @nBookedrate = @nPrice  / @nExchrate2 
	set @nRdecs      = 17 -  charindex( cast( @nBookedrate as nvarchar(64)  ) , N'.',1 )   
	set @nBookedrate =  ROUND( @nBookedrate, @nRdecs )   
	set @nReturn = @nBookedrate

create procedure O7BOORAT
	@nOutput			numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sMrc				nvarchar(15),
	@sTrade				nvarchar(15),
	@sBookedoctype		nvarchar(4),
	@sBookedocrtype		nvarchar(4),
	@sBookeddate		datetime,
	@sOrderlinertype	nvarchar(2),
	@sBookedevent		nvarchar(30),
	@nBookedact			int,
	@nOrlordprice		numeric(24,6),
	@nOrlrecprice		numeric(24,6),
	@nOrlexch			numeric(24,12),
	@sBooperson			nvarchar(15),
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@nBookedrate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTemprate				numeric(24,12)
	declare @sOrg					nvarchar(15) --r5organization.org_code%type 
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount					int
	declare @nReturn				int

/* initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	
	if @sTrade is null or @sMrc is null
		/* Return without error if no trade specified. */
		return

	if @sOrderlinertype IN ( N'ST', N'SF' )     /* W0312A1A  W0312A1B */
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7BOORA2 @nTemprate OUTPUT, @sOrderlinertype, @nOrlordprice, @nOrlrecprice, @nOrlexch, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					if @sCheckresult = N'1' 
						set @sChk = N'1'
					else
						set @sChk = N'996'

					set @nOutput = -2
					return
				end

		  if @sOrderlinertype = N'ST' 
			set @nBookedrate = coalesce( ROUND( @nTemprate, 6 ), 0 )
		  else
			 set @nBookedrate = coalesce( ROUND( @nTemprate, 6 ), 0 )
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sBookedevent IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @sOrg = evt_org
					FROM   r5events
					WHERE  evt_code = @sBookedevent
				end
			ELSE IF @sBooperson IS NOT NULL
	        BEGIN
		      	 SELECT @sOrg = per_org
		      	 FROM   r5personnel
		      	 WHERE  per_code = @sBooperson
	         END

			execute @nReturn = O7BOORA1 @nTemprate OUTPUT, @sMrc, @sTrade, @sBookedoctype, @sBookedocrtype, @sBookeddate, @sOrg, @sBooperson, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					if @sCheckresult = N'1' 
						set @sChk = N'1'
					else
						set @sChk = N'995'

					set @nOutput =  -1
					return
				end
			set @nBookedrate = ROUND( @nTemprate, 6 )
		end
   
   set @nOutput = @nBookedrate

CREATE PROCEDURE O7BREAKUPKIT
  @lot            NVARCHAR( 12 ),
  @kitstore       NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @kitpart        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @kitpartorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @kitevent       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @kitact         NUMERIC (8,0),
  @kituser        NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @lang           NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @tracode        NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUTPUT,
  @chk            NVARCHAR( 4 )  OUTPUT
  
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @kitbin         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @storeorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @buildkittrans  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @x              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @errs           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @message        NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @cnt            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sys_date       DATETIME
  DECLARE @chk2           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @obtype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @obrtype        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @price          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @tline          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @ltype          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ltyperr        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @llot           NVARCHAR( 12 )
  DECLARE @evtrstatus     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @evtcompleted   DATETIME
  DECLARE @issdays        NUMERIC
  DECLARE @rtndays        NUMERIC
  DECLARE @qtyiss         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @qtyrep         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @return         INTEGER
  DECLARE @transline      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @buptransline   NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @buppart        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @buppartorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @bupobject      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @bupobjectorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @bupqty         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @bupqtyused     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @bupqtytostore  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @bupqtytorepair NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @bupstorebin    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @buprepairbin   NVARCHAR( 15 )


  SET @errs = '-'
  SET @sys_date = getdate()
  SET @issdays = ISNULL( dbo.o7dflt2( N'ISSDAYS' ), 0 )
  SET @rtndays = ISNULL( dbo.o7dflt2( N'RTNDAYS' ), 0 )

  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @ltype OUTPUT, N'I', N'TRTP', @chk2 OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @ltyperr OUTPUT, N'RR', N'TRTP', @chk2 OUTPUT
  
  SET @chk = '0'

  /* Retrieve lot info. */
  SELECT @kitbin = bis_bin, 
         @buildkittrans = lot_buildkittrans, 
         @storeorg = str_org
  FROM   r5stores, r5binstock, r5lots
  WHERE  str_code  = @kitstore
  AND    lot_code  = @lot
  AND    bis_lot   = lot_code
  AND    bis_store =@kitstore
  AND    bis_qty   = 1
  AND    lot_buildkittrans   IS NOT NULL
  AND    lot_breakupkittrans IS NULL

  IF @storeorg IS NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Lot number not correct. */
      SET @chk = '1'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Check if all lines are there. */
  SET @x = NULL
  SELECT @x = 'x'
  FROM   r5translines
  WHERE  trl_trans = @buildkittrans
  AND    trl_qty > 0
  AND   NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5breakupkitparts
                    WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
                    AND    bup_transline = trl_line
                    AND    bup_part = trl_part
                    AND    bup_part_org = trl_part_org
                    AND    ISNULL( bup_object, N'x' ) = ISNULL( trl_object, N'x' )
                    AND    ISNULL( bup_object_org, N'x' ) = ISNULL( trl_object_org, N'x' ) )
  IF @x IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Lines missing or not correct. */
      SET @chk = '2'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Check whether WO required. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*), 
         @qtyiss = SUM( ISNULL( bup_qtyused, 0 ) + ISNULL( bup_qtytorepair, 0 ) ), 
         @qtyrep = SUM( bup_qtytorepair )
  FROM   r5breakupkitparts 
  WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
  AND    ISNULL( bup_qtyused, 0 ) + ISNULL( bup_qtytorepair, 0 ) > 0
  IF @cnt > 0 
    BEGIN
      IF @kitevent IS NULL OR @kitact IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* WO/Act required. */
          SET @chk = '3'
          RETURN
        END  
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Check whether activity correct, */
          SELECT @evtrstatus = evt_rstatus, 
                 @evtcompleted = evt_completed
          FROM   r5ucodes, r5events, r5activities
          WHERE  act_event = evt_code  
          AND    act_event = @kitevent
          AND    act_act = @kitact
          AND    evt_org = @storeorg
          AND    evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
          AND    evt_rstatus IN ( N'R', N'C' )
          AND    uco_rentity = N'JBTP'
          AND    uco_code = evt_jobtype
          AND    uco_rcode <> N'MEC'
          IF @evtrstatus IS NULL
            BEGIN
              /* WO/Act invalid. */
              SET @chk = '7'
              RETURN
            END
          IF @evtrstatus = 'C'
            BEGIN
              IF @qtyiss > 0 AND @evtcompleted + @issdays < @sys_date
                BEGIN
                  /* WO completed too long ago to allow issue. */
                  SET @chk = '9'
                  RETURN
                END  
              IF @qtyrep > 0 AND @evtcompleted + @rtndays < @sys_date
                BEGIN
                  /* WO completed too long ago to allow return. */
                  SET @chk = '10'
                  RETURN
                END          
            END
        END
    END

  /* Reset error message column. */
  UPDATE r5breakupkitparts
  SET    bup_message = NULL
  WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
  
  /* Check whether numbers are correct. */
  SET @message = NULL
  DECLARE c_bup CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT bup_transline
    FROM   r5breakupkitparts
    WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
    AND    bup_qty <> dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( bup_qtyused, 0 ), 0 ) + 
                      dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( bup_qtytostore, 0 ), 0 ) + 
                      dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( bup_qtytorepair, 0 ), 0 )
  OPEN c_bup
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_bup INTO @transline
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @errs = N'+'
      IF @message IS NULL
        SELECT @message = ert_text
        FROM   r5errtexts, r5errsource
        WHERE  ers_code   = ert_code
        AND    ers_source = N'O7BREAKUPKIT'
        AND    ers_type   = N'PROC'
        AND    ers_number = 4
        AND    ert_lang   = @lang 
      UPDATE r5breakupkitparts
      SET    bup_message = ISNULL( bup_message, '' ) + CASE WHEN bup_message IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ';' END + @message
      WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
      AND    bup_transline = @transline
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_bup INTO @transline
    END       
  CLOSE c_bup
  DEALLOCATE c_bup
  
  /* Check whether store bin is correct. */
  SET @message = NULL
  DECLARE c_bup CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT bup_transline
    FROM   r5breakupkitparts
    WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
    AND    bup_storebin IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5bins
                    WHERE  bin_store = @kitstore
                    AND    bin_code = bup_storebin )
  OPEN c_bup
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_bup INTO @transline
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @errs = N'+'
      IF @message IS NULL
        SELECT @message = ert_text
        FROM   r5errtexts, r5errsource
        WHERE  ers_code   = ert_code
        AND    ers_source = N'O7BREAKUPKIT'
        AND    ers_type   = N'PROC'
        AND    ers_number = 5
        AND    ert_lang   = @lang 
      UPDATE r5breakupkitparts
      SET    bup_message = ISNULL( bup_message, '' ) + CASE WHEN bup_message IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ';' END + @message
      WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
      AND    bup_transline = @transline
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_bup INTO @transline
    END       
  CLOSE c_bup
  DEALLOCATE c_bup
   
  /* Check whether repair bin is correct. */
  SET @message = NULL
  DECLARE c_bup CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT bup_transline
    FROM   r5breakupkitparts
    WHERE  bup_lot = @lot
    AND    bup_repairbin IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5bins
                    WHERE  bin_store = @kitstore

  DECLARE @bkp_issueqty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @obj_obtype          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @obj_obrtype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @obj_mrc             NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @found16             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @seperator           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  
  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

  SET @errs = N'-'
  SET @kitparts = 0
  SET @chk = '0'
  SET @sys_date = getdate()

  SET @x = NULL
  SELECT @x = 'x'

  IF @x IS NULL

    END

  /* Reset error message column. */
  UPDATE r5kitparts
  SET    bkp_message = NULL,

  WHERE  bkp_sessionid = @sessionid

  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)

  WHERE  bkp_sessionid = @sessionid
  AND    bkp_object IS NOT NULL
  /* If kits to build > 1, then no assets allowed. */
  IF @bks_noofkitstobuild > 1 
    BEGIN
      IF @cnt > 0

          SET @chk = '3'

    END

  IF @cnt > 0
    BEGIN

      IF @x IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Install parameter SYSKIT1 is wrong. */

    END 

  SET @x = NULL
  SELECT @x = 'x'
  FROM   r5kittemplates
  WHERE  ktt_kittemplate = @bks_kitpart
  AND    ktt_kittemplate_org = @bks_kitpart_org
  AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                  FROM   r5kitparts
                  WHERE  bkp_sessionid = @sessionid
                  AND    bkp_part      = ktt_part
                  AND    bkp_part_org  = ktt_part_org )
  IF @x IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN

    END

  /* Parts deleted from template. */
  SET @message = NULL
  DECLARE c_ktt CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT DISTINCT bkp_part, bkp_part_org
    FROM   r5kitparts
    WHERE  bkp_sessionid = @sessionid
    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5kittemplates
                    WHERE  ktt_kittemplate = @bks_kitpart
                    AND    ktt_kittemplate_org = @bks_kitpart_org
                    AND    ktt_part = bkp_part
                    AND    ktt_part_org = bkp_part_org )
  OPEN c_ktt
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_ktt INTO @part, @partorg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @errs = N'+'

        SELECT @message = ert_text
        FROM   r5errtexts, r5errsource

        AND    ers_source = N'O7BUILDKIT'

      WHERE  bkp_sessionid = @sessionid

CREATE function O7BZSNAP ( @p_Entity  NVARCHAR(30), 
                           @p_Field NVARCHAR(30), 
                           @p_R5_Lang NVARCHAR(30) ) returns nvarchar(256)
as
 
BEGIN
    Declare @v_ELM_BASECOL    NVARCHAR(50)
    Declare @v_Resultado      NVARCHAR(256)
    Declare @v_Function       NVARCHAR(6)
    
    SELECT @v_ELM_BASECOL = ELM_BASECOL 
    FROM   R5ELECMAPPING
    WHERE  ELM_ENTITY   = @p_Entity
    AND    ELM_ARCHCOL  = @p_Field
    If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
        RETURN NULL
    
    SELECT @v_Resultado = BOT_TEXT 
    FROM R5BOILERTEXTS
    WHERE BOT_FUNCTION = CASE @p_Entity
                     WHEN N'ACT'  THEN N'BZACTD'
                     WHEN N'BORD' THEN N'BZBLOD'
                     WHEN N'BORL' THEN N'BZBLLD'
                     WHEN N'BUD'  THEN N'BZPCLD'
                     WHEN N'CHNL' THEN N'BZCNLD'
                     WHEN N'CHNO' THEN N'BZCNHD'
                     WHEN N'DOCU' THEN N'BZDAED'
                     WHEN N'EAL'  THEN N'BZEALD'
                     WHEN N'EVNT' THEN N'BZEVTD'
                     WHEN N'INRH' THEN N'BZEPOD'
                     WHEN N'INSP' THEN N'BZDKLD'
                     WHEN N'INV'  THEN N'BZINVD'
                     WHEN N'INVL' THEN N'BZIVLD'
                     WHEN N'ISSU' THEN N'BZISSD'
                     WHEN N'MATL' THEN N'BZMTLD'
                     WHEN N'MLP'  THEN N'BZMLPD'
                     WHEN N'OBJ'  THEN N'BZOBJD'
                     WHEN N'PART' THEN N'BZEPAD'
                     WHEN N'PERM' THEN N'BZPRED'
                     WHEN N'PICK' THEN N'BZPICD'
                     WHEN N'PICP' THEN N'BZPIPD'
                     WHEN N'PORD' THEN N'BZORDD'
                     WHEN N'PORL' THEN N'BZORLD'
                     WHEN N'PPA'  THEN N'BZPPAD'
                     WHEN N'PPM'  THEN N'BZPPMD'
                     WHEN N'PROJ' THEN N'BZPRJD'
                     WHEN N'PROM' THEN N'BZPRVD'
                     WHEN N'ADD'  THEN N'BZADDD'
                     WHEN N'QUOL' THEN N'BZQULD'
                     WHEN N'QUOT' THEN N'BZQUOD'
                     WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'BZRECD'
                     WHEN N'REQ'  THEN N'BZREQD'
                     WHEN N'REQL' THEN N'BZRQLD'
                     WHEN N'RETN' THEN N'BZRETD'
                     WHEN N'SCAT' THEN N'BZSCAD'
                     WHEN N'STOS' THEN N'BZSTOD'
                     WHEN N'TASK' THEN N'BZTSKD'
                     WHEN N'TRAN' THEN N'BZTRAD'
                     WHEN N'TRL'  THEN N'BZTRLD'
                     WHEN N'WAR'  THEN N'BZWARD'
                     WHEN N'RFQ'  THEN N'BZRFQD'
                     WHEN N'RFQL' THEN N'BZRFLD'
                     WHEN N'RFQR' THEN N'BZRFRD'
                     WHEN N'RFRL' THEN N'BZRRLD'
                     WHEN N'CAMP' THEN N'BZCAMD'
                     WHEN N'PREQ' THEN N'BZPRQD' 
		             WHEN N'ETP'  THEN N'BZETPD'
                     WHEN N'PTW'  THEN N'BZPMTW'
                     WHEN N'SFWO' THEN N'BZSFWO'
                     WHEN N'LTPW' THEN N'BZLTPW'
                     WHEN N'CHKL' THEN N'BZACKD'
                     WHEN N'CNFL' THEN N'BZPWCD'
                     ELSE N'?'
                     END
    AND   BOT_LANG     = @p_R5_Lang
    AND   LTRIM(RTRIM(BOT_FLD1)) = @p_Entity + N'.' + @p_Field
    IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        RETURN @v_ELM_BASECOL

    set @v_Resultado = @v_Resultado + N':' 
           
    Return @v_Resultado
   
END

create function O7CALCCOSTS( @sProject	nvarchar(20),
								@sPurchaseorder	nvarchar(30),
								@sPurchaseorg	nvarchar(15) )
returns int
as
begin
	declare @nResult		int
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
	
	declare @tProjects table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )

	--build hierarchical result set
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_parent = @sProject
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tProjects values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select prj_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5projects
										 where prj_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	SELECT @nResult = ROUND( SUM( dbo.f_greatest_number( CASE o.orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN o.orl_price - COALESCE( o.orl_recvvalue, 0 )
								ELSE (((COALESCE(o.orl_ordqty, 0) - COALESCE( o.orl_recvqty, 0 ) - COALESCE( o.orl_scrapqty, 0 ) ) / COALESCE( o.orl_multiply, 1 )) * o.orl_price  * (1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 )) 
										+ ((COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) * ( (COALESCE(o.orl_ordqty, 0) - COALESCE( o.orl_recvqty, 0 ) - COALESCE( o.orl_scrapqty, 0)) /COALESCE(o.orl_ordqty, 0)))) END
								/ COALESCE( o.orl_exch, 1 ) , 0)), 2)
	FROM r5orderlines o
	WHERE o.orl_order = @sPurchaseorder
	AND o.orl_order_org = @sPurchaseorg
	AND o.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
	AND o.orl_active = N'+'
	AND ( o.orl_project IN
			(	SELECT prj_code
				FROM @tProjects
				UNION
				SELECT @sProject 
			) 
		)

	return (ROUND(COALESCE(@nResult, 0), 2))

end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CALCCUSTINVTOTALS
  @inv            NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @invrev         NUMERIC,
  @invorg         NVARCHAR( 15 )
AS
BEGIN  
    
  DECLARE @netamount       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @adjustments     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @taxamount       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )  
  DECLARE @adjadjustments  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @adjtaxamount    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )  
  DECLARE @discbase        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @discount        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @previnvoiced    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @prevdiscounted  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @contractvalue   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @maxline         NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @allinvoices     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @cadpk           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cadstatus       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @cadrtype        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @cadtype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @taxpercentage   NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @nextinv         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @nextinvorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @nextinvrev      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @contract        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @contractorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @contractrev     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tax             NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @todate          DATETIME  
  DECLARE @curr            NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @return          INT
  DECLARE @d               INT
  DECLARE @minvalue        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @percentage      NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @applyfullamount NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @whereused       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @cadstatus OUTPUT, N'I', N'AJST', @chk OUTPUT
  
  /* Retrieve customer invoice data. */
  SELECT @contract    = civ_contract, 
         @contractorg = civ_contract_org, 
         @contractrev = civ_contract_revision,
         @tax         = civ_tax, 
         @todate      = civ_todate,
         @curr        = civ_curr,
         @whereused   = civ_whereused
  FROM   r5customerinvoices
  WHERE  civ_code     = @inv
  AND    civ_revision = @invrev
  AND    civ_org      = @invorg
  
  /* Get sum of amounts from table r5customerinvoiceitems. */
  SELECT @netamount   = COALESCE( SUM( COALESCE( cii_adjustednet, cii_netamount ) ), 0 ),
         @adjustments = COALESCE( SUM( cii_adjustments ), 0 ),
         @taxamount   = COALESCE( SUM( cii_taxamount ), 0 )
  FROM   r5customerinvoiceitems
  WHERE  cii_invoice          = @inv
  AND    cii_invoice_revision = @invrev
  AND    cii_invoice_org      = @invorg
  
  /* Get sum of adjustment amounts from table r5customerinvoicedetails. */
  SELECT @adjadjustments = COALESCE( SUM( cid_invoiceamount ), 0 ),
         @adjtaxamount   = COALESCE( SUM( cid_invoicetaxamount ), 0 )
  FROM   r5ucodes, r5customerinvoicedetails
  WHERE  cid_invoice          = @inv
  AND    cid_invoice_revision = @invrev
  AND    cid_invoice_org      = @invorg
  AND    cid_adjustmenttype   = uco_code
  AND    cid_invoiceitem IS NULL
  AND    uco_rentity          = N'AJTP'
  AND    uco_rcode NOT IN ( N'CD', N'ID' )

  SET @adjustments = @adjustments + @adjadjustments
  SET @taxamount   = @taxamount + @adjtaxamount  

  SET @d = 1 
  WHILE @d <= 2 AND @whereused = 'CT01'
    BEGIN
      SET @cadpk = NULL
      IF @d = 1
        BEGIN
          /* Discount for all individual invoices on contracts */
          SET @allinvoices = N'+'
          SET @discbase    = @netamount + @adjustments
          SET @cadrtype    = N'ID'
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @cadtype OUTPUT, @cadrtype, N'AJTP', @chk OUTPUT
        END  
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Discount on contract across all invoices. */
          SET @allinvoices = N'-'      
          SET @discbase    = @contractvalue
          SET @cadrtype    = N'CD'
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @cadtype OUTPUT, @cadrtype, N'AJTP', @chk OUTPUT
        END  
        
      /* Get discounts. */
      SET @discount = 0
      DECLARE c_cdc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT cdc_minvalue, cdc_percentage, cdc_applyfullamount
        FROM   r5contractdiscounts
        WHERE  cdc_contract          = @contract
        AND    cdc_contract_org      = @contractorg
        AND    cdc_contractrevision  = @contractrev
        AND    cdc_applyeachinvoice  = @allinvoices
        AND    cdc_minvalue          < @discbase
        ORDER BY cdc_minvalue DESC
      OPEN c_cdc 
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_cdc INTO @minvalue, @percentage, @applyfullamount
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @applyfullamount = N'-'
            BEGIN
              SET @discount = @discount + ( ( @discbase - @minvalue ) * @percentage / 100 )
              SET @discbase = @minvalue
            END  
          ELSE
            BEGIN
              SET @discount = @discbase * @percentage / 100
              BREAK
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_cdc INTO @minvalue, @percentage, @applyfullamount
        END
      CLOSE c_cdc
      DEALLOCATE c_cdc  

      /* Delete existing adjustment. */
      DELETE FROM r5customerinvoicedetails
      WHERE  cid_invoice          = @inv
      AND    cid_invoice_revision = @invrev
      AND    cid_invoice_org      = @invorg
      AND EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
                  FROM   r5ucodes
                  WHERE  uco_code    = cid_adjustmenttype 
                  AND    uco_rentity = N'AJTP'
                  AND    uco_rcode   = @cadrtype )
      DELETE FROM r5contractadjustments
      WHERE  cad_invoice          = @inv
      AND    cad_invoice_org      = @invorg
      AND    cad_rtype            = @cadrtype

      IF @d = 2
        /* For Contract Discount, subtract the previously discounted value. */
        SET @discount = @discount + COALESCE( @prevdiscounted, 0 )

      IF @discount <> 0
        BEGIN
          /* Get tax percentage. */
          SET @taxpercentage = dbo.o7gettax( @tax, @todate )
          /* Insert new adjustemnt record. */
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @cadpk OUTPUT, N'CAD', N'1', @chk OUTPUT          
          INSERT INTO r5contractadjustments( cad_pk, cad_contract, cad_contract_org, cad_contractrevision, cad_date,
                 cad_status, cad_rstatus, cad_type, cad_rtype, cad_qty, cad_rate, cad_tax, cad_taxamount, cad_exch,
                 cad_invoice, cad_invoice_revision, cad_invoice_org, cad_invoiceamount, cad_invoicetaxamount )
          VALUES( @cadpk, @contract, @contractorg, @contractrev, @todate,
                  @cadstatus, N'I', @cadtype, @cadrtype, 1, -@discount, @tax, -@discount * @taxpercentage / 100, 1,
                  @inv, @invrev, @invorg, -@discount, -@discount * @taxpercentage / 100 )
        
          SELECT @maxline = COALESCE( MAX( cid_invoiceline ), 0 ) + 1
          FROM   r5customerinvoicedetails
          WHERE  cid_invoice          = @inv
          AND    cid_invoice_org      = @invorg
          AND    cid_invoice_revision = @invrev
        
          /* Insert the customer invoice detail line. */
          INSERT INTO r5customerinvoicedetails( cid_invoice, cid_invoice_org, cid_invoice_revision, cid_invoiceline,
                 cid_currency, cid_adjustmenttype, cid_invoiceqty, cid_invoiceprice, cid_fromdate, 
                 cid_todate, cid_transactionamount, cid_transactiontotal, cid_correctedtotal, cid_taxbase, cid_taxpercentage,
                 cid_taxamount, cid_exch, cid_invoiceamount, cid_invoicetaxamount )
          VALUES( @inv, @invorg, @invrev, @maxline,
                  @curr, @cadtype, 1, -@discount, @todate,
                  @todate, -@discount, -@discount, -@discount, -@discount, @taxpercentage,
                  -@discount * @taxpercentage / 100, 1, -@discount, -@discount * @taxpercentage / 100 )

       ,@sErrorCheck         NVARCHAR(30)

       ,@sErrorParm1         NVARCHAR(30)

       ,@nDummy              NUMERIC(24,6)
       ,@sDummy              NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@nReturn             INT
	   ,@sEvtOrg             NVARCHAR(15)
       ,@nTemp               int

DECLARE @tCalcEvtLines TABLE (cel_event       NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NOT NULL
                             ,cel_increment   NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
                             ,cel_line        NUMERIC(4, 0)                                       NOT NULL
                             ,cel_rtype       NVARCHAR(8)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
                             ,cel_cost        NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
                             ,cel_calc        NUMERIC(24, 6)                                          NULL
                             ,cel_trade       NVARCHAR(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
                             ,cel_octype      NVARCHAR(4)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
                             ,cel_hours       NUMERIC(12, 2)                                          NULL
                             ,cel_part        NVARCHAR(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
                             ,cel_part_org    NVARCHAR(15)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN     NULL
                             ,cel_sqlidentity INT                                                 NOT NULL)



SELECT @sErrorSource = N'O7CALCEV'
      ,@sErrorType = N'PROC'
      ,@nIncrement = null
	  ,@nAddLine = 0

IF @sEvent IS NULL
   BEGIN
       set @nIncrement = null
	   EXECUTE dbo.O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, 1
       RETURN
   END

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7DFLT @sDefOrg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheck OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
	begin
		set @nIncrement = null
		RETURN
	end

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7GETAGR @sEvent, @sAgreement OUTPUT, @nCount OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
	begin
		set @nIncrement = null
		RETURN
	end

/* Quit if no agreement match and debtor not wildcard */
IF @nCount = 0 AND @sDebtor != N'%'
    begin
        set @nIncrement = -1
        RETURN
    end

IF @nCount = 1
   BEGIN
       EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7AGR_MORE_AGR_DEBTOR @sMoreAgrDebtor OUTPUT, @sAgreement, NULL
       IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
			begin
				set @nIncrement = null
				RETURN
			end

       /* Quit if matched debtor is currently not selected */
       IF @sMoreAgrDebtor NOT LIKE ISNULL(@sDebtor, N'%')
			begin
				set @nIncrement = null
				RETURN
			end

       /* Get arrangement details */
       EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7AGR_MORE_AGR_ARRANGEMENT @sMoreAgrArrangement OUTPUT, @sAgreement, NULL
       IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
			begin
				set @nIncrement = null
				RETURN
			end

       SELECT @sARRCode = arr_code
             ,@sARROrg = arr_org
             ,@sARRCustomTariff = arr_custom_tariff
             ,@nARRLabCharge = arr_lab_charge
             ,@sARRMatSpecific = arr_mat_specific
             ,@nARRMatCharge = arr_mat_charge
             ,@nARRHirCharge = arr_hir_charge
             ,@nARRDMACharge = arr_dma_charge
             ,@nARRFixCharge = arr_fix_charge
             ,@nARRTolCharge = arr_tol_charge
             ,@nARRMinTime = arr_min_time
             ,@nARRTimeRoundup = arr_time_roundup
         FROM r5arrangements
        WHERE arr_code = @sMoreAgrArrangement

       IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
          BEGIN
		  set @nIncrement = null
          EXECUTE dbo.O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7ARR', N'PAC', 22
          RETURN
          END

       /* Get add price */
       SELECT @nAddPrice = NULL

       SELECT @nAddPrice = arp_add_price
         FROM r5events
             ,r5arrprices
        WHERE arp_arrangement = @sARRCode
          AND evt_code = @sEvent
          AND evt_org = arp_org
   END

/* Determine currently existing increment number */
SELECT @nIncrement = MAX(cev_increment)
  FROM r5calcevents
 WHERE cev_event = @sEvent

/* Check previous calculation, if there is one */
IF @nIncrement IS NULL
   SET @nIncrement = 1
ELSE
   BEGIN
       SET @sKey = @sEvent + N'#' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nIncrement)
       EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7CEV_MORE_CEV_RSTATUS @sRStatus OUTPUT, @sKey, NULL
       IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		  begin
		     set @nIncrement = null
             RETURN
		  end
       IF @sRStatus IN (N'I', N'A', N'E')
          BEGIN
              SET @sKey = @sEvent + N'#' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nIncrement)
              EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7CEV_MORE_CEV_INCREMENTABLE @sIncrementable OUTPUT, @sKey, NULL
              IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				  begin
					 set @nIncrement = null
					 RETURN
				  end

              IF @sIncrementable = N'+'
                 SET @nIncrement = @nIncrement + 1
              ELSE
                 BEGI

CREATE  function O7CALCNAME (@sEquat  nvarchar(640) )
returns nvarchar(1024)
as
   begin
   declare @nNxt	integer		--Next char position in scan
   declare @nNumEnd	integer		--end of found numeric
   declare @sThisC	char		--current char in scan
   declare @sPriorC     char		--Prior char in scan
   declare @nChild	numeric(38,0)	--Var or attr ID found
   declare @nEqStart	integer		--start of remaining input equation
   declare @nVarStart	integer		--start of found var ref
   declare @sAtrName	nvarchar(20)	--r5opvarattributes.oat_label%TYPE
   declare @sVarRef	nvarchar(255)	--converted var ref
   declare @sEquation	nvarchar(1024)	--output equation

   set @sEquation = ''

   if @sEquat is not null
      /* scan equation for each referenced V## or C## (with non-alpha before V or C) */
      begin
      set @sPriorC = '!'
      set @nNxt = charindex( N'EQ:', @sEquat) + 3
      set @nEqStart = @nNxt
      while @nNxt <= len(@sEquat) 
	begin
	set @sThisC = substring(@sEquat, @nNxt, 1)
	if (@sThisC = 'C' or @sThisC = 'V') and (@sPriorC < 'A' or @sPriorC > 'Z')
		begin
                set @nVarStart = @nNxt
		set @nNumEnd  = @nNxt + 1  /* Find ## varid until next non-numeric */
		while substring(@sEquat, @nNumEnd, 1) >= '0' and substring (@sEquat, @nNumEnd, 1) <= '9' 
			begin
			set @nNumEnd   = @nNumEnd + 1
			end
		if @nNumEnd > @nNxt+1 	/* if found any numeric, have a var reference */
			begin
			If isnumeric(substring(@sEquat, @nNxt + 1, @nNumEnd - @nNxt - 1)) = 1
				set @nChild  = cast(substring(@sEquat, @nNxt + 1, @nNumEnd - @nNxt - 1) as numeric(38,0))
			else
				return @sEquation
			select @sVarRef = ovd_shortname
				from r5opvariables
				where ovd_id = @nChild
			if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
				set @sVarRef = 'V?'
			if substring(@sEquat, @nNumEnd, 2) = '.A'
			    begin	/* Look for Attribute ID */
			    set @nNumEnd = @nNumEnd + 2
			    set @nNxt = @nNumEnd
			    while substring(@sEquat, @nNumEnd, 1) >= '0' and substring (@sEquat, @nNumEnd, 1) <= '9' 
				begin
				set @nNumEnd   = @nNumEnd + 1
				end
			    if @nNumEnd > @nNxt
			    	begin
				If isnumeric(substring(@sEquat, @nNxt, @nNumEnd - @nNxt)) = 1
				    begin
				    set @nChild  = cast(substring(@sEquat, @nNxt, @nNumEnd - @nNxt) as numeric(38,0))
				    select @sAtrName = oat_label
				    	from r5opvarattributes where oat_id = @nChild
				    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
				        set @sAtrName = 'A?'
				    end
				else
				    set @sAtrName = 'A?'
				set @sVarRef = @sVarRef + '.' + @sAtrName
			    	end
			    end
			set @nNxt = @nNumEnd - 1
			set @sThisC = '#'
			set @sEquation = @sEquation + substring(@sEquat, @nEqStart, @nVarStart-@nEqStart) + @sVarRef
			set @nEqStart = @nNumEnd
			end
		end                     
        set @nNxt  = @nNxt + 1
        set @sPriorC = @sThisC
        end
        set @sEquation = @sEquation + substring(@sEquat, @nEqStart, len(@sEquat)-@nEqStart+1)	--copy remaining equation
      end
      return @sEquation
   end

CREATE FUNCTION O7CALCOBJRRSCORE_GETSCORE(  
  @sDecay      NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sDecayorg   NVARCHAR(15), 
  @nValue      NUMERIC(24,6) )
  RETURNS NUMERIC(24,6) AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @nScore NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nX0    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nY0    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nX1    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nY1    NUMERIC(24,6)

  /* Is there an exact match? */
  SELECT @nScore = cpd_conditionscore
  FROM   r5decaycurvepoints
  WHERE  cpd_dccode      = @sDecay
  AND    cpd_dcorg       = @sDecayorg
  AND    cpd_periodusage = @nValue

  IF @nScore IS NULL
    BEGIN
      /* If no exact match, find closest records. */
      SELECT @nX0 = cpd_periodusage, 
             @nY0 = cpd_conditionscore
      FROM   r5decaycurvepoints
      WHERE  cpd_dccode      = @sDecay
      AND    cpd_dcorg       = @sDecayorg
      AND    cpd_periodusage = ( SELECT MAX( cpd_periodusage )
                                 FROM   r5decaycurvepoints
                                 WHERE  cpd_dccode      = @sDecay
                                 AND    cpd_dcorg       = @sDecayorg
                                 AND    cpd_periodusage < @nValue )

      SELECT @nX1 = cpd_periodusage, 
             @nY1 = cpd_conditionscore
      FROM   r5decaycurvepoints
      WHERE  cpd_dccode      = @sDecay
      AND    cpd_dcorg       = @sDecayorg
      AND    cpd_periodusage = ( SELECT MIN( cpd_periodusage )
                                 FROM   r5decaycurvepoints
                                 WHERE  cpd_dccode      = @sDecay
                                 AND    cpd_dcorg       = @sDecayorg
                                 AND    cpd_periodusage > @nValue )



      IF @nX0 IS NOT NULL AND @nX1 IS NOT NULL
        /* Both points found, extrapolate. */
        SET @nScore = @nY0 + ( ( @nValue - @nX0 ) * ( @nY1 - @nY0 ) / ( @nX1 - @nX0 ) )
      ELSE
        /* At least one point missing, use the one we (might) have. */
        SET @nScore = ISNULL( @nY0, @nY1 )
    END
  RETURN @nScore
END

create function O7CALCORDVALUE( @sProject	nvarchar(20),
								@sPurchaseorder	nvarchar(30),
								@sPurchaseorg	nvarchar(15) )
returns int
as
begin
	declare @nResult		int
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
	
	declare @tProjects table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )

	--build hierarchical result set
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_parent = @sProject
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tProjects values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select prj_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5projects
										 where prj_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

    SELECT @nResult = ROUND( SUM(
      CASE o.orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN ISNULL( o.orl_recvvalue, 0 )
                         ELSE CASE o.orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN  1
                                               ELSE isnull( o.orl_ordqty, 1 )
                              END * o.orl_price / isnull( o.orl_multiply, 1 )
      END / isnull( o.orl_exch, 1 ) ) , 2 )
    FROM r5orderlines o
    WHERE o.orl_order = @sPurchaseorder
    AND o.orl_order_org = @sPurchaseorg
    AND o.orl_rstatus <> N'J'
    AND ( o.orl_project IN
            (   SELECT prj_code
                FROM @tProjects
                UNION
                SELECT @sProject
            )
        )

	return ( @nResult )

end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CALCRANK
AS
  DECLARE @score               NUMERIC
  DECLARE @rrindex             NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @message             NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE @recsdone            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @recslocked          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk                 NVARCHAR( 4 )
  
  DECLARE @sortcolumn          NUMERIC( 6 )
  DECLARE @type                NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @eqrobjcode          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @eqrobjorg           NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @eqrrankingcode      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @eqrrankingorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @eqrrankingrevision  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @eqrrefreshsequence  NUMERIC
BEGIN
  /* Loop through all equipment ranking records with at least one question marked as 'to be calculated'. */
  DECLARE eqr CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ISNULL( eqr_refreshsequence, 0 ), N'O', eqr_objcode, eqr_objorg, eqr_rankingcode, eqr_rankingorg, eqr_rankingrevision, COALESCE( eqr_refreshsequence, 0 )
    FROM   r5equipmentrankings
    WHERE  eqr_lockrankingvalues = N'-'
    AND    ( eqr_nextrefresh <= getdate() OR ( eqr_nextrefresh IS NULL AND eqr_refreshevery IS NOT NULL ) )
    UNION
    SELECT ISNULL( ojv_refreshsequence, 0 ), N'J', ojv_code, ojv_org, ojv_rankingcode, ojv_rankingorg, ojv_rankingrevision, ojv_refreshsequence
    FROM   r5objectives
    WHERE  ojv_lockrankingvalues = N'-'
    AND    ( ojv_nextrefresh <= getdate() OR ( ojv_nextrefresh IS NULL AND ojv_refreshevery IS NOT NULL ) )
    UNION
    SELECT ISNULL( pol_refreshsequence, 0 ), 'P', pol_code, pol_org, pol_rankingcode, pol_rankingorg, pol_rankingrevision, pol_refreshsequence
    FROM   r5policies
    WHERE  pol_lockrankingvalues = '-'
    AND    ( pol_nextrefresh <= getdate() OR ( pol_nextrefresh IS NULL AND pol_refreshevery IS NOT NULL ) )
    UNION
    SELECT ISNULL( stg_refreshsequence, 0 ), 'T', stg_code, stg_org, stg_rankingcode, stg_rankingorg, stg_rankingrevision, stg_refreshsequence
    FROM   r5strategies
    WHERE  stg_lockrankingvalues = '-'
    AND    ( stg_nextrefresh <= getdate() OR ( stg_nextrefresh IS NULL AND stg_refreshevery IS NOT NULL ) )
    ORDER BY 1, 5
  OPEN eqr
  FETCH NEXT FROM eqr INTO @sortcolumn, @type, @eqrobjcode, @eqrobjorg, @eqrrankingcode, @eqrrankingorg, @eqrrankingrevision, @eqrrefreshsequence
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'0'
      /* Do the actual calculation. */
      EXECUTE o7calcobjrrscore @eqrobjcode, @eqrobjorg, @type, @eqrrankingcode, @eqrrankingorg, @eqrrankingrevision, NULL,
                               @score OUTPUT, @rrindex OUTPUT, @message OUTPUT, @recsdone OUTPUT, @recslocked OUTPUT, @chk OUTPUT
      IF @type = N'O'
        /* Update the equipment ranking with the calculated result. */
        UPDATE r5equipmentrankings
        SET    eqr_nextrefresh      = CASE @chk 
                                        WHEN N'0' THEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) + 
                                                       dbo.o7gtfreq( eqr_refreshevery, eqr_refresheveryunit, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) ) 
                                        ELSE eqr_nextrefresh 
                                      END, 
               eqr_calculationerror = CASE @chk WHEN N'0' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
        WHERE  eqr_objcode          = @eqrobjcode
        AND    eqr_objorg           = @eqrobjorg
        AND    eqr_rankingcode      = @eqrrankingcode
        AND    eqr_rankingorg       = @eqrrankingorg
        AND    eqr_rankingrevision  = @eqrrankingrevision
      ELSE IF @type = N'J'
        /* Update the objective with the calculated result. */
        UPDATE r5objectives
        SET    ojv_nextrefresh      = CASE @chk 
                                        WHEN N'0' THEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) + 
                                                       dbo.o7gtfreq( ojv_refreshevery, ojv_refresheveryunit, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) ) 
                                        ELSE ojv_nextrefresh 
                                      END, 
               ojv_calculationerror = CASE @chk WHEN N'0' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
        WHERE  ojv_code             = @eqrobjcode
        AND    ojv_org              = @eqrobjorg
      ELSE IF @type = 'P'
        /* Update the policy with the calculated result. */
        UPDATE r5policies
        SET    pol_nextrefresh      = CASE @chk 
                                        WHEN N'0' THEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) + 
                                                       dbo.o7gtfreq( pol_refreshevery, pol_refresheveryunit, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) ) 
                                        ELSE pol_nextrefresh 
                                      END, 
               pol_calculationerror = CASE @chk WHEN N'0' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
        WHERE  pol_code             = @eqrobjcode
        AND    pol_org              = @eqrobjorg
      ELSE IF @type = 'T'
        /* Update the strategy with the calculated result. */
        UPDATE r5strategies
        SET    stg_nextrefresh      = CASE @chk 
                                        WHEN N'0' THEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) + 
                                                       dbo.o7gtfreq( stg_refreshevery, stg_refresheveryunit, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) ) 
                                        ELSE stg_nextrefresh 
                                      END, 
               stg_calculationerror = CASE @chk WHEN N'0' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
        WHERE  stg_code             = @eqrobjcode
        AND    stg_org              = @eqrobjorg

      FETCH NEXT FROM eqr INTO @sortcolumn, @type, @eqrobjcode, @eqrobjorg, @eqrrankingcode, @eqrrankingorg, @eqrrankingrevision, @eqrrefreshsequence
    END
  CLOSE eqr
  DEALLOCATE eqr
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CALCRENTALCOSTS
  @rental        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @rentalorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
AS
BEGIN  
  
  DECLARE @code                NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @correcthours        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calculatedhours     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @correcteddays       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calculateddays      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @correctedusage      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calculatedusage     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @issuereadinguom     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @correctedfuelusage  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calculatedfuelusage NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @tax                 NVARCHAR( 20 )

  DECLARE @ccdpk               NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ccdcategory         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ccdlevel            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ccdsubcategory      NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @ccdrate             NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccdminqty           NUMERIC( 12 )
  DECLARE @ccdusageuom         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ccdadjpercbefore    NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @ccdadjunitprice     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccdadjtransaction   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccdadjpercafter     NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @ccdfreeupto         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccdmincharge        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccdmaxcharge        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccdinvoicecond      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccdtaxable          NVARCHAR( 1 )

  DECLARE @qty                 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @rate                NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @costbasis           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @origbasis           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @taxperc             NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @taxbasis            NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  
  /* Get rental data. */
  SELECT @correcthours        = crt_correcthours, 
         @calculatedhours     = crt_calculatedhours, 
         @correcteddays       = crt_correcteddays, 
         @calculateddays      = crt_calculateddays, 
         @correctedusage      = crt_correctedusage, 
         @calculatedusage     = crt_calculatedusage, 
         @issuereadinguom     = crt_issuereadinguom, 
         @correctedfuelusage  = crt_correctedfuelusage, 
         @calculatedfuelusage = crt_calculatedfuelusage, 
         @tax                 = crt_tax,
         @code                = crt_code
  FROM   r5customerrentals
  WHERE  crt_code    = @rental
  AND    crt_org     = @rentalorg
  AND    crt_rstatus IN ( N'COM', N'R' )

  /* If rental data not found, return. */
  IF @code IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* Loop through charge definitions. */
  DECLARE c_ccd CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ccd_pk, ccd_category, ccd_level, uco_rcode ccd_subcategory, ccd_rate, ccd_minqty, ccd_usageuom, 
           ccd_adjpercbefore, ccd_adjunitprice, ccd_adjtransaction, ccd_adjpercafter, ccd_freeupto, ccd_mincharge, 
           ccd_maxcharge, ccd_invoiceconditional, ccd_taxable
    FROM   r5ucodes, r5contractchargedefs
    WHERE  uco_code             = ccd_subcategory
    AND    uco_rentity          = CASE WHEN ccd_subcategory IN ( N'UCU1', N'OT00', N'UC00' ) THEN N'CCSC' 
                                       ELSE CASE WHEN ccd_category = N'OTCH' THEN N'CCOC' ELSE N'CCUC' END END 
    AND    ccd_contract         = @rental
    AND    ccd_contractrevision = -1
    AND    ccd_contract_org     = @rentalorg
    AND    ccd_invoice          = N'+'
    ORDER BY ccd_level DESC
  OPEN c_ccd
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_ccd INTO @ccdpk, @ccdcategory, @ccdlevel, @ccdsubcategory, @ccdrate, @ccdminqty, @ccdusageuom, 
        @ccdadjpercbefore, @ccdadjunitprice, @ccdadjtransaction, @ccdadjpercafter, @ccdfreeupto, @ccdmincharge, 
        @ccdmaxcharge, @ccdinvoicecond, @ccdtaxable
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Determine qty. */
      IF @ccdcategory = N'USCH' AND @ccdlevel = N'TR' AND @ccdsubcategory = N'UC01' 
        /* Hourly usage charges. */
        SET @qty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( @correcthours, @calculatedhours ), ISNULL( @ccdminqty, 0 ) )               
      ELSE IF @ccdcategory = N'USCH' AND @ccdlevel = N'TR' AND @ccdsubcategory NOT IN ( N'UC01', N'UCU1' )
        /* Daily usage charges. */
        SET @qty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( @correcteddays, @calculateddays ), ISNULL( @ccdminqty, 0 ) )
      ELSE IF @ccdcategory = N'USCH' AND @ccdlevel = N'TR' AND @ccdsubcategory = N'UCU1'
        BEGIN
          /* Usage charges. */
          IF @issuereadinguom = @ccdusageuom
            SET @qty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( @correctedusage, @calculatedusage ), ISNULL( @ccdminqty, 0 ) )
          ELSE
            SET @qty = 0
        END  
      ELSE IF @ccdcategory = N'OTCH' AND @ccdlevel = N'TR'
        BEGIN
          /* Fuel and one time charges. */
          IF @ccdsubcategory = 'OT03' 
            SET @qty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( @correctedfuelusage, @calculatedfuelusage ), ISNULL( @ccdminqty, 0 ) )
          ELSE
            SET @qty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 1, ISNULL( @ccdminqty, 0 ) )
        END

      /* Calculate cost. */
      IF @ccdlevel = N'TR' -- Transaction Adjustment
        BEGIN
          /* Determine rate. */
          SET @rate = @ccdrate
          SET @rate = CASE @ccdsubcategory
                        WHEN 'UC03' THEN @rate * ROUND( 1 / 7.00, 6 )               -- Weekly
                        WHEN 'UC04' THEN @rate * ROUND( 1 / ( 365.00 / 12.00 ), 6 ) -- Monthly
                        WHEN 'UC05' THEN @rate * ROUND( 1 / ( 365.00 / 4.00 ), 6 )  -- Quarterly
                        WHEN 'UC06' THEN @rate * ROUND( 1 / 365.00, 6 )             -- Yearly
                        ELSE @rate
                      END
          SET @costbasis = ISNULL( @qty * @rate, 0 )
        END  
      ELSE IF @ccdlevel = N'SC' -- Subcategory Adjustment
        BEGIN
          SET @qty = 1
          IF @ccdsubcategory IN ( 'UC00', 'OT00' )
            SELECT @costbasis = SUM( ccd_costbasis )
            FROM   r5ucodes, r5contractchargedefs
            WHERE  uco_code             = ccd_subcategory
            AND    uco_rentity          = CASE WHEN ccd_subcategory IN ( N'UCU1', N'OT00', N'UC00' ) THEN N'CCSC' 
                                               ELSE CASE WHEN ccd_category = N'OTCH' THEN N'CCOC' ELSE N'CCUC' END END 
            AND    ccd_contract         = @rental
            AND    ccd_contractrevision = -1 
            AND    ccd_contract_org     = @rentalorg
            AND    ccd_category         = @ccdcategory
            AND    ccd_level            = N'TR'
            AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                            FROM   r5contractchargedefs
                            WHERE  ccd_contract         = @rental
                            AND    ccd_contractrevision = -1 
                            AND    ccd_contract_org     = @rentalorg
                            AND    ccd_category         = @ccdcategory
                            AND    ccd_level            = N'SC'
                            AND    ccd_subcategory      = uco_rcode )
          ELSE
            SELECT @costbasis = SUM( ccd_costbasis )
            FROM   r5ucodes, r5contractchargedefs
            WHERE  uco_code             = ccd_subcategory
            AND    uco_rentity          = CASE WHEN ccd_subcategory IN ( N'UCU1', N'OT00', N'UC00' ) THEN N'CCSC' 
                                               ELSE CASE WHEN ccd_category = N'OTCH' THEN N'CCOC' ELSE N'CCUC' END END 
            AND    ccd_contract         = @rental
            AND    ccd_contractrevision = -1 
            AND    ccd_contract_org     = @rentalorg
            AND    ccd_category         = @ccdcategory
            AND    uco_rcode            = @ccdsubcategory
            AND    ccd_level            = N'TR'
          SET @rate = @costbasis
        END  
      ELSE IF @ccdlevel = N'CC' -- Charge Category Adjustment
        BEGIN
          SET @qty = 1
          SELECT @costbasis = SUM( ccd_costbasis )
          FROM   r5contra

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CALCSUMUSAGE
  @part    NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @partorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
AS
BEGIN 

  DECLARE @stostore    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @stopart     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @stopartorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @bycondition NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @usgmonth    DATETIME

  IF @part <> N'%' 
    BEGIN
      /* If the usage only needs to be calculated for one part, delete existing sumusage first. */
      DELETE FROM r5sumusage
      WHERE  usg_part     = @part
      AND    usg_part_org = @partorg
    END

  DECLARE sto CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT sto_store, sto_part, sto_part_org, par_trackbycondition,
           COALESCE( usg_month, CAST( '1960-12-19' AS DATETIME ) ) 
    FROM   r5parts,
           r5stock
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5sumusg ON ( usg_store = sto_store AND usg_part = sto_part AND usg_part_org = sto_part_org )
    WHERE  par_code = sto_part
    AND    par_org  = sto_part_org
    AND    par_parentpart IS NULL
    AND    sto_part     LIKE @part
    AND    sto_part_org LIKE @partorg
    AND    COALESCE( usg_month, GETDATE() - 100 ) <= dbo.f_last_day( DATEADD( mm, -2, GETDATE() ) )
    ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
  OPEN sto
  FETCH NEXT FROM sto INTO @stostore, @stopart, @stopartorg, @bycondition, @usgmonth
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      IF @bycondition = N'-' 
        BEGIN
          /* Part not tracked by condition, so use the value in column trl_part. */
          INSERT INTO r5sumusage( usg_store, usg_part, usg_part_org, usg_month, usg_usage, usg_demand, usg_total, usg_updatecount )
          SELECT s.str_code,
                 l.trl_part,
                 l.trl_part_org,
                 dbo.f_last_day( t.tra_date ),
                 SUM( CASE t.tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN l.trl_qty ELSE CASE t.tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN -l.trl_qty ELSE 0 END END ),
                 SUM( CASE l.trl_store WHEN s.str_code THEN CASE t.tra_fromcode WHEN s.str_code THEN l.trl_qty ELSE -l.trl_qty END ELSE 0 END ),
                 SUM( CASE t.tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN l.trl_qty ELSE CASE t.tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN -l.trl_qty ELSE 0 END END * l.trl_price ),
                 -10
          FROM   r5stores       s,
                 r5transactions t,
                 r5translines   l
          WHERE  l.trl_trans    = t.tra_code
          AND    l.trl_part     = @stopart
          AND    l.trl_part_org = @stopartorg
          AND    s.str_code     = @stostore
          AND    (   (      s.str_code        = t.tra_fromcode
                        AND t.tra_fromrentity = N'STOR' )
                   OR 
                     (     s.str_code      = t.tra_tocode
                       AND t.tra_torentity = N'STOR' ) )
          AND    dbo.f_trunc_date( t.tra_date, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @usgmonth + 1 AND dbo.f_last_day( DATEADD( mm, -1, GETDATE() ) )
          AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'IHI', N'RECV', N'RETN', N'RI', N'RREC', N'STST', N'STTK' )
          AND    l.trl_io <> 0 
          AND    NOT ( t.tra_rtype = N'STST' AND t.tra_fromrentity = N'STOR' AND t.tra_torentity = N'STOR' AND t.tra_tocode = t.tra_fromcode )
          GROUP BY s.str_code,
                   l.trl_part,
                   l.trl_part_org,
                   dbo.f_last_day( t.tra_date )
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Part tracked by condition, so use the value in column trl_issuedpart. */
          INSERT INTO r5sumusage( usg_store, usg_part, usg_part_org, usg_month, usg_usage, usg_demand, usg_total, usg_updatecount )
          SELECT s.str_code,
                 l.trl_issuedpart,
                 l.trl_part_org,
                 dbo.f_last_day( t.tra_date ),
                 SUM( CASE t.tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN l.trl_qty ELSE CASE t.tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN -l.trl_qty ELSE 0 END END ),
                 SUM( CASE l.trl_store WHEN s.str_code THEN CASE t.tra_fromcode WHEN s.str_code THEN l.trl_qty ELSE -l.trl_qty END ELSE 0 END ),
                 SUM( CASE t.tra_torentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN l.trl_qty ELSE CASE t.tra_fromrentity WHEN N'EVNT' THEN -l.trl_qty ELSE 0 END END * l.trl_price ),
                 -10
          FROM   r5stores       s,
                 r5transactions t,
                 r5translines   l
          WHERE  l.trl_trans      = t.tra_code
          AND    l.trl_issuedpart = @stopart
          AND    l.trl_part_org   = @stopartorg
          AND    s.str_code       = @stostore
          AND    (   (      s.str_code        = t.tra_fromcode
                        AND t.tra_fromrentity = N'STOR' )
                   OR 
                     (     s.str_code      = t.tra_tocode
                       AND t.tra_torentity = N'STOR' ) )
          AND    dbo.f_trunc_date( t.tra_date, N'DD' ) BETWEEN @usgmonth + 1 AND dbo.f_last_day( DATEADD( mm, -1, GETDATE() ) )
          AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'IHI', N'RECV', N'RETN', N'RI', N'RREC', N'STST', N'STTK' )
          AND    l.trl_io <> 0 
          AND    NOT ( t.tra_rtype = N'STST' AND t.tra_fromrentity = N'STOR' AND t.tra_torentity = N'STOR' AND t.tra_tocode = t.tra_fromcode )
          GROUP BY s.str_code,
                   l.trl_issuedpart,
                   l.trl_part_org,
                   dbo.f_last_day( t.tra_date )
         END

      FETCH NEXT FROM sto INTO @stostore, @stopart, @stopartorg, @bycondition, @usgmonth
    END
  CLOSE sto
  DEALLOCATE sto
END

create function O7CALCWOACTTOTALS( 
  @sEvent         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sActivity      NUMERIC( 8),
  @sCalcType       NVARCHAR( 10 ))
returns NUMERIC(24,6)
as
begin
   declare @sEstHrs      NUMERIC(24,6)
   declare @sPersons     NUMERIC(8)
   declare @sRemainHrs   NUMERIC(24,6)
   declare @sCount       NUMERIC(8)
   declare @sTaskQty     NUMERIC(10,2)
   declare @nReturn      NUMERIC(24,6)

   SELECT @sTaskQty = act_qty
   FROM   r5activities
   WHERE  act_act = @sActivity
   AND    act_event = @sEvent

   SELECT @sEstHrs = SUM( act_est ) * ISNULL(@sTaskQty,1), @sPersons = SUM( act_persons ), 
          @sRemainHrs = SUM( act_rem ) * ISNULL(@sTaskQty,1), @sCount = COUNT(*)
   FROM   r5activities
   WHERE  (act_act = @sActivity OR act_topparent = @sActivity OR act_parent = @sActivity)
   AND    act_event = @sEvent

   IF @sCount = 0 
      set @nReturn = 0
   ELSE IF @sCalcType = 'ESTHRS'
      set @nReturn = @sEstHrs
   ELSE IF @sCalcType = 'PERSONS'
      set @nReturn = @sPersons 
   ELSE IF @sCalcType = 'REMAINHRS'
      set @nReturn = @sRemainHrs 
   ELSE 
      set @nReturn = @sCount

   RETURN @nReturn
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CALCWOCOST
  @obj     NVARCHAR( 30 ) = NULL,
  @objorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ) = NULL,
  @caseman NVARCHAR( 30 ) = NULL AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @evtcode NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @r       INT    
  DECLARE @recs    NUMERIC
  SET @recs = 0
  IF @caseman IS NULL
    BEGIN
      IF @obj IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Loop through all work orders that need recalculation. */
          DECLARE c_evo CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT evo_event
            FROM   r5eventcost
            WHERE  evo_recalccost = N'+'
          OPEN c_evo
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_evo INTO @evtcode
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @recs = @recs + 1
              EXECUTE @r = O7CALCWOCOST_CALC @evtcode, N'-'
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_evo INTO @evtcode
            END
          CLOSE c_evo
          DEALLOCATE c_evo

          /* Loop through all work orders that need recalculation. */
          DECLARE c_evo2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT evo_event
            FROM   r5eventcost
            WHERE  evo_costcalculated = N'-'
          OPEN c_evo2
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_evo2 INTO @evtcode
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @recs = @recs + 1
              EXECUTE @r = O7CALCWOCOST_CALC @evtcode, N'-'
              IF @recs > 100000
                RETURN;
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_evo2 INTO @evtcode
            END
          CLOSE c_evo2
          DEALLOCATE c_evo2
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Set all WOs ( for current object ) which are not yet calculated to recalc. */
          UPDATE r5eventcost
          SET    evo_recalccost = N'+'
          WHERE  evo_costcalculated = N'-'
          AND    evo_event IN ( SELECT eob_event
                                FROM   r5eventobjects
                                WHERE  eob_object     = @obj
                                AND    eob_object_org = @objorg )
          /* Loop through all to recalc WOs of specified object. */
          DECLARE c_eob CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT eob_event
            FROM   r5eventcost, r5eventobjects
            WHERE  evo_event      = eob_event
            AND    eob_object     = @obj
            AND    eob_object_org = @objorg
            AND    evo_recalccost = N'+'
          OPEN c_eob
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_eob INTO @evtcode
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              EXECUTE @r = O7CALCWOCOST_CALC @evtcode, N'+'
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_eob INTO @evtcode
            END
          CLOSE c_eob
          DEALLOCATE c_eob
        END
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* Special case for Case Management, loop through all WOs involved. */
      DECLARE c_evo3 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT evo_event
        FROM   r5eventcost 
        WHERE  evo_event IN ( 
               SELECT csm_followupwo 
               FROM   r5casemanagement 
               WHERE  csm_code = @caseman
               UNION 
               SELECT tcm_followupwo 
               FROM   r5casemanagementtasks 
               WHERE  tcm_casemanagement = @caseman )
        AND    evo_recalccost = N'+'
      OPEN c_evo3
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_evo3 INTO @evtcode
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @r = O7CALCWOCOST_CALC @evtcode, N'-'
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_evo3 INTO @evtcode
        END
      CLOSE c_evo3
      DEALLOCATE c_evo3
    END
END

name: O7CALCWOCOST_CALC

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CALCWOCOST_CALC
  @evtcode   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @commit    NVARCHAR( 1 ) AS
BEGIN
  IF @commit = N'+' 
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
  DECLARE @cost          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @labor         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @material      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @tool          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @total         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @hours         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  /* Calculate costs. */
  SET @hours    = 0
  SET @labor    = 0
  SET @material = 0
  SET @tool     = 0
  SET @total    = 0
  SET @cost     = 0
  EXECUTE o7cost_labourandhours2 @evtcode, @labor OUTPUT, @hours OUTPUT
  EXECUTE o7actmat N'OSVCST', @evtcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @material OUTPUT, NULL
  EXECUTE o7actdma N'OSVCST', @evtcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @cost OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @material = ISNULL( @material, 0 ) + ISNULL( @cost, 0 )
  SET @cost = 0
  EXECUTE o7piddma N'OSVCST', @evtcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @cost OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @material = @material + ISNULL( @cost, 0 )        
  EXECUTE o7acttool N'OSVCST', @evtcode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @tool OUTPUT, NULL            
  SET @labor = ISNULL( @labor, 0 )
  SET @tool = ISNULL( @tool, 0 )           
  SET @total = @labor + @material + @tool
  UPDATE r5eventcost
  SET    evo_labor          = @labor,
         evo_material       = @material, 
         evo_tool           = @tool,
         evo_total          = @total,
         evo_hours          = @hours,
         evo_updated        = getdate(),
         evo_recalccost     = N'-',
         evo_costcalculated = N'+'
  WHERE  evo_event = @evtcode
  IF @commit = N'+'
    BEGIN
      IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        COMMIT
    END    
END

create function O7CALQTY( @sOrder       nvarchar(30),
                          @sOrderOrg    nvarchar(15), 
                          @nOrderline   numeric(8),
                          @sDockCode    nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
    declare @nPendqty   numeric(30,6)
    declare @nOrlqty    numeric(30,6)
    declare @nSmrecvqty numeric(30,6)
    declare @nDck_qty   numeric(30,6)
    declare @sPartuom   nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrlpuruom nvarchar(30)
    declare @nConfactor numeric(10,4)
    declare @nOrdqty    numeric(24,6)
    declare @nDockrecvqty   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nDelqty    numeric(24,6)
    declare @nRecvqty   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nMulfactor numeric(10,4)
    declare @sRStatus   nvarchar(4)

    SELECT  @nDck_qty = coalesce( SUM(coalesce(dkl_countqty + coalesce(dkl_scrapqty,0), dkl_recvqty)), 0 )
    FROM    r5docklines
    WHERE   dkl_order       = @sOrder
    AND     dkl_order_org   = @sOrderOrg
    AND     dkl_ordline     = @nOrderline
    AND     dkl_linerstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C')
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    SELECT  @nSmrecvqty = coalesce( SUM( coalesce( trl_qty, 0 ) + coalesce( trl_scrapqty, 0 ) ),0)
    FROM    r5translines l,r5transactions t
    WHERE   l.trl_trans     = t.tra_code
    AND     l.trl_order     = @sOrder
    AND     l.trl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
    AND     l.trl_ordline   = @nOrderline
    AND     t.tra_rstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C')
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    SELECT  @nPendqty = (coalesce(orl_ordqty,0) - (coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) + coalesce(@nDck_qty,0) + coalesce(@nSmrecvqty,0)))
    FROM    r5orderlines curr
    WHERE   curr.orl_order  = @sOrder
    AND     curr.orl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
    AND     curr.orl_ordline = @nOrderline
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    SELECT @sPartuom = par_uom 
    FROM R5PARTS 
    WHERE par_code  IN (SELECT orl_part 
                        FROM R5ORDERLINES 
                        WHERE orl_order= @sOrder 
                        AND orl_order_org= @sOrderOrg
                        AND orl_ordline= @nOrderline)
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    SELECT @sOrlpuruom   = orl_puruom,
           @nConfactor   = orl_multiply,
           @nOrdqty      = orl_ordqty,
           @nDockrecvqty = orl_dckrecvqty
    FROM R5ORDERLINES 
    WHERE orl_order= @sOrder
    AND orl_order_org= @sOrderOrg
    AND orl_ordline= @nOrderline 
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    if  @sPartuom = @sOrlpuruom
        set @nOrlqty = @nPendqty
    else
        set @nOrlqty = @nPendqty / @nConfactor

    SELECT @sRStatus = dck_rstatus
    FROM R5DOCKRECEIPTS
    WHERE dck_code= @sDockCode
    AND dck_org= @sOrderOrg;

    if  @sRStatus <> 'U'
        set @nOrlqty = @nOrdqty - @nDockrecvqty

    return( @nOrlqty ) 

end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.o7calwld (@sWPKCode nvarchar(24)) RETURNS numeric(12,2)
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @nSum   NUMERIC(12,2)
  DECLARE @nSum1  NUMERIC(12,2)
  DECLARE @nSum2  NUMERIC(12,2)

  SELECT @nSum1 = SUM( ppm_estworkload )
  FROM r5ppms, r5ppmobjects
  WHERE ppo_ppm      = ppm_code
  AND ppo_revision   = ppm_revision
  AND ppm_revrstatus = 'A'
  AND ppo_package    = @sWPKCode
  AND ppm_estworkload IS NOT NULL

  SELECT @nSum2 = SUM( ppa_est )
  FROM r5ppmacts, r5ppms, r5ppmobjects
  WHERE ppo_ppm      = ppa_ppm
  AND ppo_revision   = ppa_revision
  AND ppo_ppm        = ppm_code
  AND ppo_revision   = ppm_revision
  AND ppm_revrstatus = 'A'
  AND ppo_package    = @sWPKCode
  AND ppm_estworkload IS NULL

  SET @nSum = COALESCE( @nSum1, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nSum2, 0 )

  RETURN @nSum
end
