CREATE PROCEDURE O7CANCELSTSTREQ
  @sReq       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @nReqline   NUMERIC,
  @sEamuser   NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @sChk       NVARCHAR( 4 )     OUTPUT
AS 
  SET NOCOUNT ON 

  DECLARE @nCnt       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nIncrlino  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nTrlline   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @dTdate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @sTrans     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sBin       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sStatus    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sReqstatus NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @nReturn    INTEGER

  DECLARE @sReq_org           NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sReq_desc          NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @sSto_defaultbin    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sSto_repdefaultbin NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sTst_part          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sTst_part_org      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sTst_store         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sTst_lot           NVARCHAR( 12 )
  DECLARE @nTst_qty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nTst_repairqty     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sTst_torentity     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sTst_toentity      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sTst_tocode        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sTst_object        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sTst_object_org    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sTst_objstatus     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sTst_objrstatus    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @nTst_price         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sTst_manufacturer  NVARCHAR( 24 )
  DECLARE @sTst_manufactpart  NVARCHAR( 50 )

  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @nIncrlino OUTPUT, N'INCRLINO', @sChk OUTPUT
  SET @nTrlline = @nIncrlino
  EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sStatus OUTPUT, N'A', N'DOST', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sReqstatus OUTPUT, N'C', N'RLST', @sChk OUTPUT

  SET @sChk = '0'

  /* Check if no open translines. */
  SELECT @nCnt = count(*)
  FROM   r5translines, r5transactions
  WHERE  trl_trans       = tra_code
  AND    tra_req         = @sReq
  AND    trl_reqline     = @nReqline
  AND    tra_fromrentity = N'STOR'
  AND    tra_torentity   = N'STOR'
  AND    tra_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J', N'A' );
  IF @nCnt > 0 
    BEGIN
      SET @sChk = '1'
      RETURN
    END

  DECLARE c_tst CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT req_org, req_desc, sto_defaultbin, sto_repdefaultbin,
           tst_part, tst_part_org, tst_store, tst_lot, tst_qty, tst_repairqty, tst_torentity,
           tst_toentity, tst_tocode,  tst_object, tst_object_org, tst_objstatus, tst_objrstatus,
           tst_price, tst_manufacturer, tst_manufactpart
    FROM   r5stock, r5requisitions, r5transtock
    WHERE  tst_req      = req_code
    AND    tst_store    = sto_store
    AND    tst_part     = sto_part
    AND    tst_part_org = sto_part_org
    AND    tst_req      = @sReq
    AND    tst_reqline  = @nReqline

  OPEN c_tst
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_tst INTO @sReq_org, @sReq_desc, @sSto_defaultbin, @sSto_repdefaultbin,
    @sTst_part, @sTst_part_org, @sTst_store, @sTst_lot, @nTst_qty, @nTst_repairqty, @sTst_torentity,
    @sTst_toentity, @sTst_tocode,  @sTst_object, @sTst_object_org, @sTst_objstatus, @sTst_objrstatus,
    @nTst_price, @sTst_manufacturer, @sTst_manufactpart
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      IF @nTrlline = @nIncrlino 
        BEGIN
          /* First line, so create transaction header. */
          SET @dTdate = dbo.o7gttime2( @sReq_org )
          EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sTrans OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
          INSERT INTO r5transactions( tra_code, tra_org, tra_desc, tra_rtype, tra_date, tra_rstatus,
                 tra_fromcode, tra_fromcode_org, tra_fromrentity, tra_fromrtype, 
                 tra_tocode, tra_tocode_org, tra_torentity, tra_tortype )
          VALUES( @sTrans, @sReq_org, @sReq_desc, N'RECV', @dTdate, N'U',
                  @sTst_store, @sReq_org, N'STOR', N'*', 
                  @sTst_store, @sReq_org, N'STOR', N'*' );
          UPDATE r5transactions
          SET    tra_req  = @sReq
          WHERE  tra_code = @sTrans
        END

      /* Get value for bin. */
      IF @sSto_defaultbin IS NOT NULL
        SET @sBin = @sSto_defaultbin
      ELSE
        SELECT @sBin = MIN( bis_bin )
        FROM   r5binstock
        WHERE  bis_store    = @sTst_store
        AND    bis_part     = @sTst_part
        AND    bis_part_org = @sTst_part_org

      IF @sBin IS NULL
        BEGIN
          SET @sChk = '2'
          RETURN
        END

      /* Insert transaction line. */
      INSERT INTO r5translines( trl_trans, trl_line, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, trl_rtype,
             trl_date, trl_qty, trl_price, trl_bin, trl_lot, trl_io, trl_req, trl_reqline,
             trl_object, trl_object_org, trl_manufacturer, trl_manufactpart )
      VALUES( @sTrans, @nTrlline, @sTst_part, @sTst_part_org, @sTst_store, 
              CASE ISNULL( @nTst_qty, 0 ) WHEN 0 THEN N'RREC' ELSE N'RECV' END,
              @dTdate, dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( @nTst_qty, 0 ), ISNULL( @nTst_repairqty, 0 ) ), 
              @nTst_price, @sBin, @sTst_lot, 1, @sReq, @nReqline, @sTst_object, @sTst_object_org, 
              @sTst_manufacturer, @sTst_manufactpart );
      
      SET @nTrlline = @nTrlline + @nIncrlino
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_tst INTO @sReq_org, @sReq_desc, @sSto_defaultbin, @sSto_repdefaultbin,
        @sTst_part, @sTst_part_org, @sTst_store, @sTst_lot, @nTst_qty, @nTst_repairqty, @sTst_torentity,
        @sTst_toentity, @sTst_tocode,  @sTst_object, @sTst_object_org, @sTst_objstatus, @sTst_objrstatus,
        @nTst_price, @sTst_manufacturer, @sTst_manufactpart

    END  
  
  CLOSE c_tst
  DEALLOCATE c_tst  

  IF @nTrlline > @nIncrlino
    BEGIN
      /* Approve the created transactions. */
      UPDATE r5transactions
      SET    tra_auth    = @sEamuser,
             tra_rstatus = N'A',
             tra_status  = @sStatus
      WHERE  tra_code    = @sTrans

      /* Cancel req line. */
      UPDATE r5requislines
      SET    rql_rstatus = N'C',
             rql_status  = @sReqstatus,
             rql_active  = N'-'
      WHERE  rql_req     = @sReq
      AND    rql_reqline = @nReqline

      /* need to remove transtock as well */
      DELETE FROM r5transtock
      WHERE  tst_req      = @sReq
      AND    tst_reqline  = @nReqline

    END
  ELSE
    SET @sChk = '3'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CASDATE1
   (
   @sOnum       nvarchar(30), 
   @dStartdate   datetime,     
   @dEnddate     datetime,     
   @nFlag        integer   
   ) 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nDuration		numeric(8)
	declare @nSeq			numeric(3)
	declare @nStartlapse	numeric(9)
	declare @dStdate	    datetime

BEGIN
	SELECT @dStdate =evt_requeststart
	FROM r5events
	WHERE evt_code = @sOnum

	IF @nFlag = 1 
		begin
			set @nStartlapse = 0
			declare c_cur1 cursor local for SELECT evt_seq, max(evt_duration) 
											FROM r5events
											WHERE evt_parent = @sOnum GROUP BY evt_seq ORDER BY evt_seq
			open c_cur1
			fetch next from c_cur1 into	@nSeq, @nDuration 

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					UPDATE r5events
					SET evt_target = @dStartdate + @nStartlapse,
						evt_requeststart = @dStdate + @nStartlapse,
						evt_schedend = @dStartdate + @nStartlapse + evt_duration - 1
					WHERE evt_parent   = @sOnum
						AND evt_seq      = @nSeq
						AND evt_rstatus != N'C'
						
				    UPDATE r5activities 
					SET act_start = act_start + @nStartlapse
					WHERE act_event IN (SELECT evt_code FROM r5events 
										WHERE evt_parent = @sOnum
										AND evt_seq      = @nSeq
										AND evt_rstatus != N'C')
					
					set @nStartlapse = @nStartlapse + @nDuration
					fetch next from c_cur1 into	@nSeq, @nDuration 

				end

			close c_cur1
			deallocate c_cur1
		end


    set @nStartlapse = 0
	declare c_cur2 cursor local for SELECT evt_seq, max(evt_duration) 
									FROM r5events
									WHERE evt_parent = @sOnum GROUP BY evt_seq ORDER BY evt_seq DESC
	open c_cur2
	fetch next from c_cur2 into	@nSeq, @nDuration 

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			UPDATE r5events
			SET evt_requestend = @dEnddate - @nStartlapse
			WHERE evt_parent  = @sOnum
				AND  evt_seq     = @nSeq
				AND  evt_rstatus != N'C'
			
			set @nStartlapse = @nStartlapse + @nDuration
			fetch next from c_cur2 into	@nSeq, @nDuration 
		end

	close c_cur2
	deallocate c_cur2
	RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CASDATE2
	@sOnum				nvarchar(30),  
	@sEvtseq			numeric(3),    
	@sEvtcompleted		datetime,	
	@nFlag				integer,    
	@sParent			nvarchar(30) 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nDuration		numeric(8)
	declare @nSeq			numeric(3)
	declare @nStartlapse	numeric(9)
BEGIN
	IF @nFlag = 1 
		begin
			set @nStartlapse = 1
			

			declare c_cur1 cursor local for SELECT evt_seq, max(evt_duration) 
												FROM r5events
												WHERE evt_parent = @sParent
												AND evt_seq > @sEvtseq
												GROUP BY evt_seq
			open c_cur1
			fetch next from c_cur1 into	@nSeq, @nDuration 

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					UPDATE r5events
					SET   evt_requeststart = @sEvtcompleted + @nStartlapse
					WHERE evt_parent   = @sParent
					AND   evt_seq      = @nSeq
					AND   evt_rstatus != N'C'
					
					set @nStartlapse = @nStartlapse + @nDuration
					fetch next from c_cur1 into	@nSeq, @nDuration 
				end

			close c_cur1
			deallocate c_cur1
		end

     UPDATE r5events
     SET    evt_status  = evt_newstatus,
            evt_rstatus = evt_newrstatus
     WHERE  evt_trigevent   = @sOnum
     AND    coalesce(evt_oldstatus, evt_status)   = evt_status
     AND    coalesce(evt_oldrstatus, evt_rstatus)  = evt_rstatus
     AND    evt_rstatus     != N'C'


END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CASEMANCASCADEDATES
  @caseman   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @startseq  NUMERIC
AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @casecasc            NVARCHAR( 2000 )    -- Value of CASECASC organization option
  DECLARE @calgroupcode        NVARCHAR( 15 )      -- Calendar group
  DECLARE @calgrouporg         NVARCHAR( 15 )      -- Calendar group organization
  DECLARE @casestartdate       DATETIME            -- Scheduled start date of the case management
  DECLARE @maxdate             DATETIME            -- Latest scheduled start date of tasks
  DECLARE @maxreqdate          DATETIME            -- Latest requested start date of tasks
  DECLARE @startdate           DATETIME            -- Scheduled start date of a task 
  DECLARE @schdstart           DATETIME            -- Calculated scheduled start date of a task
  DECLARE @schdend             DATETIME            -- Calculated scheduled end date of a task
  DECLARE @reqstart            DATETIME            -- Calculated requested start date of a task
  DECLARE @reqend              DATETIME            -- Calculated requested end date of a task
  DECLARE @calcstartdate       DATETIME            -- Used during actual calculations
  DECLARE @calcenddate         DATETIME            -- Used during actual calculations
  DECLARE @reqenddate          DATETIME            -- Requested end date of the case management
  DECLARE @oldseq              NUMERIC             -- The previous sequence
  DECLARE @usecalendar         NVARCHAR( 1 )       -- Whether calendar data should be used
  DECLARE @dayfound            NVARCHAR( 1 )       -- Used in loop to determine exit ( end of loop )
  DECLARE @tries               NUMERIC             -- Used in loop to determine exit ( end of loop )
  DECLARE @remduration         NUMERIC             -- Remaining duration
  DECLARE @dayofweek           NVARCHAR( 10 )      -- Name of the day ( MONDAY ... ) of a certain date
  DECLARE @starttime           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- Start time of a calendar day ( in minutes after midnight )
  DECLARE @endtime             NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- End time of a calendar day ( in minutes after midnight )
  DECLARE @curtime             NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- Current time ( in minutes after midnight )
  DECLARE @newtime             NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- Used during actual calculations
  DECLARE @deflang             NVARCHAR( 30 )      -- Default language

  /* Case Management Task variables. */
  DECLARE @tcmcode             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tcmsequence         NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tcmstep             NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tcmstartdate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @tcmdatecompleted    DATETIME
  DECLARE @tcmfirmdates        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @tcmschdstartdate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @tcmschdenddate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @tcmreqstartdate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @tcmreqenddate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @tcmduration         NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tcmdurationunit     NVARCHAR( 10 )

  /* Calendar Group Period variables. */
  DECLARE @cgpgroupcode        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @cgpmonstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpmonend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgptuesstart        NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgptuesend          NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpwedstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpwedend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpthursstart       NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpthursend         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpfristart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpfriend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsatstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsatend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsunstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsunend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )

  SET @deflang = @@Language
  SET @oldseq  = @startseq

  /* Get the value for the CASECASC organization option and some other data. */
  SELECT @calgroupcode = org_calgroupcode, 
         @calgrouporg  = org_calgrouporg, 
         @casecasc     = opa_desc, 
         @startdate    = csm_schd_startdate, 
         @reqenddate   = csm_req_enddate
  FROM   r5organization, r5organizationoptions, r5casemanagement
  WHERE  org_code = csm_org
  AND    opa_org  = csm_org
  AND    opa_code = N'CASECASC'
  AND    csm_code = @caseman
  SET @casestartdate = @startdate

  IF @casecasc NOT IN ( N'SCHED', N'BOTH' )
    /* No cascade necessary, exit procedure. */
    RETURN

  /* Get the maximum end date. */
  SELECT @maxdate    = MAX( tcm_schd_enddate ), 
         @maxreqdate = MAX( tcm_req_enddate )
  FROM   r5casemanagementtasks
  WHERE  tcm_casemanagement = @caseman
  AND    tcm_sequence       < @startseq

  /* Set the start date. */
  SET @startdate = COALESCE( @maxdate, @startdate )

  DECLARE tcm2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT tcm_code, tcm_sequence, tcm_step, tcm_startdate, tcm_datecompleted, tcm_firmdates, 
           tcm_schd_startdate, tcm_schd_enddate, tcm_req_startdate, tcm_req_enddate, 
           ISNULL( tcm_plannedduration, 0 ), ISNULL( tcm_duration_unit, N'MONTHS' )
    FROM   r5casemanagementtasks
    WHERE  tcm_casemanagement = @caseman
    AND    tcm_sequence      >= @startseq
    AND    @startdate IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY tcm_sequence
  OPEN tcm2
  FETCH NEXT FROM tcm2 INTO @tcmcode, @tcmsequence, @tcmstep, @tcmstartdate, @tcmdatecompleted, @tcmfirmdates, 
                            @tcmschdstartdate, @tcmschdenddate, @tcmreqstartdate, @tcmreqenddate, @tcmduration, @tcmdurationunit
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Loop through all case management tasks. */
      SET @reqstart = NULL
      SET @reqend   = NULL
      IF @oldseq <> @tcmsequence
        BEGIN
          /* Get the maximum end date. */
          SELECT @startdate  = MAX( tcm_schd_enddate ), 
                 @maxreqdate = MAX( tcm_req_enddate )
          FROM   r5casemanagementtasks
          WHERE  tcm_casemanagement = @caseman
          AND    tcm_sequence       < @tcmsequence
          SET @startdate = COALESCE( @startdate, @casestartdate )
        END  

      IF @tcmdatecompleted IS NULL AND @tcmfirmdates = '-'
        BEGIN
          SET @usecalendar = N'-'
          SET @cgpgroupcode = NULL
          IF @calgroupcode IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
              /* Retrieve calendar group period. */
              SELECT @cgpgroupcode  = cgp_groupcode,
                     @cgpmonstart   = cgp_monstart,
                     @cgpmonend     = cgp_monend,
                     @cgptuesstart  = cgp_tuesstart,
                     @cgptuesend    = cgp_tuesend,
                     @cgpwedstart   = cgp_wedstart,
                     @cgpwedend     = cgp_wedend,
                     @cgpthursstart = cgp_thursstart,
                     @cgpthursend   = cgp_thursend,
                     @cgpfristart   = cgp_fristart,
                     @cgpfriend     = cgp_friend,
                     @cgpsatstart   = cgp_satstart,
                     @cgpsatend     = cgp_satend,
                     @cgpsunstart   = cgp_sunstart,
                     @cgpsunend     = cgp_sunend
              FROM   r5cctrcalgroupperiods
              WHERE  cgp_groupcode = @calgroupcode
              AND    cgp_grouporg  = @calgrouporg
              AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @startdate, N'DD' ) BETWEEN cgp_start AND cgp_end
              AND    cgp_internalofficehours = N'+'
              IF @cgpgroupcode IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                  /* Make sure start date falls within calendar. */
                  SET @tries    = 0
                  SET @dayfound = N'-'
                  WHILE @dayfound = N'-' AND @tries < 8
                    BEGIN
                      SET @tries = @tries + 1
                      SET LANGUAGE N'English'
                      SET @dayofweek = UPPER( DATENAME( dw, @startdate ) )
                      SET LANGUAGE @deflang

create function O7CCODE ( @sUcode	   nvarchar(4),
						  @sRentity	   nvarchar(4))
returns nvarchar(8)
as
begin
	declare @sRetcode	nvarchar(8)

	set @sRetcode = N'*'

	IF @sUcode IS NULL OR @sRentity IS NULL
   		RETURN @sRetcode

	IF @sRentity = N'ENT'
		begin
   			select	@sRetcode = e.ent_rentity
			from    r5entities   e
			where   e.ent_entity = @sUcode

  			IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
     			set @sRetcode = N'*'
		end
	ELSE
		begin
  			select	@sRetcode = s.uco_rcode
			from    r5ucodes  s
			where   s.uco_code    = @sUcode
			and     s.uco_rentity = @sRentity
			IF @@ROWCOUNT > 1
     			set @sRetcode = N'*'
		end
	
	RETURN @sRetcode
end

									@sKey	nvarchar(48),
									@sType	nvarchar(6)
								
as

	declare @nCount	int

body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHECKECSTRUCTURES
  @configcode       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @configorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @configrevision   NUMERIC( 4 ),
  @approve          NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @r5user           NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @objcode  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objpart  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objvar1  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objvar2  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objvar3  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objvar4  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objvar5  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objvar6  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @specific NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @rtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @common   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @appobj   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cnt      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tag      NVARCHAR( 30 )

  SET @chk = N'0'

  /* Get some object data */
  SELECT @objcode  = obj_code, 
         @objpart  = obj_part,
         @objvar1  = obj_variable1,
         @objvar2  = obj_variable2,
         @objvar3  = obj_variable3,
         @objvar4  = obj_variable4,
         @objvar5  = obj_variable5,
         @objvar6  = obj_variable6,
         @rtype    = uco_rcode, 
         @specific = obj_configspecific, 
         @common   = org_common,
         @tag      = ins_desc
  FROM   r5install, r5organization, r5ucodes, r5objects
  WHERE  org_code           = obj_org
  AND    uco_rentity        = N'OBTP'
  AND    uco_code           = obj_configtype
  AND    obj_configcode     = @configcode
  AND    obj_org            = @configorg
  AND    obj_configrevision = @configrevision
  AND    ins_code           = N'OPT_TAGS'
  
  IF @objcode IS NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* Not a correct config code provided, return. */
      SET @chk = N'10'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Select current approved object code of current config. */
  SELECT @appobj = obj_code
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_configcode      = @configcode
  AND    obj_org             = @configorg
  AND    obj_configrevision <> @configrevision
  AND    obj_configrstatus   = N'A'
  
  /* Type checks. */
  IF @rtype = N'S' AND @appobj IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check # asset/position parents. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * ) 
      FROM   r5organization, r5ucodes, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures 
      WHERE  org_code       = obj_org
      AND    obj_code       = ecs_parent
      AND    obj_org        = ecs_parent_org
      AND    uco_rentity    = N'OBTP'
      AND    uco_code       = obj_configtype
      AND    ecs_child      = @appobj
      AND    ecs_child_org  = @configorg
      AND    uco_rcode     IN ( N'A', N'P' )
      IF @cnt > 0
        BEGIN
          /* An system cannot have parent assets/positions. */
          SET @chk = N'1'
          RETURN
        END
    END 
  ELSE IF @rtype IN ( N'A', N'P' ) 
    BEGIN
      /* Check # system children. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5organization, r5ucodes, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures 
      WHERE  org_code       = obj_org
      AND    obj_code       = ecs_child
      AND    obj_org        = ecs_child_org
      AND    uco_rentity    = N'OBTP'
      AND    uco_code       = obj_configtype
      AND    ecs_parent     = @objcode
      AND    ecs_parent_org = @configorg
      AND    uco_rcode      = N'S'
      IF @cnt > 0
        BEGIN
          /* An asset/position cannot have child systems. */
          SET @chk = N'2'
          RETURN
        END
    END

  /* Organization checks. */
  IF @specific = N'+' 
    BEGIN
      IF @appobj IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Check parents of current equipment. */
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * ) 
          FROM   r5organization, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures 
          WHERE  org_code      = obj_org
          AND    obj_code      = ecs_parent
          AND    obj_org       = ecs_parent_org
          AND    obj_configspecific    <> N'+'
          AND    ecs_child     = @appobj
          AND    ecs_child_org = @configorg
          AND    org_common    = N'+'
          IF @cnt > 0 
            BEGIN
              SET @chk = N'3'
              RETURN
            END
        END
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @common = N'+'
        BEGIN
          /* Check children of current equipment. */
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
          FROM   r5organization, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures 
          WHERE  org_code       = obj_org
          AND    obj_code       = ecs_child
          AND    obj_org        = ecs_child_org
          AND    ecs_parent     = @objcode
          AND    ecs_parent_org = @configorg
          AND  ( org_common = N'-' OR obj_configspecific = N'+' )
          IF @cnt > 0 
            BEGIN
              SET @chk = N'4'
              RETURN
            END
        END    
    END

  /* Tag checks. */
  IF @tag = N'+'
    BEGIN
      SET @cnt = 0
      /* If the tag option is ON make sure positions don't have multiple asset children. */
      IF @rtype = N'A' AND @appobj IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
          FROM   r5ucodes, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures
          WHERE  obj_code    = ecs_child
          AND    obj_org     = ecs_child_org
          AND    uco_rentity = N'OBTP'
          AND    uco_code    = obj_configtype
          AND    uco_rcode   = N'A'
          AND    ecs_parent IN
                 ( SELECT ecs_parent
                   FROM   r5ucodes, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures
                   WHERE  obj_code      = ecs_parent
                   AND    obj_org       = ecs_parent_org
                   AND    uco_rentity   = N'OBTP'
                   AND    uco_code      = obj_configtype
                   AND    uco_rcode     = N'P'
                   AND    ecs_child     = @appobj
                   AND    ecs_child_org = @configorg )
          IF @cnt > 1 
            BEGIN
              /* A position cannot have more than one asset child. */
              SET @chk = N'5'
              RETURN
            END
        END           
      ELSE IF @rtype = N'P'
        BEGIN
          SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
          FROM   r5organization, r5ucodes, r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures 
          WHERE  org_code       = obj_org
          AND    obj_code       = ecs_child
          AND    obj_org        = ecs_child_org
          AND    uco_rentity    = N'OBTP'
          AND    uco_code       = obj_configtype
          AND    ecs_parent     = @objcode
          AND    ecs_parent_org = @configorg
          AND    uco_rcode      = N'A'
          IF @cnt > 1 
            BEGIN
              /* A position cannot have more than one asset child. */
              SET @chk = N'6'
              RETURN
            END
        END    
    END;

  /* Check for recursive tree structure. */ 
  WITH children ( ecs_child, ecs_child_org, ecs_useapprovedrev ) AS 
  ( SELECT ecs_child, ecs_child_org, ecs_useapprovedrev
    FROM   r5equipconfigstructures
    WHERE  ecs_parent     = @objcode 
    AND    ecs_parent_org = @configorg
    UNION ALL   
    SELECT np.ecs_child, np.ecs_child_org, np.ecs_useapprovedrev 
    FROM   r5equipconfigstructures AS np JOIN children ON np.ecs_parent = children.ecs_child AND np.ecs_parent_org = children.ecs_child_org )
  SELECT @chk = N'7'
  FROM   r5objects, children
  WHERE  obj_code           = ecs_child
  AND    obj_org            = ecs_child_org
  AND    obj_configcode     = @configcode
  AND    obj_org            = @configorg
  AND    ecs_useapprovedrev = N'+'
  IF @chk = N'7'
    RETURN

  IF @approve = N'+'
    BEGIN
      /* Extra steps in case the revision gets approved. First set some approve related columns. */
      UPDATE r5objects
      SET    obj_configapproved   = dbo.o7gttime2( obj_org ),
             obj_configapprovedby = @r5user
      WHERE  obj_configcode       = @configcode
      AND    obj_org              = @configorg
      AND    obj_configrevision   = @con

CREATE FUNCTION o7checkmatch(
  @string1  NVARCHAR( 500 ), 
  @string2  NVARCHAR( 500 ) ) 
  RETURNS NVARCHAR AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @string    NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @curstring NVARCHAR( 20 )
  SET @string = @string1
  IF @string IS NULL 
    RETURN '+'
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      WHILE @string IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          IF CHARINDEX( ',', @string ) = 0
            BEGIN
              /* Last code, so set curstring to entire string. Also set checklist filter to NULL, so loop will be exited. */
              SET @curstring = @string
              SET @string    = NULL
            END
          ELSE
            BEGIN
              SET @curstring = SUBSTRING( @string, 1, CHARINDEX(',', @string ) - 1 )
              SET @string    = SUBSTRING( @string, CHARINDEX(',', @string) + 1, CHARINDEX( ',', @string ) + 1 )
            END
          IF CHARINDEX( ',' + @curstring + ',', ',' + @string2 + ',' ) > 0
            /* There is a match, return match found. */
            RETURN '+'
        END
    END
  RETURN '-'
END

create PROCEDURE O7CHECKOVERLAP
	@sOctype     nvarchar(4),
	@sTrade       nvarchar(15),
	@sMRC         nvarchar(15),
	@sSupplier    nvarchar(30),
	@sSupplierOrg nvarchar(15),
	@dStart      datetime,
	@dEnd        datetime,
	@sOrg        nvarchar(15),
	@sPerson     nvarchar(15),
	@sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dTRRStart Datetime
	declare @dTRREnd	Datetime
	declare @dTempStartDate	Datetime
	declare @dTempEndDate	Datetime
	set @sChk = N'0'

	DECLARE cDates CURSOR local FOR SELECT trr_start, trr_end
								FROM   r5traderates
								WHERE  trr_trade        = @sTrade
								AND    trr_mrc          = @sMRC
								AND    trr_supplier     = @sSupplier
								AND    trr_supplier_org = @sSupplierOrg
								AND    trr_octype       = @sOctype
								AND    trr_person       = @sPerson
								AND    trr_org          = @sOrg


	OPEN cDates
	FETCH NEXT FROM cDates INTO @dStart, @dEnd
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			If @dStart > @dTRRStart
				Set @dTempStartDate = @dStart
			else
				Set @dTempStartDate = @dTRRStart

			If @dEnd < @dTRREnd
				Set @dTempEndDate = @dEnd
			else
				Set @dTempEndDate = @dTRRStart


			 IF  @dTempStartDate <= @dTempEndDate
				begin
					CLOSE cDates
					DEALLOCATE cDates
					set @sChk = N'1'
					Return
				end
			FETCH NEXT FROM cDates INTO @dTRRStart, @dTRREnd
		END
	CLOSE cDates
	DEALLOCATE cDates

CREATE function o7chier (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
							@sOrg	nvarchar(15),
							@sCodet	nvarchar(15),
							@action nvarchar(15))
RETURNS @tReturn table(	stc_parent		nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parenttype	nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child		nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_childtype	nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						nLevel					int )
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel					int
	DECLARE @sParent		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sParenttype	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sChildtype		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sParentorg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @tStack table (	stc_parent		nvarchar(30),
							stc_parenttype	nvarchar(30),
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_child		nvarchar(30),
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(30),
							LevelID					int )

	IF @action IN ('STC4', 'STC5')
		INSERT INTO @tStack 
			SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parent_org,
					stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, 1 
			FROM	r5structures
			WHERE	stc_child		= @sCode 
			AND		stc_child_org	= @sOrg	
			AND		stc_parentrtype = (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC5' THEN N'S' ELSE stc_parentrtype END) 
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @action = 'STC7'
				INSERT INTO @tStack 
					SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parent_org,
							stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, 1 
					FROM	r5structures
					WHERE	stc_parent	LIKE CASE WHEN @sCode = N'%' THEN N'$' ELSE @sCode END
					AND		stc_parent_org	LIKE @sOrg	
					AND		stc_rollup	= N'+'  
			ELSE		
				BEGIN
					IF @action = 'STC8'
						INSERT INTO @tStack 
						SELECT evt_parent as stc_parent, null as 
						stc_parenttype, null as stc_parent_org, 
						evt_code as stc_child, null as stc_child_org, 
						null as stc_childtype, 1 
						FROM	r5events 
						WHERE evt_code LIKE CASE WHEN @sCode = N'%' THEN N'$' ELSE @sCode END 
					ELSE
						INSERT INTO @tStack 
							SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parent_org,
									stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, 1 
							FROM	r5structures
							WHERE	stc_parent		= @sCode 
							AND		stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	
							AND		stc_parenttype	= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC1' THEN @sCodet ELSE stc_parenttype END) 
							AND		(stc_rollup		= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC2' THEN N'+' ELSE stc_rollup END) 
									OR stc_childrtype	= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC2' THEN N'L' ELSE stc_childrtype END) 
									AND stc_parentrtype	= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC2' THEN N'L' WHEN 'STC6' THEN N'S' ELSE stc_parentrtype END))
				END
		END
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@sCode		= stc_child,
							@sOrg		= stc_child_org,
							@sChildtype	= stc_childtype,
							@sParent	= stc_parent,
							@sParenttype= stc_parenttype,
							@sParentorg	= stc_parent_org
					FROM	@tStack 
					WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
					
					INSERT INTO @tReturn 
					VALUES (@sParent, @sParenttype, @sParentorg, 
							@sCode, @sOrg, @sChildtype, @nLevel )

					DELETE FROM @tStack 
					WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
					AND		stc_child 	= @sCode
					AND		stc_child_org 	= @sOrg
					AND		stc_childtype 	= @sChildtype
					AND		stc_parent 	= @sParent
					AND		stc_parenttype 	= @sParenttype
					AND		stc_parent_org 	= @sParentorg

					IF @action IN ('STC4', 'STC5')
						INSERT INTO @tStack 
							SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parent_org,
									stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, 1 
							FROM	r5structures
							WHERE	stc_child		= @sParent 
							AND		stc_child_org	= @sParentorg	
							AND		stc_parentrtype = (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC5' THEN N'S' ELSE stc_parentrtype END)
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF @action = 'STC7'
								INSERT INTO @tStack 
									SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parent_org,
											stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, @nLevel + 1  
									FROM	r5structures
									WHERE	stc_parent	= @sCode 
									AND		stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	
									AND		stc_rollup	= N'+'  
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									IF @action = 'STC8'
										INSERT INTO @tStack 	
										SELECT evt_parent as stc_parent, null as 
										stc_parenttype, null as stc_parent_org, 
										evt_code as stc_child, null as stc_child_org, 
										null as stc_childtype, 
										@nLevel + 1 
										FROM r5events 
										WHERE evt_parent = @sCode 
									ELSE
										INSERT INTO @tStack 
											SELECT	stc_parent, stc_parenttype, stc_parent_org,
													stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, @nLevel + 1 
											FROM	r5structures
											WHERE	stc_parent		= @sCode 
											AND		stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	
											AND		stc_parenttype	= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC1' THEN @sCodet ELSE stc_parenttype END) 
											AND		(stc_rollup		= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC2' THEN N'+' ELSE stc_rollup END) 
													OR stc_childrtype	= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC2' THEN N'L' ELSE stc_childrtype END) 
													AND stc_parentrtype	= (CASE @action  WHEN 'STC2' THEN N'L' WHEN 'STC6' THEN N'S' ELSE stc_parentrtype END))
								END
						END
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHISTL 
	@sStore				nvarchar(15),
	@sPart				nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg			nvarchar(15),
	@sBin				nvarchar(15),
	@sLot				nvarchar(12),
	@nExpqty			numeric			OUTPUT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
begin
	declare @sX			nvarchar(1) 
	declare @nReturn	INTEGER
	declare @nCount	INTEGER

	set  @sChk = N'0'  
	set  @sX   = NULL
	set  @nReturn = 0 

	SELECT @sX = N'x'
	FROM   r5parts
	WHERE  par_code = @sPart
	AND    par_org  = @sPartorg 
	IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1  
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'2' 
			RETURN 
		end

	SELECT @sX = N'x'
	FROM   r5bins
	WHERE  bin_store = @sStore
	AND    bin_code  = @sBin 
	IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1   
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'3' 
			RETURN 
		end


	SELECT @sX = N'x'
	FROM   r5lots
	WHERE  lot_code  = @sLot 
	IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1   
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'4' 
			RETURN 
		end

	SELECT @sX = N'x'
	FROM   r5stock
	WHERE  sto_part     = @sPart
	AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg
	AND    sto_store    = @sStore 
	IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1    
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'5' 
			RETURN 
		end

	SELECT @sX = N'x'
	FROM   r5stocktakelines
	WHERE  stl_part     = @sPart
	AND    stl_part_org = @sPartorg
	AND    stl_store    = @sStore
	AND    stl_bin      = @sBin
	AND    stl_lot      = @sLot 
    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0   
       begin
         set  @sChk = N'6' 
         RETURN 
       end

	SELECT @nExpqty = ISNULL( bis_qty, 0  )
	FROM   r5binstock
	WHERE  bis_part     = @sPart
	AND    bis_part_org = @sPartorg
	AND    bis_store    = @sStore
	AND    bis_bin      = @sBin
	AND    bis_lot      = @sLot 
	IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1   
		set @nExpqty = -1

	if @nExpqty = -1 
		begin
			INSERT	INTO r5binstock ( bis_store, bis_part, bis_part_org, bis_bin,   bis_lot,  bis_qty )
					VALUES ( @sStore,@sPart, @sPartorg, @sBin, @sLot, 0 ) 
			
			set   @nExpqty = 0 
		end  

end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHKACP 
   @sYear					nvarchar(8),
   @sChk                    nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare   @dStart					datetime 
	declare   @dEnd				        datetime
	declare   @dAcpstart	            datetime 
	declare   @dAcpend					datetime
	declare   @sCheckresult             nvarchar(4) 
	declare   @nCount					integer

	set @sChk          = N'0' 
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0' 

	if @sYear IS NULL
	begin
		set @sChk = N'1' 
		return 
	end  

	if not exists (select 1 from r5years WHERE  acy_year = @sYear )
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2' 
			return 
		end
	else
		SELECT @dStart = acy_start,
			 @dEnd = acy_end
		FROM   r5years
		WHERE  acy_year = @sYear 
      

	declare c_per  cursor local for select acp_start,acp_end
									from   r5periods
									where  acp_year = @sYear
									order by acp_seqno 

    open c_per
	fetch next from c_per into @dAcpstart, @dAcpend
	WHILE  @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			if @dStart <> @dAcpstart
				begin
					set  @sChk = N'3' 
					close c_per
					deallocate c_per
					return 
				end 
			set @dStart = @dAcpend + 1 
			fetch next from c_per into @dAcpstart, @dAcpend
		end  
	close c_per
	deallocate c_per

	if @dStart - 1 <> @dEnd 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3' 
			return 
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHKBUD   @sBudget        nvarchar(17),
                            @sYear          nvarchar(8),
                            @nActlevel      numeric(1),
                            @sCode          nvarchar(30),
                            @sGroup         nvarchar(5),
                            @sCodefield     nvarchar(30),
                            @sGroupfield    nvarchar(5),
                            @sAndclause1    nvarchar(1000),
                            @sAndclause2    nvarchar(1000),
                            @sAndclause3    nvarchar(1000),
                            @sAndclause4    nvarchar(1000),
                            @sAndclause5    nvarchar(1000),
                            @nCountit       numeric(38)         OUTPUT,
                            @sChk           nvarchar(6)         OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSelclause1    nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sSelclause2    nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sSelclause3    nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sSelclause4    nvarchar(1000)
    declare @sAndclause6    nvarchar(1000)

    declare @sSQL           nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sParm          nvarchar(2000)

    set @sSelclause1 =  N'select @nCount = count(*) ' + 
                        N'  from r5budgetdetails ' + 
                        N' where bdt_level =  @actlevel ' + 
                        N' and   bdt_budget = @cbudget ' + 
                        N' and   bdt_year   = @cyear '

    set @sSelclause2 =  N'select @nCount = count(*) ' +
                        N'  from r5budgetdetails d, ' +
                        N'       r5budgetitems i ' +
                        N' where i.bit_group = @groupfield ' +
                        N' and   i.bit_code  = @code ' + 
                        N' and   d.bdt_level = @actlevel ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_budget = @cbudget ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_year   = @cyear '

    set @sSelclause3 =  N'select @nCount = count(*) ' +
                        N'  from r5budgetdetails d, ' +
                        N'       r5budgetitems i, ' +
                        N'       r5budgetitems i2 ' +
                        N' where i.bit_group = @groupfield ' +
                        N' and   i2.bit_group = @cgroup ' +
                        N' and   i.bit_code   = i2.bit_code ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_level  = @actlevel ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_budget = @cbudget ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_year   = @cyear '

    set @sSelclause4 =  N'select @nCount = count(*) ' + 
                        N'  from r5budgetdetails d, ' +
                        N'       r5budgetitems i ' +
                        N' where i.bit_group  = @cgroup ' +
                        N' and   i.bit_code   = @codefield ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_level  = @actlevel ' + 
                        N' and   d.bdt_budget = @cbudget ' +
                        N' and   d.bdt_year   = @cyear '

    if @sCode is not null 
        set @sAndclause6 = N' and @codefield = @code '
    else
        set @sAndclause6 = N' and @groupfield = @cgroup '


    set @sSQL = @sSelclause1 + @sAndclause6 + 
                coalesce( @sAndclause1, '') + 
                coalesce( @sAndclause2, '') + 
                coalesce( @sAndclause3, '') + 
                coalesce( @sAndclause4, '') + 
                coalesce( @sAndclause5, '') 

    set @sParm = N'@actlevel numeric(1), @cbudget nvarchar(17), @cyear nvarchar(8), ' + 
                 N'@groupfield nvarchar(5), @code nvarchar(30), @cgroup nvarchar(5) ' +
                 N'@codefield nvarchar(30), @nCount numeric(38) OUTPUT'

    execute sp_executesql @sSQL, @sParm, @nActlevel, @sBudget, @sYear, @sGroupfield, @sCode, @sGroup, @sCodefield, @nCountit OUTPUT

    if @nCountit > 0
        return

    if @sCode is not null
        begin
            if @sGroupfield = N'BDT_PERIODGR'
                return

            set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause1, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause2, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause3, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause4, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause5, '') 

            execute sp_executesql @sSQL, @sParm, @nActlevel, @sBudget, @sYear, @sGroupfield, @sCode, @sGroup, @sCodefield, @nCountit OUTPUT
        end
    else
        begin
            set @sSQL = @sSelclause3 + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause1, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause2, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause3, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause4, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause5, '') 

            execute sp_executesql @sSQL, @sParm, @nActlevel, @sBudget, @sYear, @sGroupfield, @sCode, @sGroup, @sCodefield, @nCountit OUTPUT

            if @nCountit > 0
                return


            set @sSQL = @sSelclause4 + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause1, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause2, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause3, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause4, '') + 
                        coalesce( @sAndclause5, '') 

            execute sp_executesql @sSQL, @sParm, @nActlevel, @sBudget, @sYear, @sGroupfield, @sCode, @sGroup, @sCodefield, @nCountit OUTPUT
        end

IF @sEntity = N'PORD'

ELSE IF @sEntity = N'EVNT'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5ACTIVITIES'

ELSE IF @sEntity = N'INV'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5INVOICELINES'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'INVL'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'IVL_INVOICE'
         ,@sPrimaryKey2 = N'IVL_INVOICE_ORG'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'IVL_INVLINE'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'OBJ'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5WARRANTIES'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'WAR'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'WAR_OBJECT'
         ,@sPrimaryKey2 = N'WAR_OBJECT_ORG'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'WAR_ID'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'PICK'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5PICKLISTPARTS'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'PICP'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'PIP_PICKLIST'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'PIP_PART'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'PROJ'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5PROJBUDCLASSES'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'BUD'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'PCL_PROJECT'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'PCL_PROJBUD'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'QUOT'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5QUOTLINES'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'QUOL'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'QUL_QUOTATION'
         ,@sPrimaryKey2 = N'QUL_SEQNO'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'QUL_LINE'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'REQ'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5REQUISLINES'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'REQL'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'RQL_REQ'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'RQL_REQLINE'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'TRAN'
   SELECT @sTableName   = N'R5TRANSLINES'
         ,@sChildEntity = N'TRL'
         ,@sPrimaryKey1 = N'TRL_TRANS'
         ,@sPrimaryKey3 = N'TRL_LINE'

IF @sPrimaryKey3 IS NULL
   RETURN

CREATE TABLE #PrimaryKey3Values (pk3value NVARCHAR(4000) NULL)

DECLARE GetPrimaryKey3Values CURSOR LOCAL FOR
SELECT pk3value FROM #PrimaryKey3Values

SET @sSQLStatement = N'INSERT INTO #PrimaryKey3Values '
                   + N'SELECT ' + @sPrimaryKey3 + N' FROM ' + @sTableName + N' WHERE ' + @sPrimaryKey1 + N' = ''' + @sCode + N''''
IF @sPrimaryKey2 IS NOT NULL
   SET @sSQLStatement = @sSQLStatement + N' AND ' + @sPrimaryKey2 + N' = ''' + @sOrg + N''''
EXECUTE (@sSQLStatement)
IF @@ERROR != 0
   RETURN -1

SET @sSQLStatement = N'SELECT @sReturnValue = ' + dbo.GET_MAPPED_COLUMNS(@sChildEntity,1,250)
					+ N', @sReturnValue2 = ' + dbo.GET_MAPPED_COLUMNS(@sChildEntity,251,500)
					+ N' FROM ' + @sTableName + N' WHERE ' + @sPrimaryKey1 + N' = '''+@sCode +''''
IF @sSQLStatement IS NULL
   RETURN -1
IF @sPrimaryKey2 IS NOT NULL
   SET @sSQLStatement = @sSQLStatement + N' AND ' + @sPrimaryKey2 + N' = ''' + @sOrg + N''''
SET @sSQLStatement = @sSQLStatement + N' AND ' + @sPrimaryKey3 + N' = @sPrimaryKey3Value'

OPEN GetPrimaryKey3Values
WHILE 1=1
      BEGIN
		  FETCH GetPrimaryKey3Values INTO @sPrimaryKey3Value
		  IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
			 BEGIN
			 SET @nLoopComplete = 1
			 BREAK
			 END

		  SELECT @sELAAcode = ela_code
			FROM r5elecarchive
		   WHERE ela_entity = @sChildEntity
			 AND ela_parent = @sArchCode
			 AND ela_entcode = @sReturnValue
		  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			 BREAK

		set @nPos = charindex(@sSQLStatement, SUBSTRING(@sPrimaryKey1, 1, 4) + 'UPDATECOUNT') - 1

		IF @nPos <> 0 
			begin
				set @sSQLStatement = SUBSTRING( @sSQLStatement, 1, @nPos ) + SUBSTRING(@sPrimaryKey1, 1, 4) + ' UPDATECOUNT - @nCounter ' + SUBSTRING( @sSQLStatement, @nPos + 16, len(@sSQLStatement) )
				set @nCounter = 0
				WHILE @nCounter <= 5
					begin
						EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQLStatement, N'@sReturnValue NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @sReturnValue2 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @sPrimaryKey3Value NVARCHAR(4000), @nCounter INTEGER', @sReturnValue OUTPUT, @sReturnValue2 OUTPUT, @sPrimaryKey3Value, @nCounter
						IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
							BREAK
						SET @sHash = dbo.O7HASH(COALESCE(@sReturnValue,'') + COALESCE(@sReturnValue2,''), N'GBJMIONL')
						IF @sHash = @sELAAcode 
							break 
						set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
					end	
			end
		else
			begin
				EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQLStatement, N'@sReturnValue NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @sReturnValue2 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @sPrimaryKey3Value NVARCHAR(4000), @nCounter INTEGER', @sReturnValue OUTPUT, @sReturnValue2 OUTPUT, @sPrimaryKey3Value, @nCounter
				IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @@ROWCOUNT = 0
					BREAK
				SET @sHash = dbo.O7HASH(COALESCE(@sReturnValue,'') + COALESCE(@sReturnValue2,''), N'GBJMIONL')
			end

		  IF @sHash != @sELAAcode
			 BREAK
      END
CLOSE GetPrimaryKey3Values
DEALLOCATE GetPrimaryKey3Values

IF @nLoopComplete = 0
   SET @sCheck = N'FALSE'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHKDATE
			@dSchedend			datetime,
			@dTarget			datetime,
			@dRequestend		datetime,
			@dRequeststart		datetime,
			@nDuration			integer,
			@sChk				nvarchar(20) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @dVardate	datetime
	declare @sDonotcheck6	nvarchar(20)

BEGIN
	set @dVardate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate(), N'DD' ) 
	set @sDonotcheck6 = @sChk
	set @sChk = null

	if @dSchedend IS NOT NULL AND @dTarget IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dSchedend, N'DD' )  < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dTarget, N'DD' )  
				begin
					set @sChk = N'1'  
					return
				end
		end

	if @dRequestend IS NOT NULL AND @dRequeststart IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequestend, N'DD' ) < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequeststart, N'DD' ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2' 
					return
				end
		end

	if @dRequeststart IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequeststart, N'DD' ) < @dVardate 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3' 
					return
				end
		end

	if @dRequestend IS NOT NULL AND @dRequeststart IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequestend, N'DD' ) - dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequeststart, N'DD' )) + 1 < @nDuration 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'	
					return
				end
		end

	if @dSchedend IS NOT NULL AND @dTarget IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dSchedend, N'DD' ) - dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dTarget, N'DD' )) + 1 < @nDuration 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'	
					return
				end
		end
	
	if @sDonotcheck6 <> N'donotcheck6' OR @sDonotcheck6 IS NULL
		if @dTarget IS NOT NULL AND @dRequeststart IS NOT NULL AND @dRequestend IS NOT NULL AND @dSchedend IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				if NOT (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dTarget, N'DD' ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequeststart, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequestend, N'DD' ) )
				OR  (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dSchedend, N'DD' ) NOT BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequeststart, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRequestend, N'DD' ) ) 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'6'	
						return
					end
			end


END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7CHKERECORD
                 @sHash             NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
                ,@sEntity           NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sTableName        NVARCHAR(128)
                ,@sPrimaryKey1      NVARCHAR(4000)
                ,@sPrimaryKey2      NVARCHAR(4000)
                ,@sPrimaryKey3      NVARCHAR(4000)
                ,@sPrimaryKeyValue1 NVARCHAR(4000)
                ,@sPrimaryKeyValue2 NVARCHAR(4000)
                ,@sPrimaryKeyValue3 NVARCHAR(4000)
				,@nFail				numeric(38,0) = 0
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @sSQLStatement NVARCHAR(max)
		   ,@sReturnValue  NVARCHAR(MAX)
		   ,@sReturnValue2  NVARCHAR(MAX)
		   ,@nRowcount		int
		   ,@nError			int
		   ,@nPos			int

	SET @nPos = 0
	SET @sHash = N''
	

	SET @sSQLStatement = N'SELECT @sReturnValue = ' + dbo.GET_MAPPED_COLUMNS(@sEntity,1,250)
					   + N', @sReturnValue2 = ' + dbo.GET_MAPPED_COLUMNS(@sEntity,251,500)
					   + N'  FROM ' + @sTableName
					   + N' WHERE ' + @sPrimaryKey1 + '= ''' + @sPrimaryKeyValue1 + ''''
	IF @sSQLStatement IS NULL
	   RETURN -1

	IF ISNULL(@sPrimaryKey2, N'x') != N'x' AND @sPrimaryKeyValue2 IS NOT NULL
	   SET @sSQLStatement = @sSQLStatement
					   + N'   AND ' + @sPrimaryKey2 + '= ''' + @sPrimaryKeyValue2 + ''''
	IF ISNULL(@sPrimaryKey3, N'x') != N'x' AND @sPrimaryKeyValue3 IS NOT NULL
	   SET @sSQLStatement = @sSQLStatement
					   + N'   AND ' + @sPrimaryKey3 + '= ''' + @sPrimaryKeyValue3 + ''''

	set @nPos = charindex(SUBSTRING(@sPrimaryKey1, 1, 4) + N'UPDATECOUNT', @sSQLStatement) - 1

	IF @nPos <> 0 
		set @sSQLStatement = SUBSTRING( @sSQLStatement, 1, @nPos ) + SUBSTRING(@sPrimaryKey1, 1, 4) + 'UPDATECOUNT - @nFail ' + SUBSTRING ( @sSQLStatement, @nPos + 16, len(@sSQLStatement) )


	EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQLStatement, N'@sReturnValue NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT, @sReturnValue2 NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT, @nFail	numeric(38,0)', @sReturnValue OUTPUT, @sReturnValue2 OUTPUT, @nFail
	select @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
	IF @nError != 0
	   RETURN -1
       
	if @nRowcount = 0
		SET @sHash = N'AAA'
	else	
		SET @sHash = dbo.O7HASH(COALESCE(@sReturnValue,'') + COALESCE(@sReturnValue2,''), N'GBJMIONL')

create function O7CHKEVT(	@sEvtcode	nvarchar(30),
							@sFlag		nvarchar(32),
							@sUser		nvarchar(255),
							@sRole    nvarchar(30) = '*' )
returns int
as
begin
	declare @nFlg	int

	if @sFlag = N'd'
		SELECT @nFlg = count(*)
		FROM r5events e
		WHERE e.evt_code = @sEvtcode
		AND e.evt_rstatus <> N'C'
		AND COALESCE(evt_mpproj, N'-') = N'-'
		AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'DEPTSEC' AND upper(ins_desc) = N'ON') 
			OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = @sUser AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND COALESCE(dse_readonly, '-') = N'-'))
		AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'JTAUTH' AND upper(ins_desc) = N'YES') 
			OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization JOIN r5jobtypeauth ON uog_group = jta_group 
			WHERE uog_org = evt_org AND uog_user = @sUser AND uog_role = @sRole AND jta_jobtype = evt_jobtype AND (jta_status = N'ALLSTATS' OR jta_status = evt_status) AND jta_delete = N'+'))
		AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_org = evt_org AND uog_user = @sUser AND uog_role = @sRole)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5elecarchive WHERE ela_entity = N'EVNT' AND ela_entcode = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5requisitions WHERE req_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5requislines WHERE rql_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5orderlines WHERE orl_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5actschedules WHERE acs_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5picklists WHERE pic_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5bookedhours WHERE boo_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5translines WHERE trl_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5toolusage WHERE tou_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5warclaims WHERE wcl_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5joblines WHERE jbl_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5repairbins WHERE rpb_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5eventaspects WHERE eas_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5agreements WHERE agr_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5additionalcharge WHERE adc_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5suppevaluation WHERE eva_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5permevents WHERE pev_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5dispatches WHERE swd_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5transtock WHERE tst_tocode = evt_code AND tst_torentity = N'EVNT')
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5calcevents WHERE cev_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5eventpoints WHERE epo_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5issues WHERE iss_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5transactions WHERE (tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT' AND tra_fromcode = evt_code) OR (tra_torentity = N'EVNT' AND tra_tocode = evt_code))
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5events e2 WHERE e2.evt_parent = e.evt_code AND COALESCE(e2.evt_routeparent, N'!') <> COALESCE(e2.evt_parent, N'!'))
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5events e2 WHERE e2.evt_trigevent = e.evt_code)
	else
		SELECT @nFlg = count(*)
		FROM r5events e
		WHERE e.evt_code = @sEvtcode
		AND e.evt_rstatus <> N'C'
		AND e.evt_object IS NOT NULL
		AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'DEPTSEC' AND upper(ins_desc) = N'ON') 
				OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = @sUser AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND COALESCE(dse_readonly, N'-') = N'-'))
		AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = N'JTAUTH' AND upper(ins_desc) = N'YES') 
				OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization JOIN r5jobtypeauth ON uog_group = jta_group 
				WHERE uog_org = evt_org AND uog_user = @sUser AND uog_role = @sRole AND jta_jobtype = evt_jobtype AND (jta_status = N'ALLSTATS' OR jta_status = evt_status) AND jta_update = N'+'))
		AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_org = evt_org AND uog_user = @sUser AND uog_role = @sRole)
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
							FROM r5bookedhours b
							WHERE b.boo_event = e.evt_code )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
							FROM r5activities a
							WHERE a.act_event = e.evt_code
							AND a.act_order IS NOT NULL )
		AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
							FROM r5translines t
							WHERE t.trl_event = e.evt_code )
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5requisitions WHERE req_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5requislines WHERE rql_event = evt_code)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5orderlines WHERE orl_event = evt_code)
		
	return ( @nFlg )

end

create function O7CHKEY( @sDatastr nvarchar(12) )
returns int
as
begin
	declare @nPoly	int
	declare @nScrc	int
	declare @nTemp	int
	declare @nI		int
	declare @nJ		int
	declare @nAscii	int

	set @nPoly = 33800
	set @nScrc = 24520

	set @nTemp = @nScrc

	set @nI = 0
	while @nI < 12
		begin
			set @nAscii = ascii( substring( @sDatastr, @nI + 1, 1) )
			set @nTemp = @nTemp ^ @nAscii

			set @nJ = 0
			while @nJ < 8
				begin
					if (@nTemp & 1) = 0
						set @nTemp = floor( @nTemp / 2 ) ^ 0
					else
						set @nTemp = floor( @nTemp / 2 ) ^ @nPoly
					
					set @nJ = @nJ + 1
				end
			
			set @nI = @nI + 1
		end

	return ( @nTemp )
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHKOBJ 
	@sObject nvarchar(30),
	@sOrg    nvarchar(15),
	@sFunc   nvarchar(6),

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

   set @sChk = N'0'

	WHERE  pmt_function  = @sFunc
	AND    pmt_query     = que_code
	AND    pmt_parameter = N'SEL_PARENT'
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0

	IF @sStatement IS NULL 
		RETURN


	set @sStatement = N' r5objects ' +	N'WHERE  obj_code = N''' + @sObject + '''' +
		N'AND    obj_org  = N''' + @sOrg  + '''' + N'AND  ( obj_code, obj_org ) IN ( N' + @sStatement +N')'


	SET @sStatement = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sStatement

	EXEC sp_executesql @sStatement, N'@nCount int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT

	if @nCount > 0
		set @sChk= N'0'
	else
		set @sChk= N'1'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CHKPAR
	@sPart			nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sObject		nvarchar(30),
	@sObjectorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sPickdays		nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sPick			nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT  
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit       integer
	declare @dPickdate      datetime
	declare @dTempDate		datetime
	declare @nReturn		integer
BEGIN
  set @sChk = N'0'

	execute @nReturn = o7gttime @dTempDate OUTPUT,@sPartorg 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1  

	SELECT @nCountit = coalesce( SUM( pip_qty ), 0 )
	FROM   r5picklists, r5parts, r5picklistparts
	WHERE  pip_part       = @sPart
	AND    pip_part_org   = @sPartorg
	AND    pic_code       = pip_picklist
	AND    pic_object     = @sObject
	AND    pic_object_org = @sObjectorg
	AND    par_code       = pip_part
	AND    par_org        = pip_part_org
	AND    pic_required  >= ( @dTempDate - coalesce( par_wardays, -1 ) )

	IF @nCountit > 0 
		begin
			SELECT @dPickdate = MAX( pic_required )
				FROM   r5picklists, r5picklistparts
				WHERE  pic_object     = @sObject
				AND    pic_object_org = @sObjectorg
				AND    pic_code       = pip_picklist
				AND    pip_part       = @sPart
				AND    pip_part_org   = @sPartorg
				AND    pip_qty        > 0

			SELECT @sPick = MAX( pic_code )
			FROM   r5picklists, r5picklistparts
			WHERE  pic_object     = @sObject
			AND    pic_object_org = @sObjectorg
			AND    pic_code       = pip_picklist
			AND    pip_part       = @sPart
			AND    pip_part_org   = @sPartorg
			AND    pip_qty        > 0
			AND    pic_required   = @dPickdate
						
			set @sPickdays = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' ) - dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dPickdate, N'DD' ) 
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
END

create PROCEDURE O7CHKPSD 
	@sUsr		nvarchar(255), 
	@sPswd		nvarchar(32), 
	@sChk		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	declare @sR5pass   	nvarchar(12)
	declare @dExpuser  	datetime
	declare @dExppass  	datetime
	declare @sEncrppass 	nvarchar(32)
	declare @dToday		datetime
	declare @nCount		integer

	set @sChk = 0
	set @dToday = GetDate()
	
	set @sEncrppass = dbo.O7CRPPAS (@sPswd)

	SELECT @sR5pass = usr_password , @dExpuser = usr_expuser, @dExppass = usr_exppass
	FROM   r5users
	WHERE  usr_code = @sUsr
	AND    coalesce( usr_login, N'+' ) = N'+'


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			if @sR5pass <> coalesce(@sEncrppass, N'@')   
				begin
					set @sChk = 2
					return
				end

			if @dExpuser < @dToday 
				begin
					set @sChk = 3
					return
				end

			if @dExppass < @dToday 
				begin
					set @sChk = 4
					return
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = 1
			return
		end
end

create procedure O7CKCCL1 
	@sClcode       nvarchar (8),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount       int

	declare @nReturn	int

	/* Initialise */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @nCount     = 0
	set @sX           = NULL

	 /* Check all mandatory parameters */
	if @sClcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'

	/* C03413 - Not linked to contract  */
	execute @nReturn = o7existc N'CLAU', N'CLAU', @sClcode, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

	if @nCount = -1

			set @sChk = @sCheckresult
			RETURN
		end
	else
		begin
			if @nCount > 0 
				begin 
					/* Records found for given condition.  */
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end
		end

create procedure O7CKDIS1
	@sInsupd          nvarchar(4),
	@sCditype        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sCdirtype       nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sCdicontract    nvarchar(30),
	@dCdistartdt     datetime,
	@dCdienddt       datetime,
	@sConorg         nvarchar(15),
	@sConsupplier    nvarchar(30),
	@sConsupplierorg nvarchar(15),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 

   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dConstartdt     datetime                            /* Contract Start Date */
	declare @dConenddt       datetime                            /* Contract End datetime   */
	declare @sConrstatus     nvarchar(4) --R5CONTRACTS.CON_RSTATUS%TYPE    /* Contract rstatus    */
	declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sX               nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @nCountit         int
	declare @nCount         int
	declare @nReturn		int
	/* Initialise */
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @nCountit     = 0
	set @sX           = NULL
	
	/* Check for Mandatory Parameters  */
	if @sInsupd       NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		OR @sInsupd IS  NULL
		OR ( @sCditype   IS  NULL AND @sCdirtype IS  NULL )
		OR @sCdicontract IS  NULL
		OR @dCdistartdt  IS  NULL
		OR @dCdienddt    IS  NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end



	if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			if @sCdirtype IN ( N'O', N'Y',  N'L', N'P') 
				begin
					if @sConsupplier    IS NULL OR  @sConsupplierorg IS NULL 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'1'
						RETURN
					end
				end
		end

	/* C13223 - Type must exist (r5ucodes) */
	if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCdirtype OUTPUT, @sCditype OUTPUT, N'DITP', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin 
					set @sChk = N'6'
					RETURN
				end

			/* C13227 - Check for overlapping active contract with discounts type */
			/*          = per order or per period ( 'O', 'Y' )                    */
			/* C13228 - Check for overlapping active contract with                */
			/*          discounts type = per part per period/per order above      */
			/*          certain value.   ( 'L', 'P' )                             */
			if @sCdirtype IN ( N'O', N'Y', N'L', N'P' ) 
				begin
					/* there are types 'Q' and 'T' to be determined at the time of writing */
					/* Note: non-overlap for contracts having same
					supplier and part is implied by non-overlap
					for contracts having matching supplier alone.
					*/
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5condiscounts c,
						 r5contracts    o
					WHERE  o.con_code        <> @sCdicontract
					AND    c.cdi_contract     = o.con_code
					AND    o.con_rstatus      = N'A'
					AND    c.cdi_rtype        = @sCdirtype
					AND    o.con_org          = @sConorg
					AND    o.con_supplier     = @sConsupplier
					  AND    o.con_supplier_org = @sConsupplierorg
					AND    o.con_end         >= @dCdistartdt
					AND    o.con_start       <= @dCdienddt

					if @nCountit > 0
						begin 
							set @sChk = N'7'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CKLIMI
	@sWhichlimit	nvarchar(4),
	@sUser			nvarchar(255),
	@sCode			nvarchar(30),
	@sOrg			nvarchar(100),
	@nLine			numeric(8),
	@sRtype			nvarchar(4),
	@nPrice			numeric(24,6),
	@nQty			numeric(24,6),
	@nExch			numeric(24,6),
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sRole		nvarchar(30) = '*'
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nLimit						numeric(24,6)
	declare @nValue						numeric(24,6)
	declare @nLinevalue					numeric(24,6)
	declare @nActqty					numeric(24,6)
	declare @sLimitlevel				nvarchar(200)		/*R5INSTALL.INS_DESC%TYPE*/
	declare @sTempOrg                   nvarchar(100)  
	declare @nReturn					integer
	declare @nCount						integer
BEGIN

	set @sTempOrg = @sOrg
	set @sChk     = N'0'

	SELECT @sLimitlevel = coalesce( upper(ins_desc), N'L' )
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'LIMITLEV'
	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        set @sLimitlevel = N'L'

	if @sOrg is null 
		begin
			SELECT @sTempOrg = req_org
			FROM   r5requisitions
			WHERE  req_code = @sCode
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @sChk = N'1'
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5userorganization
	WHERE  uog_user = @sUser
	AND    uog_org  = @sTempOrg
	AND    uog_role = @sRole
	

	if @nCount > 0 
			SELECT @nLimit = CASE @sWhichlimit WHEN N'OLI' THEN uog_pordappvlimit
												WHEN N'OHI' THEN uog_pordappvlimit
												WHEN N'OLA' THEN uog_pordauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'OHA' THEN uog_pordauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'RLI' THEN uog_reqappvlimit
												WHEN N'RHI' THEN uog_reqappvlimit
												WHEN N'RLA' THEN uog_reqauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'RHA' THEN uog_reqauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'PHA' THEN uog_picappvlimit
												END

		FROM   r5userorganization
		WHERE  uog_user = @sUser
		AND    uog_org  = @sTempOrg
		AND    uog_role = @sRole
	else
		set @nLimit = null


	if @nLimit IS NULL 
		RETURN
	
   
	if @sRtype = N'SF' 
		set @nActqty = 1
	else
		set @nActqty = @nQty
   
   
	set @nLinevalue = coalesce( @nActqty, 0 ) * coalesce( @nPrice, 0 ) / coalesce( @nExch, 1 )
   
	IF SUBSTRING( @sWhichlimit, 1, 1 ) = N'O' 
		begin
			IF @sLimitlevel = N'H' 
				begin
					SELECT @nValue = SUM( ( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END) ELSE (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END) * orl_price END /
					coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) / coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) * ( 1 - 0.01 * coalesce( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) ) +
					( ( coalesce( orl_tottaxamount, 0 ) + coalesce( orl_totextra, 0 ) ) / coalesce( orl_exch, 1) ) )
					FROM   r5orderlines
					WHERE  orl_order     = @sCode
					AND    orl_order_org = @sTempOrg
					AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'
					AND    orl_ordline <> coalesce( @nLine, -1 )
					IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
						set @nValue = 0
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @sWhichlimit = N'OHA' 
						begin
							SELECT @nValue= MAX( ( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END) ELSE (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END) * orl_price END /
							coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) / coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) * ( 1 - 0.01 * coalesce( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) ) +
							( ( coalesce( orl_tottaxamount, 0 ) + coalesce( orl_totextra, 0 ) ) / coalesce( orl_exch, 1) ) )
							FROM   r5orderlines
							WHERE  orl_order     = @sCode
							AND    orl_order_org = @sTempOrg
							AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'
							IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
								set @nValue = 0
						end
				end
				
		end



	IF SUBSTRING( @sWhichlimit, 1, 1 ) = N'R' 
		begin
			IF @sLimitlevel = N'H' 
				begin
					SELECT @nValue = SUM( CASE rql_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN rql_price ELSE rql_qty * rql_price END /
						 coalesce( rql_exch, 1 ) )
					FROM   r5requislines
					WHERE  rql_req  = @sCode
					AND    rql_reqline <> coalesce( @nLine, -1 )
					AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'J', N'C' )
					IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
						set @nValue = 0					
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @sWhichlimit = N'RHA' 
						begin
							SELECT @nValue = MAX( CASE rql_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN rql_price ELSE rql_qty * rql_price END /
								   coalesce( rql_exch, 1 ) )
							FROM   r5requislines
							WHERE  rql_req  = @sCode
							AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'J', N'C' )
							IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
								set @nValue = 0					
						end
				end
		end

	if @sWhichlimit = N'PHA' 
		begin
			SELECT @nValue = SUM( pip_qty * coalesce( pip_parprice, 0 ) )
			FROM   r5picklistparts
			WHERE  pip_picklist = @sCode
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @nValue = 0
		end


	if coalesce( @nLinevalue, 0 ) + coalesce( @nValue, 0 ) > @nLimit 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
END

create procedure O7CKLIMI2	@sCwhichlimit	nvarchar(4), 
							@sCuser			nvarchar(255), 
							@sCcode			nvarchar(30), 
							@sCorg			nvarchar(100), 
							@nNline			numeric(8),
							@sCrtype		nvarchar(4), 
							@nNprice		numeric(24,6), 
							@nNqty			numeric(24,6), 
							@nNexch			numeric(24,6), 
							@nReqlimit		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT, 
							@sChk			nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
							@sRole		nvarchar(30) = '*'
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nLimit				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nNvalue            numeric(24,6)
	declare @nNlinevalue        numeric(24,6)
	declare @nNactqty           numeric(24,6)
	declare @sClimitlevel       nvarchar(200)	--5INSTALL.INS_DESC%TYPE
	declare @sOrg               nvarchar(100)  
	declare @nCount				int

/* Initialize */
   set @sOrg		=	@sCorg
   set @sChk		=	N'0'

 /* Get limit level from r5install */
	Select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'LIMITLEV'

	If @nCount = 1 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sClimitlevel = COALESCE( upper(ins_desc), N'L' )
			FROM   r5install
			WHERE  ins_code = N'LIMITLEV'
		END
	ELSE
		SET @sClimitlevel = N'L'
 
/* Get the organization if the organization is null */
	IF @sCorg is null 
		BEGIN
			Select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5requisitions
			WHERE  req_code = @sCcode

			If @nCount = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @sOrg = req_org
					FROM   r5requisitions
					WHERE  req_code = @sCcode
				END
			ELSE
				SET @sChk = N'1'
		END

/* Get limit of current user. */
	Select @nCount = count(*)	
	FROM   r5userorganization
	WHERE  uog_user = @sCuser
	AND    uog_org  = @sOrg
	AND    uog_role = @sRole


	If @nCount = 1  
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nLimit = CASE @sCwhichlimit WHEN N'OLI' THEN uog_pordappvlimit
												WHEN N'OHI' THEN uog_pordappvlimit
												WHEN N'OLA' THEN uog_pordauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'OHA' THEN uog_pordauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'RLI' THEN uog_reqappvlimit
												WHEN N'RHI' THEN uog_reqappvlimit
												WHEN N'RLA' THEN uog_reqauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'RHA' THEN uog_reqauthappvlimit
												WHEN N'PHA' THEN uog_picappvlimit
												END
			FROM   r5userorganization
			WHERE  uog_user = @sCuser
			AND    uog_org  = @sOrg
			AND    uog_role = @sRole
		END
	Else
	    Set @nLimit = null
   
	SET @nReqlimit = @nLimit

	IF @nLimit IS NULL 
		RETURN

	IF @sCrtype = N'SF' 
		SET @nNactqty = 1
	ELSE
		SET @nNactqty = @nNqty

	SET @nNlinevalue = COALESCE( @nNactqty, 0 ) * COALESCE( @nNprice, 0 ) / COALESCE( @nNexch, 1 )



	IF SUBSTRING( @sCwhichlimit, 1, 1 ) = N'O' 
		begin
			IF @sClimitlevel = N'H' 
				begin
     				        SELECT @nNvalue = SUM( ( CASE orl_rtype WHEN  N'SF' THEN (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END) ELSE (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END) * orl_price END  /
					Coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) / Coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) * ( 1 - 0.01 * Coalesce( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) ) +
					( ( Coalesce( orl_tottaxamount, 0 ) + Coalesce( orl_totextra, 0 ) ) / Coalesce( orl_exch, 1) ) )
					FROM   r5orderlines
					WHERE  orl_order     = @sCcode
					AND    orl_order_org = @sOrg
					AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'
					AND    orl_ordline <> Coalesce( @nNline, -1 )
					IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
						set @nNvalue = 0
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @sCwhichlimit = N'OHA' 
						begin
							SELECT @nNvalue = MAX( ( CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END) ELSE (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END) * orl_price END /
							Coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ) / Coalesce( orl_exch, 1 ) * ( 1 - 0.01 * Coalesce( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) ) +
							( ( Coalesce( orl_tottaxamount, 0 ) + Coalesce( orl_totextra, 0 ) ) / Coalesce( orl_exch, 1) ) )
							FROM   r5orderlines
							WHERE  orl_order     = @sCcode
							AND    orl_order_org = @sOrg
							AND    orl_rstatus <> N'J'
							IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
								set @nNvalue = 0
						end
				end
		end


	IF SUBSTRING( @sCwhichlimit, 1, 1 ) = N'R' 
		begin
			IF @sClimitlevel = N'H' 
				begin
					SELECT @nNvalue = SUM( CASE rql_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN rql_price ELSE rql_qty * rql_price END /Coalesce( rql_exch, 1 ) )
					FROM   r5requislines
					WHERE  rql_req  = @sCcode
					AND    rql_reqline <> Coalesce( @nNline, -1 )
					AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'J', N'C' )
					IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
						set @nNvalue = 0				
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @sCwhichlimit = N'RHA' 
					begin
						SELECT @nNvalue = MAX( CASE rql_rtype WHEN N'SF' THEN rql_price ELSE rql_qty * rql_price END / Coalesce( rql_exch, 1 ) )
						FROM   r5requislines
						WHERE  rql_req  = @sCcode
						AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'J', N'C' )
						IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
							set @nNvalue = 0				
					end
				end
		end

  /* Code added for picklist approval limit */
	IF @sCwhichlimit = N'PHA' 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nNvalue = SUM( pip_qty * Coalesce( pip_parprice, 0 ) )
			FROM   r5picklistparts
			WHERE  pip_picklist = @sCcode
		END

/* Value may not exceed maximum. */
	IF COALESCE( @nNlinevalue, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nNvalue, 0 ) > @nLimit 
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		END
