create PROCEDURE O7CKNEST 
   @sPppmnested					nvarchar(20),
   @nEvtfreq					numeric(8),
   @sEvtperioduom				nvarchar(10),
   @sEvtobject					nvarchar(30),
   @sEvtobjectorg				nvarchar(15),
   @sEvtobtype					nvarchar(4),
   @dEvttarget					DATETIME,
   @nPpmmeter					numeric(24,6),
   @sEvtmetuom					nvarchar(30),
   @nEvtmeterdue				int,
   @nPpmmeter2					numeric(24,6),
   @sEvtmetuom2					nvarchar(30),
   @nEvtmeterdue2				numeric(24,6),
   @nPpmnestedtolmin			numeric(5),
   @nPpmnestedtolmax			numeric(5),
   @nPpmnestedtolmetmin			numeric(5),
   @nPpmnestedtolmetmax			numeric(5),
   @nPpmnestedtolmet2min		numeric(5),
   @nPpmnestedtolmet2max		numeric(5),
   @nCountit					int OUTPUT,
   @sChk						nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sResult            nvarchar(4) /* Result of the function called */
	declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
	declare @dTarget		    datetime
	declare @dCompleted		    datetime	
	declare @sWOOrg			    nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg			    nvarchar(15)
	declare @nDuration		    numeric(8)
	declare @sIsstype		    nvarchar(1)
	declare @dTempdate		    datetime
	declare @nMeterdue		    int
	declare @nTotalUsage	    int
	declare @nMeter			    numeric(24,6)
	declare @nMeterdue2		    numeric(24,6)
	declare @nMajormeterdue		    numeric(24,6)
	declare @nMajormeterdue2	    numeric(24,6)	
	declare	@nReturn		    int
	declare @sPmnest		    nvarchar(200)	
	declare @sCancstat		    nvarchar(200)	
	declare @sReturnwhichdue	nvarchar(1)


    declare @sCompletedExists   nvarchar(1)
    declare @sRstatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @dTodate            datetime


	set @sReturnwhichdue    = N'-'

	if @sChk = N'WHICH'
		/* Only when input/output parameter chk is set to 'WHICH', */
		/* keep track of which due data causes a bypass.           */
		begin
			set @sReturnwhichdue = N'+'
			set @sChk = N'---'
		end
	else
		set @sChk = N'0'

	set @sCheckresult       = N'0'
	set @sResult            = NULL
	set @nCountit           = 0
    set @sCompletedExists    = N'-'

	IF @sPppmnested IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	set @sPmnest = dbo.o7dflt2( N'PMNEST' )
	set @sCancstat = dbo.o7dflt2( N'CANCSTAT' )

	IF @nEvtfreq IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			DECLARE cCal CURSOR local FOR SELECT evt_target,
										  evt_org,
										  evt_duration,
										  evt_isstype, 
                                          evt_rstatus,
                                          CASE evt_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN evt_completed ELSE evt_target + evt_duration - 1 END
									FROM	r5events,
											r5ppmobjects,
											r5ppms
									WHERE  evt_ppm        = ppm_code
									AND    evt_ppmrev     = ppm_revision
									AND    evt_rstatus IN ( N'R', CASE UPPER( @sPmnest ) WHEN N'NO' THEN N'R' ELSE N'C' END )
									AND    ppo_ppm        = evt_ppm
									AND    ppo_revision   = evt_ppmrev
									AND    ppo_pk         = evt_ppopk
									AND    ppm_nested     = @sPppmnested
									AND    dbo.o7gtfreq( evt_freq, evt_perioduom, evt_target ) >
										  dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtfreq, @sEvtperioduom, evt_target )
									AND    evt_object     = @sEvtobject
									AND    evt_object_org = @sEvtobjectorg
									AND    evt_obtype     = @sEvtobtype
									AND    evt_status    <> @sCancstat

			OPEN cCal
			FETCH NEXT FROM cCal INTO @dTarget, @sOrg, @nDuration, @sIsstype, @sRstatus, @dTodate
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							CLOSE cCal
							DEALLOCATE cCal
							RETURN -1
						end
					IF @dEvttarget <= @dTempdate AND @dTarget <= @dTempdate AND @sIsstype <> N'D' AND @sRstatus = N'R'
						begin
							set @nCountit = 1
							if @sReturnwhichdue = '-'
								begin
									CLOSE cCal
									DEALLOCATE cCal
									return
								end
							else
								set @sChk = N'+--'
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							IF @dEvttarget BETWEEN  ( @dTarget - ( ( dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtfreq, @sEvtperioduom, @dTarget ) * coalesce (@nPpmnestedtolmin, 0 ) ) / 100 ) ) 
										   AND		( @dTodate + ( ( dbo.o7gtfreq( @nEvtfreq, @sEvtperioduom, @dTarget ) * coalesce( @nPpmnestedtolmax, 0 ) ) / 100 ) ) 
								begin
									if @sReturnwhichdue = N'+' 
										/* Set date due -/+ checkbox ( first ) to '+'. */
										set @sChk = '+--'
									if @sRstatus = N'R'
										begin
											set @nCountit = 1
											if @sReturnwhichdue = '-'
												begin
													CLOSE cCal
													DEALLOCATE cCal
													return
												end
										end
									else
										set @sCompletedExists = N'+'
							        end
						end				
					FETCH NEXT FROM cCal INTO @dTarget, @sOrg, @nDuration, @sIsstype, @sRstatus, @dTodate
				END
			CLOSE cCal
			DEALLOCATE cCal
		end

	IF @sEvtmetuom IS NOT NULL AND @nCountit = 0 
		begin
			DECLARE cMet1 CURSOR local FOR    SELECT evt_meterdue,
													  oud_totalusage,
													  ppm_meter, 
                                                      							  evt_rstatus,
                                                      							  evt_org,
                                                      							  evt_completed
												FROM   r5events,
													  r5objusagedefs,
													  r5ppmobjects,
													  r5ppms
												WHERE  evt_ppm        = ppm_code
												AND    evt_ppmrev     = ppm_revision
												AND    evt_rstatus IN ( N'R', CASE UPPER( @sPmnest ) WHEN N'NO' THEN N'R' ELSE N'C' END )
												AND    ppo_ppm        = evt_ppm
												AND    ppo_revision   = evt_ppmrev
												AND    ppo_pk         = evt_ppopk
												AND    ppm_nested     = @sPppmnested
												AND    ppm_meter      > @nPpmmeter
												AND    oud_object     = evt_object
												AND    oud_object_org = evt_object_org
												AND    oud_uom        = evt_metuom
												AND    evt_object     = @sEvtobject
												AND    evt_object_org = @sEvtobjectorg
												AND    evt_obtype     = @sEvtobtype
												AND    evt_metuom     = @sEvtmetuom
												AND    evt_status    <> @sCancstat


			OPEN cMet1
			FETCH NEXT FROM cMet1 INTO @nMeterdue, @nTotalUsage, @nMeter, @sRstatus, @sWOOrg, @dCompleted  
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					IF @nEvtmeterdue <= @nTotalUsage and @sRstatus = N'R'
						begin
							set @nCountit = 1
							if @sReturnwhichdue = '-'
								begin
									CLOSE cMet1
									DEALLOCATE cMet1
									return
								end
							else
								set @sChk = substring( @sChk, 1, 1 ) + N'+-'
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							IF @sRstatus = N'C'
								SET @nMajormeterdue = isnull( @nTotalUsage, 0 ) - 
									isnull( dbo.o7gtread( @sEvtobject, @sEvtobjectorg, @sEvtmetuom, @sWOOrg, @dCompleted ), 0 )
							ELSE
								SET @nMajormeterdue = @nMeterdue

							IF @nEvtmeterdue BETWEEN @nMajormeterdue - ( @nPpmmeter * coalesce( @nPpmnestedtolmetmin, 0 ) / 100 ) AND
								@nMajormeterdue + ( @nPpmmeter * coalesce( @nPpmnestedtolmetmax, 0 ) / 100 ) 
								begin
									if @sReturnwhichdue = N'+' 
										/* Set date due -/+ checkbox ( second ) to '+'. */
										set @sChk = substring( @sChk, 1, 1 ) + N'+-'

									if @sRstatus = N'R'
										begin
											set @nCountit = 1
											if @sReturnwhichdue = '-'
												begin
													CLOSE cMet1
													DEALLOCATE cMet1
													return
												end
										end
									else
										set @sCompletedExists = N'+'
							        end
						end

					FETCH NEXT FROM cMet1 INTO @nMeterdue, @nTotalUsage, @nMeter, @sRstatus, @sWOOrg, @dCompleted
				END
			CLOSE cMet1
			DEALLOCATE cMet1
		end


	IF @sEvtmetuom2 IS NOT NULL AND @nCountit = 0 
		begin
			DECLARE cMet2 CURSOR local FOR  SELECT evt_meterdue2,
												  oud_totalusa

create procedure O7CKOCOM @sOrg nvarchar(15), @sCHK nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sMultiorg           nvarchar(200)	--R5INSTALL.INS_DESC%TYPE
	declare @sCommon             nvarchar(1)		--R5ORGANIZATION.ORG_COMMON%TYPE
	declare @nCount				int

	/* Initialize */
	SET @sCHK          = N'0'


	/* Get multi org parameter from r5install */

	Select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'MULTIORG'


	If @nCount = 1 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sMultiorg = COALESCE( ins_desc, N'NO' )
			FROM   r5install
			WHERE  ins_code = N'MULTIORG'
		END
	ELSE
		Set @sMultiorg = N'NO'


	IF UPPER( @sMultiorg ) IN ( N'YES', N'Y', N'ON', N'+' ) 
		BEGIN
			Select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5organization
			WHERE  org_code = @sOrg


			If @nCount = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @sCommon = org_common
					FROM   r5organization
					WHERE  org_code = @sOrg
				END
			ELSE
				SET @sCommon = N'-'
		END

	IF @sCommon = N'+' 
		BEGIN
			/* If multiorg = 'ON' and common, then message! */
			SET @sCHK = N'1'
			RETURN
		END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CKPRAS 
	@nRet	int	 OUTPUT,
    @sCdockid  nvarchar(30)      
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sVDefaultOrg    	nvarchar(200)          
    declare @sCheckResult    	nvarchar(3)       		
    declare @nObjcount       	int         		    
    declare @sVAuto          	nvarchar(200)  
	declare @nReturn			int  		
	declare @sDkl_dckcode 		nvarchar(30),
            @nDkl_line			numeric(8,0),
            @sDkl_part			nvarchar(30),
            @sDkl_part_org		nvarchar(15),
            @sDkl_byasset		nvarchar(1),
            @sDkl_object		nvarchar(30),
            @sDkl_obtype		nvarchar(4),
            @sDkl_object_org	nvarchar(15),
            @sDck_org			nvarchar(15),
            @nDkl_sqlidentity	int


	set @nObjcount = 0
    -- get default organization code
    execute O7DFLT @sVDefaultOrg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG',@sCheckResult
    if @@error <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
  
    -- check to see if need to auto generate asset number
    execute O7DFLT @sVAuto OUTPUT, N'AUTOANUM', @sCheckResult
	if @@error <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    IF @sCheckResult <> 0
        set @sVAuto = N'NO'

	declare cCursor_dockline cursor local for
    	SELECT  d.dkl_dckcode,
              	d.dkl_line,
              	d.dkl_part,
              	d.dkl_part_org,
              	p.par_byasset dkl_byasset,
              	d.dkl_object,
              	d.dkl_obtype,
              	d.dkl_object_org,
              	r.dck_org,
              	d.dkl_sqlidentity
              	FROM   r5docklines d, r5parts p, r5dockreceipts r
              	WHERE  d.dkl_dckcode     = @sCdockid 
              	AND    (d.dkl_linerstatus = N'U' OR d.dkl_linerstatus = N'R' )
              	AND    r.dck_code        = d.dkl_dckcode
              	AND    d.dkl_part        = p.par_code
     	      	AND    d.dkl_part_org    = p.par_org
	OPEN cCursor_dockline
	fetch next from cCursor_dockline into @sDkl_dckcode 		,
								            @nDkl_line			,
								            @sDkl_part			,
								            @sDkl_part_org		,
								            @sDkl_byasset		,
								            @sDkl_object		,
								            @sDkl_obtype		,
								            @sDkl_object_org	,
								            @sDck_org			,
								            @nDkl_sqlidentity	
	while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin         
			-- auto generate object if needed
			IF @sDkl_byasset = N'+'
				begin
					IF @sDkl_object IS NULL
						begin
							IF UPPER( @sVAuto ) = N'YES' 
								begin
									set @nRet = 1
									close cCursor_dockline
									deallocate cCursor_dockline
									return
								end
						end
					ELSE
						begin 
							IF @sDkl_object_org IS NULL
								begin 
									IF  dbo.O7GETMOS( N'OBJ' ) != N'+'
	             						set @sDkl_object_org =  @sVDefaultOrg 
								end
                
							SELECT @nObjcount = count(1)
							FROM   r5objects
							WHERE  obj_code  = @sDkl_object 
							AND    obj_org   = @sDkl_object_org       
				 
	     					IF @nObjcount = 0
								begin
									set @nRet = 1
									close cCursor_dockline
									deallocate cCursor_dockline
									return
								end
						end
				end 

			fetch next from cCursor_dockline into @sDkl_dckcode 		,
												@nDkl_line			,
												@sDkl_part			,
												@sDkl_part_org		,
												@sDkl_byasset		,
												@sDkl_object		,
												@sDkl_obtype		,
												@sDkl_object_org	,
												@sDck_org			,
												@nDkl_sqlidentity		
		end
	close cCursor_dockline
	deallocate cCursor_dockline
    set @nRet = 0

create PROCEDURE O7CKPRJ1
   @sProject       nvarchar(20),
   @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	declare @sRstatus       nvarchar(4) 

	if @sProject is not null
		begin
			SELECT @sRstatus= prj_rstatus
			FROM   r5projects
			WHERE  prj_code = @sProject
			AND    prj_org  = coalesce(@sOrg,prj_org)

			if @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
				begin
					if @sRstatus = N'A' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CKPRJ1', N'PROC', 2
							return -1
						end
					if @sRstatus = N'B' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CKPRJ1', N'PROC', 1
							return -1
						end
					if @sRstatus = N'C' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CKPRJ1', N'PROC', 4
							return -1
						end
					if @sRstatus <> N'O' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CKPRJ1', N'PROC', 5
							return -1
						end
		
				end
			else
		  		begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CKPRJ1', N'PROC', 1
					return -1
				end
		end
end

create PROCEDURE O7CKRAT1
	@nOldRate			integer,
	@nNewRate			integer		OUTPUT,
	@nSysrate			integer,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	declare @sX         nvarchar(1)
	set @sX = null
	set @sChk         = N'0'
 
 	if @nOldRate IS NULL    
	begin
		set @sChk = N'1'
		RETURN
	end

	if @nNewRate IS NULL OR @nNewRate <  0 OR @nOldRate <  0  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	if @nOldRate = @nNewRate 
		--  smth changed i.e. by user. Reason: trigger on, say, trade which
		--  updates rate does not fire when-validate trigger on rate so
		--  the rate is not the system value pertaining to the new trade.
		RETURN
 
	if @nOldRate = 0 
		-- user updates null system value (perhaps after an intermediate
		-- change to a user value > 0 and a subsequent reset to 0)
		RETURN

	if @nSysrate <> 0 
		begin
			set @nNewRate = @nOldRate 
			set @sChk = N'29' 
		end
end

create procedure O7CKROT1
	@sSuggest		nvarchar(4),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit          int
	declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX                nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn	int
begin
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @nCountit     = 0
	set @sX           = NULL

	set @sChk			= N'0'
	set @nCountit			= 0

		IF @sSuggest     IS NULL  
			begin
				set @sChk = N'1'
				RETURN
			end

		execute @nReturn = o7existw N'RECO', N'*', N'*', N'4', @sSuggest, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1


		IF @nCountit = 0

create procedure O7CKRQL1 	@sCreq				nvarchar(30),
	@nRecvqty			INT,
	@nRecvvalue			INT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit        INT
	declare @sCheckresult    nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX              nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int


	/* Initialise */
	SET @sChk         = N'0' 
	SET @nCountit     =  0  
	SET @sCheckresult = NULL
	SET @sX           = NULL

	/* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied */
	IF @sCreq       IS NULL OR @nRecvqty   IS NULL OR @nRecvvalue IS NULL 
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		END
	/* S11412 : Check if recvqty is 0 */
	IF @nRecvqty <> 0 
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk = N'3'      /* Received Quantity <> 0 */
			RETURN
		END
	
	/* S11413 : Check if recvvalue is 0 */
	IF @nRecvvalue <> 0 
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk = N'4'      /* Received Quantity <> 0 */
			RETURN
		END
	/* S11421 : Check if rstatus of r5requisitions = N'U' */

	execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'REQ', N'*', @sCreq, N'REQ', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @nCountit > 0 
			SET @sX = null
	IF @nCountit = 0 
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk = N'5'           /* rstatus of r5requisitions <> N'U' */
			RETURN
		END
	IF @nCountit < 0                      /* @nCountit = -1   */
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk = @sCheckresult   /* @sChk = 2 or 999 */
			RETURN
		END
	RETURN

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CKSCHD
  @sPerson      nvarchar(15),
  @sObject      nvarchar(30),
  @sObjectorg   nvarchar(15),
  @dSched       datetime,
  @nStart       numeric(24,6),
  @nEnd         numeric(24,6),
  @sRowid       nvarchar(64),
  @sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@nCount		integer
	declare	@nSeqeunce	integer

	set @sChk = null
	IF ( @sPerson IS NULL AND @sObject IS NULL )
	OR   @dSched  IS NULL
	OR   @nStart  IS NULL
	OR   @nEnd    IS NULL 
		RETURN
	
	set @nSeqeunce = cast(@sRowid as integer) 
	IF @sPerson IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if exists (select 1 FROM   r5actschedules s
								WHERE  s.acs_sched       = @dSched
								AND    s.acs_responsible = @sPerson
								AND    ( @nStart >= s.acs_starttime AND @nStart < s.acs_endtime OR
										 s.acs_starttime >=  @nStart AND s.acs_starttime < @nEnd )
								AND    acs_SQLIDENTITY <> coalesce( @nSeqeunce, -1 ) )
				set @sChk = N'3'
		end

	IF @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if exists ( 	SELECT 1
							FROM   r5actschedules s
							WHERE  s.acs_sched      = @dSched
							AND    s.acs_object     = @sObject
							AND    s.acs_object_org = @sObjectorg
							AND    ( @nStart >= s.acs_starttime AND @nStart < s.acs_endtime OR
									 s.acs_starttime >=  @nStart AND s.acs_starttime < @nEnd )
							AND    acs_SQLIDENTITY <> coalesce( @nSeqeunce, -1 ))
				set @sChk = @sChk + N'4'
		end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7CKSTTL
               (@sPart                      NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@sPartOrg                   NVARCHAR(15)
               ,@sPartClass                 NVARCHAR(8)
               ,@sStore                     NVARCHAR(15)
               ,@sFacility                  NVARCHAR(4000)
               ,@sClass                     NVARCHAR(8)
               ,@sFromBinLoc                NVARCHAR(4000)
               ,@sToBinLoc                  NVARCHAR(4000)
               ,@sUser                      NVARCHAR(255)
               ,@sOrderBy                   NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@dStockTakeDate             DATETIME
               ,@sABCClass                  NCHAR(1)
               ,@sChildstore                nvarchar(1)
               ,@sIncludeconsignmentitem    nvarchar(1)
               ,@sIncludeoutofserviceitem   nvarchar(1)
               ,@sRole                      nvarchar(30) = '*' )
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @nCount   INT
       ,@sFromBin NVARCHAR(4000)
       ,@sToBin   NVARCHAR(4000)
		, @nError int
		
SET @nCount = 0

SELECT @sFromBin = CASE @sFromBinLoc WHEN N'%' THEN N'!' ELSE @sFromBinLoc END
      ,@sToBin = CASE @sToBinLoc WHEN N'%' THEN N'ZZZZZZZZZZ' ELSE @sToBinLoc END

IF CHARINDEX('#', @sPart) = 0
	begin
   IF EXISTS (SELECT top 101 '1'
     FROM r5binstock BIS
         ,r5stock
         ,r5parts
		,r5userorganization
		,r5stores
    WHERE bis_part = par_code
      AND bis_part_org = par_org
      AND sto_part = bis_part
      AND sto_part_org = bis_part_org
      AND ISNULL(par_class, N'%') LIKE @sPartClass
      AND sto_store = bis_store
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                        FROM r5stocktakelines
                       WHERE stl_store = BIS.bis_store
                         AND stl_part = BIS.bis_part
                         AND stl_part_org = BIS.bis_part_org
                         AND stl_bin = BIS.bis_bin
                         AND stl_lot = BIS.bis_lot)
	  AND (( @sChildstore = N'-' AND sto_store LIKE @sStore ) OR 
		   ( @sChildstore = N'+' AND sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code FROM dbo.O7CKSTTL_GET_HIERARCHY_R5STORES ( @sStore) )))
      AND ((@sIncludeconsignmentitem = N'-'  AND sto_consignment ='-') OR
           (@sIncludeconsignmentitem = N'+'  AND (sto_consignment = '-' OR sto_consignment='+')))
      AND ((@sIncludeoutofserviceitem = N'-' and par_notused ='-')  OR
           (@sIncludeoutofserviceitem = N'+' AND (par_notused = '-' OR par_notused = '+')))
      AND sto_part LIKE @sPart
      AND sto_store  = str_code AND str_org  = uog_org AND uog_org LIKE @sPartOrg AND uog_user = @sUser AND uog_role = @sRole
      AND ISNULL(sto_class, N'%') LIKE @sClass
      AND ISNULL(bis_bin, N'%') BETWEEN @sFromBin AND @sToBin
      AND ISNULL(sto_stocktake, CONVERT(DATETIME, N'01-01-1900', 105)) <= @dStockTakeDate
      AND ISNULL(sto_abcclass, N'%' ) LIKE @sABCClass)
		begin
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			set @nCount = 1
		end
	end
ELSE
	begin
	IF EXISTS (SELECT top 101 '1'
     FROM r5binstock BIS
         ,r5stock
         ,r5parts
		, r5userorganization
		,r5stores
    WHERE bis_part = par_code
      AND bis_part_org = par_org
      AND sto_part = bis_part
      AND sto_part_org = bis_part_org
      AND ISNULL(par_class, N'%') LIKE @sPartClass
      AND sto_store = bis_store
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                        FROM r5stocktakelines
                       WHERE stl_store = BIS.bis_store
                         AND stl_part = BIS.bis_part
                         AND stl_part_org = BIS.bis_part_org
                         AND stl_bin = BIS.bis_bin
                         AND stl_lot = BIS.bis_lot)
	  AND (( @sChildstore = N'-' AND sto_store LIKE @sStore ) OR 
		   ( @sChildstore = N'+' AND sto_store IN ( SELECT str_code FROM dbo.O7CKSTTL_GET_HIERARCHY_R5STORES ( @sStore) )))
      AND ((@sIncludeconsignmentitem = N'-'  AND sto_consignment ='-') OR
           (@sIncludeconsignmentitem = N'+'  AND (sto_consignment = '-' OR sto_consignment='+')))
      AND ((@sIncludeoutofserviceitem = N'-' and par_notused ='-')  OR
           (@sIncludeoutofserviceitem = N'+' AND (par_notused = '-' OR par_notused = '+')))
      AND CHARINDEX('#' + sto_part + N'#', N'#' + @sPart + N'#') > 0
      AND sto_store = str_code AND str_org  = uog_org AND uog_org LIKE @sPartOrg AND uog_user = @sUser AND uog_role = @sRole
      AND ISNULL(sto_class, N'%') LIKE @sClass
      AND ISNULL(bis_bin, N'%') BETWEEN @sFromBin AND @sToBin
      AND ISNULL(sto_stocktake, CONVERT(DATETIME, N'01-01-1900', 105)) <= @dStockTakeDate
      AND ISNULL(sto_abcclass, N'%' ) LIKE @sABCClass) 
		begin
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			set @nCount = 1
		end
	end

IF @nError != 0 OR @nCount  = 0
   RETURN 2
RETURN 1
END

create function O7CKSTTL_GET_HIERARCHY_R5STORES (	@sCode	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( str_code nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCstore		nvarchar(15)
	declare @tStack table ( Code nvarchar(15), Parent nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	

    INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, str_parent, 1 from r5stores where str_code = @sCode
	
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCstore = Code, @sParent = Parent from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values (@sCstore )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND Code = @sCstore 
					insert into @tStack	select str_code, str_parent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5stores
										 where str_parent = @sCstore
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CLEANUPMOBILEFILTERDATA
AS
BEGIN

  SET @commitrows  = 200000

  WHILE @rowsdeleted = @commitrows
    BEGIN
      BEGIN TRANSACTION
      DELETE TOP ( @commitrows ) r5mobilefilteredobjects
      WHERE  mfo_created <= @deleteuntil
      SET @rowsdeleted = @@ROWCOUNT
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
    END
END

		@sCheck             nvarchar(6) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nCount				integer
	declare @nCount2			integer
	declare @sState				nvarchar(8)		--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_STATE%TYPE

    declare @sRstate            nvarchar(4) 	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_RSTATE%TYPE
    declare @sDefstate          nvarchar(4) 	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_STATE%TYPE
    declare @sDefrstate         nvarchar(4) 	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_RSTATE%TYPE := 'CNPE'
    declare @sNewstate          nvarchar(4) 	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_STATE%TYPE
    declare @sNewrstate         nvarchar(4) 	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_RSTATE%TYPE

	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
    declare @sNewcn             nvarchar(24) 	--r5changenotice.cnh_code%TYPE
	declare @sObjcode			nvarchar(30)	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_CODE%TYPE
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)	--r5changenotice.cnh_org%TYPE
    declare @sObjcn             nvarchar(24)	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_CN%TYPE
    declare @sObjrstate         nvarchar(4) 	--R5OBJECTS.OBJ_RSTATE%TYPE
	declare @sCnrstatus			nvarchar(4)		--r5changenotice.cnh_rstatus%TYPE
	declare @sMfgmatchflag		nvarchar(24)	--r5changenotice.cnh_mfgmatchflag%TYPE
	declare @sManufact			nvarchar(24)		--r5changenotice.cnh_manufact%TYPE
	declare @sOldpart			nvarchar(30)	--r5changenoticelines.cnl_oldpart%TYPE
	declare @sOldpartorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5changenoticelines.cnl_oldpart_org%TYPE
	declare @sFromobjectcode	nvarchar(30)	--r5changenoticelines.cnl_fromobjectcode%TYPE
	declare @sToobjectcode		nvarchar(30)	--r5changenoticelines.cnl_toobjectcode%TYPE
	declare @sFromserialno		nvarchar(30)	--r5changenoticelines.cnl_fromserialno%TYPE
	declare @sToserialno		nvarchar(30)	--r5changenoticelines.cnl_toserialno%TYPE
	declare @sSelectclause		nvarchar(1000)
	declare @sAndobject			nvarchar(100)
	declare @sAndpart			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sAndmanufact		nvarchar(100)
	declare @sAndobj			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sAndserial			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sAndlocation		nvarchar(500)
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @sCnl				nvarchar(24)
	declare @sSQL				nvarchar(4000)
    declare @dStartdate         datetime
    declare @dCnhstartdate      datetime
    declare @sFromobjectcode_org    nvarchar(15)

    declare @sObjOrg            nvarchar(15)

	set @sCheck   = N'0'
	set @nCount   = 0
	set @nRecords = 0

	SELECT @sOrg = cnh_org ,@sManufact = cnh_manufact, @sCnrstatus = cnh_rstatus, @sMfgmatchflag = cnh_mfgmatchflag, @dCnhstartdate = cnh_startdate
	FROM r5changenotice
	WHERE cnh_code = @sCnhcode

    set @sDefrstate = N'CNPE'
	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
	   begin
			
			set @sSelectclause =	N' insert into #tObjects  SELECT obj_code, obj_org, obj_cn, obj_rstate  ' + 
									N' FROM   r5objects (UPDLOCK)' + 
									N' WHERE  obj_obrtype             = N''A'' ' + 
									N' AND    coalesce( obj_cn, ''-1'' )  <> N''' +  @sCnhcode + N''' '  + 
									N' AND    obj_rstatus            <> N''D'' ' + 
                                    N' AND    obj_rstate             <> N''DEF'' '+
                                    N' AND    obj_org           IN (  SELECT  u.uog_org '  +
                                                                   N' FROM   r5userorganization u ' +
                                                                   N' WHERE  u.uog_user   = '''+ @sCuser + '''  ) ' +
                                    N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT ''x'' FROM r5organization o1, r5organization o2 ' +
                                                    N' WHERE o1.org_code = obj_org ' +
                                                    N' AND   o2.org_code = ''' + @sOrg + '''' +
                                                    N' AND   o1.org_common = N''-'' ' +
                                                    N' AND   o2.org_common = N''-'' ' +
                                                    N' AND   o1.org_code <> o2.org_code )'

			SELECT @nCount2 = count(*)
			FROM   r5cnlocations
			WHERE  cnc_cn = @sCnhcode

			IF @sCnrstatus IN ( N'U', N'X', N'C' ) AND @sObject IS NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @nRecords = count(*)
					FROM   r5objects
					WHERE  obj_cn     = @sCnhcode
					AND    obj_rstate = N'CNPE'
                    AND    obj_rstate <> 'DEF'

					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sState OUTPUT, N'GOOD', N'OBSA', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

                    IF @sCnrstatus = N'X' 
                        /* CN got cancelled, delete all history records. */
                        DELETE FROM r5cnhist
                        WHERE  cni_cn = @sCnhcode
                    ELSE
                        begin
                            IF @sCnrstatus = N'U' 
                            /* CN got completed, delete all not completed history records,
                            that do not belong to an asset ( on OMOBJC ). */
                            DELETE FROM r5cnhist
                            WHERE  cni_cn = @sCnhcode
                            AND    cni_dispdate IS NULL
                            AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                                                FROM   r5objects
                                                WHERE  obj_code = cni_object
                                                AND    obj_org  = cni_object_org
                                                AND    obj_cn   = @sCnhcode )
                        end

		            declare c_obj cursor local for SELECT obj_code, obj_org, obj_rstate 
                                                            FROM   r5objects
                                                            WHERE  obj_cn = @sCnhcode
		            open c_obj
		            fetch next from c_obj into @sObjcode, @sObjOrg, @sObjrstate
		            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			            begin
                            /* Reset the CNHIST records and the assets. */
                            IF @sObjrstate = N'CNPE' AND @sCnrstatus = N'U' 
                                DELETE FROM r5cnhist
                                WHERE  cni_cn = @sCnhcode
                                AND    cni_object     = @sObjcode
                                AND    cni_object_org = @sObjOrg
                                AND    cni_dispdate IS NULL

                            UPDATE r5objects
                            SET    obj_cn   = null
                            WHERE  obj_code = @sObjcode
                            AND    obj_org  = @sObjOrg

                            UPDATE r5objects
                            SET     obj_state  = @sState,
                                    obj_rstate = N'GOOD'
                            WHERE  obj_code   = @sObjcode
                            AND    obj_org    = @sObjOrg

                            /* Check whether there is another CN active for this asset. */
                            set @sNewcn = null

                            SELECT @sNewcn = cni_cn, @sNewstate = cni_state
                            FROM   r5changenotice, r5ucodes, r5cnhist
                            WHERE  cni_cn = cnh_code
                            AND    uco_code = cni_state
                            AND    uco_rentity = N'OBSA'
                            AND    cnh_rstatus = N'A'
                            AND    cni_cn <> @sCnhcode
                            AND    cni_object = @sObjcode
                            AND    cni_object_org = @sObjOrg
                            AND  ( cni_dispdate IS NULL OR uco_rcode = N'CNC' )
                            ORDER BY cnh_startdate

                            IF @sNewcn IS NOT NULL 
                                begin
                                    /* There is another CN open, so set object to that CN. */
						            execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sNewrstate OUTPUT, @sNewst

create function O7CNPROC_GET_HIERARCHY (	@sOrg	nvarchar(15),
											@sCnhcode	nvarchar(24) )
returns @tReturn table( childtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						childrtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							stc_childtype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_childrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				stc_childtype,
				stc_childrtype,
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parentrtype = 'L'
		 and stc_parent + N'#' + stc_parent_org in ( select cnc_object + N'#' + cnc_object_org from r5cnlocations where cnc_cn = @sCnhcode )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org,
							@sCurrentType	= stc_childtype,
							@sCurrentRtype	= stc_childrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentType, @sCurrentRtype, @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												stc_childtype,
												stc_childrtype,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										where	stc_parentrtype = 'L'
										 and	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CONTRACTITEMS
  @cc           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @ccrev        NUMERIC,
  @ccorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @contractitem NVARCHAR( 30 )
AS 
BEGIN

  DECLARE @return          INTEGER
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @pk              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newpk           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @citcode         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cittax          NVARCHAR( 20 )
    
  /* All parameters required. */
  IF @cc IS NULL OR @ccrev IS NULL OR @ccorg IS NULL OR @contractitem IS NULL
    RETURN
   
  /* Delete old data first. */
  DELETE FROM r5contractchargedefs
  WHERE  ccd_contract         = @cc
  AND    ccd_contractrevision = @ccrev
  AND    ccd_contract_org     = @ccorg
  AND    ccd_contractitem LIKE @contractitem
  AND    ccd_sourcecode IN ( N'GI', N'I', N'IT' )

  /* Create Usage Charge Defs ( without template ). */
  EXECUTE @return = o7copyusagechargedefs @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, @contractitem, NULL, NULL, N'CLEARCONTRACTITEM'
  
  /* Create Energy Charge Defs ( without template ). */
  EXECUTE @return = o7copyenergychargedefs @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, @contractitem, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'CLEARCONTRACTITEM'
     
  /* Copy non Usage/Energy Charge Defs. */
  DECLARE c_pk CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT tcd_pk, cit_code, cit_tax
    FROM   r5templatechargedefs, r5contractitems 
    WHERE  tcd_contracttemplate     = cit_contracttemplate
    AND    tcd_contracttemplate_org = cit_contracttemplate_org
    AND    tcd_org                  = cit_invoicingorg
    AND    cit_contract             = @cc
    AND    cit_contractrevision     = @ccrev
    AND    cit_contract_org         = @ccorg    
    AND    cit_code LIKE @contractitem
    AND    NOT ( tcd_category = N'USCH' AND tcd_level = N'TR' AND tcd_subcategory = N'UCU1' )
    AND    NOT ( tcd_category = N'ENER' AND tcd_level = N'TR' )
    AND    ( ( cit_object IS NULL AND tcd_category IN ( N'SATR', N'WOCH', N'OTCH' ) ) OR
               cit_object IS NOT NULL )
  OPEN c_pk
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_pk INTO @pk, @citcode, @cittax
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'CHARGEDEFS', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
      INSERT INTO r5contractchargedefs( ccd_pk, ccd_contract, ccd_contractrevision, ccd_contract_org,
             ccd_contractitem, ccd_sourcecode, ccd_invoicingorg, ccd_invoicingdescription, ccd_invoice, ccd_invoiceconditional,
             ccd_category, ccd_level, ccd_subcategory, ccd_rate, ccd_adjpercbefore, ccd_adjunitprice, ccd_adjtransaction,
             ccd_adjpercafter, ccd_minqty, ccd_mincharge, ccd_maxcharge, ccd_freeupto, ccd_taxable, ccd_tax, ccd_usageuom,
             ccd_chargeestusage, ccd_rollover, ccd_startmetervalue, ccd_estdailyusage, ccd_trade, ccd_octype, ccd_ocrtype,
             ccd_partclass, ccd_partclass_org, ccd_submetered, ccd_usefloorarea, ccd_invoicingpercentage, ccd_utilitybillsource,
             ccd_utilitybillsource_org,
             ccd_udfchar01, ccd_udfchar02, ccd_udfchar03, ccd_udfchar04, ccd_udfchar05,
             ccd_udfchar06, ccd_udfchar07, ccd_udfchar08, ccd_udfchar09, ccd_udfchar10,
             ccd_udfchar11, ccd_udfchar12, ccd_udfchar13, ccd_udfchar14, ccd_udfchar15,
             ccd_udfcHar16, ccd_udfchar17, ccd_udfchar18, ccd_udfchar19, ccd_udfchar20,
             ccd_udfchar21, ccd_udfchar22, ccd_udfchar23, ccd_udfchar24, ccd_udfchar25,
             ccd_udfchar26, ccd_udfchar27, ccd_udfchar28, ccd_udfchar29, ccd_udfchar30,
             ccd_udfnum01, ccd_udfnum02, ccd_udfnum03, ccd_udfnum04, ccd_udfnum05,
             ccd_udfdate01, ccd_udfdate02, ccd_udfdate03, ccd_udfdate04, ccd_udfdate05,
             ccd_udfchkbox01, ccd_udfchkbox02, ccd_udfchkbox03, ccd_udfchkbox04, ccd_udfchkbox05 )
      SELECT @newpk, @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, 
             @citcode, N'IT', tcd_org, tcd_invoicingdescription, tcd_invoice, tcd_invoiceconditional,
             tcd_category, tcd_level, tcd_subcategory, tcd_rate, tcd_adjpercbefore, tcd_adjunitprice, tcd_adjtransaction,
             tcd_adjpercafter, tcd_minqty, tcd_mincharge, tcd_maxcharge, tcd_freeupto, tcd_taxable,
             CASE tcd_taxable WHEN '+' THEN @cittax ELSE NULL END, tcd_usageuom,
             tcd_chargeestusage, tcd_rollover, NULL, NULL, tcd_trade, tcd_octype, tcd_ocrtype,
             tcd_partclass, tcd_partclass_org, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
             tcd_udfchar01, tcd_udfchar02, tcd_udfchar03, tcd_udfchar04, tcd_udfchar05,
             tcd_udfchar06, tcd_udfchar07, tcd_udfchar08, tcd_udfchar09, tcd_udfchar10,
             tcd_udfchar11, tcd_udfchar12, tcd_udfchar13, tcd_udfchar14, tcd_udfchar15,
             tcd_udfcHar16, tcd_udfchar17, tcd_udfchar18, tcd_udfchar19, tcd_udfchar20,
             tcd_udfchar21, tcd_udfchar22, tcd_udfchar23, tcd_udfchar24, tcd_udfchar25,
             tcd_udfchar26, tcd_udfchar27, tcd_udfchar28, tcd_udfchar29, tcd_udfchar30,
             tcd_udfnum01, tcd_udfnum02, tcd_udfnum03, tcd_udfnum04, tcd_udfnum05,
             tcd_udfdate01, tcd_udfdate02, tcd_udfdate03, tcd_udfdate04, tcd_udfdate05,
             tcd_udfchkbox01, tcd_udfchkbox02, tcd_udfchkbox03, tcd_udfchkbox04, tcd_udfchkbox05
      FROM   r5templatechargedefs
      WHERE  tcd_pk = @pk      
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_pk INTO @pk, @citcode, @cittax
    END   
  CLOSE c_pk
  DEALLOCATE c_pk  

  /* Create Usage Charge Defs ( with template ). */
  EXECUTE @return = o7copyusagechargedefs @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, @contractitem, NULL, NULL, N'ADDCONTRACTITEM'
  
  /* Create Energy Charge Defs ( with template ). */
  EXECUTE @return = o7copyenergychargedefs @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, @contractitem, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'ADDCONTRACTITEM'
    
END

create procedure O7CONVWRAPPER @nUploadid           numeric(38),
                               @sOperation          nvarchar(4),
                               @sChklengthviolation nvarchar(128),
                               @sChkspecialchar     nvarchar(128),
                               @sChkduprecords      nvarchar(128),
                               @sUserid             nvarchar(255)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

    declare @sChkresult nvarchar(4)
    declare @nReturn    int


    UPDATE r5jobparamvalue SET jpv_value = null
     WHERE jpv_code = '25'
       AND jpv_line > 0

    execute o7sess_init_sess @sUserid, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL

    if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        commit transaction

    if @sOperation = N'C'
        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7cvmain_convertdata @nUploadid, @sChkresult OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
        end

    if @sOperation = N'P'
        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7cvmain_analyzedata @nUploadid, @sUserid, @sChklengthviolation, @sChkspecialchar, @sChkduprecords, @sChkresult OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
        end

    if @sChkresult <> N'0'
        begin
            execute o7rae N'O7CVMAIN', N'PROC', @sChkresult, @@ERROR
            return -1
        end

create procedure O7COPDAT 
   @sCcode        nvarchar(100),
   @sCnewcode     nvarchar(50),
   @sCrentity     nvarchar(4),
   @sCnewrentity  nvarchar(4),
   @sChk          nvarchar(5)	OUTPUT
as

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCnewentity   nvarchar(4)		/*r5entities.ent_entity%TYPE;*/
    declare @sCheckresult  nvarchar(4)		/*VARCHAR2( 4 );*/
    declare @sV_NewDocCode nvarchar(30)		/*r5documents.doc_code%TYPE;*/
    declare @sV_FileName   nvarchar(150)	/*r5documents.doc_filename%TYPE;*/
    declare @sV_Chk        nvarchar(5)		/*VARCHAR2(5);*/
	declare @nReturn	   int
	/*  cC_DynamicDocs cursor variable declaration */
	declare 	@sDoc_filename	nvarchar(150)
    declare     @sDoc_rtype		nvarchar(4)
    declare     @sDoc_type		nvarchar(4)
    declare     @sDoc_filetype	nvarchar(50)
    declare     @nDoc_filesize	int
    declare     @sDoc_org		nvarchar(15)
    declare     @sDae_type		nvarchar(4)
    declare     @sDae_rtype		nvarchar(4)
    declare     @sDae_copytowo	nvarchar(1)
    declare     @sDae_printonwo	nvarchar(1)
    declare     @sDae_copytopo	nvarchar(1)
    declare     @sDae_printonpo	nvarchar(1)
    declare     @sDae_document	nvarchar(30)
	/*  cGet_addetails,cGet_addetails2 cursor variable declaration */
	declare 	@sAdd_entity	nvarchar(4)
	declare 	@sAdd_rentity	nvarchar(4)
	declare 	@sAdd_code		nvarchar(100)
	declare 	@sAdd_type		nvarchar(4)
	declare 	@sAdd_rtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare 	@sAdd_lang		nvarchar(2)
	declare 	@nAdd_line		numeric(12)
	declare 	@sAdd_print		nvarchar(1)
	declare 	@sAdd_text	    nvarchar(4000)
	declare 	@sAdd_user	    nvarchar(255)
	declare 	@dAdd_created	datetime
	declare 	@sAdd_upduser	nvarchar(255)
	declare 	@dAdd_updated	datetime

	/* Initialize */
    set @sChk = N'0'
    /* Check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCcode       IS NULL
    OR @sCnewcode    IS NULL
    OR @sCrentity    IS NULL
    OR @sCnewrentity IS NULL
	begin 
        set @sChk = N'1'
        return
    end
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCnewentity OUTPUT, @sCnewrentity, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk= @sCheckresult
        return
    end 

	/* Copy the docentity records to the new code ( r5docentities ), only 'F' and 'S' documents */
    INSERT INTO r5docentities (
						        dae_document,
						        dae_entity,
						        dae_rentity,
						        dae_type,
						        dae_rtype,
						        dae_code,
						        dae_copytowo,
						        dae_printonwo,
						        dae_copytopo,
						        dae_printonpo)
					   SELECT   d.dae_document,
					            @sCnewentity,
					            @sCnewrentity,
					            d.dae_type,
					            d.dae_rtype,
					            @sCnewcode,
								CASE @sCrentity WHEN N'EVNT'THEN d.dae_printonwo ELSE d.dae_copytowo END,
					            d.dae_printonwo,
					            d.dae_copytopo,
					            d.dae_printonpo
					   FROM     r5docentities d, r5documents e
					   WHERE    d.dae_code    = @sCcode
					   AND      d.dae_rentity = @sCrentity
					   AND      d.dae_document = e.doc_code
					   AND      e.doc_rtype IN ( N'F', N'S' )

	/* Copy the docentity records to the new code ( r5docentities ), only 'D' documents */
	DECLARE cC_DynamicDocs CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT  e.doc_filename,
										            e.doc_rtype,
										            e.doc_type,
										            e.doc_filetype,
										            e.doc_filesize,
										            e.doc_org,
										            d.dae_type,
										            d.dae_rtype,
										            d.dae_copytowo,
										            d.dae_printonwo,
										            d.dae_copytopo,
										            d.dae_printonpo,
										            d.dae_document
										      FROM  r5docentities d, r5documents e
										      WHERE d.dae_code  = @sCcode     AND
										       d.dae_rentity    = @sCrentity  AND
										       d.dae_document   = e.doc_code  AND
										       e.doc_rtype      = N'D'        AND
                                               e.doc_notused    = '-'

	OPEN cC_DynamicDocs 
	FETCH NEXT FROM cC_DynamicDocs INTO @sDoc_filename, @sDoc_rtype, @sDoc_type, @sDoc_filetype, 
										@nDoc_filesize, @sDoc_org, @sDae_type, @sDae_rtype, 
										@sDae_copytowo, @sDae_printonwo, @sDae_copytopo,
										@sDae_printonpo, @sDae_document 
	
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN	 
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sV_NewDocCode OUTPUT, N'DOCS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			close cC_DynamicDocs
			deallocate cC_DynamicDocs
			return -1
		end   
		set @sV_FileName = @sV_NewDocCode  +  N'-' + @sDoc_filename
		INSERT INTO r5documents
	       (doc_code, doc_desc, doc_rtype, doc_type, doc_filetype, doc_filename, doc_filesize, doc_org)
	    VALUES
	       ( @sV_NewDocCode, @sCrentity + @sCnewcode, @sDoc_rtype, @sDoc_type, @sDoc_filetype, @sV_FileName, @nDoc_filesize, @sDoc_org)
	
		execute @nReturn = O7DUPBODY @sDae_document, @sV_NewDocCode
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		begin
			close cC_DynamicDocs
			deallocate cC_DynamicDocs
			return -1
		end
		INSERT INTO r5docentities
       	( dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type, dae_rtype, dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo )
       	VALUES
       	( @sV_NewDocCode, @sCnewentity, @sCnewrentity, @sDae_type, @sDae_rtype, @sCnewcode,
         CASE @sCrentity WHEN N'EVNT'THEN @sDae_printonwo ELSE @sDae_copytowo END, @sDae_printonwo, @sDae_copytopo, @sDae_printonpo )
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM cC_DynamicDocs INTO @sDoc_filename, @sDoc_rtype, @sDoc_type, @sDoc_filetype, 
										@nDoc_filesize, @sDoc_org, @sDae_type, @sDae_rtype, 
										@sDae_copytowo, @sDae_printonwo, @sDae_copytopo,
										@sDae_printonpo, @sDae_document 
	END
	CLOSE cC_DynamicDocs
	DEALLOCATE cC_DynamicDocs

	/* Copy the addetails to the new code ( r5addetails ) */
	DECLARE cGet_addetails CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT     a.add_entity,
										               a.add_rentity,
										               a.add_code,
										               a.add_type,
										               a.add_rtype,

										               a.add_updated
										      FROM     r5addetails   a
										      WHERE    a.add_code    = @sCcode
										      AND      a.add_rentity = @sCrentity
										      AND      a.add_type    = CASE @sCnewrentity WHEN N'STWO' THEN N'*' ELSE a.add_type END


 	OPEN cGet_addetails
	FETCH NEXT FROM cGet_addetails INTO @sAdd_entity, @sAdd_rentity, @sAdd_code, @sAdd_type, @sAdd_rtype,
										@sAdd_lang, @nAdd_line, @sAdd_print, @sAdd_text, @sAdd_user, 
										@dAdd_created, @sAdd_upduser, @dAdd_updated 
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN	
			if not exists( select '1' from r5addetails
							where 
								add_code = @sCnewcode and
								add_rentity = @sCnewrentity and

								 add_rtype,
								 add_code,
								 add_lang,

								 add_print,

								 add_user,
								 add_created,
								 add_upduser,
								 add_updated)
						  VALUES (

SET NOCOUNT ON

       ,@nReturn      INT
       ,@sCheck       NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sWSPromptTab NVARCHAR(10)

SET @sWSPromptTab = N'[YU][0-9]%'

	UPDATE r5functions
	SET fun_lst         = value1,
		fun_hdr         = value2,
		fun_public      = value3,
		fun_displayft   = value4,
        fun_rs          = value5,
        fun_rentity     = value6,

        fun_startupview = value11,
        fun_udfrentity  = value12,
        fun_fieldfilterchecklist = value13,
        fun_reservationcalendar = value14,
        fun_mobileroute = value15
	FROM
	(
   SELECT fun_lst as value1, fun_hdr as value2, fun_public as value3, fun_displayft as value4, fun_rs as value5, fun_rentity as value6, 
          fun_mekey as value7, fun_advrept as value8, fun_nodesign as value9, fun_xtype as value10, fun_startupview as value11, fun_udfrentity as value12, 
          fun_fieldfilterchecklist as value13, fun_reservationcalendar as value14, fun_mobileroute as value15
   FROM r5functions WHERE fun_code=@sOldFunc

	WHERE fun_code=@sNewFunc

	       fun_defaultreservationstatus = (SELECT uco_code FROM r5ucodes where uco_rentity = N'RNST' AND uco_rcode = N'U' AND uco_system = N'+'),

	WHERE  @sOldFunc = N'OSESCH'

           ,ftb_ewsbtn
           ,ftb_xtype
           ,ftb_nodesign
           ,ftb_designpopup
           ,ftb_product)
SELECT @sNewFunc
      ,ftb_tab
      ,ftb_rentity
      ,ftb_visible
      ,ftb_select
      ,ftb_update
      ,ftb_insert
      ,ftb_delete
      ,ftb_displayft
      ,ftb_seq

      ,ftb_sysrequired

      ,ftb_product
  FROM r5functiontabs
 WHERE ftb_function = @sOldFunc
   AND ftb_tab NOT LIKE @sWSPromptTab;

IF @@ERROR != 0
   RETURN -1

/* Copy URL Parameters - this must be done before copy Function User Tabs */
    INSERT INTO r5urlparameters (
        url_userfunction, 
        url_tab, 
        url_parametername,
        url_alternateparametername,
        url_parametervalue,
        url_system,
        url_active)
    SELECT

        url_parametervalue,

        url_active
    FROM   r5urlparameters
    WHERE  url_userfunction = @sOldFunc
    AND    url_parametername NOT IN (SELECT url_parametername FROM r5urlparameters WHERE url_userfunction = @sNewFunc)

    DECLARE c_UrlParameter CURSOR STATIC LOCAL FOR
       SELECT url_tab, url_parametername, url_alternateparametername, url_parametervalue,  url_system, url_active FROM r5urlparameters WHERE  url_userfunction = @sOldFunc
    DECLARE @nUrlTab     NVARCHAR(6)

    DECLARE @nAlterName     NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @nParaValue     NVARCHAR(80)
    DECLARE @nSystem     NVARCHAR(1)
    DECLARE @nActive     NVARCHAR(1)

    OPEN c_UrlParameter
    FETCH NEXT FROM c_UrlParameter INTO @nUrlTab, @nParName, @nAlterName, @nParaValue, @nSystem, @nActive
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        UPDATE r5urlparameters 
        SET url_alternateparametername = @nAlterName,
            url_parametervalue = @nParaValue,
            url_system = @nSystem,
            url_active = @nActive
        WHERE     url_userfunction = @sNewFunc
              AND url_tab = @nUrlTab
              AND url_parametername = @nParName
        IF @@ERROR != 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_UrlParameter
          DEALLOCATE c_UrlParameter
          RETURN -1
        END      
        FETCH NEXT FROM c_UrlParameter INTO @nUrlTab, @nParName, @nAlterName, @nParaValue, @nSystem, @nActive     
    END
    CLOSE c_UrlParameter
    DEALLOCATE c_UrlParameter


   IF @@ERROR != 0

    INSERT INTO r5functionusertabs (
        fub_function, 
        fub_tab, 
        fub_type,
        fub_url,
        fub_issecure)
    SELECT

        fub_tab, 
        fub_type,
        fub_url,
        fub_issecure
    FROM   r5functionusertabs
    WHERE  fub_function = @sOldFunc
    AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                FROM   r5functionusertabs

IF @@ERROR != 0
   RETURN -1

/* Copy the remember data */

SELECT @sNewFunc

 WHERE RMB_FUNCTION = @sOldFunc
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                     FROM R5REMEMBER
                    WHERE rmb_function = @sNewFunc)
IF @@ERROR != 0

    select @sToUEntity = ent_entity from r5entities where ent_rentity = @sToREntity
	/* Insert into additional details table ( order free text ). */
        INSERT INTO r5addetails (

             ADD_TYPE,
             ADD_CODE,
             ADD_LANG,
             ADD_LINE,

    SELECT @sToREntity,
           @sToUEntity,
           a.ADD_RTYPE,
           a.ADD_TYPE,

  DECLARE @csp_rentity    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @csp_code       NVARCHAR( 50 ) 
  DECLARE @csp_store      NVARCHAR( 15 ) 

  DECLARE @ccd_pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_usageuom   NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_trade      NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_octype     NVARCHAR( 4 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_partclass  NVARCHAR( 8 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_partclorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_billsrc    NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @ccd_billsrcorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  
  DECLARE @cit_code       NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @cit_object     NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @cit_object_org NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @cit_customer   NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @cit_custorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ) 
  DECLARE @cit_event      NVARCHAR( 30 )

  DECLARE @ucode          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @addcode        NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @newdoccode     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @filename       NVARCHAR( 150 )
  DECLARE @doc_filename   NVARCHAR( 150 )
  DECLARE @doc_rtype      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @doc_type       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @doc_filetype   NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @doc_filesize   NUMERIC( 12 )
  DECLARE @doc_org        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @dae_type       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @dae_rtype      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @dae_copytowo   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_printonwo  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_copytopo   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_printonpo  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_document   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return         INTEGER
  DECLARE @pk             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newpk          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @x              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @skipchild      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @skip           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @cnt            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @deptsec        NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
    
  SET @chk = N'0'
  SET @skipchild = N'-'

  /* Some parameters required. */
  IF @contract IS NULL OR @rev IS NULL OR @org IS NULL OR @r5user IS NULL 
    BEGIN
      SET @newcontract = NULL
      RETURN
    END

  /* Check whether customer and currency data are still correct. */
  SELECT @com_notused  = com_notused, 
         @com_customer = com_customer, 
         @cur_notused  = cur_notused
  FROM   r5companies, r5currencies, r5customercontracts
  WHERE  com_code     = cct_customer
  AND    com_org      = cct_customer_org
  AND    cur_code     = cct_invoicingcurrency
  AND    cct_code     = @contract
  AND    cct_org      = @org
  AND    cct_revision = @rev
  IF @com_notused = N'+' OR @com_customer = N'-' OR @cur_notused = N'+' 
    BEGIN
      /* Required data no longer valid, abort with error. */
      SET @chk = N'2'
      RETURN
    END

  IF @newcontract IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* Check whether contract already exists. */
      SELECT @x = N'x'
      FROM   r5customercontracts
      WHERE  cct_code = @newcontract
      AND    cct_org  = @org
      IF @x IS NOT NULL 
        BEGIN
          SET @chk = N'1'
          RETURN
        END
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* New contract code not specified, so retrieve next contract code. */
      WHILE @newcontract IS NULL
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newcontract OUTPUT, N'CCT', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
          SET @x = NULL
          SELECT @x = N'x'
          FROM   r5customercontracts
          WHERE  cct_code = @newcontract
          AND    cct_org  = @org
          IF @x IS NOT NULL 
            /* Contract already exists, try again. */
            SET @newcontract = NULL
        END
    END 

  /* Get value for install parameter DEPTSEC. */
  SET @deptsec = UPPER( ISNULL( dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEPTSEC'), N'OFF' ) )
   
  /* Fetching the System Ucode for Unfinished. */
  SELECT @ucode = uco_code 
  FROM   r5ucodes 
  WHERE  uco_rcode   = N'U' 
  AND    uco_rentity = N'CCST' 
  AND    uco_system  = N'+'
 
   /* Inserting a new Contract. */
  INSERT INTO r5customercontracts( cct_code, cct_revision, cct_org, cct_desc, cct_customer,
         cct_customer_org, cct_status, cct_rstatus, cct_contracttemplate, cct_contracttemplate_org,
         cct_class, cct_class_org, cct_tax, cct_startdate, cct_enddate,
         cct_revisitdate, cct_contact, cct_phone, cct_email, cct_emailinvoice,
         cct_period, cct_perioduom, cct_nextinvoicedate, cct_offsetinvgeneration, cct_defaultinvstatus,
         cct_defaultinvorg, cct_invoicingcurrency, cct_lastinvociedate, cct_lastinvoice, cct_amountinvoiced,
         cct_fixedexchrate, cct_synxfixedexchrates, cct_closedwoonly, cct_roundinghours, cct_roundingdays,
         cct_starttimehours, cct_starttimeminutes, cct_endtimehours, cct_endtimeminutes, cct_requestedby,
         cct_daterequested, cct_approvedby, cct_dateapproved, cct_revisionreason, 
         cct_udfchar01, cct_udfchar02, cct_udfchar03, cct_udfchar04, cct_udfchar05, 
         cct_udfchar06, cct_udfchar07, cct_udfchar08, cct_udfchar09, cct_udfchar10, 
         cct_udfchar11, cct_udfchar12, cct_udfchar13, cct_udfchar14, cct_udfchar15, 
         cct_udfchar16, cct_udfchar17, cct_udfchar18, cct_udfchar19, cct_udfchar20, 
         cct_udfchar21, cct_udfchar22, cct_udfchar23, cct_udfchar24, cct_udfchar25, 
         cct_udfchar26, cct_udfchar27, cct_udfchar28, cct_udfchar29, cct_udfchar30, 
         cct_udfnum01, cct_udfnum02, cct_udfnum03, cct_udfnum04, cct_udfnum05, 
         cct_udfdate01, cct_udfdate02, cct_udfdate03, cct_udfdate04, cct_udfdate05, 
         cct_udfchkbox01, cct_udfchkbox02, cct_udfchkbox03, cct_udfchkbox04, cct_udfchkbox05 )
  SELECT @newcontract, 0, cct_org, ISNULL( @newdesc, cct_desc ), cct_customer,
         cct_customer_org, @ucode, N'U', 
         CASE ctp_notused WHEN N'-' THEN cct_contracttemplate ELSE NULL END, 
         CASE ctp_notused WHEN N'-' THEN cct_contracttemplate_org ELSE NULL END,
         cct_class, cct_class_org, cct_tax, cct_startdate, cct_enddate,
         cct_revisitdate, cct_contact, cct_phone, cct_email, cct_emailinvoice,
         cct_period, cct_perioduom, cct_nextinvoicedate, cct_offsetinvgeneration, cct_defaultinvstatus,
         cct_defaultinvorg, cct_invoicingcurrency, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         cct_fixedexchrate, cct_synxfixedexchrates, cct_closedwoonly, cct_roundinghours, cct_roundingdays,
         cct_starttimehours, cct_starttimeminutes, cct_endtimehours, cct_endtimeminutes, NULL,
         NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 
         cct_udfchar01, cct_udfchar02, cct_udfchar03, cct_udfchar04, cct_udfchar05, 
         cct_udfchar06, cct_udfchar07, cct_udfchar08, cct_udfchar09, cct_udfchar10,

         cct_udfchar16, cct_udfchar17, cct_udfchar18, cct_udfchar19, cct_udfchar20,
         cct_udfchar21, cct_udfchar22, cct_udfchar23, cct_udfchar24, cct_udfchar25, 
         cct_udfchar26, cct_udfchar27, cct_udfchar28, cct_udfchar29, cct_udfchar30, 
         cct_udfnum01, cct_udfnum02, cct_udfnum03, cct_udfnum04, cct_udfnum05, 
         cct_udfdate01, cct_udfdate02, cct_udfdate03, cct_udfdate04, cct_udfdate05, 
         cct_udfchkbox01, cct_udfchkbox02, cct_udfchkbox03, cct_udfchkbox04, cct_udfchkbox05

CREATE PROCEDURE O7COPYDATASPYTOUSER
  @dataspy      NUMERIC,
  @eamuser      NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @useasdefault NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @chk          NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @gridid     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @spyname    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @owner      NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @chk2       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @cnt        NUMERIC
  DECLARE @newdataspy NUMERIC

  SET @chk = N'0'
  SELECT @gridid  = dds_gridid, 
         @spyname = dds_ddspyname,
         @owner   = dds_owner
  FROM   r5dddataspy
  WHERE  dds_ddspyid = @dataspy

  IF @owner <> N'R5'
    BEGIN
      /* Copy the selected dataspy to the user specified. */
      /* Check if name already used. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5dddataspy
      WHERE  dds_gridid    = @gridid
      AND    dds_owner     = @eamuser
      AND    dds_ddspyname = @spyname
      IF @cnt > 0 
        BEGIN
          /* Dataspy name has already been used, to return with chk equals '1'. */
          SET @chk = N'1'
          RETURN
        END

        /* Get new ddspy id. */
        EXECUTE r5o7_o7maxseq @newdataspy OUTPUT, N'DDS', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT

        /* Insert the new dataspy. */
        INSERT INTO r5dddataspy( dds_ddspyname, dds_ddspyid, dds_autorun, dds_scope, dds_organization, dds_createdstamp, dds_updateable,
               dds_filterstrxml, dds_sortstrxml, dds_fieldlist, dds_displayrow, dds_owner, dds_gridid, dds_type, dds_defaultflag, dds_fieldlist_portlet,
               dds_clientrows, dds_portletrows, dds_hints, dds_botname, dds_userfilter, dds_securitydataspy, dds_mekey, dds_updated, dds_ddspyfilter, dds_globaldataspy )
        SELECT dds_ddspyname, @newdataspy, dds_autorun, dds_scope, dds_organization, dds_createdstamp, dds_updateable,
               dds_filterstrxml, dds_sortstrxml, dds_fieldlist, dds_displayrow, @eamuser, dds_gridid, dds_type, N'-', dds_fieldlist_portlet,
               dds_clientrows, dds_portletrows, dds_hints, dds_botname, dds_userfilter, dds_securitydataspy, dds_mekey, dds_updated, dds_ddspyfilter, dds_globaldataspy
        FROM   r5dddataspy
        WHERE  dds_ddspyid = @dataspy

        /* Insert the query fields. */
        INSERT INTO r5queryfield( dqf_ddspyid, dqf_fieldid, dqf_columnwidth, dqf_columnorder, dqf_viewtype )
        SELECT @newdataspy, dqf_fieldid, dqf_columnwidth, dqf_columnorder, dqf_viewtype
        FROM   r5queryfield
        WHERE  dqf_ddspyid = @dataspy
      
        /* Insert the custom field query fields. */
        INSERT INTO r5ddcustomfields( dcf_ddspyid, dcf_tagname, dcf_width, dcf_order, dcf_viewtype )
        SELECT @newdataspy, dcf_tagname, dcf_width, dcf_order, dcf_viewtype
        FROM   r5ddcustomfields
        WHERE  dcf_ddspyid = @dataspy
      END

    IF @useasdefault = N'+'
      BEGIN
        IF @owner = N'R5' 
          BEGIN
            /* Check whether the dataspy is hidden. */
            SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
            FROM   r5users, r5hiddendataspies
            WHERE  hds_group     = usr_group
            AND    hds_dataspyid = @dataspy
            AND    usr_code      = @eamuser
            IF @cnt > 0
              BEGIN
                /* Dataspy is hidden, so return with chk equals '2'. */
                SET @chk = N'2'
                RETURN;
              END
            SET @newdataspy = @dataspy
          END 

        /* Delete the current default if the new dataspy should become the new default. */
        DELETE FROM r5usegridsysdefault
        WHERE  usd_gridid = @gridid
        AND    usd_userid = @eamuser
        /* Insert new default. */
        INSERT INTO r5usegridsysdefault( usd_gridid, usd_userid, usd_dataspyid, usd_dataspyfilter )
        VALUES( @gridid, @eamuser, @newdataspy, NULL )
      END
END

create procedure O7COPYDOCS @sPKCode    nvarchar(46),
                            @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
                            @sEntity    nvarchar(4),
                            @sEquip     nvarchar(46),
                            @sPPM       nvarchar(30),
                            @sStandWO   nvarchar(20),
                            @sPart      nvarchar(46),
                            @sTask      nvarchar(25),
                            @sChk       nvarchar(6)    OUTPUT
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sNewDocCode        nvarchar(30)       --r5documents.doc_code%TYPE
    declare @sDocRType          nvarchar(4)        --r5documents.doc_rtype%TYPE
    declare @sDocType           nvarchar(4)        --r5documents.doc_rtype%TYPE
    declare @sChk2              nvarchar(5)
    declare @sFileType          nvarchar(50)       --r5documents.doc_filetype%TYPE
    declare @sFileName          nvarchar(300)      --r5documents.doc_filename%TYPE
    declare @sOrigFileName      nvarchar(300)      --r5documents.doc_filename%TYPE
    declare @nFileSize          int                --r5documents.doc_filesize%TYPE
    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @sDaeDoc            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sDaePrintonwo      nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDaePrintonpo      nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDaeCopyToWO       nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDaeCreateCopyToWO    nvarchar(1)
    declare @nCount                int

    create table #tDocument (dae_document         nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                             dae_printonwo        nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                             dae_printonpo        nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                             name                 nvarchar(256)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                             dae_copytowo         nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                             dae_createcopytowo   nvarchar(1)     COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL )

    create table #tDocument_exists (dae_document    nvarchar(30)   COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                                    dae_printonwo   nvarchar(1)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                                    dae_printonpo   nvarchar(1)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL , 
                                    name            nvarchar(256)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN    NULL)

    set @sChk = N'0'

    if @sPKCode is null or @sEntity is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
        end

    /* Add existing documents to update document list */
    insert into #tDocument_exists SELECT dae_document, dae_printonwo, null, coalesce( replace( name, dob_code + N'-', N'' ), dae_document )
    FROM r5documents, r5docentities LEFT OUTER JOIN r5docbody on dae_document = dob_code
    WHERE dae_rentity = N'EVNT'
    AND   dae_code = @sPKCode
    AND   doc_code = dae_document
    AND   doc_notused = N'-'

    if @sEntity = N'EVNT'
        begin
            /* Searching for existing documents, If Print on WO flag is -, then change to U */
            if @sEquip is not null
            update #tDocument_exists set dae_printonwo = 'U'
            from #tDocument_exists e
            WHERE dae_printonwo = N'-' and exists (select 'x' FROM    r5documents, r5docentities d LEFT OUTER JOIN r5docbody b on d.dae_document = b.dob_code
                                        WHERE    d.dae_rentity        = N'OBJ'    AND
                                                d.dae_code        = @sEquip    AND
                                                doc_code = d.dae_document AND
                                                doc_notused = N'-' AND
                                                d.dae_printonwo = N'+'                AND
                                                coalesce( replace( b.name, b.dob_code + N'-', N'' ), d.dae_document ) = e.name and
                                                d.dae_copytowo    = N'+'        )
            if @sPPM is not null
            update #tDocument_exists set dae_printonwo = 'U'
            from #tDocument_exists e
            WHERE dae_printonwo = N'-' and exists (select 'x' FROM    r5documents, r5docentities d LEFT OUTER JOIN r5docbody b on d.dae_document = b.dob_code
                                        WHERE    d.dae_rentity        = N'PPM'    AND
                                                d.dae_code        = @sPPM    AND
                                                doc_code = d.dae_document AND
                                                doc_notused = N'-' AND
                                                d.dae_printonwo = N'+'                AND
                                                coalesce( replace( b.name, b.dob_code + N'-', N'' ), d.dae_document ) = e.name and
                                                d.dae_copytowo    = N'+'        )

            if @sStandWO is not null
            update #tDocument_exists set dae_printonwo = 'U'
            from #tDocument_exists e
            WHERE dae_printonwo = N'-' and exists (select 'x' FROM    r5documents, r5docentities d LEFT OUTER JOIN r5docbody b on d.dae_document = b.dob_code
                                        WHERE    d.dae_rentity        = N'STWO'    AND
                                                d.dae_code        = @sStandWO    AND
                                                doc_code = d.dae_document AND
                                                doc_notused = N'-' AND
                                                d.dae_printonwo = N'+'                AND
                                                coalesce( replace( b.name, b.dob_code + N'-', N'' ), d.dae_document ) = e.name and
                                                d.dae_copytowo    = N'+'        )
            
            if @sTask is not null
            update #tDocument_exists set dae_printonwo = 'U'
            from #tDocument_exists e
            WHERE dae_printonwo = N'-'
            and exists (select 'x' FROM r5documents, r5docentities d LEFT OUTER JOIN r5docbody b on d.dae_document = b.dob_code
                    WHERE d.dae_rentity = N'TASK'
                    AND d.dae_code = @sTask
                    AND doc_code = d.dae_document
                    AND doc_notused = N'-'
                    AND d.dae_printonwo = N'+'
                    AND coalesce( replace( b.name, b.dob_code + N'-', N'' ), d.dae_document ) = e.name
            AND d.dae_copytowo = N'+')

            /* Add documents for equipment to document list */
            if @sEquip is not null
            insert into #tDocument     SELECT    d.dae_document, d.dae_printonwo, null, coalesce( replace( b.name, b.dob_code + N'-', N'' ), d.dae_document ),d.dae_copytowo, d.dae_createcopytowo
                                        FROM    r5documents, r5docentities d LEFT OUTER JOIN r5docbody b on d.dae_document = b.dob_code
                                        WHERE    d.dae_rentity        = N'OBJ'    AND
                                                d.dae_code        = @sEquip    AND
                                                doc_code = d.dae_document AND
                                                doc_notused = N'-' AND
                                                d.dae_copytowo    = N'+'    AND
                                                NOT EXISTS ( select 'x' from #tDocument_exists e 
                                                                where coalesce( replace( b.name, b.dob_code + N'-', N'' ), d.dae_document ) = e.name )
            
            /* Add documents for PPM to document list */
            if @sPPM is not null
            begin
            update #tDocument set dae_printonwo = N'+'
                FROM     #tDocument t, r5documents, r5docentities d LEFT OUT

AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @udfnum03             NUMERIC( 24,6 )
  DECLARE @udfnum04             NUMERIC( 24,6 )
  DECLARE @udfnum05             NUMERIC( 24,6 )

  DECLARE @udfdate02            DATETIME
  DECLARE @udfdate03            DATETIME
  DECLARE @udfdate04            DATETIME
  DECLARE @udfdate05            DATETIME
  DECLARE @udfchkbox01          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @udfchkbox02          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @udfchkbox03          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @udfchkbox04          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @udfchkbox05          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @vfactor              NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @objectlength         NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @objectlengthuom      NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @linearrefuom         NVARCHAR(10)
  DECLARE @objrefprecision      NUMERIC(2)
  DECLARE @converted_length     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @pk                   NUMERIC( 38 )
  DECLARE @newpk                NUMERIC( 38 )
  DECLARE @entity               NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @return               INTEGER
  DECLARE @setid                NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @repeatloops           NUMERIC
  DECLARE @repeatlength          NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @repeatlengthconverted NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @counter               NUMERIC

  SET @chk = N'0'
  
  /* Some parameters required. */
  IF @classcode IS NULL OR @classorg IS NULL OR @object IS NULL OR @objectorg IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'1'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Get OBJECT entity */
  SELECT @entity = ent_entity
  FROM   r5entities
  WHERE  ent_rentity = 'OBJ'

  /* Get equipment length, uom, and precision */
  SELECT @objectlength = obj_length, 
         @objectlengthuom = obj_lengthuom, 
         @linearrefuom = obj_linearrefuom, 
         @objrefprecision = obj_linearrefprecision
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @object
  AND    obj_org  = @objectorg

  /* Calculate linear reference "To Point" from converted length in equipment uom to equipment reference precision */
  IF @linearrefuom IS NOT NULL
    set @vfactor = dbo.O7COPYLR_GETCONVERT(@objectlengthuom) / dbo.O7COPYLR_GETCONVERT(@linearrefuom)
  ELSE
    set @vfactor = 1;
  IF @objectlength IS NOT NULL
    set @converted_length = ROUND (@objectlength * @vfactor, @objrefprecision)
  ELSE
    set @converted_length = 0;

  /* Cursor to retrieve class linear references. */
  DECLARE c_clr CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
      SELECT clr_id, clr_rtype, clr_type, clr_linearref_class, clr_linearref_class_org,

         clr_color, clr_icon, clr_iconpath, clr_relationshiptype,

         clr_verticaloffset, clr_verticaloffsetuom, clr_verticaloffsettype, 
         clr_qtyperuom, clr_qtyuom, clr_width, clr_widthuom, clr_height, clr_heightuom, clr_created, 
         clr_udfchar01, clr_udfchar02, clr_udfchar03, clr_udfchar04, clr_udfchar05, 
         clr_udfchar06, clr_udfchar07, clr_udfchar08, clr_udfchar09, clr_udfchar10, 
         clr_udfchar11, clr_udfchar12, clr_udfchar13, clr_udfchar14, clr_udfchar15, 
         clr_udfchar16, clr_udfchar17, clr_udfchar18, clr_udfchar19, clr_udfchar20, 
         clr_udfchar21, clr_udfchar22, clr_udfchar23, clr_udfchar24, clr_udfchar25, 
         clr_udfchar26, clr_udfchar27, clr_udfchar28, clr_udfchar29, clr_udfchar30, 
         clr_udfnum01,  clr_udfnum02,  clr_udfnum03,  clr_udfnum04,  clr_udfnum05, 
         clr_udfdate01, clr_udfdate02, clr_udfdate03, clr_udfdate04, clr_udfdate05, 
         clr_udfchkbox01, clr_udfchkbox02, clr_udfchkbox03, clr_udfchkbox04, clr_udfchkbox05 
      FROM   r5classlinearrefs
      WHERE  clr_class         = @classcode
      AND    clr_class_org     = @classorg
      AND    clr_entity        = @entity  
      AND    (clr_rtype        = 'LRS' OR clr_rtype = 'RP') 
      AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                  FROM   r5objlinearref
                  WHERE  ISNULL(lrf_class, '#') = ISNULL(clr_linearref_class, '#')
                  AND    ISNULL(lrf_class_org, '#') = ISNULL(clr_linearref_class_org, '#')
                  AND    lrf_reftype = clr_type 
                  AND    lrf_objcode = @object
                  AND    lrf_objorg = @objectorg);

  OPEN c_clr
    FETCH NEXT FROM c_clr INTO
         @refid, @refrtype, @reftype, @lrclass, @lrclassorg, 
         @lrpart, @lrpartorg, @lrdesc, @georef, @

create PROCEDURE O7COPYLR   @sObject      nvarchar(30),
                            @sObjectOrg   nvarchar(15),
                            @sEvent       nvarchar(30)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @nObj_length                 numeric(24,6)   --r5objects.obj_length%TYPE   
   declare @sObj_lengthuom              nvarchar(10)    --r5objects.obj_lengthuom%TYPE := NULL
   declare @sObj_linearrefuom           nvarchar(10)    --r5objects.obj_linearrefuom%TYPE := NULL   
   declare @nObj_linearrefprecision     numeric(2,0)    --r5objects.obj_linearrefprecision%TYPE
   declare @sFrom_refdesc               nvarchar(80)    --r5objlinearref.lrf_refdesc%TYPE
   declare @sFrom_georef                nvarchar(1000)  --r5objlinearref.lrf_georef%TYPE
   declare @nFactor                     numeric(24,12)
   declare @nConverted_length           numeric(24,6)
   declare @sTo_refdesc                 nvarchar(80)    --r5objlinearref.lrf_refdesc%TYPE
   declare @sTo_georef                  nvarchar(1000)  --r5objlinearref.lrf_georef%TYPE
               
 
  SELECT @nObj_length = obj_length, 
         @sObj_lengthuom = obj_lengthuom, 
         @sObj_linearrefuom = obj_linearrefuom, 
         @nObj_linearrefprecision = obj_linearrefprecision
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
  AND    obj_org  = @sObjectOrg
        
    IF @sObj_linearrefuom IS NOT NULL 
    begin
        /* Populate the From Point linear reference of the work order with 0.  */
        /* If a single linear reference record exists for the equipment where the From and */
        /* To Point = 0, the system will copy the Ref. Description and Geographical Ref. */
        /* of the equipment to the From Point Ref. Description and From Point Geographical Ref. */
        /* of the work order. */
        SELECT @sFrom_refdesc = lrf_refdesc, @sFrom_georef = lrf_georef
        FROM   r5objlinearref
        WHERE  lrf_objcode = @sObject
                AND    lrf_objorg  = @sObjectOrg
                AND    lrf_frompoint = 0
                AND    lrf_topoint = 0
        IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
            begin
                set @sFrom_refdesc = NULL
                set @sFrom_georef = NULL
            end

        /* Calculate equipment length in equipment linear reference uom */
        set @nFactor = dbo.O7COPYLR_GETCONVERT(@sObj_lengthuom) / dbo.O7COPYLR_GETCONVERT(@sObj_linearrefuom)
        set @nConverted_length = ROUND (@nObj_length * @nFactor, @nObj_linearrefprecision)

        /* Populate the To Point linear reference of the work order with the calculated */
        /* equipment length in the linear reference UOM.  If a single linear reference record */
        /* exists for the equipment where the From and To Point = <calculated equipment length>, */
        /* the system will copy the Ref. Description and Geographical Ref. of the equipment */
        /* to the To Point Ref. Description and To Point Geographical Ref. of the work order. */
        SELECT @sTo_refdesc = lrf_refdesc, @sTo_georef = lrf_georef
        FROM   r5objlinearref
        WHERE  lrf_objcode = @sObject
                AND    lrf_objorg  = @sObjectOrg
                AND    lrf_frompoint = @nConverted_length
                AND    lrf_topoint = @nConverted_length
        IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
            begin
                set @sTo_refdesc = NULL
                set @sTo_georef = NULL
            end
    
        UPDATE r5events
        SET    evt_frompoint = 0,
               evt_fromrefdesc = @sFrom_refdesc,
               evt_fromgeoref = @sFrom_georef,
               evt_topoint = @nConverted_length,
               evt_torefdesc = @sTo_refdesc,
               evt_togeoref = @sTo_georef
        WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent

    end

name: O7COPYLR_GETCONVERT
body:
create function O7COPYLR_GETCONVERT (
  @sUnit   nvarchar(30)
  )
  returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin

    declare @nReturn      numeric(24,6)
    set @nReturn = 0.0

     IF @sUnit = N'FEET' 
        set @nReturn = 1
     ELSE
         begin
             IF @sUnit = N'METERS' 
                set @nReturn =  3.2808
             ELSE
                 begin
                     IF @sUnit = N'MILES' 
                        set @nReturn = 5280
                     ELSE
                     begin
                         IF @sUnit = N'KILOMETERS' 
                            set @nReturn = 3280.8
                         ELSE
                            set @nReturn =  1
                    end
                end
         end

    RETURN (@nReturn) 
end
