    @sChk            nvarchar(5)  OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    
	declare @nReturn		   int
	/*  cursor  variable  */
	declare @nMlp_line 		int
    declare @sMlp_part 		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_part_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nMlp_qty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sMlp_uom		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_crit		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_reserv	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_code		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_code_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sMlp_obrtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMlp_obtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMlp_direct	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_equipfilter nvarchar(500)
	
	/* Check mandatory parameters: lists */
    IF @sCreflist    IS NULL
    OR @nCreflistrev IS NULL
    OR @sCtmplist    IS NULL
    OR @nCtmplistrev IS NULL
	begin
      	set @sChk = N'1'
      	RETURN
    end

	DECLARE cCmlp CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT m.mlp_line,
	       m.mlp_part,
	       m.mlp_part_org,
	       m.mlp_qty,
	       m.mlp_uom,
	       m.mlp_crit,
	       m.mlp_reserv,
	       m.mlp_code,
	       m.mlp_code_org,
	       m.mlp_obrtype,
	       m.mlp_obtype,
	       m.mlp_direct,
	       m.mlp_equipfilter
	FROM   r5matlparts m
	WHERE  m.mlp_matlist  = @sCreflist
	AND    m.mlp_matlrev  = @nCreflistrev

	/* insert */
	OPEN cCmlp
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								@sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_direct, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
     	INSERT INTO r5matlparts
     	(  mlp_matlist,
        mlp_matlrev,
        mlp_line,
        mlp_part,
        mlp_part_org,
        mlp_qty,
        mlp_uom,
        mlp_crit,
        mlp_reserv,
        mlp_code,
        mlp_code_org,
        mlp_obrtype,
        mlp_obtype,
		mlp_direct,
		mlp_equipfilter
        )
     	VALUES
        (
        @sCtmplist,
        @nCtmplistrev,
        @nMlp_line,
        @sMlp_part,
        @sMlp_part_org,
        @nMlp_qty,
        @sMlp_uom,
        @sMlp_crit,
        @sMlp_reserv,
        @sMlp_code,
        @sMlp_code_org,
        @sMlp_obrtype,
        @sMlp_obtype,
		@sMlp_direct,
		@sMlp_equipfilter
        )
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								   @sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_direct, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	end 
	CLOSE cCmlp
	DEALLOCATE cCmlp
END

  FROM   r5permittowork
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5classes ON ( cls_rentity = N'PTW' AND cls_code = ptw_class AND cls_org = ptw_class_org )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ucodes u1 ON ( u1.uco_rentity = N'PTTP' AND u1.uco_code = ptw_typeofwork )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ucodes u2 ON ( u2.uco_rentity = N'JBPR' AND u2.uco_code = ptw_priority )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5lockoutboxes ON ( lox_code = ptw_lockoutbox AND lox_org = ptw_lockoutbox_org ) 
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5personnel ON ( per_code = ptw_requestedby )
  WHERE  ptw_code = @ptw
	
  /* Some parameters required. */
  IF @ptw IS NULL OR @r5user IS NULL OR @ptworg IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'1'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Fetching the System Ucode for Unfinished. */
  SELECT @ucode = uco_code 
  FROM   r5ucodes 
  WHERE  uco_rcode   = N'U' 
  AND    uco_rentity = N'PWST' 
  AND    uco_system  = N'+'

  /* Retrieve next permittowork code. */
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newptw OUTPUT, N'PTW', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT

  /* If copying ptw, replaces and wo are NULL */
  IF @action = N'COPY'
    BEGIN
      SET @replaces  = NULL
      SET @workorder = NULL
      SET @activity  = NULL
    END  
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      SET @replaces  = @ptw
      SET @workorder = @wo
      SET @activity  = @act
    END

  /* Assign datereviewed and Set esign global variables for elec signature. */
  IF @reviewedby IS NULL OR @reviewedby = N''
    BEGIN
      IF @action = N'COPY' 
        BEGIN
          SET @copydatereviewed     = NULL
          SET @copyreviewedby       = NULL
          SET @copysignaturetype    = NULL
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          IF @action = N'REPLACE' 
            BEGIN
              SET @replacedatereviewed      = NULL
              SET @replacereviewedby        = NULL
              SET @replacesignaturetype     = NULL
              SET @copydatereviewed         = NULL
              SET @copyreviewedby           = NULL
              SET @copysignaturetype        = NULL
            END
        END
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = o7esign_saveuser @reviewedby, @signaturetype, NULL, NULL, @pextdate
      IF @action = N'COPY' 
        BEGIN
          SET @copydatereviewed = @sysdate
          SET @copyreviewedby = @reviewedby
          SET @copysignaturetype = @signaturetype
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          IF @action = N'REPLACE' 
            BEGIN
              SET @replacedatereviewed  = @sysdate
              SET @replacereviewedby     = @reviewedby
              SET @replacesignaturetype  = @signaturetype
              SET @copyreviewedby        = NULL
              SET @copysignaturetype     = NULL
            END
        END
    END

  /* Inserting a new Permit To Work. */
  INSERT INTO r5permittowork( ptw_code, ptw_org, ptw_desc, ptw_object, ptw_object_org, ptw_type, ptw_mrc, ptw_rstatus, ptw_status,
         ptw_reviewed, ptw_reviewedby, ptw_reviewedtype, ptw_location, ptw_location_org, ptw_locationnote, ptw_class, ptw_class_org,
         ptw_typeofwork, ptw_priority, ptw_risk, ptw_lockoutbox, ptw_lockoutbox_org, ptw_unassessedconflicts, ptw_event, ptw_act, ptw_permit,
         ptw_permit_org, ptw_permitrev, ptw_replacesptw, ptw_replacedbyptw, ptw_created, ptw_createdby, ptw_requested, ptw_requestedby,
         ptw_updated, ptw_updatedby, ptw_prepared, ptw_preparedby, ptw_responsible, ptw_holder, ptw_isolated, ptw_daterequired,
         ptw_duration, ptw_extension, ptw_validuntil, ptw_durationtotal, ptw_extensioncount, ptw_suspensionreason, ptw_note, ptw_assignedto,
         ptw_udfchar01, ptw_udfchar02, ptw_udfchar03, ptw_udfchar04, ptw_udfchar05,
         ptw_udfchar06, ptw_udfchar07, ptw_udfchar08, ptw_udfchar09, ptw_udfchar10,
         ptw_udfchar11, ptw_udfchar12, ptw_udfchar13, ptw_udfchar14, ptw_udfchar15,
         ptw_udfchar16, ptw_udfchar17, ptw_udfchar18, ptw_udfchar19, ptw_udfchar20,
         ptw_udfchar21, ptw_udfchar22, ptw_udfchar23, ptw_udfchar24, ptw_udfchar25,
         ptw_udfchar26, ptw_udfchar27, ptw_udfchar28, ptw_udfchar29, ptw_udfchar30,
         ptw_udfchar31, ptw_udfchar32, ptw_udfchar33, ptw_udfchar34, ptw_udfchar35,
         ptw_udfchar36, ptw_udfchar37, ptw_udfchar38, ptw_udfchar39, ptw_udfchar40,
         ptw_udfchar41, ptw_udfchar42, ptw_udfchar43, ptw_udfchar44, ptw_udfchar45,
         ptw_udfnum01, ptw_udfnum02, ptw_udfnum03, ptw_udfnum04, ptw_udfnum05,
         ptw_udfnum06, ptw_udfnum07, ptw_udfnum08, ptw_udfnum09, ptw_udfnum10,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7COPYSCE
    @sColdconsist       nvarchar(20),
    @sCnewconsist       nvarchar(20),
    @sChk               nvarchar(5)  OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
     SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare @nReturn                int
    /*  cursor  variable  */
    declare @sSce_object            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSce_object_org        nvarchar(15)
    declare @nSce_setposition       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSce_consistposition   nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSce_setpk             nvarchar(30)
    
    /* Check mandatory parameters: old consist pk, new consist pk */
    IF @sColdconsist    IS NULL
    OR @sCnewconsist IS NULL
    begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end

    DECLARE cCsce CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT s.sce_object,
           s.sce_object_org,
           s.sce_setposition,
           s.sce_consistposition,
           s.sce_setpk
    FROM   r5setconsistequipment s
    WHERE  s.sce_setconsistpk  = @sColdconsist

    /* insert */
    OPEN cCsce
    FETCH NEXT FROM cCsce INTO @sSce_object, @sSce_object_org, @nSce_setposition, @sSce_consistposition, @sSce_setpk
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
        INSERT INTO r5setconsistequipment
        (  
        sce_setconsistpk,
        sce_object,
        sce_object_org,
        sce_setposition,
        sce_consistposition,
        sce_setpk
        )
         VALUES
        (
        @sCnewconsist,
        @sSce_object,
        @sSce_object_org,
        @nSce_setposition,
        @sSce_consistposition,
        @sSce_setpk
        )
        FETCH NEXT FROM cCsce INTO @sSce_object, @sSce_object_org, @nSce_setposition, @sSce_consistposition, @sSce_setpk
    end 
    CLOSE cCsce
    DEALLOCATE cCsce
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7COPYTEMPLATEDATA
  @cc           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @ccrev        NUMERIC,
  @ccorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @template     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @templateorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  
  @action       NVARCHAR( 10 )
AS 
BEGIN
  
  DECLARE @ccorgcommon     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @tax             NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @invcurr         NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @return          INTEGER
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @pk              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newpk           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  
  /* All parameters required. */
  IF @cc IS NULL OR @ccrev IS NULL OR @ccorg IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* Is org common? */
  IF @ccrev >= 0
    /* Contract. */
    SELECT @ccorgcommon = org_common,
           @tax = cct_tax,
           @invcurr = cct_invoicingcurrency  
    FROM   r5organization, r5customercontracts
    WHERE  org_code     = cct_org
    AND    cct_code     = @cc       
    AND    cct_revision = @ccrev  
    AND    cct_org      = @ccorg
  ELSE  
    /* Rental. */
    SELECT @ccorgcommon = org_common, 
           @invcurr = org_curr  
    FROM   r5organization, r5customerrentals
    WHERE  org_code = crt_org
    AND    crt_code = @cc
    AND    -1       = @ccrev
    AND    crt_org  = @ccorg

  IF @ccorgcommon IS NULL
    /* Wrong contract/rental, return. */
    RETURN

  IF ISNULL( @action, N'x' ) = N'UPDATE'  AND @ccrev >= 0
    BEGIN
      /* Delete old data first. */
      DELETE FROM r5contractwocriteria
      WHERE  cwc_contract         = @cc 
      AND    cwc_contractrevision = @ccrev 
      AND    cwc_contract_org     = @ccorg
   
      DELETE FROM r5contractclauses
      WHERE  ccs_contract         = @cc 
      AND    ccs_contractrevision = @ccrev 
      AND    ccs_contract_org     = @ccorg
   
      DELETE FROM r5contractsalesprice
      WHERE  csp_contract         = @cc 
      AND    csp_contractrevision = @ccrev 
      AND    csp_contract_org     = @ccorg
   
      DELETE FROM r5contractdiscounts
      WHERE  cdc_contract         = @cc 
      AND    cdc_contractrevision = @ccrev 
      AND    cdc_contract_org     = @ccorg
    END

  IF ISNULL( @action, N'x' ) IN(  N'UPDATE', N'REFRESHCD' )
    BEGIN
      IF @ccrev >= 0
        BEGIN
          /* Contract. */
          DELETE FROM r5contractchargedefs
          WHERE  ccd_contract         = @cc 
          AND    ccd_contractrevision = @ccrev 
          AND    ccd_contract_org     = @ccorg
          AND    ccd_sourcecode IN ( N'H', N'HT' )
   
          DELETE FROM r5contractchargedefs
          WHERE  ccd_contract         = @cc 
          AND    ccd_contractrevision = @ccrev 
          AND    ccd_contract_org     = @ccorg
          AND    ccd_sourcecode IN ( N'GI', N'I' )
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                       FROM   r5contractitems
                       WHERE  cit_code = ccd_contractitem
                       AND    cit_contracttemplate IS NULL )
        END
      ELSE
        /* Rental. */
        DELETE FROM r5contractchargedefs
        WHERE  ccd_contract         = @cc 
        AND    ccd_contractrevision = @ccrev 
        AND    ccd_contract_org     = @ccorg      
    END  

  IF ISNULL( @action, N'x' ) IN ( N'INSERT', N'UPDATE' ) AND @ccrev >= 0
    BEGIN
      /* WO Criteria. */
      INSERT INTO r5contractwocriteria( cwc_contract, cwc_contractrevision, cwc_contract_org, 
             cwc_mrc, cwc_jobtype, cwc_class, cwc_class_org, cwc_grouping,
             cwc_udfchar01, cwc_udfchar02, cwc_udfchar03, cwc_udfchar04, cwc_udfchar05,
             cwc_udfchar06, cwc_udfchar07, cwc_udfchar08, cwc_udfchar09, cwc_udfchar10,
             cwc_udfchar11, cwc_udfchar12, cwc_udfchar13, cwc_udfchar14, cwc_udfchar15,
             cwc_udfcHar16, cwc_udfchar17, cwc_udfchar18, cwc_udfchar19, cwc_udfchar20,
             cwc_udfchar21, cwc_udfchar22, cwc_udfchar23, cwc_udfchar24, cwc_udfchar25,
             cwc_udfchar26, cwc_udfchar27, cwc_udfchar28, cwc_udfchar29, cwc_udfchar30,
             cwc_udfnum01, cwc_udfnum02, cwc_udfnum03, cwc_udfnum04, cwc_udfnum05,
             cwc_udfdate01, cwc_udfdate02, cwc_udfdate03, cwc_udfdate04, cwc_udfdate05,
             cwc_udfchkbox01, cwc_udfchkbox02, cwc_udfchkbox03, cwc_udfchkbox04, cwc_udfchkbox05 )
      SELECT @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg,
             twc_mrc, twc_jobtype, twc_class, twc_class_org, twc_grouping,
             twc_udfchar01, twc_udfchar02, twc_udfchar03, twc_udfchar04, twc_udfchar05,
             twc_udfchar06, twc_udfchar07, twc_udfchar08, twc_udfchar09, twc_udfchar10,
             twc_udfchar11, twc_udfchar12, twc_udfchar13, twc_udfchar14, twc_udfchar15,
             twc_udfcHar16, twc_udfchar17, twc_udfchar18, twc_udfchar19, twc_udfchar20,
             twc_udfchar21, twc_udfchar22, twc_udfchar23, twc_udfchar24, twc_udfchar25,
             twc_udfchar26, twc_udfchar27, twc_udfchar28, twc_udfchar29, twc_udfchar30,
             twc_udfnum01, twc_udfnum02, twc_udfnum03, twc_udfnum04, twc_udfnum05,
             twc_udfdate01, twc_udfdate02, twc_udfdate03, twc_udfdate04, twc_udfdate05,
             twc_udfchkbox01, twc_udfchkbox02, twc_udfchkbox03, twc_udfchkbox04, twc_udfchkbox05
      FROM   r5mrcs, r5organization o1, r5organization o2, r5templatewocriteria
      WHERE  mrc_code    = twc_mrc
      AND    o1.org_code = mrc_org
      AND    o2.org_code = twc_class_org
      AND    twc_contracttemplate     = @template
      AND    twc_contracttemplate_org = @templateorg
      AND  ( @ccorgcommon = N'+' OR
              ( ( o1.org_common = N'+' OR o1.org_code = @ccorg ) AND ( o2.org_common = N'+' OR o2.org_code = @ccorg ) ) )

      /* Clauses. */
      INSERT INTO r5contractclauses( ccs_contract, ccs_contractrevision, ccs_contract_org, ccs_clause, ccs_sequence )
      SELECT @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, tcs_clause, tcs_sequence
      FROM   r5templateclauses
      WHERE  tcs_contracttemplate     = @template
      AND    tcs_contracttemplate_org = @templateorg
    
      /* Sales prices.*/
      DECLARE c_pk CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT tsc_pk
        FROM   r5templatesalesprice
        WHERE  tsc_contracttemplate      = @template
        AND    tsc_contracttemplate_org  = @templateorg
        AND  ( ( @ccorgcommon = N'-' AND tsc_org = @ccorg ) OR @ccorgcommon = N'+' )
      OPEN c_pk
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_pk INTO @pk
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newpk OUTPUT, N'CSP', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
          INSERT INTO r5contractsalesprice( csp_pk, csp_contract, csp_contractrevision, csp_contract_org,
                 csp_rentity, csp_code, csp_org, csp_salesprice, csp_startdate, csp_enddate, csp_store,
                 csp_udfchar01, csp_udfchar02, csp_udfchar03, csp_udfchar04, csp_udfchar05,
                 csp_udfchar06, csp_udfchar07, csp_udfchar08, csp_udfchar09, csp_udfchar10,
                 csp_udfchar11, csp_udfchar12, csp_udfchar13, csp_udfchar14, csp_udfchar15,
                 csp_udfcHar16, csp_udfchar17, csp_udfchar18, csp_udfchar19, csp_udfchar20,
                 csp_udfchar21, csp_udfchar22, csp_udfchar23, csp_udfchar24, csp_udfchar25,
                 csp_udfchar26, csp_udfchar27, csp_udfchar28, csp_udfchar29, csp_udfchar30,
                 csp_udfnum01, csp_udfnum02, csp_udfnum03, csp_udfnum04, csp_udfnum05,
                 csp_udfdate01, csp_udfdate02, csp_udfdate03, csp_udfdate04, csp_udfdate05,
                 csp_udfchkbox01, csp_udfchkbox02, csp_udfchkbox03, csp_udfchkbox04, csp_udfchkbox05 )
          SELECT @newpk, @cc, @ccrev, @ccorg, 
                 tsc_rentity, tsc_code, tsc_org, tsc_salesprice, tsc_startdate, tsc_enddate, tsc_store,
                 tsc_udfchar01, tsc_udfchar02, tsc_udfchar03, tsc_udfchar04, tsc_udfchar05,
                 tsc_udfchar06, tsc_udfchar07, tsc_udfchar08, tsc_udfchar09, tsc_udfchar10,
                 tsc_udfchar11, tsc_udfchar12, tsc_udfchar13, tsc_udfchar14

CREATE PROCEDURE O7COPYTP @sEvent nvarchar(30) 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @dCdate datetime
    declare @sEvt_object 		nvarchar(30),
            @sEvt_object_org 	nvarchar(15),
            @sObj_loop		 	nvarchar(1),
            @sObj_instrument 	nvarchar(1),
            @sObj_devicetoltype nvarchar(1),
			@nObjIncrement		numeric(24,6),
			@nObjPrecision		numeric(2),
			@sObjPidno			nvarchar(80),
			@sObjPiddrawing		nvarchar(80),
			@nObjServiceperc	numeric(24,6),
			@sObjSop			nvarchar(30),
			@sObjOutputCalcType nvarchar(4),
			@sEvtOutputCalcType nvarchar(4),
			@sUcoRcode			nvarchar(4),
            @sObj_set			nvarchar(4),
    	    @sObj_outputcalctype   nvarchar(4),
    	    @nObj_outputrangeto    numeric(24,6),
    	    @nObj_outputrangefrom  numeric(24,6),
    	    @nObj_devicerangeto    numeric(24,6),
    	    @nObj_devicerangefrom  numeric(24,6),
    	    @sObj_outputuom        nvarchar(30)
    declare @dLastcal datetime,
    	    @sCalStatus nvarchar(2), 
    	    @nIncrement numeric(24,6),
    	    @nPrecision numeric(2),
    	    @sPidNo nvarchar(80),
    	    @sPidDrawing nvarchar(80),
    	    @nServicePerc numeric(24,6),
    	    @sSop nvarchar(30)
    
    declare @sStc_child          nvarchar(30),
    	    @sStc_child_org      nvarchar(15),
    	    @nOtp_seq            numeric(4),
    	    @nOtp_testpoint      numeric(24,6),
    	    @sOtp_testpointuom   nvarchar(30),
    	    @nOtp_output         numeric(24,6),
    	    @sOtp_outputuom      nvarchar(30),
    	    @sOtp_devicetoltype  nvarchar(1),
    	    @nOtp_devicetolfrom  numeric(24,6),
    	    @nOtp_devicetolto    numeric(24,6),
    	    @sOtp_comments       nvarchar(2000)
	
    declare cEvt cursor local for
    
	SELECT e.evt_object,
         e.evt_object_org,
         obj_loop,
         obj_instrument,
         case obj_increment when 0 then NULL else obj_increment end,
         obj_precision,
         obj_pidno,
         obj_piddrawing,
         obj_serviceperc,
         obj_sop,
         obj_outputcalctype,
         coalesce( p.peq_set, coalesce( o.ppo_set, o2.ppo_set, obj_set ) ) obj_set,
         obj_outputcalctype,
         obj_outputrangeto,
         obj_outputrangefrom,
         obj_devicerangeto,
         obj_devicerangefrom,
         obj_outputuom,         
		 uco_rcode,
         e.evt_lastcal,
         e.evt_calstatus,
         e.evt_increment,
         e.evt_pidno,
         e.evt_piddrawing,
         e.evt_serviceperc,
         e.evt_sop ,
         e.evt_outputcalctype
    FROM   r5objects,
           r5ucodes,
	   r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppmobjects o ON e.evt_ppopk = o.ppo_pk and e.evt_ppmrev = o.ppo_revision
	   LEFT OUTER JOIN r5patternequipment p ON e.evt_mp  = p.peq_mp and e.evt_mp_org = p.peq_mp_org and
                e.evt_mp_rev = p.peq_revision and e.evt_object = p.peq_object and e.evt_object_org = p.peq_object_org
	   left outer join r5events e2 on e.evt_routeparent = e2.evt_code 
	   left outer join r5ppmobjects o2 on e2.evt_ppopk = o2.ppo_pk and e2.evt_ppmrev = o2.ppo_revision
    WHERE  e.evt_object     = obj_code
    AND    e.evt_object_org = obj_org
    AND    e.evt_code       = @sEvent
	AND    coalesce( e2.evt_jobtype, e.evt_jobtype ) = uco_code
	AND    uco_rentity    =N'JBTP'
    AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                     FROM   r5evttestpoints
                     WHERE  etp_event = @sEvent )

    /* Before copying Test points, delete existing records for this event first */
    UPDATE r5events
    SET    evt_lastcal     = null,
           evt_increment   = null,
           evt_precision   = null,
           evt_pidno       = null,
           evt_piddrawing  = null,
           evt_serviceperc = null,
           evt_sop         = null
    WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent 
    AND    (    evt_lastcal     IS NOT NULL
             OR evt_increment   IS NOT NULL
             OR evt_precision   IS NOT NULL
             OR evt_pidno       IS NOT NULL
             OR evt_piddrawing  IS NOT NULL
             OR evt_serviceperc IS NOT NULL
             OR evt_sop         IS NOT NULL )
    DELETE FROM r5evttestpoints  WHERE  etp_event = @sEvent 
    DELETE FROM r5evtinstruments WHERE  eis_event = @sEvent 
    DELETE FROM r5evtstandards   WHERE  est_event = @sEvent 

    OPEN cEvt
    fetch next from cEvt into @sEvt_object, @sEvt_object_org, @sObj_loop, @sObj_instrument, @nObjIncrement,@nObjPrecision ,@sObjPidno , @sObjPiddrawing , @nObjServiceperc, @sObjSop, @sObjOutputCalcType, @sObj_set,    
    			      @sObj_outputcalctype,@nObj_outputrangeto,@nObj_outputrangefrom,@nObj_devicerangeto,@nObj_devicerangefrom,@sObj_outputuom,@sUcoRcode,
    			      @dLastcal,@sCalStatus,@nIncrement,@sPidNo,@sPidDrawing,@nServicePerc,@sSop,@sEvtOutputCalcType    
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
		IF @sUcoRcode = N'CAL' 
            begin
                if @sObj_loop = N'+'
		            begin	
						declare cOtp cursor local for
			            SELECT stc_child,
				               stc_child_org,
				               otp_seq,
				               otp_testpoint,
				               otp_testpointuom,
				               dbo.o7getoutputvalue2( otp_testpoint, otp_output, @nObj_outputrangeto, @nObj_outputrangefrom,  
				               		@nObj_devicerangeto, @nObj_devicerangefrom, ISNULL( otp_precision, @nObjprecision ), @sObj_outputcalctype ),
				               otp_outputuom,
				               otp_devicetoltype,
				               otp_devicetolfrom,
				               otp_devicetolto,
				               otp_comments,
				               ISNULL( otp_precision, @nObjprecision ) 
			            FROM   r5objtestpoints,
				               r5objects,
				               r5structures
			            WHERE  otp_object         = stc_parent
			            AND    otp_object_org     = stc_parent_org
			            AND    stc_child          = obj_code
			            AND    stc_child_org      = obj_org
			            AND    obj_instrument     = N'+'
			            AND    obj_instrumenttype = N'O'
			            AND    otp_object         = @sEvt_object
			            AND    otp_object_org     = @sEvt_object_org
			            AND    otp_set            = @sObj_set

						open cOtp
						fetch next from cOtp into @sStc_child, @sStc_child_org, @nOtp_seq, @nOtp_testpoint, @sOtp_testpointuom,
							@nOtp_output, @sOtp_outputuom, @sOtp_devicetoltype, @nOtp_devicetolfrom, @nOtp_devicetolto, @sOtp_comments, @nPrecision
						while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
							begin
			            		/* Copy records to the event test points table. */
			            		INSERT INTO r5evttestpoints (
				        	       etp_event,
				        	       etp_object,
				        	       etp_object_org,
				        	       etp_seq,
				        	       etp_testpoint,
				        	       etp_testpointuom,
				        	       etp_output,
				        	       etp_outputuom,
				        	       etp_standard,
				        	       etp_standarduom,
				        	       etp_devicetolfrom,
				        	       etp_devicetolto,
								   etp_outputcalctype,
								   etp_precision,
				        	       etp_comments )
			            		VALUES(@sEvent,

				        	       @nOtp_seq,
				        	       @nOtp_testpoint,
				        	       @sOtp_testpointuom,

				        	       ISNULL( @sOtp_outputuom, @sObj_outputuom ),
				            	   @nOtp_testpoint,

										   ELSE isnull( @nOtp_output, @nOtp_testpoint ) - ABS(( isnull( @nOtp_output, @nOtp_testpoint ) * @nOtp_devicetolfrom / 100 )) END, coalesce(@nPrecision, 100) ),

CREATE PROCEDURE O7COPYUSAGECHARGEDEFS
  @cc            NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @ccrev         NUMERIC,
  @ccorg         NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @contractitem  NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @chargedef     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @updexisting   NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @action        NVARCHAR( 30 )
AS
BEGIN  
  
  DECLARE @contract                  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @contractorg               NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @contractrev               NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @usageuom                  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @invoicingorg              NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @estdailyusage             NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @totalusage                NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @return                    INTEGER
  DECLARE @chk                       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @newpk                     NVARCHAR( 30 )

  DECLARE @cit_code                  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cit_object                NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cit_object_org            NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @cit_tax                   NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @ccd_contract              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ccd_contractrevision      NUMERIC(8, 0 )
  DECLARE @ccd_contract_org          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ccd_invoicingorg          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ccd_invoicingdescription  NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_invoice               NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccd_invoiceconditional    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccd_category              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ccd_level                 NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ccd_subcategory           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ccd_rate                  NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_adjpercbefore         NUMERIC(7, 4 )
  DECLARE @ccd_adjunitprice          NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_adjtransaction        NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_adjpercafter          NUMERIC(7, 4 )
  DECLARE @ccd_minqty                NUMERIC(12, 0 )
  DECLARE @ccd_mincharge             NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_maxcharge             NUMERIC(24, 6 )

  DECLARE @ccd_ocrtype               NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ccd_partclass             NVARCHAR( 8 )

  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar09             NVARCHAR( 80 )

  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar11             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar12             NVARCHAR( 80 )

  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar25             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar26             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar27             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar28             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar29             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchar30             NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfnum01              NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfnum02              NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfnum03              NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfnum04              NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfnum05              NUMERIC(24, 6 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfdate01             DATETIME
  DECLARE @ccd_udfdate02             DATETIME
  DECLARE @ccd_udfdate03             DATETIME
  DECLARE @ccd_udfdate04             DATETIME
  DECLARE @ccd_udfdate05             DATETIME
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchkbox01           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchkbox02           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchkbox03           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchkbox04           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ccd_udfchkbox05           NVARCHAR( 1 )

  IF @action = N'ADDCHARGEDEF'
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve contract data. */
      SELECT @contract     = ccd_contract, 
             @contractorg  = ccd_contract_org, 
             @contractrev  = ccd_contractrevision,
             @usageuom     = ccd_usageuom,
             @invoicingorg = ccd_invoicingorg
      FROM   r5contractchargedefs
      WHERE  ccd_pk = @chargedef
      IF @contract IS NULL
        RETURN
      
      DELETE FROM r5contractchargedefs
      WHERE  ccd_contract         = @contract
      AND    ccd_contract_org     = @contractorg
      AND    ccd_contractrevision = @contractrev
      AND    ccd_usageuom         = @usageuom
      AND    ccd_invoicingorg     = @invoicingorg
      AND    ccd_category         = N'USCH'
      AND    ccd_level            = N'TR'
      AND    ccd_subcategory      = N'UCU1'
      AND    ccd_pk              <> @chargedef
      AND  ( ccd_sourcecode = N'GI' OR ( ccd_sourcecode = N'I' AND @updexisting = N'+' ) )
      AND EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                  FROM   r5contractitems
                  WHERE  cit_code = ccd_contractitem
                  AND    cit_contracttemplate IS NULL )
    END    

  /* Charge Definitions, usage based. */
  DECLARE c_ccd CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT '-', cit_code, cit_object, cit_object_org, cit_tax, ccd_contract, ccd_contractrevision, ccd_contract_org,
           ccd_invoicingorg, ccd_invoicingdescription, ccd_invoice, ccd_invoiceconditional,
           ccd_category, ccd_level, ccd_subcategory, ccd_rate, ccd_adjpercbefore, ccd_adjunitprice, ccd_adjtransaction,
           ccd_adjpercafter, ccd_minqty, ccd_mincharge, ccd_maxcharge, ccd_freeupto, ccd_taxable, ccd_usageuom,
           ccd_chargeestusage, ccd_rollover, ccd_trade, ccd_octype, ccd_ocrtype, ccd_partclass, ccd_partclass_org, 
           ccd_udfchar01, ccd_udfchar02, ccd_udfchar03, ccd_udfchar04, ccd_udfchar05,
           ccd_udfchar06, ccd_udfchar07, ccd_udfchar08, ccd_udfchar09, ccd_udfchar10,
           ccd_udfchar11, ccd_udfchar12, ccd_udfchar13, ccd_udfchar14, ccd_udfchar15,
           ccd_udfcHar16, ccd_udfchar17, ccd_udfchar18, ccd_udfchar19, ccd_udfchar20,
           ccd_udfchar21, ccd_udfchar22, ccd_udfchar23, ccd_udfchar24, ccd_udfchar25,
           ccd_udfchar26, ccd_udfchar27, ccd_udfchar28, ccd_udfchar29, ccd_udfchar30,
           ccd_udfnum01, ccd_udfnum02, ccd_udfnum03, ccd_udfnum04, ccd_udfnum05,
           ccd_udfdate01, ccd_udfdate02, ccd_udfdate03, ccd_udfdate04, ccd_udfdate05,
           ccd_udfchkbox01, ccd_udfchkbox02, ccd_udfchkbox03, ccd_udfchkbox04, ccd_udfchkbox05
    FROM   r5contractchargedefs, r5contractitems  
    WHERE  ccd_contract         = cit_contract
    AND    ccd_contractrevision = cit_contractrevision
    AND    ccd_contract_org     = cit_contract_org    
    AND    cit_invoicingorg     = ccd_invoicingorg
    AND    ccd_category         = N'USCH'
    AND    ccd_level            = N'TR'
    AND    ccd_subcategory      = N'UCU1'
    AND    cit_contract         = @cc
    AND    cit_contractrevision = @ccrev
    AND    cit_contract_or

CREATE PROCEDURE O7COST_LABOURANDHOURS @sEvent  nvarchar(30)
                ,@nLabour numeric(30, 6) OUTPUT
                ,@nHours  numeric(30, 6) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nOutput numeric(30, 6)
	declare @nHir numeric(30,6)
	declare @nFix numeric(30,6)
	declare @sOutput nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn integer

	SELECT @nLabour = 0
			,@nHours = 0
			,@nHir = 0
			,@nFix = 0

	/* Get actual cost for own labour. */
	execute @nReturn = O7ACTLAB N'EVT2', @sEvent, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	
	SELECT @nLabour = @nLabour + isnull(@nOutput, 0)
		,@nHours = @nHours + isnull(CONVERT(numeric(30, 6), @sOutput), 0)

	/* Get actual cost AND HOURS for hired labour */
	execute @nReturn = O7ACTHIR N'EVT2', @sEvent, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1

	SELECT @nLabour = @nLabour + isnull(@nOutput, 0)
		,@nHours = @nHours + isnull(CONVERT(numeric(30, 6), @sOutput), 0)

	/* Get actual cost for fixed price services */
	execute @nReturn = O7ACTFIX N'EVT', @sEvent, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1

	/* Get the cost difference in invoice amount and purchase order amount */
    execute @nReturn = O7PIDHIR N'EVT', @sEvent, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nHir OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
    execute @nReturn = O7PIDFIX N'EVT', @sEvent, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nFix OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	
    SELECT @nLabour = @nLabour + isnull(@nOutput, 0) + isnull( @nHir, 0 ) + isnull( @nFix, 0 )

create procedure O7CPCLAS
   @sOrg		    nvarchar(100),
   @sParent			nvarchar(100)

as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount					int
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4)	
	declare @sChk			        nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX						nvarchar(1)
	declare	@sDeforg				nvarchar(200) --R5INSTALL.INS_DESC%TYPE;
	declare @sMos					nvarchar(1) --R5ENTITYTABLES.ETT_MOS%TYPE;

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sX = null


	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	if coalesce( @sParent, N'x' ) = N'PREUPD_ETT' 
		set @sMos = N'+'
	else
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5entitytables
			WHERE  ett_rentity = N'CLAS'

			if @nCount > 0 
				select @sMos = ett_mos
				FROM   r5entitytables
				WHERE  ett_rentity = N'CLAS'
		end


	if @sMos = N'+' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @sDeforg = @sOrg
			begin
			    /* Nothing to copy if org equals the default. */
				set @sX = null
				return
			end


			/* Copy all '*' codes. */
			INSERT INTO r5classes 
				(cls_entity, cls_rentity, cls_code, cls_desc, cls_org )
				SELECT cls_entity, cls_rentity, cls_code, cls_desc, @sOrg
				FROM   r5classes c1
				WHERE  cls_code = N'*'
				AND    cls_org  = @sDeforg
				AND    coalesce( cls_notused, N'-' ) = N'-'
				AND    cls_rentity NOT IN ( N'ROLE', N'ASPC', N'CLVL', N'FIND', N'COND', N'FORM', N'PNTP', N'ORG' )
				AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
								FROM   r5classes c2
								WHERE  c2.cls_entity = c1.cls_entity
								AND    c2.cls_code   = c1.cls_code
								AND    c2.cls_org    = @sOrg );

			/* Copy 'N' class for PART. */
			INSERT INTO r5classes (
				   cls_entity, cls_rentity, cls_code, cls_desc, cls_org )
			SELECT cls_entity, cls_rentity, cls_code, cls_desc, @sOrg
			FROM   r5classes c1
			WHERE  cls_code    = N'N'
			AND    cls_rentity = N'PART'
			AND    coalesce( cls_notused, N'-' ) = N'-'
			AND    cls_org     = @sDeforg
			AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
							FROM   r5classes c2
							WHERE  c2.cls_entity = c1.cls_entity
							AND    c2.cls_code   = c1.cls_code
							AND    c2.cls_org    = @sOrg )
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CPCONT   @sFromcontract  nvarchar(30),
                            @sTocontract    nvarchar(30),
                            @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sSupplier      nvarchar(30)--r5contracts.con_@sSupplier%TYPE
    declare @sSupplierorg   nvarchar(15)--r5contracts.con_@sSupplier_org%TYPE
    declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)--r5contracts.con_org%TYPE
    declare @sFromcurr      nvarchar(3)--r5contracts.con_curr%TYPE
    declare @sTocurr        nvarchar(3)--r5contracts.con_curr%TYPE
    declare @dStartdate     DATETIME
    declare @dEnddate       DATETIME

    /* Initialize ooutput variable @sChk. */
    set @sChk = '0'

    /* Get to contract info. */
    SELECT @sSupplier = con_supplier,
         @sSupplierorg = con_supplier_org,
         @dStartdate = con_start,
         @dEnddate = con_end,
         @sOrg = con_org,
         @sTocurr = con_curr
    FROM   r5contracts
    WHERE  con_code = @sTocontract
    AND    con_rstatus = 'U'

    /* Get from contract info. */
    SELECT @sFromcurr = con_curr
    FROM   r5contracts
    WHERE  con_code = @sFromcontract

    IF @sSupplier IS NULL 
        begin
            /* If supplier has no value, then the to contract must be wrong. */
            set @sChk = '1'
            RETURN
        end 

    IF @sTocurr <> coalesce( @sFromcurr, N'x' ) 
        begin
        /* Currencies of the two contracts have to be the same. */
            set @sChk = '2'
            RETURN
        end 

    /* Copy the parts first. */
    INSERT INTO r5conparts( cpa_contract, cpa_supplier, cpa_supplier_org, cpa_part, cpa_part_org, 
    cpa_multiply, cpa_leadtime, cpa_price, cpa_ref, cpa_puruom )
    SELECT @sTocontract, 
           @sSupplier, 
           @sSupplierorg, 
         cpa_part, 
         cpa_part_org,    
         cpa_multiply,
         cpa_leadtime, 
         cpa_price, 
         cpa_ref, 
         cpa_puruom
    FROM   r5organization, r5contracts, r5conparts c1
    WHERE  cpa_contract = @sFromcontract
    AND    con_code     = cpa_contract
    AND    cpa_part_org = org_code
    AND  ( org_common = N'+' OR con_org = @sOrg )
    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                  FROM   r5conparts c2
                  WHERE  c2.cpa_contract = @sTocontract
                  AND    c2.cpa_part     = c1.cpa_part
                  AND    c2.cpa_part_org = c1.cpa_part_org )


    /* Then copy all discounts. */
    INSERT INTO r5condiscounts( cdi_contract, cdi_part, cdi_part_org, cdi_type, cdi_rtype,
        cdi_value, cdi_purqty, cdi_disperc, cdi_start, cdi_end )
    SELECT @sTocontract,
         cdi_part,
         cdi_part_org,    
         cdi_type,
         cdi_rtype,
         cdi_value,
         cdi_purqty,
         cdi_disperc,
         @dStartdate, 
         @dEnddate
    FROM   r5condiscounts c1
    WHERE  cdi_contract = @sFromcontract
    AND ( cdi_part IS NULL OR 
        EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                FROM   r5conparts
                WHERE  cpa_contract = @sTocontract
                AND    cpa_part     = cdi_part
                AND    cpa_part_org = cdi_part_org ) )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CPRISK 
   @nOldpk   integer,
   @nPk      integer,
   @nRev     numeric(4),
   @sR5user  nvarchar(255)  
AS 
   SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @nNewpk      integer
   declare @sChk        nvarchar(4)
   declare @dGtTime     datetime
   declare @nRisk       integer
   declare @nReturn     integer

   declare c_risk cursor local for SELECT ris_pk
                                 FROM   r5risk
                                 WHERE  ris_parent = @nOldpk
   open c_risk
   fetch next from c_risk into   @nRisk 

   while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
         execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nNewpk OUTPUT, N'RISK', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            begin
               close c_risk
               deallocate c_risk
               return -1
            end
         
         execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, null
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            begin
               close c_risk
               deallocate c_risk
               return -1
            end
         set @dGtTime = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dGtTime, N'DD' )
         
   
         INSERT INTO r5risk ( ris_pk, ris_code, ris_desc, ris_risk, ris_revision,
           ris_class, ris_class_org, ris_type, ris_parent, ris_normalize, ris_ranklevel,
           ris_rankvalue, ris_notused, ris_created, ris_user, ris_formula )
         SELECT @nNewpk, ris_code, ris_desc, ris_risk, @nRev, ris_class, ris_class_org,
           ris_type, @nPk, ris_normalize, ris_ranklevel, ris_rankvalue,
           ris_notused, @dGtTime, @sR5user, ris_formula
         FROM   r5risk
         WHERE  ris_pk = @nRisk

         INSERT INTO r5risknorm ( rno_pk, rno_min, rno_max, rno_norm )
         SELECT @nNewpk, rno_min, rno_max, rno_norm
         FROM   r5risknorm
         WHERE  rno_pk = @nRisk

         execute @nReturn = O7CPRISK @nRisk, @nNewpk, @nRev, @sR5user
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            begin
               close c_risk
               deallocate c_risk
               return -1
            end
      
      fetch next from c_risk into   @nRisk 
         
      end
   close c_risk
   deallocate c_risk

  SET NOCOUNT ON

  SELECT @sCopy   = str_copy,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CPSTOR_GET_HIERARCHY_R5STORES @sCstore nvarchar(15)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(15)
        declare @tStack table( Code nvarchar(15), Parent nvarchar(515), LevelID int  )	
      
	CREATE TABLE #tCodes ( Code nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select str_code, str_parent, 1 from r5stores where str_code = @sCstore
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCstore = Code, @sParent = Parent from #tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into #tCodes values ( @sCstore, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND Code = @sCstore and Parent = @sParent
					insert into @tStack select str_code, str_parent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5stores
										 where str_code = @sParent
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	SELECT * FROM #tCodes

CREATE PROCEDURE O7CRACD1 @pRowId int,
                          @pREntity NVARCHAR(4),
                          @pAction NVARCHAR(3)
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @vACDCode        bigint
  declare @vWorkOrder      nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vReq            nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vOrg            nvarchar( 15 )
  declare @vOrgValue       nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vStore          nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vDept           nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vStoreDeptValue nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vCostCode       nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vCostCodeValue  nvarchar( 30 )
  declare @vLineRType      nvarchar( 4 )
  declare @vLineRLookup    nvarchar( 4 )

BEGIN
  set @vOrg = NULL
  set @vOrgValue = NULL
  set @vStore = NULL
  set @vDept = NULL
  set @vStoreDeptValue = NULL
  set @vCostCode = NULL
  set @vCostCodeValue = NULL

  IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT NAME FROM SYSOBJECTS WHERE NAME ='#tTempACDValues' )
    CREATE TABLE #tTempACDValues( adp_valuelookup nvarchar(2)  null,
                                  adp_default     nvarchar(30) null,
                                  adp_segment     nvarchar(30) null,
                                  actualvalue     nvarchar(30) null )

  INSERT INTO #tTempACDValues (adp_valuelookup, adp_default, adp_segment )
  SELECT COALESCE(adp_valuelookup, 'N') , adp_default, adp_segment
  FROM r5acdparams
  WHERE adp_segment  IN ('ACD_SEGMENT1','ACD_SEGMENT2','ACD_SEGMENT3');

  -- When all values are ACD Segment definition are Null
  IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT adp_valuelookup FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_valuelookup <> 'N')
    RETURN;

  -- Fetch information from the record being inserted/update
  IF( @pREntity = 'REQ' )
    BEGIN
      SELECT @vReq = r.req_code,
             @vOrg = r.req_org,
             @vStore = r.req_tocode,
             @vCostCode = r.req_costcode,
             @vACDCode = r.req_acd
      FROM   r5requisitions r
      WHERE  req_sqlidentity = @pRowId;
    END;
  ELSE
    IF ( @pREntity = 'REQL' )
    BEGIN
      SELECT @vReq = rl.rql_req,
             @vCostCode = rl.rql_costcode,
             @vLineRType = rl.rql_rtype,
             @vWorkOrder = rl.rql_event,
             @vACDCode =  rl.rql_acd
      FROM   r5requislines rl
      WHERE  rl.rql_sqlidentity = @pRowId;

      SELECT @vOrg = r.req_org,
             @vStore = r.req_tocode
      FROM   r5requisitions r
      WHERE  r.req_code = @vReq;

      IF ( @vLineRType IN ( 'PD', 'ST', 'SF' ) AND @vWorkOrder IS NOT NULL )
        SELECT @vDept = evt_mrc
        FROM   r5events
        WHERE  evt_code = @vWorkOrder;
    END

  -- Get the possible segment values
  -- Organization :
  IF ( @vOrg IS NOT NULL )
    SELECT @vOrgValue = org_segmentvalue
    FROM   r5organization
    WHERE  org_code = @vOrg;

  -- Store/Department
  IF ( @vDept IS NOT NULL )
    SELECT @vStoreDeptValue = mrc_segmentvalue
    FROM   r5mrcs
    WHERE  mrc_code = @vDept;
  ELSE
    IF( @vStore IS NOT NULL )
      SELECT @vStoreDeptValue = str_segmentvalue
      FROM   r5stores
      WHERE  str_code = @vStore;

  -- Cost Code
  IF( @vCostCode IS NOT NULL )
    SELECT @vCostCodeValue = cst_segmentvalue
    FROM   r5costcodes
    WHERE  cst_code = @vCostCode;

  -- Assign ACD code lookup values
  UPDATE #tTempACDValues
  SET actualvalue  = ( CASE WHEN adp_valuelookup = 'FV' THEN adp_default
                  ELSE CASE WHEN adp_valuelookup = 'O'  THEN @vOrgValue
                  ELSE CASE WHEN adp_valuelookup = 'CC' THEN @vCostCodeValue
                  ELSE CASE WHEN adp_valuelookup = 'SD' THEN @vStoreDeptValue
                  ELSE CASE WHEN adp_valuelookup = 'N'  THEN '' END END END END END )

  -- Insert or Update the r5accountdetail record
  IF( @pAction = 'INS' )
    INSERT INTO r5accountdetail
      ( acd_code, acd_rentity, acd_segment1, acd_segment2, acd_segment3 )
    SELECT  @vACDCode, @pREntity,
            (SELECT actualvalue FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_segment = 'ACD_SEGMENT1'),
            (SELECT actualvalue FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_segment = 'ACD_SEGMENT2'),
            (SELECT actualvalue FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_segment = 'ACD_SEGMENT3')
    FROM r5requisitions WHERE req_code = @vReq;
  ELSE
    IF( @pAction = 'UPD' )
      UPDATE r5accountdetail
      SET    acd_segment1 = ( SELECT actualvalue FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_segment = 'ACD_SEGMENT1'),
             acd_segment2 = ( SELECT actualvalue FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_segment = 'ACD_SEGMENT2'),
             acd_segment3 = ( SELECT actualvalue FROM #tTempACDValues WHERE adp_segment = 'ACD_SEGMENT3')
      WHERE  acd_code = @vACDCode;

  DROP TABLE #tTempACDValues
END

    declare @sMinh              nvarchar(1)   --R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_MINHOURS%TYPE /* ERROR ! Should be a NUMBER. Change req. 21 */
    declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar( 4 )
    declare @dStart             datetime

    declare @nRevision          int
    declare @sDeforg            nvarchar(15)  --R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_SUPPLIER_ORG%TYPE

    declare @sEnter             nvarchar(100)
    declare @sAction            nvarchar(255)   --R5BOILERTEXTS.BOT_TEXT%TYPE

create function O7CRACT1_GETTEXT(
	  @sType        nvarchar(4),
	  @sLang        nvarchar(2) ) 

returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin
	declare @sRetval      nvarchar(255)
	SELECT @sRetval = BOT_text
	FROM  r5boilertexts
	WHERE bot_pool = CASE @sType WHEN N'ACTN' THEN 12357 WHEN N'WHAT' THEN 18422 WHEN N'WHER' THEN 18423 WHEN N'HOW' THEN 18424 ELSE 12697 END
	AND   bot_lang = @sLang
	RETURN( @sRetval)

end

name: O7CRACT2
body:
create procedure O7CRACT2 
    @sCeventno     nvarchar(30),
    @sCtrade       nvarchar(15),
    @sCmrc         nvarchar(15),
    @dDstart       datetime,
    @sChk          nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
as
begin
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nNntrate      int				/*NUMBER := 0;*/
    declare @nNotrate      int				/*NUMBER := 0;*/
    declare @sCheckresult  nvarchar( 4 )
    declare @sCfoundit     nvarchar( 1 )
    declare @sDeforg       nvarchar(15)	    /*R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_SUPPLIER_ORG%TYPE;*/
    declare @nNdefactline  int				/*R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_ACT%TYPE;*/
    declare @sChk1         nvarchar(3)
	declare @nReturn	   int 

	set @nNntrate = 0
	set @nNotrate = 0
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sChk = N'0'
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @nNdefactline OUTPUT, N'INCRLINO', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	----------------------------------------------------------------------
   --                          Check Parameters
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   IF ( @sCeventno        IS NULL OR
        @sCtrade         IS NULL OR
        @sCmrc           IS NULL OR
        @dDstart          IS NULL )
		begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
   		end
	----------------------------------------------------------------------
   --                 Check if an activity already exists
   --
   -- This is used when updating a Rapid Job entry
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------
	DECLARE cChk_activity CURSOR LOCAL FOR   SELECT NULL
										     FROM   r5activities
										     WHERE  act_event = @sCeventno


	OPEN cChk_activity
	FETCH NEXT FROM cChk_activity INTO @sCfoundit
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		return
	END
    CLOSE cChk_activity
	DEALLOCATE cChk_activity
	
	----------------------------------------------------------------------
   --                       Retrieve Trade Rates
   -----------------------------------------------------------------------
	execute @nReturn  = O7BOORAT @nNntrate OUTPUT, @sCmrc, @sCtrade,null, N'N', @dDstart, N'ZZ',N'*',0,0,0,0,null,@sCheckresult OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'2'
        return
   	end
	
	execute @nReturn  = O7BOORAT @nNotrate OUTPUT, @sCmrc, @sCtrade,null, N'O', @dDstart, N'ZZ',N'*',0,0,0,0,null,@sCheckresult OUTPUT 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'3'
        return
   	end
	----------------------------------------------------------------------
   --                          Create Activity
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   -- The estimated and remaining hours where chosen as 4 because that
   -- is the way they are currently defaulted in WDACTJ.FMB.
	INSERT INTO r5activities
          (
             act_event,
             act_act,
             act_mrc,
             act_trade,
             act_duration,
             act_est,
             act_rem,
             act_persons,
             act_special,
             act_hire,
             act_time,
             act_start,
             act_fixh,
             act_minhours,
             act_ntrate,
             act_otrate
           )
   VALUES (
             @sCeventno,
             isnull(@nNdefactline,N'10'),
             @sCmrc,
             @sCtrade,
             1,
             0,
             0,
             1,
             N'-',
             N'-',
             1,
             @dDstart,
             N'-',
             N'-',
             @nNntrate,
             @nNotrate
          )
END
